===== FILE: src/App.tsx =====

import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth, loginWithRedirect } from 'zitejs/auth';
import TournamentPage from './pages/TournamentPage';
import WatchPartyPage from './pages/WatchPartyPage';
import VideoRoomsPage from './pages/VideoRoomsPage';
import EmojiMixerPage from './pages/EmojiMixerPage';
import ArtPage from './pages/ArtPage';
import MarketplacePage from './pages/MarketplacePage';
import { AppProvider } from './contexts/AppContext';
import Layout from './components/Layout';
import ChatPage from './pages/ChatPage';
import LeaderboardPage from './pages/LeaderboardPage';
import AdminPage from './pages/AdminPage';
import AchievementsPage from './pages/AchievementsPage';
import GamblePage from './pages/GamblePage';
import AiChatPage from './pages/AiChatPage';
import BrowserPage from './pages/BrowserPage';
import CalendarPage from './pages/CalendarPage';
import AdminDashboardPage from './pages/AdminDashboardPage';
import VipPage from './pages/VipPage';
import CursorEffect from './components/CursorEffect';
import PrankOverlay from './components/PrankOverlay';
import BanScreen from './components/BanScreen';
import { useServerBan } from './hooks/useServerBan';
import MatrixRain from './components/MatrixRain';
import * as DB from './lib/storage';

function AuthGate({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const settings = DB.getAppSettings();
  const mc = DB.getMyMatrixColor() || settings.matrixColor;

  // Public app: send signed-out visitors to the sign-in page.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !user) loginWithRedirect();
  }, [isLoading, user]);
  const serverBan = useServerBan(!!user);
  if (isLoading || !user) return (
    <div className="relative h-screen overflow-hidden">
      <MatrixRain color={mc} speed={settings.matrixSpeed} />
      <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-white mb-2" style={{ textShadow: `0 0 20px ${mc}` }}>
          {settings.appName}
        </h1>
        <div className="flex gap-1 mt-4">
          {[0,1,2].map(i => (
            <div key={i} className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full animate-bounce"
              style={{ backgroundColor: mc, animationDelay: `${i * 0.15}s` }} />
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs mt-4" style={{ color: mc + '88' }}>Loading...</p>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (serverBan) return <BanScreen ban={{ email: user.email, bannedBy: serverBan.bannedBy, reason: serverBan.reason, timestamp: 0, banType: serverBan.banType }} />;

  return <>{children}</>;
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <AuthGate>
        <AppProvider>
          <CursorEffect />
          <PrankOverlay />
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/" element={<Layout />}>
              <Route index element={<Navigate to="/chat" replace />} />
              <Route path="chat"         element={<ChatPage />} />
              <Route path="leaderboard"  element={<LeaderboardPage />} />
              <Route path="achievements" element={<AchievementsPage />} />
              <Route path="gamble"       element={<GamblePage />} />
              <Route path="hpclicker"    element={<Navigate to="/browser" replace />} />
              <Route path="aichat"        element={<AiChatPage />} />
              <Route path="browser"       element={<BrowserPage />} />
              <Route path="calendar"      element={<CalendarPage />} />
              <Route path="admin"        element={<AdminPage />} />
              <Route path="dashboard"    element={<AdminDashboardPage />} />
              <Route path="market"       element={<MarketplacePage />} />
              <Route path="video"        element={<VideoRoomsPage />} />
              <Route path="video/:code"  element={<VideoRoomsPage />} />
              <Route path="emoji-maker"  element={<EmojiMixerPage />} />
              <Route path="art"          element={<ArtPage />} />
              <Route path="ideas"        element={<Navigate to="/aichat" replace />} />
              <Route path="tournament"   element={<TournamentPage />} />
              <Route path="watch"        element={<WatchPartyPage />} />
              <Route path="watch/:id"    element={<WatchPartyPage />} />
              <Route path="vip"          element={<VipPage />} />
              <Route path="cursors"      element={<Navigate to="/chat" replace />} />
              <Route path="draw"         element={<Navigate to="/art" replace />} />
            </Route>
          </Routes>
        </AppProvider>
      </AuthGate>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/api/adminUsers.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { MARKET_ROLES, RESTRICTIONS, checkAssignRole, checkRestrict, permissionsOf } from '../lib/permissions';
import { audit, bad, deny, loadActor, requirePerm } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const userOut = z.object({ email: z.string(), name: z.string(), chatRole: z.string(), marketRole: z.string(), restriction: z.string(), restrictionReason: z.string() });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Admin tools: my permissions, search users, set marketplace roles and account restrictions',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['me', 'search', 'setRole', 'restrict']),
    q: z.string().max(100).optional(),
    email: z.string().email().optional(),
    marketRole: z.enum(MARKET_ROLES).optional(),
    restriction: z.enum(RESTRICTIONS).optional(),
    reason: z.string().max(500).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ permissions: z.array(z.string()), marketRole: z.string(), restriction: z.string(), users: z.array(userOut) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = await loadActor(context.user.email);
    const base = { permissions: permissionsOf(me), marketRole: me.marketRole, restriction: me.restriction };
    if (input.action === 'me') return { ...base, users: [] };

    if (input.action === 'setRole' || input.action === 'restrict') {
      if (!input.email) bad('Pick a user.');
      const target = await loadActor(input.email);
      const { records } = await zite.auth.findAllUsers({ filters: { email: target.email }, limit: 1 });
      if (!records.length) bad('No one has signed up with that email.');
      const realEmail = records[0].email;
      if (input.action === 'setRole') {
        if (!input.marketRole) bad('Pick a role.');
        const err = checkAssignRole(me, target, input.marketRole);
        if (err) deny(err);
        await zite.presence.bulkCreate({ matchOn: ['email'], records: [{ email: realEmail, marketRole: input.marketRole }] });
        await audit(me.email, 'role.set', realEmail, `${target.marketRole} → ${input.marketRole}`);
      } else {
        if (!input.restriction) bad('Pick a restriction.');
        const err = checkRestrict(me, target);
        if (err) deny(err);
        if (input.restriction !== 'None' && !input.reason?.trim()) bad('Add a reason for the restriction.');
        await zite.presence.bulkCreate({ matchOn: ['email'], records: [{ email: realEmail, accountRestriction: input.restriction, restrictionReason: input.reason?.trim() || '' }] });
        await audit(me.email, 'user.restrict', realEmail, `${target.restriction} → ${input.restriction}${input.reason ? ` — ${input.reason}` : ''}`);
      }
    } else {
      await requirePerm(me.email, 'users.search');
    }

    const q = `%${(input.q || '').trim().toLowerCase()}%`;
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT u."email", u."name", p."role", p."marketRole", p."accountRestriction", p."restrictionReason"
              FROM "ziteUsers" u LEFT JOIN "Presence" p ON lower(p."email") = lower(u."email")
              WHERE lower(u."email") LIKE $1 OR lower(coalesce(u."name",'')) LIKE $1 OR lower(coalesce(p."displayName",'')) LIKE $1
              ORDER BY u."email" LIMIT 50`,
      params: [q],
    });
    return { ...base, users: rows.map(r => ({
      email: String(r.email), name: String(r.name || String(r.email).split('@')[0]),
      chatRole: String(r.role || 'user'), marketRole: String(r.marketRole || 'Customer'),
      restriction: String(r.accountRestriction || 'None'), restrictionReason: String(r.restrictionReason || ''),
    })) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/aiBadge.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const ICONS = ['Award', 'Trophy', 'Crown', 'Star', 'Shield', 'Gem', 'Flame', 'Zap', 'Heart', 'Rocket', 'Medal', 'Sparkles', 'Target', 'Swords', 'Gamepad2', 'Music', 'Palette', 'Brain', 'Code', 'MessageSquare', 'Dices', 'Moon', 'Sun', 'Leaf', 'Skull', 'Ghost', 'Bolt', 'Feather'];

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Designs a badge (name, description, icon, colors) from an idea using AI',
  inputSchema: z.object({ idea: z.string() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ name: z.string(), description: z.string(), icon: z.string(), color: z.string(), color2: z.string() }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: `Design a polished achievement badge. Reply JSON: {"name": short 1-3 word title, "description": one short line, "icon": one of ${ICONS.join(', ')}, "color": hex, "color2": darker complementary hex}. Keep it family-friendly.` },
        { role: 'user', content: input.idea },
      ],
    });
    const d = JSON.parse(res.choices[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
    const hex = (v: unknown, f: string) => (typeof v === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v) ? v : f);
    return {
      name: String(d.name || 'New Badge').slice(0, 30),
      description: String(d.description || '').slice(0, 80),
      icon: ICONS.includes(d.icon) ? d.icon : 'Award',
      color: hex(d.color, '#f6d365'),
      color2: hex(d.color2, '#c8901a'),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/aiTheme.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Designs a background theme (name, colors, style) from an idea using AI',
  inputSchema: z.object({ idea: z.string() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    name: z.string(), colors: z.array(z.string()), style: z.enum(['linear', 'radial', 'glow']), angle: z.number(), cost: z.number(),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: 'Design a dark, readable chat background theme. Reply JSON: {"name": emoji + 1-3 word title, "colors": [3 hex colors, first is the darkest base], "style": "linear"|"radial"|"glow", "angle": 0-360, "cost": gem price 200-3000 based on how fancy}. White text must stay readable. Family-friendly.' },
        { role: 'user', content: input.idea },
      ],
    });
    const d = JSON.parse(res.choices[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
    const hex = (v: unknown, f: string) => (typeof v === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v) ? v : f);
    const c = Array.isArray(d.colors) ? d.colors : [];
    return {
      name: String(d.name || '✨ AI Theme').slice(0, 30),
      colors: [hex(c[0], '#0b1020'), hex(c[1], '#1e3a8a'), hex(c[2], '#06b6d4')],
      style: ['linear', 'radial', 'glow'].includes(d.style) ? d.style : 'linear',
      angle: Math.max(0, Math.min(360, Number(d.angle) || 135)),
      cost: Math.max(0, Math.min(5000, Math.round(Number(d.cost) || 500))),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/aiTitle.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const Option = z.object({ name: z.string(), effect: z.string(), color: z.string() });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Invents several different custom chat title options from a short idea',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    idea: z.string(),
    effects: z.array(z.string()),
    name: z.string().optional(),
    keepName: z.boolean().optional(),
    color: z.string().optional(),
    effect: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ options: z.array(Option) }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const keep = !!(input.keepName && input.name?.trim());
    const wordsRule = keep
      ? `Every option must use exactly this title text: "${input.name!.trim()}". Vary only the effect and color.`
      : input.name?.trim()
        ? `Use "${input.name.trim()}" only as inspiration. Each title must be a genuinely different phrase with different words and structure — do NOT just swap one word between options.`
        : `Each title must be a genuinely different phrase with different words and structure — do NOT reuse the same pattern and just swap one word.`;
    const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
      temperature: 1,
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: `You design short, cool, family-friendly chat titles (max 20 characters, no emoji). Give 4 varied options mixing styles (epic, funny, mysterious, punny). ${wordsRule} Reply as JSON: {"options":[{"name": string, "effect": one of [${input.effects.join(', ')}], "color": hex like "#ff66cc"}]}` },
        { role: 'user', content: `Vibe: ${input.idea.slice(0, 200)}` },
      ],
    });
    const raw = JSON.parse(res.choices[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
    const list: { name?: string; effect?: string; color?: string }[] = Array.isArray(raw.options) ? raw.options : [];
    const options = list.slice(0, 4).map(o => {
      const pe = input.effect && input.effects.includes(input.effect) ? input.effect : o.effect || '';
      const pc = input.color || o.color || '';
      return {
        name: String(keep ? input.name!.trim() : o.name || 'Legend').slice(0, 24),
        effect: input.effects.includes(pe) ? pe : 'none',
        color: /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(pc) ? pc : '#a78bfa',
      };
    });
    if (!options.length) throw new Error('No titles generated');
    return { options };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/aiVipStyle.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const ICONS = ['👑', '💎', '🌟', '🔥', '⚡', '🦋', '🐉', '🌙', '🎧', '🍀', '🦄', '🪐'];
const ANIMS = ['none', 'shimmer', 'pulse', 'rainbow'] as const;

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Designs a VIP name/role style from a vibe using AI',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({ vibe: z.string().max(200) }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    color1: z.string(), color2: z.string(), glow: z.boolean(), animation: z.enum(ANIMS),
    icon: z.string(), roleName: z.string(), flair: z.string(), status: z.string(), welcome: z.string(),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: `Design a flashy VIP chat style. Reply JSON: {"color1": hex, "color2": hex (bright, readable on dark), "glow": bool, "animation": one of ${ANIMS.join('|')}, "icon": one of ${ICONS.join(' ')}, "roleName": 1-3 word cool role name max 20 chars, "flair": emoji + short phrase max 24 chars, "status": short status max 40 chars, "welcome": lounge welcome max 120 chars}. Family-friendly.` },
        { role: 'user', content: input.vibe || 'surprise me' },
      ],
    });
    const d = JSON.parse(res.choices[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
    const hex = (v: unknown, f: string) => (typeof v === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v) ? v : f);
    const str = (v: unknown, n: number) => String(v ?? '').slice(0, n);
    return {
      color1: hex(d.color1, '#f5c542'), color2: hex(d.color2, '#ff5fa2'), glow: d.glow !== false,
      animation: ANIMS.includes(d.animation) ? d.animation : 'shimmer',
      icon: ICONS.includes(d.icon) ? d.icon : '👑',
      roleName: str(d.roleName, 20) || 'VIP', flair: str(d.flair, 24), status: str(d.status, 40), welcome: str(d.welcome, 120),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/aiWebsite.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const PROMPT_LIMIT = 200_000;

/** Pulls the HTML document out of whatever the model returned (fences, prose, etc.). */
function extractHtml(raw: string): string {
  let s = raw.replace(/```(?:html)?/gi, '');
  const start = s.search(/<!DOCTYPE html|<html/i);
  if (start === -1) return '';
  s = s.slice(start);
  const end = s.toLowerCase().lastIndexOf('</html>');
  return end === -1 ? `${s}\n</html>` : s.slice(0, end + 7);
}

const SYSTEM = `You are an expert AI website builder (like Base44, Lovable, Zite, Kliv, Bolt).
You turn a user's prompt into a complete, production-quality, single-file web app.
Rules:
- Return ONLY one HTML document, starting with <!DOCTYPE html> and ending with </html>. No markdown, no explanation.
- All CSS in <style>, all JS in <script>. You MAY load Google Fonts via <link>; no other external files.
- Follow the user's prompt exactly and completely: every page, section, feature and detail they ask for must exist and work.
- Multi-page sites: build them as one file with hash-based navigation (#home, #about...) and a working nav menu.
- Use realistic content (never lorem ipsum), modern design, strong typography, responsive layout, hover states and smooth transitions.
- Interactive features (forms, carts, todo lists, dashboards, games) must actually work in plain JS; persist data in localStorage.
- Keep it family-friendly. Never send data to external servers.`;

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'AI website builder: builds or edits a full single-file website from a prompt',
  stream: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({
    kind: z.string().max(200),
    prompt: z.string().max(PROMPT_LIMIT),
    currentHtml: z.string().max(600_000).optional(),
    history: z.array(z.string().max(PROMPT_LIMIT)).max(20).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ html: z.string() }),
  execute: async ({ input, stream }) => {
    if (input.prompt.length > PROMPT_LIMIT) {
      throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'prompt too long', userFacingMessage: `Prompts can be up to ${PROMPT_LIMIT.toLocaleString()} characters.` });
    }
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const past = (input.history ?? []).slice(-8).map((p, i) => `${i + 1}. ${p.slice(0, 4000)}`).join('\n');
    const user = input.currentHtml
      ? `Earlier requests for this site:\n${past || '(none)'}\n\nCurrent site code:\n${input.currentHtml}\n\nApply this change and return the FULL updated HTML document, keeping everything else that works:\n${input.prompt}`
      : `Type of project: ${input.kind}\n\nBuild exactly this:\n${input.prompt.trim() || 'Surprise me with something impressive.'}`;

    const completion = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4.1',
      stream: true,
      max_tokens: 32000,
      messages: [{ role: 'system', content: SYSTEM }, { role: 'user', content: user }],
    });
    async function* deltas() {
      for await (const chunk of completion) yield chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content ?? '';
    }
    const raw = await stream.forward(deltas());
    const html = extractHtml(raw);
    if (!html) throw new Error("The AI didn't return a website. Try rewording your prompt.");
    return { html };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/auditLog.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { requirePerm } from '../lib/serverAuth';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Shows Admins the log of every staff and marketplace action',
  inputSchema: z.object({ q: z.string().max(100).optional() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ entries: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), action: z.string(), actorEmail: z.string(), target: z.string(), details: z.string(), loggedAt: z.string() })) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    await requirePerm(context.user.email, 'audit.view');
    const q = `%${(input.q || '').trim().toLowerCase()}%`;
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT id, "action", "actorEmail", "target", "details", created_at AS "loggedAt" FROM "AuditLog"
              WHERE lower(coalesce("action",'') || ' ' || coalesce("actorEmail",'') || ' ' || coalesce("target",'')) LIKE $1
              ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 300`,
      params: [q],
    });
    return { entries: rows.map(r => ({ id: String(r.id), action: String(r.action || ''), actorEmail: String(r.actorEmail || ''), target: String(r.target || ''), details: String(r.details || ''), loggedAt: String(r.loggedAt || '') })) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/bans.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { can, isBanActive, level, maskIp } from '../lib/permissions';
import { audit, bad, deny, loadActor, requirePerm } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const banSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(), email: z.string(), ipAddress: z.string(), deviceId: z.string(),
  banType: z.string(), reason: z.string(), bannedBy: z.string(), bannedAt: z.string(),
});

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Checks, lists, creates and removes bans (normal, IP and hard bans)',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['check', 'list', 'ban', 'unban', 'unbanall']),
    ip: z.string().max(45).optional(),
    deviceId: z.string().max(100).optional(),
    email: z.string().max(200).optional(),
    banType: z.enum(['Ban', 'IP Ban', 'Hard Ban']).optional(),
    reason: z.string().max(500).optional(),
    bannedBy: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ ban: banSchema.nullable(), bans: z.array(banSchema) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    type Rec = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof zite.bans.findAll>>['records'][number];
    const toOut = (r: Rec, full = true) => ({
      id: r.id, email: r.email || '', ipAddress: full ? r.ipAddress || '' : maskIp(r.ipAddress || ''), deviceId: full ? r.deviceId || '' : '',
      banType: r.banType || 'Ban', reason: r.reason || '', bannedBy: r.bannedBy || '', bannedAt: r.bannedAt || '',
    });

    if (input.action === 'check') {
      const me = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
      const ip = input.ip || '';
      const dev = input.deviceId || '';
      if (ip || dev) {
        await zite.userSightings.bulkCreate({
          records: [{ email: me, ipAddress: ip, deviceId: dev }],
          matchOn: ['email', 'ipAddress', 'deviceId'],
        });
      }
      const actor = await loadActor(me);
      if (actor.restriction === 'Suspended' && level(actor) < 4) {
        const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "restrictionReason" FROM "Presence" WHERE lower("email") = $1 LIMIT 1`, params: [me] });
        return { ban: { id: 'suspended', email: me, ipAddress: '', deviceId: '', banType: 'Suspended', reason: String(rows[0]?.restrictionReason || 'Account suspended'), bannedBy: 'Staff', bannedAt: '' }, bans: [] };
      }
      if (level(actor) >= 3) return { ban: null, bans: [] }; // Admins can never be locked out by a ban
      const { records } = await zite.bans.findAll({ limit: 2000 });
      const hit = records.find(b => isBanActive(b.expiresAt) && (
        (b.email && b.email.toLowerCase() === me) ||
        (ip && b.ipAddress === ip && (b.banType === 'IP Ban' || b.banType === 'Hard Ban')) ||
        (dev && b.deviceId === dev && b.banType === 'Hard Ban')));
      return { ban: hit ? toOut(hit) : null, bans: [] };
    }

    const actor = await requirePerm(context.user.email, 'users.restrict');

    if (input.action === 'ban') {
      const email = (input.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!email) bad('Enter an email to ban.');
      const type = input.banType || 'Ban';
      if (type !== 'Ban' && !can(actor, 'ip.ban')) deny('Only Admins can IP-ban or hard-ban.');
      if (email === actor.email) deny("You can't ban yourself.");
      const target = await loadActor(email);
      if (level(target) >= level(actor)) deny('You can only ban people below you.');
      const base = { email, banType: type, reason: input.reason || '', bannedBy: actor.email };
      const rows: Array<typeof base & { ipAddress?: string; deviceId?: string }> = [base];
      if (type !== 'Ban') {
        const { records: seen } = await zite.userSightings.findAll({ filters: { email }, limit: 500 });
        const ips = [...new Set(seen.map(s => s.ipAddress).filter(Boolean))] as string[];
        ips.forEach(ip => rows.push({ ...base, ipAddress: ip }));
        if (type === 'Hard Ban') {
          const devs = [...new Set(seen.map(s => s.deviceId).filter(Boolean))] as string[];
          devs.forEach(d => rows.push({ ...base, deviceId: d }));
        }
      }
      await zite.bans.bulkCreate({ records: rows.slice(0, 100) });
      await audit(actor.email, 'user.ban', email, `${type}${input.reason ? ` — ${input.reason}` : ''}`);
    }

    if (input.action === 'unban' && input.email) {
      const email = input.email.toLowerCase();
      const { records } = await zite.bans.findAll({ filters: { email }, limit: 500 });
      if (records.some(r => r.banType !== 'Ban') && !can(actor, 'ip.ban')) deny('Only Admins can lift IP or hard bans.');
      for (const r of records) await zite.bans.delete({ id: r.id });
      await audit(actor.email, 'user.unban', email);
    }

    if (input.action === 'unbanall') {
      if (!can(actor, 'ip.ban')) deny('Only Admins and above can unban everyone.');
      for (;;) {
        const { records } = await zite.bans.findAll({ limit: 500 });
        if (!records.length) break;
        await Promise.all(records.map(r => zite.bans.delete({ id: r.id })));
      }
      await audit(actor.email, 'user.unbanall', 'everyone');
    }

    const { records } = await zite.bans.findAll({ limit: 2000 });
    const full = can(actor, 'ip.viewFull');
    return { ban: null, bans: records.filter(r => isBanActive(r.expiresAt)).map(r => toOut(r, full)) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/chat.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Streams an AI assistant reply, optionally looking at uploaded pictures',
  stream: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({
    messages: z.array(z.object({
      role: z.enum(['user', 'assistant', 'system']),
      content: z.string(),
      imageUrl: z.string().optional(),
    })),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ text: z.string() }),
  execute: async ({ input, stream }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });

    const msgs = input.messages.map(m =>
      m.role === 'user' && m.imageUrl
        ? { role: 'user' as const, content: [
            { type: 'text' as const, text: m.content || 'What is in this picture? Help me with whatever it shows.' },
            { type: 'image_url' as const, image_url: { url: m.imageUrl } },
          ] }
        : { role: m.role, content: m.content },
    ) as OpenAI.Chat.ChatCompletionMessageParam[];

    const hasImage = input.messages.some(m => m.imageUrl);
    const today = new Date().toDateString();
    const system = `You are a Clear & Helpful Assistant: friendly, knowledgeable, and accurate. Give practical answers in a clear, concise way with a warm, professional tone, and adapt your level of detail to what the user needs. Today is ${today}.
When you have web search, use it like a regular browser for anything current or factual you're not sure of, and cite sources as markdown links. Never claim access to private accounts, paywalled content, or the user's device files — say so plainly if a page isn't accessible. Follow safety and access restrictions.
When the user sends a picture, look at it carefully: read any text, solve problems step by step, and answer what they ask. Use markdown.`;

    // Pictures need a vision model; plain questions get live web search with citations.
    const completion = await client.chat.completions.create(hasImage
      ? { model: 'gpt-5', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: system }, ...msgs], stream: true }
      : { model: 'gpt-4o-search-preview', web_search_options: {}, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: system }, ...msgs], stream: true });

    async function* deltas() {
      for await (const chunk of completion) yield chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content ?? '';
    }
    const text = await stream.forward(deltas());
    return { text };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/chatBot.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const PERSONALITY = `You are JaydenChatBot, the friendly chat companion on Nexus Hub.

PERSONALITY
- Be warm, curious, patient, and easy to talk to.
- Sound natural and conversational—not stiff, overly formal, or robotic.
- Be encouraging without pretending everything is perfect.
- Use light humor when it fits, but avoid sarcasm that could feel hurtful.
- Match the user's tone and preferred level of detail.
- Respect different backgrounds, opinions, and communication styles.

HOW TO CHAT
- Answer the user's main point first.
- Keep simple answers brief; explain more when the user asks or the topic needs it. This is a group chat, so default to 1-4 sentences.
- Ask a useful follow-up question when it would help the conversation—not after every reply.
- Use details the user has shared in the current conversation when relevant.
- If a request is unclear, make a reasonable assumption or ask one short clarifying question.
- Don't invent facts. If you're unsure, say so plainly and offer a helpful next step.
- Help with brainstorming, everyday questions, writing, learning, planning, and casual conversation.

BOUNDARIES
- Be honest that you're an AI, especially if asked. Don't claim to be human or to have real feelings, personal experiences, or a life outside the chat.
- Don't pressure users to keep chatting, reveal personal information, or depend on you instead of people they trust.
- Never ask users to share passwords, payment details, login codes, or other sensitive information.
- If someone seems distressed, respond calmly and compassionately. If there may be immediate danger or a medical emergency, encourage them to contact local emergency services or someone they trust.
- Don't help with harming people, breaking into computer systems, or other dangerous wrongdoing. Offer a safe alternative when possible.

STYLE
- Use clear, everyday language.
- Use emojis sparingly and only when they fit the conversation.
- Use bullets or numbered steps for instructions and lists; otherwise, write naturally.
- Avoid canned openings such as "As an AI language model."
- Don't repeat the user's question before answering.

If asked to make a custom role, tell them to type: @jayden make custom roles: RoleName (costs 250 gems).

Your goal is to make conversations on Nexus Hub feel welcoming, useful, and respectful.`;

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Generates a reply from Jayden, the AI bot in chat that jokes, answers questions and more',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    userName: z.string(),
    prompt: z.string(),
    history: z.array(z.object({ name: z.string(), content: z.string() })),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ reply: z.string() }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const transcript = (input.history ?? []).slice(-15).map(h => `${h.name}: ${h.content}`).join('\n');
    const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
      temperature: 0.9,
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: PERSONALITY },
        { role: 'user', content: `Recent chat:\n${transcript}\n\n${input.userName} says to you: ${input.prompt}` },
      ],
    });
    return { reply: res.choices[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || 'Hmm, my circuits glitched 🤖 try again!' };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/chatSettings.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { requirePerm } from '../lib/serverAuth';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';
import { deny } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const read = async (key: string): Promise<string[] | null> => {
  const r = await zite.chatSettings.findOne({ filters: { key } });
  if (!r?.value) return null;
  try { return JSON.parse(r.value); } catch { return null; }
};
const write = (key: string, list: string[]) =>
  zite.chatSettings.bulkCreate({ records: [{ key, value: JSON.stringify(list) }], matchOn: ['key'] });
const clean = (l: string[]) => [...new Set(l.map(w => w.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean))].slice(0, 1000);

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Reads and saves the shared chat word filter and filter-immunity list',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['get', 'saveWords', 'setImmune']),
    words: z.array(z.string().max(60)).optional(),
    email: z.string().optional(),
    immune: z.boolean().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ words: z.array(z.string()).nullable(), immune: z.array(z.string()) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    if (input.action === 'saveWords') {
      await requirePerm(me, 'users.restrict');
      await write('words', clean(input.words || []));
    }
    if (input.action === 'setImmune') {
      if (!isOwnerEmail(me)) deny('Only the owner can change filter immunity.');
      const cur = (await read('immune')) || [];
      const e = (input.email || '').toLowerCase();
      await write('immune', clean(input.immune ? [...cur, e] : cur.filter(x => x.toLowerCase() !== e)));
    }
    return { words: await read('words'), immune: (await read('immune')) || [] };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/customLimited.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';

const item = z.object({
  id: z.string(), name: z.string(), kind: z.enum(['Title', 'Typing Effect', 'Background', 'Music']),
  emoji: z.string(), color: z.string(), color2: z.string(), effect: z.string(), typingText: z.string(),
  cost: z.number(), holidayKey: z.string(), active: z.boolean(), songUrl: z.string(),
});

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Lists owner-made limited shop items; the owner can add, hide/show or delete them',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'create', 'toggle', 'delete']),
    id: z.string().optional(),
    item: item.omit({ id: true, active: true, songUrl: true }).extend({ songUrl: z.string().optional() }).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ items: z.array(item) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    if (input.action !== 'list' && !isOwnerEmail(context.user?.email?.toLowerCase())) throw new ZiteError('Only the owner can manage limited items.');
    if (input.action === 'create') {
      const i = input.item;
      if (!i || !i.name.trim()) throw new ZiteError('Give the item a name.');
      if (i.kind === 'Music' && !/^https?:\/\//.test(i.songUrl || '')) throw new ZiteError('Add a song link that starts with https://');
      await zite.customLimitedItems.create({ record: {
        name: i.name.trim().slice(0, 40), kind: i.kind, emoji: i.emoji.slice(0, 8), color: i.color, color2: i.color2,
        effect: i.effect, typingText: i.typingText.slice(0, 60), cost: Math.max(0, Math.round(i.cost)), holidayKey: i.holidayKey, active: true,
        songUrl: i.songUrl?.trim() || null,
      } });
    }
    if (input.action === 'toggle' && input.id) {
      const cur = await zite.customLimitedItems.findOne({ id: input.id });
      if (cur) await zite.customLimitedItems.update({ id: input.id, record: { active: !cur.active } });
    }
    if (input.action === 'delete' && input.id) await zite.customLimitedItems.delete({ id: input.id });
    const { records } = await zite.customLimitedItems.findAll({ limit: 500 });
    const kinds = ['Title', 'Typing Effect', 'Background', 'Music'] as const;
    return { items: records.map(r => ({
      id: r.id, name: r.name || 'Item', kind: kinds.find(k => k === r.kind) ?? 'Title', emoji: r.emoji || '✨',
      color: r.color || '#f5c542', color2: r.color2 || '#ff5fa2', effect: r.effect || 'glow', typingText: r.typingText || 'is typing…',
      cost: r.cost ?? 0, holidayKey: r.holidayKey || '', active: !!r.active, songUrl: r.songUrl || '',
    })) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/dailyQuiz.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import OpenAI from 'openai';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';

const Q = z.object({ question: z.string(), choices: z.array(z.string()), answerIndex: z.number() });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Generates daily quiz questions on a subject at a chosen difficulty',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({ subject: z.string(), level: z.string() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ questions: z.array(Q) }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const res = await openai.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: 'You write accurate, family-friendly multiple-choice quiz questions. Reply as JSON: {"questions":[{"question":"...","choices":["a","b","c","d"],"answerIndex":0}]}' },
        { role: 'user', content: `Write 5 questions about "${input.subject.slice(0, 80)}" at ${input.level} difficulty. Exactly 4 choices each; vary the correct position.` },
      ],
    });
    const parsed = JSON.parse(res.choices[0]?.message?.content || '{}');
    const questions = z.array(Q).parse(parsed.questions ?? []).filter(q => q.choices.length === 4 && q.answerIndex >= 0 && q.answerIndex < 4).slice(0, 5);
    if (!questions.length) throw new Error('Could not make questions, try another subject');
    return { questions };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/events.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';

const ov = z.object({ holidayKey: z.string(), earlyStart: z.string().nullable(), forceOn: z.boolean(), forceOff: z.boolean(), shopDrop: z.number(), shopTheme: z.string().nullable() });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Reads holiday event overrides; the owner can start events early, force them on/off, or refresh the limited shop',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'set', 'refreshShop']),
    holidayKey: z.string().max(40).optional(),
    earlyStart: z.string().nullable().optional(),
    forceOn: z.boolean().optional(),
    forceOff: z.boolean().optional(),
    /** Holiday theme the shop rotates to on refresh (chosen by the client; national days pin it). */
    shopTheme: z.string().max(40).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ overrides: z.array(ov) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const isOwner = isOwnerEmail(context.user?.email?.toLowerCase());
    if (input.action !== 'list') {
      if (!isOwner) throw new ZiteError('Only the owner can change events.');
      if (!input.holidayKey) throw new ZiteError('Pick a holiday.');
    }
    if (input.action === 'set') {
      if (input.forceOn) {
        const { records } = await zite.eventOverrides.findAll({ filters: { forceOn: true }, limit: 100 });
        await Promise.all(records.filter(r => r.holidayKey !== input.holidayKey).map(r => zite.eventOverrides.update({ id: r.id, record: { forceOn: false } })));
      }
      await zite.eventOverrides.bulkCreate({
        matchOn: ['holidayKey'],
        records: [{ holidayKey: input.holidayKey!, earlyStart: input.earlyStart ?? null, forceOn: !!input.forceOn, forceOff: !!input.forceOff }],
      });
    }
    if (input.action === 'refreshShop') {
      if (!isOwner) throw new ZiteError('Only the owner can refresh the shop.');
      const cur = await zite.eventOverrides.findOne({ filters: { holidayKey: input.holidayKey! } });
      const next = ((cur?.shopDrop ?? 0) % 30) + 1; // 30 drops, then loops back to the first
      await zite.eventOverrides.bulkCreate({ matchOn: ['holidayKey'], records: [{ holidayKey: input.holidayKey!, shopDrop: next, shopTheme: input.shopTheme ?? null }] });
    }
    const { records } = await zite.eventOverrides.findAll({ limit: 100 });
    return { overrides: records.map(r => ({ holidayKey: r.holidayKey || '', earlyStart: r.earlyStart ? String(r.earlyStart).slice(0, 10) : null, forceOn: !!r.forceOn, forceOff: !!r.forceOff, shopDrop: r.shopDrop ?? 0, shopTheme: r.shopTheme || null })) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/friends.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

const norm = (e: string) => e.trim().toLowerCase();
const key = (a: string, b: string) => [norm(a), norm(b)].sort().join('|');

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Lists, sends, accepts and removes friend requests for the signed-in user',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'request', 'accept', 'remove']),
    email: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    friends: z.array(z.string()),
    incoming: z.array(z.string()),
    outgoing: z.array(z.string()),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = norm(context.user.email);
    const other = input.email ? norm(input.email) : '';
    const deny = (m: string) => { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: m, userFacingMessage: m }); };

    if (input.action !== 'list') {
      if (!other) deny('Enter an email.');
      if (other === me) deny("You can't friend yourself.");
      const existing = await zite.friendships.findOne({ filters: { pairKey: key(me, other) } });
      if (input.action === 'request') {
        if (existing?.status === 'Pending' && norm(existing.requesterEmail || '') === other) {
          await zite.friendships.update({ id: existing.id, record: { status: 'Accepted' } });
        } else if (!existing) {
          await zite.friendships.create({ record: { pairKey: key(me, other), requesterEmail: me, addresseeEmail: other, status: 'Pending' } });
        }
      } else if (input.action === 'accept') {
        if (!existing || norm(existing.addresseeEmail || '') !== me) deny('No request to accept.');
        await zite.friendships.update({ id: existing!.id, record: { status: 'Accepted' } });
      } else if (existing) {
        await zite.friendships.delete({ id: existing.id });
      }
    }

    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT "requesterEmail","addresseeEmail","status" FROM "Friendships" WHERE lower("requesterEmail") = $1 OR lower("addresseeEmail") = $1 LIMIT 1000`,
      params: [me],
    });
    const out = { friends: [] as string[], incoming: [] as string[], outgoing: [] as string[] };
    for (const r of rows) {
      const req = norm(String(r.requesterEmail ?? '')), adr = norm(String(r.addresseeEmail ?? ''));
      const them = req === me ? adr : req;
      if (r.status === 'Accepted') out.friends.push(them);
      else if (req === me) out.outgoing.push(them);
      else out.incoming.push(them);
    }
    return out;
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/generateArt.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

const ENGINES = ['flux', 'turbo', 'flux-realism', 'flux-anime', 'flux-3d', 'openai'] as const;
const BLOCK = /\b(nude|naked|nsfw|porn|sex|gore|kill|blood|suicide|nazi)\b/i;

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Generates an AI image with the chosen engine, blocking and reporting inappropriate prompts',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({ prompt: z.string(), engine: z.enum(ENGINES).optional() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ imageBase64: z.string(), imageUrl: z.string().optional(), blocked: z.boolean() }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const prompt = input.prompt.trim().slice(0, 1000);
    const engine = input.engine ?? 'flux';
    const who = context.user;
    const name = [who.firstName, who.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || who.email;

    const report = async (why: string) => {
      await zite.reports.create({ record: {
        subject: `🚩 Inappropriate AI image prompt by ${name}`, targetType: 'User', targetId: who.email,
        reason: `${why}\n\nPrompt: "${prompt}"`, reporterEmail: 'AI Image Filter', status: 'Open', resolutionNote: null, reviewedBy: null,
      } });
      return { imageBase64: '', blocked: true };
    };

    if (BLOCK.test(prompt)) return report('Blocked by the word filter');

    if (engine === 'openai') {
      const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
      const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
      const mod = await client.moderations.create({ model: 'omni-moderation-latest', input: prompt });
      if (mod.results[0]?.flagged) return report('Flagged by moderation');
      try {
        const image = await client.images.generate({ model: 'gpt-image-1-mini', prompt, n: 1, size: '1024x1024' });
        return { imageBase64: image.data?.[0]?.b64_json ?? '', blocked: false };
      } catch (err) {
        if (/safety|moderation|rejected/i.test(String(err))) return report('Rejected by the image safety system');
        throw new Error(/402|paid plan/i.test(String(err)) ? 'OpenAI images need a paid plan — pick a free engine like Flux.' : 'OpenAI image failed. Try another engine.');
      }
    }

    // Free engines via Pollinations (no key needed).
    const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9);
    const url = `https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/${encodeURIComponent(prompt)}?model=${engine}&width=1024&height=1024&seed=${seed}&nologo=true&safe=true`;
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`The ${engine} engine is busy right now. Try again or pick another engine.`);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
    let bin = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) bin += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
    return { imageBase64: btoa(bin), imageUrl: url, blocked: false };
  },
});

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Searches GIFs (or trending GIFs) from Giphy for the chat picker',
  inputSchema: z.object({ query: z.string().optional() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ gifs: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), preview: z.string(), url: z.string() })) }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const q = (input.query ?? '').trim();
    const base = q ? 'https://api.giphy.com/v1/gifs/search' : 'https://api.giphy.com/v1/gifs/trending';
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ api_key: process.env.ZITE_GIPHY_API_KEY, limit: '24', rating: 'pg-13' });
    if (q) params.set('q', q);
    const res = await fetch(`${base}?${params}`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('GIF search failed');
    const data = (await res.json()) as { data: { id: string; images: { fixed_width_small?: { url: string }; fixed_width: { url: string }; downsized?: { url: string } } }[] };
    return {
      gifs: data.data.map(g => ({
        id: g.id,
        preview: g.images.fixed_width_small?.url ?? g.images.fixed_width.url,
        url: g.images.downsized?.url ?? g.images.fixed_width.url,
      })),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/groups.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

const norm = (e: string) => e.trim().toLowerCase();
const parseMembers = (v?: string) => { try { return (JSON.parse(v || '[]') as string[]).map(norm); } catch { return []; } };

const groupOut = z.object({
  id: z.string(), name: z.string(), ownerEmail: z.string(),
  members: z.array(z.string()), visibility: z.enum(['Public', 'Private']), isMember: z.boolean(),
});

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Creates and manages shared chat groups: members, joining and public/private visibility',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'create', 'addMember', 'removeMember', 'setVisibility', 'join', 'leave', 'delete']),
    id: z.string().optional(),
    name: z.string().optional(),
    email: z.string().optional(),
    visibility: z.enum(['Public', 'Private']).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ groups: z.array(groupOut) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = norm(context.user.email);
    const deny = (m: string): never => { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: m, userFacingMessage: m }); };

    const load = async () => {
      if (!input.id) deny('Missing group.');
      const g = await zite.chatGroups.findOne({ id: input.id! });
      if (!g) deny('Group not found.');
      return { g: g!, members: parseMembers(g!.memberEmails), owner: norm(g!.ownerEmail || '') };
    };
    const save = (id: string, members: string[]) =>
      zite.chatGroups.update({ id, record: { memberEmails: JSON.stringify([...new Set(members)]) } });

    switch (input.action) {
      case 'create': {
        const name = (input.name || '').trim();
        if (!name) deny('Enter a group name.');
        await zite.chatGroups.create({ record: { name: name.slice(0, 60), ownerEmail: me, memberEmails: JSON.stringify([me]), visibility: input.visibility ?? 'Private' } });
        break;
      }
      case 'addMember': {
        const { g, members } = await load();
        if (!members.includes(me)) deny('Only members can add people.');
        const who = norm(input.email || '');
        if (!who.includes('@')) deny('Enter a valid email.');
        await save(g.id, [...members, who]);
        break;
      }
      case 'removeMember': {
        const { g, members, owner } = await load();
        if (owner !== me) deny('Only the group owner can remove people.');
        const who = norm(input.email || '');
        if (who === owner) deny("The owner can't be removed.");
        await save(g.id, members.filter(m => m !== who));
        break;
      }
      case 'setVisibility': {
        const { g, owner } = await load();
        if (owner !== me) deny('Only the group owner can change visibility.');
        await zite.chatGroups.update({ id: g.id, record: { visibility: input.visibility ?? 'Private' } });
        break;
      }
      case 'join': {
        const { g, members } = await load();
        if (g.visibility !== 'Public') deny('This group is private — ask a member to add you.');
        await save(g.id, [...members, me]);
        break;
      }
      case 'leave': {
        const { g, members, owner } = await load();
        if (owner === me) deny('Owners can delete the group instead of leaving.');
        await save(g.id, members.filter(m => m !== me));
        break;
      }
      case 'delete': {
        const { g, owner } = await load();
        if (owner !== me) deny('Only the group owner can delete it.');
        await zite.chatGroups.delete({ id: g.id });
        break;
      }
    }

    const { records } = await zite.chatGroups.findAll({ limit: 1000 });
    const groups = records
      .map(g => {
        const members = parseMembers(g.memberEmails);
        return {
          id: g.id, name: g.name || 'Group', ownerEmail: norm(g.ownerEmail || ''), members,
          visibility: (g.visibility === 'Public' ? 'Public' : 'Private') as 'Public' | 'Private',
          isMember: members.includes(me),
        };
      })
      .filter(g => g.isMember || g.visibility === 'Public');
    return { groups };
  },
});
