===== FILE: src/api/ipBans.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { isOwnerEmail, can, checkIpBan, isBanActive, level, maskIp } from '../lib/permissions';
import { audit, bad, deny, requirePerm } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const DURATIONS = ['1h', '24h', '7d', '30d', 'permanent'] as const;
const HOURS: Record<typeof DURATIONS[number], number | null> = { '1h': 1, '24h': 24, '7d': 168, '30d': 720, permanent: null };

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Lets staff review recent IP addresses and lets Admins ban or unban an IP for a set time',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'ban', 'unban']),
    ip: z.string().trim().max(45).optional(),
    duration: z.enum(DURATIONS).optional(),
    reason: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
    banId: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    canBan: z.boolean(),
    fullIps: z.boolean(),
    bans: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), ip: z.string(), reason: z.string(), bannedBy: z.string(), bannedAt: z.string(), expiresAt: z.string(), active: z.boolean() })),
    sightings: z.array(z.object({ ip: z.string(), emails: z.array(z.string()), lastSeen: z.string(), banned: z.boolean(), staff: z.boolean() })),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = await requirePerm(context.user.email, 'ip.view');

    // Which IPs belong to staff (lockout safeguard) and to me
    const { rows: seen } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT s."ipAddress", lower(s."email") AS email, s.updated_at AS "lastSeen", p."role", p."marketRole"
              FROM "UserSightings" s LEFT JOIN "Presence" p ON lower(p."email") = lower(s."email")
              WHERE coalesce(s."ipAddress",'') <> '' ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT 20000`,
    });
    const staffIps = new Set<string>();
    const myIps = new Set<string>();
    for (const r of seen) {
      const email = String(r.email);
      const lvl = level({ email, chatRole: isOwnerEmail(email) ? 'owner' : String(r.role || 'user'), marketRole: String(r.marketRole || ''), restriction: 'None' });
      if (lvl >= 2) staffIps.add(String(r.ipAddress));
      if (email === me.email) myIps.add(String(r.ipAddress));
    }

    if (input.action === 'ban') {
      const ip = input.ip || '';
      const err = checkIpBan(me, ip, [...myIps], [...staffIps]);
      if (err) deny(err);
      if (!input.duration) bad('Pick how long the ban lasts.');
      if (!input.reason) bad('Add a reason for the ban.');
      const hours = HOURS[input.duration];
      const expiresAt = hours === null ? null : new Date(Date.now() + hours * 3600_000).toISOString();
      await zite.bans.create({ record: { email: '', ipAddress: ip, banType: 'IP Ban', reason: input.reason, bannedBy: me.email, expiresAt } });
      await audit(me.email, 'ip.ban', ip, `${input.duration} — ${input.reason}`);
    }

    if (input.action === 'unban') {
      if (!can(me, 'ip.ban')) deny('Only Admins can remove IP bans.');
      if (!input.banId) bad('Pick a ban to remove.');
      const ban = await zite.bans.findOne({ id: input.banId });
      if (!ban || ban.banType !== 'IP Ban') bad('That IP ban no longer exists.');
      await zite.bans.delete({ id: input.banId });
      await audit(me.email, 'ip.unban', ban.ipAddress || '', ban.reason || '');
    }

    const full = can(me, 'ip.viewFull');
    const show = (ip: string) => (full ? ip : maskIp(ip));
    const { records: banRecs } = await zite.bans.findAll({ filters: { banType: 'IP Ban' }, limit: 500 });
    const activeIps = new Set(banRecs.filter(b => isBanActive(b.expiresAt)).map(b => b.ipAddress || ''));

    const byIp = new Map<string, { emails: Set<string>; lastSeen: string }>();
    for (const r of seen) {
      const ip = String(r.ipAddress);
      const e = byIp.get(ip) ?? { emails: new Set<string>(), lastSeen: String(r.lastSeen || '') };
      e.emails.add(String(r.email));
      byIp.set(ip, e);
    }

    return {
      canBan: can(me, 'ip.ban'),
      fullIps: full,
      bans: banRecs.map(b => ({
        id: b.id, ip: show(b.ipAddress || ''), reason: b.reason || '', bannedBy: b.bannedBy || '',
        bannedAt: b.bannedAt || '', expiresAt: b.expiresAt || '', active: isBanActive(b.expiresAt),
      })).sort((a, b) => b.bannedAt.localeCompare(a.bannedAt)),
      sightings: [...byIp.entries()].map(([ip, v]) => ({
        ip: show(ip), emails: [...v.emails], lastSeen: v.lastSeen, banned: activeIps.has(ip), staff: staffIps.has(ip),
      })),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/itemOwners.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Records limited item ownership and reports how many people own each item and who was first',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['claim', 'stats']),
    itemId: z.string().max(120).optional(),
    ownerName: z.string().max(40).optional(),
    itemIds: z.array(z.string().max(120)).max(50).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    stats: z.array(z.object({ itemId: z.string(), count: z.number(), firstEmail: z.string(), firstName: z.string() })),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    if (input.action === 'claim' && input.itemId) {
      await zite.itemOwners.bulkCreate({
        matchOn: ['itemId', 'ownerEmail'],
        records: [{ itemId: input.itemId, ownerEmail: me, ownerName: input.ownerName || me.split('@')[0] }],
      });
    }
    const ids = input.itemIds ?? (input.itemId ? [input.itemId] : []);
    if (!ids.length) return { stats: [] };
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT DISTINCT ON ("itemId") "itemId", "ownerEmail", "ownerName",
                COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "itemId") AS cnt
              FROM "ItemOwners" WHERE "itemId" = ANY($1)
              ORDER BY "itemId", "claimedAt" ASC`,
      params: [ids],
    });
    return {
      stats: rows.map(r => ({ itemId: String(r.itemId), count: Number(r.cnt ?? 0), firstEmail: String(r.ownerEmail ?? '').toLowerCase(), firstName: String(r.ownerName ?? '') })),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/listings.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { can, canEditListing } from '../lib/permissions';
import { audit, bad, deny, loadActor } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const listingOut = z.object({ id: z.string(), title: z.string(), description: z.string(), price: z.number(), inventory: z.number(), status: z.string(), sellerEmail: z.string(), imageUrl: z.string(), createdAt: z.string() });
const orderOut = z.object({ id: z.string(), orderNumber: z.number(), listingTitle: z.string(), buyerEmail: z.string(), sellerEmail: z.string(), quantity: z.number(), total: z.number(), status: z.string(), orderedAt: z.string() });

const fields = z.object({
  title: z.string().trim().min(3).max(100),
  description: z.string().trim().max(2000),
  price: z.number().min(0).max(1_000_000),
  inventory: z.number().int().min(0).max(100_000),
  imageUrl: z.string().url().max(1000).or(z.literal('')),
});

type L = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof zite.listings.findAll>>['records'][number];
type O = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof zite.orders.findAll>>['records'][number];
const toL = (r: L) => ({ id: r.id, title: r.title || '', description: r.description || '', price: Number(r.price ?? 0), inventory: Number(r.inventory ?? 0), status: r.status || 'Active', sellerEmail: r.sellerEmail || '', imageUrl: r.imageUrl || '', createdAt: r.createdAt || '' });
const toO = (r: O) => ({ id: r.id, orderNumber: Number(r.orderNumber ?? 0), listingTitle: r.listingTitle || '', buyerEmail: r.buyerEmail || '', sellerEmail: r.sellerEmail || '', quantity: Number(r.quantity ?? 0), total: Number(r.total ?? 0), status: r.status || 'Placed', orderedAt: r.orderedAt || '' });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Marketplace: browse and buy listings, sellers manage their listings and orders, staff moderate',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['browse', 'mine', 'create', 'update', 'setStatus', 'buy', 'sellerOrders', 'myPurchases', 'search', 'setOrderStatus']),
    id: z.string().optional(),
    data: fields.optional(),
    status: z.enum(['Active', 'Paused', 'Removed']).optional(),
    orderStatus: z.enum(['Placed', 'Shipped', 'Completed', 'Cancelled']).optional(),
    quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).optional(),
    q: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ listings: z.array(listingOut), orders: z.array(orderOut) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = await loadActor(context.user.email);
    const none = { listings: [] as ReturnType<typeof toL>[], orders: [] as ReturnType<typeof toO>[] };
    const getListing = async (id?: string) => {
      if (!id) bad('Pick a listing.');
      const l = await zite.listings.findOne({ id });
      if (!l || l.status === 'Removed') bad('That listing no longer exists.');
      return l;
    };

    switch (input.action) {
      case 'browse': {
        const { records } = await zite.listings.findAll({ filters: { status: 'Active' }, sort: [{ field: 'createdAt', direction: 'desc' }], limit: 200 });
        return { ...none, listings: records.map(toL) };
      }
      case 'search': {
        if (!can(me, 'listings.moderate')) deny("You don't have permission to do that.");
        const q = `%${(input.q || '').trim().toLowerCase()}%`;
        const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT id, "title", "description", "price", "inventory", "status", "sellerEmail", "imageUrl", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM "Listings" WHERE lower(coalesce("title",'')) LIKE $1 OR lower(coalesce("sellerEmail",'')) LIKE $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100`, params: [q] });
        return { ...none, listings: rows.map(r => toL({ ...(r as object), id: String(r.id), createdAt: String(r.createdAt || '') } as L)) };
      }
      case 'mine': {
        const { records } = await zite.listings.findAll({ filters: { sellerEmail: me.email }, limit: 500 });
        return { ...none, listings: records.filter(r => r.status !== 'Removed').map(toL) };
      }
      case 'create': {
        if (!can(me, 'listings.sell')) deny('Only Sellers can create listings.');
        if (!input.data) bad('Fill in the listing details.');
        const rec = await zite.listings.create({ record: { ...input.data, status: 'Active', sellerEmail: me.email } });
        await audit(me.email, 'listing.create', rec.id, input.data.title);
        return { ...none, listings: [toL(rec)] };
      }
      case 'update': {
        const l = await getListing(input.id);
        if (!canEditListing(me, l.sellerEmail || '')) deny('You can only edit your own listings.');
        if (!input.data) bad('Fill in the listing details.');
        const rec = await zite.listings.update({ id: l.id, record: input.data });
        await audit(me.email, 'listing.update', l.id, input.data.title);
        return { ...none, listings: [toL(rec)] };
      }
      case 'setStatus': {
        const l = await getListing(input.id);
        if (!input.status) bad('Pick a status.');
        if (!canEditListing(me, l.sellerEmail || '')) deny('You can only change your own listings.');
        const rec = await zite.listings.update({ id: l.id, record: { status: input.status } });
        await audit(me.email, `listing.${input.status.toLowerCase()}`, l.id, l.title || '');
        return { ...none, listings: [toL(rec)] };
      }
      case 'buy': {
        if (me.restriction === 'Suspended') deny('Your account is suspended.');
        const l = await getListing(input.id);
        const qty = input.quantity ?? 1;
        if (l.status !== 'Active') bad('That listing is paused.');
        if ((l.sellerEmail || '').toLowerCase() === me.email) bad("You can't buy your own listing.");
        if (Number(l.inventory ?? 0) < qty) bad('Not enough in stock.');
        await zite.listings.update({ id: l.id, record: { inventory: Number(l.inventory ?? 0) - qty } });
        const order = await zite.orders.create({ record: {
          listing: l.id, listingTitle: l.title || '', buyerEmail: me.email, sellerEmail: l.sellerEmail || '',
          quantity: qty, total: Math.round(Number(l.price ?? 0) * qty * 100) / 100, status: 'Placed',
        } });
        await audit(me.email, 'order.place', order.id, `${qty} × ${l.title}`);
        return { ...none, orders: [toO(order)] };
      }
      case 'sellerOrders': {
        const filters = can(me, 'listings.moderate') && input.q === 'all' ? {} : { sellerEmail: me.email };
        const { records } = await zite.orders.findAll({ filters, sort: [{ field: 'orderedAt', direction: 'desc' }], limit: 500 });
        return { ...none, orders: records.map(toO) };
      }
      case 'myPurchases': {
        const { records } = await zite.orders.findAll({ filters: { buyerEmail: me.email }, sort: [{ field: 'orderedAt', direction: 'desc' }], limit: 500 });
        return { ...none, orders: records.map(toO) };
      }
      case 'setOrderStatus': {
        if (!input.id || !input.orderStatus) bad('Pick an order and status.');
        const o = await zite.orders.findOne({ id: input.id });
        if (!o) bad('That order no longer exists.');
        const isSeller = (o.sellerEmail || '').toLowerCase() === me.email;
        if (!isSeller && !can(me, 'listings.moderate')) deny('You can only update your own orders.');
        const rec = await zite.orders.update({ id: o.id, record: { status: input.orderStatus } });
        await audit(me.email, 'order.status', o.id, input.orderStatus);
        return { ...none, orders: [toO(rec)] };
      }
    }
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/messages.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { filterText } from '../lib/wordFilter';
import { BAD_WORDS, isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/gameData';

/** The shared word list + immunity list live in Chat Settings. The server is the one place filtering happens. */
async function applyFilter(email: string, text: string): Promise<{ text: string; immune: boolean }> {
  const e = email.toLowerCase();
  const { records } = await zite.chatSettings.findAll({ limit: 10 });
  const read = (k: string): string[] | null => { const v = records.find(r => r.key === k)?.value; if (!v) return null; try { return JSON.parse(v); } catch { return null; } };
  const immuneList = (read('immune') || []).map(x => x.toLowerCase());
  const immune = isOwnerEmail(e) || immuneList.includes(e);
  if (immune || text.startsWith('[gif]')) return { text, immune };
  return { text: filterText(text, read('words') ?? BAD_WORDS).text, immune: false };
}

const messageSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  chatRoomId: z.string(),
  senderEmail: z.string(),
  senderName: z.string(),
  content: z.string(),
  reactions: z.record(z.array(z.string())),
  deleted: z.boolean(),
  senderTitle: z.string(),
  senderTitleEffect: z.string(),
  senderTitleColor: z.string(),
  senderNameColor: z.string(),
  replyTo: z.object({ id: z.string(), senderName: z.string(), content: z.string() }).optional(),
  timestamp: z.number(),
  edited: z.boolean().optional(),
  uncensored: z.boolean().optional(),
  hidden: z.boolean().optional(),
});

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Sends, lists, reacts to and deletes shared chat messages',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['getMessages', 'send', 'react', 'delete', 'clear', 'edit', 'hide', 'unhide']),
    content: z.string().optional(),
    roomId: z.string().optional(),
    limit: z.number().optional(),
    message: messageSchema.optional(),
    messageId: z.string().optional(),
    reactions: z.record(z.array(z.string())).optional(),
    uncensored: z.boolean().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ messages: z.array(messageSchema) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const viewerIsOwner = isOwnerEmail((context.user?.email || '').toLowerCase());
    if ((input.action === 'hide' || input.action === 'unhide') && input.messageId) {
      if (!viewerIsOwner) throw new Error('Only the owner can hide messages');
      const rec = await zite.chatMessages.findOne({ filters: { messageId: input.messageId } });
      if (!rec) throw new Error('Message not found');
      await zite.chatMessages.update({ id: rec.id, record: { hidden: input.action === 'hide' } });
      return { messages: [] };
    }
    if (input.action === 'edit' && input.messageId) {
      const text = (input.content || '').trim();
      if (!text) throw new Error('Message cannot be empty');
      const rec = await zite.chatMessages.findOne({ filters: { messageId: input.messageId } });
      if (!rec) throw new Error('Message not found');
      if ((rec.senderEmail || '').toLowerCase() !== (context.user?.email || '').toLowerCase()) {
        throw new Error('You can only edit your own messages');
      }
      const f = await applyFilter(context.user?.email || '', text);
      await zite.chatMessages.update({ id: rec.id, record: { content: f.text, edited: true, uncensored: f.immune } });
      return { messages: [] };
    }
    if (input.action === 'send' && input.message) {
      const m = input.message;
      const f = await applyFilter(context.user?.email || m.senderEmail, m.content);
      await zite.chatMessages.create({ record: {
        messageId: m.id, roomId: m.chatRoomId, senderEmail: m.senderEmail, senderName: m.senderName,
        content: f.text, senderTitle: m.senderTitle, senderTitleColor: m.senderTitleColor,
        senderTitleEffect: m.senderTitleEffect, senderNameColor: m.senderNameColor,
        reactionsJson: JSON.stringify(m.reactions || {}), replyToJson: m.replyTo ? JSON.stringify(m.replyTo) : null,
        deleted: false, uncensored: f.immune, sentAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      } });
      return { messages: [] };
    }

    if (input.action === 'clear') {
      const { records } = await zite.chatMessages.findAll({ filters: { roomId: input.roomId ?? 'global' }, limit: 2000 });
      for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i += 25) {
        await Promise.all(records.slice(i, i + 25).map(r => zite.chatMessages.delete({ id: r.id })));
      }
      return { messages: [] };
    }

    if ((input.action === 'react' || input.action === 'delete') && input.messageId) {
      const rec = await zite.chatMessages.findOne({ filters: { messageId: input.messageId } });
      if (rec) {
        await zite.chatMessages.update({ id: rec.id, record: input.action === 'delete'
          ? { deleted: true } as never
          : { reactionsJson: JSON.stringify(input.reactions || {}) } as never });
      }
      return { messages: [] };
    }

    const limit = Math.min(input.limit ?? 200, 500);
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT * FROM (SELECT "messageId","roomId","senderEmail","senderName","content","senderTitle","senderTitleColor","senderTitleEffect","senderNameColor","reactionsJson","replyToJson","deleted","edited","uncensored","hidden","sentAt" FROM "ChatMessages" WHERE "roomId" = $1${viewerIsOwner ? '' : ' AND COALESCE("hidden", false) = false'} ORDER BY "sentAt" DESC, "messageId" DESC LIMIT ${limit}) t ORDER BY "sentAt" ASC, "messageId" ASC`,
      params: [input.roomId ?? 'global'],
    });
    const parse = <T,>(v: unknown, fb: T): T => { try { return v ? JSON.parse(String(v)) : fb; } catch { return fb; } };
    // Show each sender's current profile name, not the name saved on old messages
    const emails = [...new Set(rows.map(r => String(r.senderEmail ?? '').toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean))];
    const names = new Map<string, string>();
    // Fallback: the name on each sender's newest message
    for (const r of rows) { const e = String(r.senderEmail ?? '').toLowerCase(); if (e && r.senderName) names.set(e, String(r.senderName)); }
    if (emails.length) {
      const pres = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "email","displayName" FROM "Presence" WHERE LOWER("email") = ANY($1)`, params: [emails] });
      for (const p of pres.rows) if (p.displayName) names.set(String(p.email).toLowerCase(), String(p.displayName));
      const prof = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "email","profileData" FROM "UserProfiles" WHERE LOWER("email") = ANY($1)`, params: [emails] });
      for (const p of prof.rows) { const n = parse<{ name?: string }>(p.profileData, {}).name; if (n) names.set(String(p.email).toLowerCase(), n); }
    }
    return {
      messages: rows.map(r => ({
        id: String(r.messageId ?? ''), chatRoomId: String(r.roomId ?? ''),
        senderEmail: String(r.senderEmail ?? ''), senderName: names.get(String(r.senderEmail ?? '').toLowerCase()) || String(r.senderName ?? ''),
        content: String(r.content ?? ''), reactions: parse<Record<string, string[]>>(r.reactionsJson, {}),
        deleted: Boolean(r.deleted), senderTitle: String(r.senderTitle ?? ''),
        senderTitleEffect: String(r.senderTitleEffect ?? ''), senderTitleColor: String(r.senderTitleColor ?? ''),
        senderNameColor: String(r.senderNameColor ?? ''),
        replyTo: parse<{ id: string; senderName: string; content: string } | undefined>(r.replyToJson, undefined),
        timestamp: r.sentAt ? new Date(String(r.sentAt)).getTime() : 0,
        edited: Boolean(r.edited),
        uncensored: Boolean(r.uncensored),
        hidden: Boolean(r.hidden),
      })),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/pranks.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/gameData';
import { findPrank, VIP_MEAN_IDS } from '../lib/pranks';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Sends a prank to another user or picks up pranks sent to you',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['send', 'inbox']),
    targetEmail: z.string().optional(),
    prankId: z.string().optional(),
    senderName: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    pranks: z.array(z.object({ prankId: z.string(), senderName: z.string() })),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    if (input.action === 'send') {
      const p = findPrank(input.prankId || '');
      const target = (input.targetEmail || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!p || !target) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Bad prank', userFacingMessage: 'Pick a prank and a person.' });
      if (target === me) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'self', userFacingMessage: "You can't prank yourself." });
      if (p.mean && !isOwnerEmail(me) && !VIP_MEAN_IDS.includes(p.id))
        throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'locked', userFacingMessage: 'Only the owner can send that prank.' });
      await zite.pranks.create({ record: {
        prankId: p.id, targetEmail: target, senderEmail: me,
        senderName: (input.senderName || me.split('@')[0]).slice(0, 40), seen: false,
      } });
      return { pranks: [] };
    }
    const { records } = await zite.pranks.findAll({ filters: { targetEmail: me, seen: false }, limit: 5 });
    if (records.length) await Promise.all(records.map(r => zite.pranks.update({ id: r.id, record: { seen: true } })));
    return { pranks: records.map(r => ({ prankId: r.prankId || '', senderName: r.senderName || 'Someone' })) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/presence.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

const userSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  profilePic: z.string(),
  nameColor: z.string(),
  activeTitle: z.string(),
  activeTitleColor: z.string(),
  activeTitleEffect: z.string(),
  role: z.string(),
  lastSeen: z.number(),
});

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Marks a user as online and lists everyone online right now',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['ping', 'getOnline']),
    user: userSchema.omit({ lastSeen: true }).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ online: z.array(userSchema), everyone: z.array(userSchema) }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    if (input.action === 'ping' && input.user) {
      const u = input.user;
      await zite.presence.bulkCreate({
        matchOn: ['email'],
        records: [{
          email: u.email, displayName: u.name, profilePic: u.profilePic, nameColor: u.nameColor,
          activeTitle: u.activeTitle, activeTitleColor: u.activeTitleColor,
          activeTitleEffect: u.activeTitleEffect, lastSeen: new Date().toISOString(),
        }],
      });
    }
    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 1000).toISOString();
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT u."email", coalesce(nullif(CASE WHEN up."profileData" LIKE '{%' THEN up."profileData"::json->>'name' END,''), nullif(p."displayName",''), u."name", split_part(u."email",'@',1)) AS "displayName",
              coalesce(p."profilePic", u."image") AS "profilePic", p."nameColor", p."activeTitle", p."activeTitleColor", p."activeTitleEffect", p."role", p."lastSeen"
              FROM "ziteUsers" u LEFT JOIN "Presence" p ON lower(p."email") = lower(u."email")
              LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "profileData" FROM "UserProfiles" x WHERE lower(x."email") = lower(u."email") LIMIT 1) up ON true
              ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2000`,
    });
    const all = rows.map(r => ({
        email: String(r.email ?? ''), name: String(r.displayName ?? ''), profilePic: String(r.profilePic ?? ''),
        nameColor: String(r.nameColor ?? ''), activeTitle: String(r.activeTitle ?? ''),
        activeTitleColor: String(r.activeTitleColor ?? ''), activeTitleEffect: String(r.activeTitleEffect ?? ''),
        role: String(r.role ?? 'user'), lastSeen: r.lastSeen ? new Date(String(r.lastSeen)).getTime() : 0,
      }));
    const cut = Date.parse(cutoff);
    return { online: all.filter(u => u.lastSeen > cut), everyone: all };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/profileSync.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

// One profile per email, shared across devices. The oldest row is the original;
// any duplicate rows for the same email are deleted.
export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Loads or saves the signed-in user\'s single shared profile',
  inputSchema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['get', 'save', 'setName']), data: z.string().max(200000).optional(), targetEmail: z.string().optional(), name: z.string().max(30).optional() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ data: z.string().nullable() }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    if (input.action === 'setName') {
      if (!isOwnerEmail(context.user.email.toLowerCase())) throw new ZiteError('Only the owner can rename users.');
      const target = (input.targetEmail || '').toLowerCase(); const name = (input.name || '').trim();
      if (!target || !name) throw new ZiteError('Pick a user and a name.');
      const row = await zite.userProfiles.findOne({ filters: { email: target } });
      const data = JSON.stringify({ ...(row?.profileData ? JSON.parse(row.profileData) : {}), email: target, name, renamedByOwnerAt: Date.now() });
      if (row) await zite.userProfiles.update({ id: row.id, record: { profileData: data } });
      else await zite.userProfiles.create({ record: { email: target, profileData: data } });
      return { data };
    }
    const email = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    const { records } = await zite.userProfiles.findAll({ filters: { email }, sort: [{ field: 'created', direction: 'asc' }], limit: 50 });
    const [original, ...dupes] = records;
    for (const d of dupes) await zite.userProfiles.delete({ id: d.id });

    if (input.action === 'save' && input.data) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(input.data);
      const prev = original?.profileData ? JSON.parse(original.profileData) : {};
      // An owner rename beats a device that still has the old name cached
      if (prev.renamedByOwnerAt && (parsed.renamedByOwnerAt ?? 0) < prev.renamedByOwnerAt) { parsed.name = prev.name; parsed.renamedByOwnerAt = prev.renamedByOwnerAt; }
      const clean = JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, email });
      if (original) await zite.userProfiles.update({ id: original.id, record: { profileData: clean } });
      else await zite.userProfiles.create({ record: { email, profileData: clean } });
      return { data: clean };
    }
    return { data: original?.profileData || null };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/proxyPage.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { fetchViaProxy, ProxyConfig } from '../lib/proxyCore';

function readConfig(): ProxyConfig {
  const env = process.env as Record<string, string | undefined>;
  return {
    // On by default; set ZITE_PROXY_ENABLED=false to turn it off.
    enabled: (env.ZITE_PROXY_ENABLED ?? 'true').toLowerCase() !== 'false',
    endpoint: env.ZITE_PROXY_ENDPOINT || undefined,
    token: env.ZITE_PROXY_TOKEN || undefined,
    timeoutMs: Math.min(Math.max(Number(env.ZITE_PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS) || 12000, 2000), 25000),
  };
}

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Loads a public web page through the configured proxy for the in-app browser',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({ url: z.string().min(1).max(2048) }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    ok: z.boolean(),
    html: z.string().optional(),
    finalUrl: z.string().optional(),
    code: z.string().optional(),
    message: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const r = await fetchViaProxy(input.url, readConfig(), (u, init) => fetch(u, init));
    if (!r.ok && r.code !== 'DISABLED') {
      // Log only host + error code — never the full URL (may hold query/PII) or proxy credentials.
      let host = 'invalid'; try { host = new URL(input.url).hostname; } catch { /* keep */ }
      console.error('[proxyPage] load failed', { host, code: r.code, status: r.status });
    }
    return r.ok ? { ok: true, html: r.html, finalUrl: r.finalUrl } : { ok: false, code: r.code, message: r.message };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/reports.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { audit, bad, requirePerm } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const reportOut = z.object({ id: z.string(), subject: z.string(), targetType: z.string(), targetId: z.string(), reason: z.string(), reporterEmail: z.string(), status: z.string(), resolutionNote: z.string(), reviewedBy: z.string(), reportedAt: z.string() });
type R = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof zite.reports.findAll>>['records'][number];
const toR = (r: R) => ({ id: r.id, subject: r.subject || '', targetType: r.targetType || 'User', targetId: r.targetId || '', reason: r.reason || '', reporterEmail: r.reporterEmail || '', status: r.status || 'Open', resolutionNote: r.resolutionNote || '', reviewedBy: r.reviewedBy || '', reportedAt: r.reportedAt || '' });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Anyone can report a user or listing; Moderators review and resolve reports',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['create', 'list', 'review']),
    targetType: z.enum(['User', 'Listing', 'Ban Appeal', 'Chat Message']).optional(),
    targetId: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),
    subject: z.string().trim().max(150).optional(),
    reason: z.string().trim().max(2000).optional(),
    id: z.string().optional(),
    status: z.enum(['Open', 'Resolved', 'Dismissed']).optional(),
    note: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ reports: z.array(reportOut) }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const email = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    if (input.action === 'create') {
      if (!input.targetType || !input.targetId || !input.reason) bad('Say what you are reporting and why.');
      const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "Reports" WHERE lower("reporterEmail") = $1 AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'`, params: [email] });
      if (Number(rows[0]?.n ?? 0) >= 10) bad("You've sent a lot of reports — try again later.");
      const r = await zite.reports.create({ record: { targetType: input.targetType, targetId: input.targetId, subject: input.subject || input.targetId, reason: input.reason, reporterEmail: email, status: 'Open' } });
      return { reports: [toR(r)] };
    }
    const me = await requirePerm(email, 'reports.review');
    if (input.action === 'review') {
      if (!input.id || !input.status) bad('Pick a report and outcome.');
      await zite.reports.update({ id: input.id, record: { status: input.status, resolutionNote: input.note || '', reviewedBy: me.email } });
      await audit(me.email, `report.${input.status.toLowerCase()}`, input.id, input.note || '');
    }
    const { records } = await zite.reports.findAll({ sort: [{ field: 'reportedAt', direction: 'desc' }], limit: 300 });
    return { reports: records.map(toR) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/researchSummary.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Summarizes search results into a short research brief with numbered sources',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    query: z.string(),
    results: z.array(z.object({ title: z.string(), url: z.string(), snippet: z.string() })),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ summary: z.string() }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const sources = input.results.slice(0, 8).map((r, i) => `[${i + 1}] ${r.title} — ${r.snippet}`).join('\n');
    const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4.1-mini',
      temperature: 0.3,
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: 'You are a research helper for a student. Using ONLY the numbered sources, write a clear summary: 3-5 bullet points of key facts, each citing sources like [1]. Then one line "Look into next:" with 2 follow-up search ideas. Say plainly if the sources are thin. Remind nothing else.' },
        { role: 'user', content: `Topic: ${input.query}\n\nSources:\n${sources}` },
      ],
    });
    return { summary: res.choices[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || 'No summary available.' };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/roles.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

type RoleUser = { email: string; name: string; role: string };
const NO_USERS: RoleUser[] = [];
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';
const ROLES = ['user', 'vip', 'helper', 'guardian', 'mod', 'senior-mod', 'admin', 'co-owner', 'owner'] as const;
const RANK: Record<string, number> = { user: 0, vip: 1, helper: 2, mod: 3, 'senior-mod': 4, admin: 5, 'co-owner': 6, owner: 7 };

async function roleOf(email: string): Promise<string> {
  if (isOwnerEmail(email.toLowerCase())) return 'owner';
  const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "role" FROM "Presence" WHERE lower("email") = $1 LIMIT 1`, params: [email.toLowerCase()] });
  const r = String(rows[0]?.role ?? 'user');
  return r in RANK ? r : 'user';
}

export default createEndpoint({
  authenticated: true,
  description: 'Lists everyone who signed up with their role, and lets staff change roles',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'set', 'mine', 'profile', 'setCustom']),
    email: z.string().optional(),
    role: z.enum(ROLES).optional(),
    customRole: z.object({ name: z.string(), color: z.string(), color2: z.string() }).nullable().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    myRole: z.string(),
    users: z.array(z.object({ email: z.string(), name: z.string(), role: z.string(), customRole: z.string(), customRoleColor: z.string(), customRoleColor2: z.string() })),
    profile: z.object({ email: z.string(), name: z.string(), profilePic: z.string(), nameColor: z.string(), activeTitle: z.string(), activeTitleColor: z.string(), activeTitleEffect: z.string(), role: z.string(), lastSeen: z.number(), joinedAt: z.number() }).nullable().optional(),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = context.user;
    const myRole = await roleOf(me.email);

    if (input.action === 'mine') return { myRole, users: NO_USERS };

    if (input.action === 'profile') {
      const email = (input.email || '').toLowerCase();
      const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT * FROM "Presence" WHERE lower("email") = $1 LIMIT 1`, params: [email] });
      const r = rows[0];
      if (!r) return { myRole, users: NO_USERS, profile: null };
      const joined = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "created_at" FROM "ziteUsers" WHERE lower("email") = $1 LIMIT 1`, params: [email] });
      const joinedAt = joined.rows[0]?.created_at ?? r.created_at;
      return { myRole, users: NO_USERS, profile: {
        joinedAt: joinedAt ? new Date(String(joinedAt)).getTime() : 0,
        email: String(r.email), name: String(r.displayName || email.split('@')[0]), profilePic: String(r.profilePic ?? ''),
        nameColor: String(r.nameColor ?? ''), activeTitle: String(r.activeTitle ?? ''), activeTitleColor: String(r.activeTitleColor ?? ''),
        activeTitleEffect: String(r.activeTitleEffect ?? ''), role: isOwnerEmail(email) ? 'owner' : String(r.role || 'user'),
        lastSeen: r.lastSeen ? new Date(String(r.lastSeen)).getTime() : 0,
      } };
    }

    if (input.action === 'set') {
      const email = (input.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const role = input.role;
      if (!email || !role) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Missing email or role', userFacingMessage: 'Pick a user and a role.' });
      if (RANK[myRole] < RANK.admin) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'forbidden', userFacingMessage: 'Only Admins and above can set roles.' });
      if (isOwnerEmail(email)) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'owner', userFacingMessage: "The owner's role can't be changed." });
      const targetRole = await roleOf(email);
      const canAssign = myRole === 'owner' || RANK[role] < RANK[myRole];
      const canTouch = myRole === 'owner' || RANK[targetRole] < RANK[myRole];
      if (!canAssign || !canTouch) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'rank', userFacingMessage: "You can only give roles below your own, to people below you." });
      let { records } = await zite.auth.findAllUsers({ filters: { email }, limit: 1 });
      if (!records.length) {
        // Emails may be stored with capital letters — fall back to a case-insensitive match.
        const all = await zite.auth.findAllUsers({ limit: 1000 });
        records = all.records.filter(u => u.email.toLowerCase() === email);
      }
      if (!records.length) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'not found', userFacingMessage: 'No one has signed up with that email.' });
      const u = records[0];
      await zite.presence.bulkCreate({ matchOn: ['email'], records: [{ email: u.email, role, displayName: u.name || u.email.split('@')[0] }] });
    }

    if (input.action === 'setCustom') {
      const email = (input.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!email) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Missing email', userFacingMessage: 'Pick a user.' });
      if (RANK[myRole] < RANK.admin && email !== me.email.toLowerCase()) throw new ZiteError({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'forbidden', userFacingMessage: 'Only Admins and above can give custom roles.' });
      const { records } = await zite.auth.findAllUsers({ filters: { email }, limit: 1 });
      const realEmail = records[0]?.email ?? email;
      const cr = input.customRole;
      await zite.presence.bulkCreate({ matchOn: ['email'], records: [{
        email: realEmail,
        customRole: cr ? cr.name.slice(0, 32) : '',
        customRoleColor: cr ? cr.color : '',
        customRoleColor2: cr ? cr.color2 : '',
      }] });
    }

    const [{ records: all }, { rows }] = await Promise.all([
      zite.auth.findAllUsers({ appIds: ['8hj7vk7ren'], sort: [{ field: 'email', direction: 'asc' }], limit: 1000 }),
      zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "email","role","displayName","customRole","customRoleColor","customRoleColor2" FROM "Presence"` }),
    ]);
    const byEmail = new Map(rows.map(r => [String(r.email).toLowerCase(), r]));
    const users = all.map(u => {
      const p = byEmail.get(u.email.toLowerCase());
      const role = isOwnerEmail(u.email.toLowerCase()) ? 'owner' : String(p?.role ?? 'user');
      return {
        email: u.email, name: String(p?.displayName || u.name || u.email.split('@')[0]), role: role in RANK ? role : 'user',
        customRole: String(p?.customRole ?? ''), customRoleColor: String(p?.customRoleColor ?? ''), customRoleColor2: String(p?.customRoleColor2 ?? ''),
      };
    });
    return { myRole, users };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/staffTools.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { requirePerm, loadActor, deny, bad, audit } from '../lib/serverAuth';
import { level } from '../lib/permissions';

const warningSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), reason: z.string(), fromEmail: z.string(), created: z.string() });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Staff warnings and bulk deletion of a user\'s recent messages',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['warn', 'myWarnings', 'ack', 'bulkDelete', 'hold']),
    messageId: z.string().optional(),
    email: z.string().optional(),
    reason: z.string().optional(),
    warningId: z.string().optional(),
    hours: z.number().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ warnings: z.array(warningSchema), deleted: z.number() }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = (context.user?.email || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!me) deny('Please sign in.');

    if (input.action === 'myWarnings') {
      const { rows } = await zite.sql({
        query: `SELECT "id","reason","fromEmail","created" FROM "Warnings" WHERE lower("toEmail") = $1 AND COALESCE("acknowledged", false) = false ORDER BY "created" ASC LIMIT 20`,
        params: [me],
      });
      return { warnings: rows.map(r => ({ id: String(r.id), reason: String(r.reason ?? ''), fromEmail: String(r.fromEmail ?? ''), created: String(r.created ?? '') })), deleted: 0 };
    }

    if (input.action === 'ack') {
      const w = input.warningId ? await zite.warnings.findOne({ filters: { id: input.warningId } }) : null;
      if (!w || (w.toEmail || '').toLowerCase() !== me) bad('Warning not found');
      await zite.warnings.update({ id: w.id, record: { acknowledged: true } });
      return { warnings: [], deleted: 0 };
    }

    const target = (input.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!target) bad('Pick a user');
    if (target === me) bad("You can't do that to yourself");
    const self = await loadActor(me);
    const tgt = await loadActor(target);
    if ((input.action === 'warn' || input.action === 'hold') && self.chatRole === 'guardian') {
      // Guardians may warn / hold messages from regular members only
      if (level(tgt) > 0 || ['helper', 'guardian', 'mod', 'senior-mod', 'admin', 'co-owner', 'owner'].includes(tgt.chatRole)) deny('Guardians can only act on regular members.');
    } else {
      const actor = await requirePerm(me, 'users.restrict');
      if (level(tgt) >= level(actor)) deny('You can only act on users below your rank.');
    }

    if (input.action === 'hold') {
      if (!input.messageId) bad('Pick a message');
      const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "id","content","roomId" FROM "ChatMessages" WHERE "messageId" = $1 AND lower("senderEmail") = $2 LIMIT 1`, params: [input.messageId, target] });
      const m = rows[0];
      if (!m) bad('Message not found');
      await zite.chatMessages.update({ id: String(m.id), record: { deleted: true } as never });
      await zite.reports.create({ record: { subject: `Held message from ${target}`, targetType: 'Chat Message', targetId: input.messageId!, reason: `Hidden by ${me} for mod review. Room: ${String(m.roomId)}. Message: "${String(m.content ?? '').slice(0, 500)}"`, reporterEmail: me, status: 'Open', resolutionNote: null, reviewedBy: null } });
      await audit(me, 'holdMessage', target, input.messageId!);
      return { warnings: [], deleted: 1 };
    }

    if (input.action === 'warn') {
      const reason = (input.reason || '').trim();
      if (!reason) bad('Add a reason for the warning');
      await zite.warnings.create({ record: { reason: reason.slice(0, 500), toEmail: target, fromEmail: me, acknowledged: false } });
      await audit(me, 'warn', target, reason);
      return { warnings: [], deleted: 0 };
    }

    // bulkDelete: soft-delete the user's messages from the last N hours
    const hours = Math.min(Math.max(input.hours ?? 24, 1), 24 * 30);
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - hours * 3600_000).toISOString();
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT "id" FROM "ChatMessages" WHERE lower("senderEmail") = $1 AND "sentAt" >= $2 AND COALESCE("deleted", false) = false LIMIT 1000`,
      params: [target, since],
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += 25) {
      await Promise.all(rows.slice(i, i + 25).map(r => zite.chatMessages.update({ id: String(r.id), record: { deleted: true } as never })));
    }
    await audit(me, 'bulkDeleteMessages', target, `${rows.length} messages, last ${hours}h`);
    return { warnings: [], deleted: rows.length };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/tournaments.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { requirePerm, bad, audit } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const GAMES = ['Reaction', 'Click Frenzy', 'Speed Typing'] as const;
// Sanity caps so obviously faked scores are rejected
const MAX_SCORE: Record<string, number> = { Reaction: 900, 'Click Frenzy': 250, 'Speed Typing': 250 };

const tSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(), title: z.string(), game: z.string(), prizeGems: z.number(),
  endsAt: z.string(), ended: z.boolean(), prizePaid: z.boolean(),
  leaderboard: z.array(z.object({ email: z.string(), name: z.string(), score: z.number(), attempts: z.number() })),
});

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Lists, creates, scores and pays out mini-game tournaments',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'create', 'submit', 'claim', 'delete']),
    tournamentId: z.string().optional(),
    title: z.string().optional(),
    game: z.enum(GAMES).optional(),
    prizeGems: z.number().optional(),
    hours: z.number().optional(),
    score: z.number().optional(),
    playerName: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ tournaments: z.array(tSchema), prize: z.number() }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    const empty = { tournaments: [], prize: 0 };

    if (input.action === 'create') {
      await requirePerm(me, 'users.restrict');
      const title = (input.title || '').trim();
      if (!title || !input.game) bad('Add a title and pick a game');
      const hours = Math.min(Math.max(input.hours ?? 24, 1), 24 * 14);
      await zite.tournaments.create({ record: {
        title: title.slice(0, 60), game: input.game, prizeGems: Math.max(0, Math.floor(input.prizeGems ?? 0)),
        endsAt: new Date(Date.now() + hours * 3600_000).toISOString(), createdBy: me, prizePaid: false,
      } });
      await audit(me, 'createTournament', title, `${input.game}, ${hours}h`);
      return empty;
    }

    if (input.action === 'delete') {
      await requirePerm(me, 'users.restrict');
      if (input.tournamentId) await zite.tournaments.delete({ id: input.tournamentId });
      return empty;
    }

    const t = input.tournamentId ? await zite.tournaments.findOne({ filters: { id: input.tournamentId } }) : null;

    if (input.action === 'submit') {
      if (!t) bad('Tournament not found');
      if (new Date(t.endsAt || 0).getTime() < Date.now()) bad('This tournament has ended');
      const score = Math.floor(input.score ?? 0);
      if (score < 0 || score > (MAX_SCORE[t.game || ''] ?? 1000)) bad('That score looks invalid');
      const { records } = await zite.tournamentEntries.findAll({ filters: { tournamentId: t.id, playerEmail: me }, limit: 1 });
      const cur = records[0];
      const name = (input.playerName || context.user.firstName || me.split('@')[0]).slice(0, 30);
      if (cur) {
        await zite.tournamentEntries.update({ id: cur.id, record: { bestScore: Math.max(cur.bestScore ?? 0, score), attempts: (cur.attempts ?? 0) + 1, playerName: name } });
      } else {
        await zite.tournamentEntries.create({ record: { tournamentId: t.id, playerEmail: me, playerName: name, bestScore: score, attempts: 1 } });
      }
      return empty;
    }

    if (input.action === 'claim') {
      if (!t) bad('Tournament not found');
      if (new Date(t.endsAt || 0).getTime() > Date.now()) bad('Tournament is still running');
      if (t.prizePaid) bad('Prize already claimed');
      const { rows } = await zite.sql({
        query: `SELECT "playerEmail" FROM "TournamentEntries" WHERE "tournamentId" = $1 ORDER BY "bestScore" DESC LIMIT 1`,
        params: [t.id],
      });
      if (String(rows[0]?.playerEmail || '').toLowerCase() !== me) bad('Only the winner can claim the prize');
      await zite.tournaments.update({ id: t.id, record: { prizePaid: true } });
      return { tournaments: [], prize: t.prizeGems ?? 0 };
    }

    // list
    const { records: ts } = await zite.tournaments.findAll({ limit: 50 });
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT "tournamentId","playerEmail","playerName","bestScore","attempts" FROM "TournamentEntries" ORDER BY "bestScore" DESC LIMIT 2000`,
    });
    const now = Date.now();
    return {
      prize: 0,
      tournaments: ts
        .map(x => ({
          id: x.id, title: x.title || 'Tournament', game: x.game || 'Reaction', prizeGems: x.prizeGems ?? 0,
          endsAt: x.endsAt || '', ended: new Date(x.endsAt || 0).getTime() < now, prizePaid: !!x.prizePaid,
          leaderboard: rows.filter(r => r.tournamentId === x.id).slice(0, 10).map(r => ({
            email: String(r.playerEmail ?? ''), name: String(r.playerName ?? ''), score: Number(r.bestScore ?? 0), attempts: Number(r.attempts ?? 0),
          })),
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => Number(a.ended) - Number(b.ended) || b.endsAt.localeCompare(a.endsAt)),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/trades.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

const item = z.object({ kind: z.enum(['theme', 'typing', 'title', 'song']), id: z.string(), name: z.string() });
const deny = (m: string): never => { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: m, userFacingMessage: m }); };
const parse = (s?: string | null) => { try { return z.array(item).parse(JSON.parse(s || '[]')); } catch { return []; } };

export default createEndpoint({
  authenticated: true,
  description: 'Sends, answers and lists item trades (themes, typing effects, titles, songs) between users',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'offer', 'accept', 'decline', 'cancel', 'applied']),
    id: z.string().optional(),
    toEmail: z.string().optional(),
    items: z.array(item).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    trades: z.array(z.object({
      id: z.string(), fromEmail: z.string(), toEmail: z.string(), status: z.string(), created: z.string(),
      offer: z.array(item), giveBack: z.array(item), mine: z.boolean(), needsApply: z.boolean(),
    })),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    const me = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    const items = input.items ?? [];

    if (input.action === 'offer') {
      const to = (input.toEmail || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!to) deny('Pick who to trade with.');
      if (to === me) deny("You can't trade with yourself.");
      if (!items.length) deny('Add at least one item to offer.');
      const { records } = await zite.auth.findAllUsers({ filters: { email: to }, limit: 1 });
      if (!records.length) deny('No one has signed up with that email.');
      await zite.trades.create({ record: {
        summary: `${me} → ${to}: ${items.map(i => i.name).join(', ')}`.slice(0, 250),
        fromEmail: me, toEmail: to, offerItems: JSON.stringify(items), returnItems: '[]', status: 'Pending',
      } });
    } else if (input.action !== 'list') {
      const t = input.id ? await zite.trades.findOne({ id: input.id }) : null;
      if (!t) deny('Trade not found.');
      const from = (t!.fromEmail || '').toLowerCase(), to = (t!.toEmail || '').toLowerCase();
      if (me !== from && me !== to) deny('This is not your trade.');
      if (input.action === 'applied') {
        await zite.trades.update({ id: t!.id, record: me === from ? { appliedByFrom: true } : { appliedByTo: true } });
      } else {
        if (t!.status !== 'Pending') deny('This trade was already answered.');
        if (input.action === 'cancel' && me !== from) deny('Only the sender can cancel.');
        if ((input.action === 'accept' || input.action === 'decline') && me !== to) deny('Only the receiver can answer.');
        const status = input.action === 'accept' ? 'Accepted' : input.action === 'decline' ? 'Declined' : 'Cancelled';
        await zite.trades.update({ id: t!.id, record: { status, ...(input.action === 'accept' ? { returnItems: JSON.stringify(items) } : {}) } });
      }
    }

    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT * FROM "Trades" WHERE lower("fromEmail") = $1 OR lower("toEmail") = $1 ORDER BY "created" DESC LIMIT 50`,
      params: [me],
    });
    return { trades: rows.map(r => {
      const mine = String(r.fromEmail).toLowerCase() === me;
      const applied = mine ? r.appliedByFrom === true || r.appliedByFrom === 'true' : r.appliedByTo === true || r.appliedByTo === 'true';
      return {
        id: String(r.id), fromEmail: String(r.fromEmail), toEmail: String(r.toEmail), status: String(r.status),
        created: String(r.created ?? ''), offer: parse(r.offerItems as string), giveBack: parse(r.returnItems as string),
        mine, needsApply: r.status === 'Accepted' && !applied,
      };
    }) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/translate.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { integrations } from 'zitejs/integrations';
import OpenAI from 'openai';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Translates a batch of app interface text into the user\'s language',
  inputSchema: z.object({ lang: z.string().max(10), texts: z.array(z.string().max(500)).max(80) }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ translations: z.array(z.string()) }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    if (!input.texts.length) return { translations: [] };
    const { accessToken } = await integrations.get('openai-2');
    const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: accessToken });
    const res = await openai.chat.completions.create({
      model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
      temperature: 0,
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: `Translate each UI string of a chat app into the language with code "${input.lang}", using that language's own script/alphabet. Keep emoji, numbers, @mentions, URLs and placeholders unchanged. Keep it short and natural. If a string is already in that language, return it unchanged. Reply as JSON {"t":[...]} with exactly ${input.texts.length} strings in the same order.` },
        { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify(input.texts) },
      ],
    });
    const parsed = JSON.parse(res.choices[0]?.message?.content || '{"t":[]}');
    const out: string[] = Array.isArray(parsed.t) ? parsed.t.map(String) : [];
    return { translations: input.texts.map((t, i) => out[i] || t) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/typing.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Shares who is typing in a chat room across all devices',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['start', 'stop', 'list']),
    roomId: z.string(),
    email: z.string().optional(),
    name: z.string().optional(),
    style: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ typing: z.array(z.object({ email: z.string(), name: z.string(), style: z.string() })) }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    if ((input.action === 'start' || input.action === 'stop') && input.email) {
      await zite.presence.bulkCreate({
        matchOn: ['email'],
        records: [{
          email: input.email,
          ...(input.name ? { displayName: input.name } : {}),
          ...(input.style !== undefined ? { typingStyle: input.style } : {}),
          typingRoom: input.action === 'start' ? input.roomId : null,
          typingAt: input.action === 'start' ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
        } as never],
      });
    }
    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 6000).toISOString();
    const { rows } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT "email","displayName","typingStyle" FROM "Presence" WHERE "typingRoom" = $1 AND "typingAt" > $2`,
      params: [input.roomId, cutoff],
    });
    return { typing: rows.map(r => ({ email: String(r.email ?? ''), name: String(r.displayName ?? ''), style: String(r.typingStyle ?? '') })) };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/videoRooms.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';

const ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789'; // no 0/O/1/I/L for easy copying
const ROOM_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const STALE_MS = 15_000;

const fail = (m: string, code: 'BAD_REQUEST' | 'NOT_FOUND' = 'BAD_REQUEST'): never => {
  throw new ZiteError({ code, message: m, userFacingMessage: m });
};
const genCode = () => Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(6)), b => ALPHABET[b % ALPHABET.length]).join('');
const normCode = (c?: string) => (c || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');

async function liveRoom(code: string) {
  if (!code) fail('Enter a room code.');
  const room = await zite.videoRooms.findOne({ filters: { code } });
  if (!room) fail("That room doesn't exist. Check the code and try again.", 'NOT_FOUND');
  if (room!.expiresAt && new Date(room!.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now()) fail('This room has expired. Ask the host to create a new one.', 'NOT_FOUND');
  return room!;
}

function iceServers() {
  const servers: { urls: string | string[]; username?: string; credential?: string }[] = [
    { urls: ['stun:stun.l.google.com:19302', 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'] },
  ];
  const env = process.env as Record<string, string | undefined>;
  if (env.ZITE_TURN_URL) {
    servers.push({ urls: env.ZITE_TURN_URL.split(',').map(s => s.trim()), username: env.ZITE_TURN_USERNAME, credential: env.ZITE_TURN_CREDENTIAL });
  }
  return servers;
}

const signalSchema = z.object({ to: z.string(), kind: z.string(), payload: z.string() });

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Creates and validates video rooms and relays WebRTC signaling between participants',
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['create', 'check', 'sync', 'leave']),
    code: z.string().optional(),
    peerId: z.string().optional(),
    displayName: z.string().optional(),
    outgoing: z.array(signalSchema).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    code: z.string(),
    iceServers: z.array(z.object({ urls: z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]), username: z.string().optional(), credential: z.string().optional() })),
    participants: z.array(z.object({ peerId: z.string(), displayName: z.string() })),
    signals: z.array(z.object({ from: z.string(), kind: z.string(), payload: z.string() })),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const base = { iceServers: iceServers(), participants: [], signals: [] };

    if (input.action === 'create') {
      let code = genCode();
      for (let i = 0; i < 5 && (await zite.videoRooms.findOne({ filters: { code } })); i++) code = genCode();
      await zite.videoRooms.create({ record: { code, hostName: (input.displayName || '').slice(0, 40), expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + ROOM_TTL_MS).toISOString() } });
      return { ...base, code };
    }

    const code = normCode(input.code);
    if (input.action === 'check') { await liveRoom(code); return { ...base, code }; }

    const peerId = input.peerId || fail('Missing peer id.');
    if (input.action === 'leave') {
      const { records } = await zite.videoParticipants.findAll({ filters: { peerId }, limit: 10 });
      await Promise.all(records.map(r => zite.videoParticipants.delete({ id: r.id })));
      return { ...base, code };
    }

    // sync: heartbeat + send + receive
    await liveRoom(code);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    await zite.videoParticipants.bulkCreate({
      records: [{ peerId, roomCode: code, displayName: (input.displayName || 'Guest').slice(0, 40), lastSeen: now }],
      matchOn: ['peerId'],
    });
    const out = (input.outgoing || []).slice(0, 100);
    if (out.length) {
      await zite.videoSignals.bulkCreate({ records: out.map(s => ({ roomCode: code, fromPeer: peerId, toPeer: s.to, kind: s.kind, payload: s.payload })) });
    }

    const { rows: inbox } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT "id","fromPeer","kind","payload" FROM "VideoSignals" WHERE "roomCode" = $1 AND "toPeer" = $2 LIMIT 200`,
      params: [code, peerId],
    });
    if (inbox.length) await Promise.all(inbox.map(r => zite.videoSignals.delete({ id: String(r.id) })));

    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - STALE_MS).toISOString();
    const { rows: people } = await zite.sql({
      query: `SELECT "peerId","displayName" FROM "VideoParticipants" WHERE "roomCode" = $1 AND "lastSeen" >= $2 LIMIT 50`,
      params: [code, cutoff],
    });

    return {
      ...base, code,
      participants: people.map(p => ({ peerId: String(p.peerId), displayName: String(p.displayName || 'Guest') })).filter(p => p.peerId !== peerId),
      signals: inbox.map(r => ({ from: String(r.fromPeer), kind: String(r.kind), payload: String(r.payload) })),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/vipSettings.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';
import { deny } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const KEY = 'vipMonthlyPrice';
const DEFAULT = 7000;

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Reads the VIP monthly price, and lets the owner change it',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({ monthlyPrice: z.number().int().min(0).max(100_000_000).optional() }),
  outputSchema: z.object({ monthlyPrice: z.number() }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }) => {
    if (input.monthlyPrice !== undefined) {
      if (!isOwnerEmail(context.user.email)) deny('Only the owner can change the VIP price.');
      await zite.chatSettings.bulkCreate({ records: [{ key: KEY, value: String(input.monthlyPrice) }], matchOn: ['key'] });
    }
    const r = await zite.chatSettings.findOne({ filters: { key: KEY } });
    const n = Number(r?.value);
    return { monthlyPrice: Number.isFinite(n) && r?.value ? n : DEFAULT };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/watchParty.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint, ZiteError } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { zite } from 'zitejs/db';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';
import { loadActor } from '../lib/serverAuth';

const LIVE_MS = 20_000;
const ROLE_KEY = 'theaterRoles';
const DEFAULT_ROLES = ['co-owner'];
const fail = (m: string): never => { throw new ZiteError({ code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: m, userFacingMessage: m }); };

const party = z.object({ id: z.string(), title: z.string(), videoUrl: z.string(), hostEmail: z.string(), hostName: z.string(), scheduledFor: z.string(), endsAt: z.string(), playing: z.boolean(), positionSeconds: z.number(), syncedAtMs: z.number(), ended: z.boolean(), viewers: z.array(z.object({ email: z.string(), name: z.string() })) });
type P = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof zite.watchParties.findOne>>>;
const toParty = (p: P, viewers: { email: string; name: string }[]) => ({
  id: p.id, title: p.title || 'Theater', videoUrl: p.videoUrl || '', hostEmail: p.hostEmail || '', hostName: p.hostName || '',
  scheduledFor: p.scheduledFor || '', endsAt: p.endsAt || '', playing: !!p.playing, positionSeconds: p.positionSeconds || 0, syncedAtMs: p.syncedAtMs || 0, ended: !!p.ended, viewers,
});
const isOver = (p: P) => !!p.endsAt && new Date(p.endsAt).getTime() <= Date.now();

async function viewersOf(ids: string[]) {
  const map = new Map<string, { email: string; name: string }[]>();
  if (!ids.length) return map;
  const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "partyId", "email", "name" FROM "WatchPartyViewers" WHERE "lastSeenMs" > $1 LIMIT 2000`, params: [Date.now() - LIVE_MS] });
  const want = new Set(ids);
  for (const r of rows) { const k = String(r.partyId); if (!want.has(k)) continue; map.set(k, [...(map.get(k) || []), { email: String(r.email), name: String(r.name || r.email) }]); }
  return map;
}
async function allowedRoles(): Promise<string[]> {
  const r = await zite.chatSettings.findOne({ filters: { key: ROLE_KEY } });
  try { return r?.value ? JSON.parse(r.value) : DEFAULT_ROLES; } catch { return DEFAULT_ROLES; }
}
/** Ends any movie whose end time has passed. */
async function closeExpired(records: P[]) {
  const over = records.filter(isOver);
  await Promise.all(over.map(p => zite.watchParties.update({ id: p.id, record: { ended: true, playing: false } })));
  return records.filter(p => !isOver(p));
}

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Runs the Theater: movie listings, who can start movies, playback sync, start/end times and chat',
  authenticated: true,
  inputSchema: z.object({
    action: z.enum(['list', 'friends', 'create', 'state', 'control', 'send', 'end', 'schedule', 'access', 'setRoles', 'deleteMessage']),
    messageId: z.string().optional(),
    id: z.string().optional(),
    name: z.string().max(60).optional(),
    title: z.string().trim().max(100).optional(),
    videoUrl: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional(),
    scheduledFor: z.string().optional(),
    endsAt: z.string().optional(),
    playing: z.boolean().optional(),
    positionSeconds: z.number().min(0).optional(),
    text: z.string().trim().max(300).optional(),
    isReaction: z.boolean().optional(),
    roles: z.array(z.string().max(40)).max(20).optional(),
  }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    parties: z.array(party),
    messages: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), text: z.string(), senderName: z.string(), senderEmail: z.string(), isReaction: z.boolean(), sentAt: z.string() })),
    canStart: z.boolean().optional(),
    allowedRoles: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input, context }): Promise<{ parties: ReturnType<typeof toParty>[]; messages: { id: string; text: string; senderName: string; senderEmail: string; isReaction: boolean; sentAt: string }[]; canStart?: boolean; allowedRoles?: string[] }> => {
    const email = context.user.email.toLowerCase();
    const name = input.name?.trim() || context.user.firstName || email.split('@')[0];
    const owner = isOwnerEmail(email);
    type Out = { parties: ReturnType<typeof toParty>[]; messages: { id: string; text: string; senderName: string; senderEmail: string; isReaction: boolean; sentAt: string }[]; canStart?: boolean; allowedRoles?: string[] };
    const empty: Out = { parties: [], messages: [] };

    if (input.action === 'access' || input.action === 'setRoles') {
      if (input.action === 'setRoles') {
        if (!owner) fail('Only the owner can change who starts movies.');
        await zite.chatSettings.bulkCreate({ records: [{ key: ROLE_KEY, value: JSON.stringify(input.roles || []) }], matchOn: ['key'] });
      }
      const roles = await allowedRoles();
      const me = await loadActor(email);
      return { ...empty, allowedRoles: roles, canStart: owner || roles.includes(me.chatRole) };
    }
    if (input.action === 'list') {
      const { records } = await zite.watchParties.findAll({ filters: { ended: false }, sort: [{ field: 'scheduledFor', direction: 'asc' }], limit: 100 });
      const open = await closeExpired(records);
      const v = await viewersOf(open.map(r => r.id));
      return { parties: open.map(r => toParty(r, v.get(r.id) || [])), messages: [] };
    }
    if (input.action === 'friends') {
      const { rows } = await zite.sql({ query: `SELECT "requesterEmail","addresseeEmail" FROM "Friendships" WHERE "status" = 'Accepted' AND (lower("requesterEmail") = $1 OR lower("addresseeEmail") = $1) LIMIT 1000`, params: [email] });
      const friends = new Set(rows.map(r => [String(r.requesterEmail).toLowerCase(), String(r.addresseeEmail).toLowerCase()].find(e => e !== email)!));
      if (!friends.size) return empty;
      const { records } = await zite.watchParties.findAll({ filters: { ended: false }, limit: 200 });
      const open = records.filter(p => !isOver(p));
      const v = await viewersOf(open.map(r => r.id));
      const soon = Date.now() + 15 * 60_000;
      return { parties: open.map(r => toParty(r, v.get(r.id) || [])).filter(p =>
        (friends.has(p.hostEmail.toLowerCase()) || p.viewers.some(x => friends.has(x.email.toLowerCase())))
        && new Date(p.scheduledFor).getTime() <= soon && !p.viewers.some(x => x.email.toLowerCase() === email)), messages: [] };
    }
    if (input.action === 'create') {
      const me = await loadActor(email);
      if (!owner && !(await allowedRoles()).includes(me.chatRole)) fail("You can't start movies. Join one that's playing instead!");
      if (!input.title || !input.videoUrl) fail('Add a title and a movie link.');
      if (!/^https?:\/\//.test(input.videoUrl!)) fail('The movie link must start with http:// or https://');
      const start = input.scheduledFor || new Date().toISOString();
      if (input.endsAt && new Date(input.endsAt) <= new Date(start)) fail('The end time must be after the start time.');
      const p = await zite.watchParties.create({ record: { title: input.title!, videoUrl: input.videoUrl!, hostEmail: email, hostName: name, scheduledFor: start, endsAt: input.endsAt || null, playing: false, positionSeconds: 0, syncedAtMs: Date.now(), ended: false } });
      return { parties: [toParty(p, [])], messages: [] };
    }

    if (!input.id) fail('Pick a movie.');
    const p = await zite.watchParties.findOne({ id: input.id! });
    if (!p) fail('That movie is no longer showing.');
    const canControl = owner || (p!.hostEmail || '').toLowerCase() === email;

    if (input.action === 'control') {
      if (!canControl) fail('Only the host or the owner controls playback.');
      await zite.watchParties.update({ id: p!.id, record: { playing: input.playing ?? !!p!.playing, positionSeconds: input.positionSeconds ?? p!.positionSeconds ?? 0, syncedAtMs: Date.now() } });
    }
    if (input.action === 'schedule') {
      if (!canControl) fail('Only the host or the owner can change the showtimes.');
      const start = input.scheduledFor || p!.scheduledFor || new Date().toISOString();
      if (input.endsAt && new Date(input.endsAt) <= new Date(start)) fail('The end time must be after the start time.');
      await zite.watchParties.update({ id: p!.id, record: { scheduledFor: start, endsAt: input.endsAt || null } });
    }
    if (input.action === 'end') {
      if (!canControl) fail('Only the host or the owner can end the movie.');
      await zite.watchParties.update({ id: p!.id, record: { ended: true, playing: false } });
    }
    if (input.action === 'send') {
      if (!input.text) fail('Type a message first.');
      await zite.watchPartyMessages.create({ record: { text: input.text!, partyId: p!.id, senderEmail: email, senderName: name, isReaction: !!input.isReaction } });
    }

    if (input.action === 'deleteMessage') {
      if (!owner) fail('Only the owner can delete Theater messages.');
      if (!input.messageId) fail('Pick a message to delete.');
      const m = await zite.watchPartyMessages.findOne({ id: input.messageId! });
      if (m && m.partyId === p!.id) await zite.watchPartyMessages.delete({ id: m.id });
    }

    if (isOver(p!) && !p!.ended) await zite.watchParties.update({ id: p!.id, record: { ended: true, playing: false } });
    await zite.watchPartyViewers.bulkCreate({ records: [{ email, partyId: p!.id, name, lastSeenMs: Date.now() }], matchOn: ['email', 'partyId'] });
    const fresh = (await zite.watchParties.findOne({ id: p!.id }))!;
    const v = await viewersOf([p!.id]);
    const { records: msgs } = await zite.watchPartyMessages.findAll({ filters: { partyId: p!.id }, sort: [{ field: 'sentAt', direction: 'desc' }], limit: 80 });
    return {
      parties: [toParty(fresh, v.get(p!.id) || [])],
      messages: msgs.reverse().map(m => ({ id: m.id, text: m.text || '', senderName: m.senderName || '', senderEmail: m.senderEmail || '', isReaction: !!m.isReaction, sentAt: m.sentAt || '' })),
    };
  },
});


===== FILE: src/api/webSearch.ts =====

import { z } from 'zod';
import { createEndpoint } from 'zitejs/backend';
import { runSearch } from '../lib/searchCore';

export default createEndpoint({
  description: 'Searches the web for the in-app browser',
  inputSchema: z.object({ query: z.string().max(500) }),
  outputSchema: z.object({
    ok: z.boolean(),
    provider: z.string().optional(),
    query: z.string().optional(),
    results: z.array(z.object({ title: z.string(), url: z.string(), snippet: z.string(), source: z.string() })).optional(),
    code: z.string().optional(),
    message: z.string().optional(),
  }),
  execute: async ({ input }) => {
    const env = process.env as Record<string, string | undefined>;
    const r = await runSearch(input.query, { braveKey: env.ZITE_BRAVE_SEARCH_KEY || undefined }, (u, init) => fetch(u, init));
    if (!r.ok && r.code !== 'EMPTY_QUERY') console.error('[webSearch] failed', { code: r.code, status: r.status, queryLength: input.query.length });
    return r.ok ? { ok: true, provider: r.provider, query: r.query, results: r.results } : { ok: false, code: r.code, message: r.message };
  },
});
