import { useState } from 'react';
import { Gem } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { getShopBgThemes, getShopTypingStyles } from '../lib/cosmetics';
import { COSMETICS_EVENT } from './SettingsExtras';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { shopPrice, isVip } from '../lib/vip';

// Shop section for backgrounds and typing styles — buy, then equip right away
export default function CosmeticShop({ kind }: { kind: 'bg' | 'typing' }) {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const owned = DB.getUserItems(profile.email);
  const eq = DB.getEquipped(profile.email);
  const items = kind === 'bg' ? getShopBgThemes() : getShopTypingStyles();

  function equip(id: string) {
    DB.setEquipped(profile!.email, kind === 'bg' ? { bg: id } : { typing: id });
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(COSMETICS_EVENT));
    bump(n => n + 1);
  }
  function buy(id: string, base: number, name: string) {
    const cost = shopPrice(base, profile!.email);
    if (profile!.gems < cost) { toast.error(`Need ${cost - profile!.gems} more gems!`); return; }
    addGems(-cost);
    DB.addUserItem(profile!.email, id);
    equip(id);
    toast.success(`🎉 Unlocked & equipped ${name}!`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {items.map(it => {
        const isOwned = owned.includes(it.id);
        const isOn = (kind === 'bg' ? eq.bg : eq.typing) === it.id;
        return (
          <div key={it.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/30">
            {'css' in it
              ? <div className="w-14 h-10 rounded-lg border border-border flex-shrink-0" style={{ background: it.css }} />
              : <div className="w-14 h-10 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] flex-shrink-0">
                  <span className={it.className} style={{ color: it.color }}>{it.text.split(' ')[0]}</span>
                </div>}
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{it.name}</p>
              {'text' in it && <p className={`text-[11px] ${it.className}`} style={{ color: it.color }}>You {it.text}</p>}
            </div>
            {isOwned
              ? <Button size="sm" variant={isOn ? 'secondary' : 'outline'} className="text-xs" onClick={() => equip(isOn ? '' : it.id)}>{isOn ? 'Equipped ✓' : 'Equip'}</Button>
              : <Button size="sm" className="text-xs gap-1" disabled={profile.gems < shopPrice(it.cost, profile.email)} onClick={() => buy(it.id, it.cost, it.name)}><Gem className="w-3 h-3" />{shopPrice(it.cost, profile.email).toLocaleString()}{isVip(profile.email) && <span className="text-[10px]">👑−25%</span>}</Button>}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/CursorEffect.tsx =====

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { CURSOR_EVENT, cursorCss, getEquipped } from '../lib/cursors';

// Applies the player's equipped cursor across the whole app.
export default function CursorEffect() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const email = profile?.email || '';
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = document.createElement('style');
    document.head.appendChild(el);
    const apply = () => {
      const css = email ? cursorCss(getEquipped(email), email) : '';
      el.textContent = css ? `*, *::before, *::after { cursor: ${css} !important; }` : '';
    };
    apply();
    window.addEventListener(CURSOR_EVENT, apply);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener(CURSOR_EVENT, apply); el.remove(); };
  }, [email]);
  return null;
}


===== FILE: src/components/CursorShop.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { CURSORS, CursorItem, addOwned, equip, getEquipped, getOwned, cursorCss, cursorPrice } from '../lib/cursors';
import { useVip } from '../hooks/useVip';
import CustomCursorMaker from './CustomCursorMaker';

export default function CursorShop() {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const email = profile?.email || '';
  const { active: vip } = useVip(email);
  const [owned, setOwned] = useState(() => getOwned(email));
  const [equipped, setEquipped] = useState(() => getEquipped(email));
  if (!profile) return null;

  function use(c: CursorItem) { equip(email, c.id); setEquipped(c.id); }
  function buy(c: CursorItem) {
    const cost = cursorPrice(c, vip);
    if (c.vipOnly && !vip) { toast.error('This cursor is VIP only'); return; }
    if (profile!.gems < cost) { toast.error(`You need 💎 ${cost}`); return; }
    addGems(-cost);
    addOwned(email, c.id);
    setOwned(getOwned(email));
    use(c);
    toast.success(`${c.emoji} ${c.name} cursor bought and equipped!`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Change how your mouse looks everywhere. Hover a card to try it.</p>
      <CustomCursorMaker onChange={() => { setOwned(getOwned(email)); setEquipped(getEquipped(email)); }} />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
        {CURSORS.map(c => {
          const has = owned.includes(c.id), on = equipped === c.id;
          return (
            <div key={c.id} style={{ cursor: cursorCss(c.id) || undefined }}
              className={`rounded-xl border p-2 text-center space-y-1 ${on ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10' : 'border-border'}`}>
              <div className="text-3xl">{c.emoji}</div>
              <p className="font-semibold text-xs truncate">{c.name}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{c.vipOnly ? '👑 VIP · ' : ''}{c.price ? `💎 ${cursorPrice(c, vip)}` : 'Free'}</p>
              {on ? <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className="w-full h-7 text-xs gap-1" disabled><Check className="w-3 h-3" />On</Button>
                : has ? <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => use(c)}>Equip</Button>
                : <Button size="sm" className="w-full h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => buy(c)}>Buy</Button>}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/CustomBackground.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ImageIcon, Lock, Loader2, Upload } from 'lucide-react';
import { useUpload } from 'zitejs/upload';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as P from '../lib/personalize';

export default function CustomBackground() {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const { upload, isUploading } = useUpload();
  const [url, setUrl] = useState(() => (profile ? P.getCustomBg(profile.email) : ''));
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  if (!profile) return null;
  // Free for everyone now — upload your own background from files.
  const unlocked = true;

  function buy() {
    if (profile!.gems < P.CUSTOM_BG_PRICE) { toast.error(`You need ${P.CUSTOM_BG_PRICE} gems`); return; }
    addGems(-P.CUSTOM_BG_PRICE);
    P.unlockCustomBg(profile!.email);
    bump(n => n + 1);
    toast.success('Custom background unlocked forever!');
  }

  async function onFile(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) { toast.error('Pick an image file'); return; }
    try {
      const res = await upload(file);
      setUrl(res.url);
      P.setCustomBg(profile!.email, res.url);
      toast.success('Background set!');
    } catch {
      toast.error('Upload failed, try again');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"><ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />Custom Background</h3>
      {unlocked ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {url && <div className="h-24 rounded-lg border border-border bg-cover bg-center" style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${url})` }} />}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <label className="flex-1">
              <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={onFile} disabled={isUploading} />
              <span className="h-8 w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer">
                {isUploading ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {url ? 'Change picture' : 'Upload picture'}
              </span>
            </label>
            {url && <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-8 text-xs" onClick={() => { setUrl(''); P.setCustomBg(profile.email, ''); }}>Remove</Button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/30 text-center">
          <Lock className="w-4 h-4 mx-auto mb-1 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">Use your own picture as the app background. Pay once, keep it forever.</p>
          <Button size="sm" className="h-8 text-xs" onClick={buy}>Unlock for 💎 {P.CUSTOM_BG_PRICE}</Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/CustomCursorMaker.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Wand2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Slider } from '@project/components/ui/slider';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { CUSTOM_CURSOR_PRICE, addOwned, emojiCursorCss, equip, getCustom, getOwned, saveCustom } from '../lib/cursors';
import { isInfiniteGems } from '../lib/formatGems';
import { useVip } from '../hooks/useVip';

/** Lets a player design their own cursor from any emoji or symbol. */
export default function CustomCursorMaker({ onChange }: { onChange: () => void }) {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const email = profile?.email || '';
  const { active: vip } = useVip(email);
  const saved = getCustom(email);
  const [emoji, setEmoji] = useState(saved?.emoji || '🦊');
  const [size, setSize] = useState(saved?.size || 24);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const owns = vip || getOwned(email).includes('custom');
  const glyph = [...emoji.trim()].slice(0, 2).join('');

  function save() {
    if (!glyph) { toast.error('Type an emoji or symbol first'); return; }
    if (!owns) {
      if (!isInfiniteGems(profile!.gems) && profile!.gems < CUSTOM_CURSOR_PRICE) { toast.error(`You need 💎 ${CUSTOM_CURSOR_PRICE}`); return; }
      addGems(-CUSTOM_CURSOR_PRICE); addOwned(email, 'custom');
    }
    saveCustom(email, { emoji: glyph, size }); equip(email, 'custom'); onChange();
    toast.success(`${glyph} Custom cursor equipped!`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-primary/50 p-3 space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-sm"><Wand2 className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> Make your own cursor</div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-lg bg-muted grid place-items-center" style={{ cursor: glyph ? emojiCursorCss(glyph, size) : undefined, fontSize: size }}>{glyph || '?'}</div>
        <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
          <Input value={emoji} onChange={e => setEmoji(e.target.value)} placeholder="Type any emoji, e.g. 🦊" maxLength={8} />
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Size <Slider min={16} max={40} step={2} value={[size]} onValueChange={v => setSize(v[0])} className="flex-1" /> {size}px</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Button size="sm" className="w-full" onClick={save}>{owns ? (vip ? 'Save & equip · free for VIP' : 'Save & equip') : `Create · 💎 ${CUSTOM_CURSOR_PRICE}`}</Button>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/DailyLottery.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Ticket } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { formatGems } from '../lib/formatGems';

export const LOTTERY_MAX = 20_000_000;
const DAYS_OPEN = 7; // only the last 7 days of each month

// Weighted prize table — jackpot is the 20M max prize
const PRIZES: [number, number][] = [
  [100, 40], [500, 25], [1_000, 15], [5_000, 10], [25_000, 6], [100_000, 2.5], [1_000_000, 1], [5_000_000, 0.4], [LOTTERY_MAX, 0.1],
];

function draw() {
  const total = PRIZES.reduce((s, [, w]) => s + w, 0);
  let r = Math.random() * total;
  for (const [p, w] of PRIZES) { if ((r -= w) <= 0) return p; }
  return PRIZES[0][0];
}

function lotteryWindow(now = new Date()) {
  const last = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  const openFrom = last - DAYS_OPEN + 1;
  return { open: now.getDate() >= openFrom, openFrom, daysUntil: openFrom - now.getDate() };
}

export default function DailyLottery() {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const today = new Date().toDateString();
  const key = `nexus_lottery:${profile?.email}`;
  const [last, setLast] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(key));
  const [won, setWon] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const win = lotteryWindow();
  const played = last === today;

  function play() {
    if (!win.open || played) return;
    const prize = draw();
    localStorage.setItem(key, today);
    setLast(today);
    setWon(prize);
    addGems(prize, { noBonus: true });
    toast.success(prize === LOTTERY_MAX ? `🎉 JACKPOT! ${formatGems(prize)} gems!` : `You won ${formatGems(prize)} gems!`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-4 space-y-2">
      <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Ticket className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> Daily Lottery</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Free ticket every day during the last week of the month. Jackpot: 💎 {formatGems(LOTTERY_MAX)}</p>
      {won !== null && <p className="text-2xl font-black text-primary">+{formatGems(won)}</p>}
      {!win.open
        ? <p className="text-sm font-medium">Opens in {win.daysUntil} day{win.daysUntil === 1 ? '' : 's'} (on the {win.openFrom}th)</p>
        : <Button className="w-full" disabled={played} onClick={play}>{played ? 'Come back tomorrow' : '🎟️ Scratch today\'s ticket'}</Button>}
      {profile && <span className="sr-only">{profile.gems}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/DailyQuestsModal.tsx =====

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Progress } from '@project/components/ui/progress';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { formatStreak } from '../lib/storage';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Flame, Gift } from 'lucide-react';

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void };

export default function DailyQuestsModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const { profile, refreshProfile } = useApp();
  const [questProgress, setQuestProgress] = useState<DB.DailyQuestProgress | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !profile) return;
    setQuestProgress(DB.getDailyQuestProgress(profile.email));
    const t = setInterval(() => setQuestProgress(DB.getDailyQuestProgress(profile.email)), 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [open, profile?.email]);

  function claim(questId: string) {
    if (!profile) return;
    const reward = DB.claimQuestReward(profile.email, questId);
    if (reward > 0) {
      toast.success(`💎 +${reward} gems claimed!`);
      refreshProfile();
      setQuestProgress(DB.getDailyQuestProgress(profile.email));
    }
  }

  if (!profile || !questProgress) return null;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(v) => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md bg-card border-border">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg">
            <Gift className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-400" />
            Daily Quests
          </DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>

        {/* Streak display */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500/10 to-red-500/10 border border-orange-500/20">
          <Flame className="w-8 h-8 text-orange-400" />
          <div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-black text-orange-400">{formatStreak(profile.streak || 0)}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-semibold">Day Streak</p>
          </div>
          <div className="ml-auto text-right">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Log in daily to</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">keep your streak!</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quests */}
        <div className="space-y-2 mt-2">
          {DB.DAILY_QUESTS.map(quest => {
            const current = Math.min(questProgress.progress[quest.id] || 0, quest.target);
            const done = current >= quest.target;
            const claimed = questProgress.claimed.includes(quest.id);
            const pct = Math.round((current / quest.target) * 100);

            return (
              <div key={quest.id} className={`p-3 rounded-xl border transition-colors ${claimed ? 'bg-green-500/5 border-green-500/20' : done ? 'bg-yellow-500/5 border-yellow-500/30' : 'bg-secondary/30 border-border'}`}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <span className="text-xl">{quest.icon}</span>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{quest.title}</p>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-yellow-400">💎 {quest.reward}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{quest.description}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1.5">
                      <Progress value={pct} className="h-1.5 flex-1" />
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">{current}/{quest.target}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {claimed ? (
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-green-400">✓</span>
                  ) : done ? (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="default" className="text-xs h-7 px-2.5 bg-yellow-500 hover:bg-yellow-600 text-black font-bold" onClick={() => claim(quest.id)}>
                      Claim
                    </Button>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <p className="text-[10px] text-center text-muted-foreground mt-2">Quests reset every day at midnight</p>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export default function EmojiGifPicker({ onEmoji, onGif }: Props) {

  useEffect(() => {

    setLoading(true);
    gifsApi({ query: debounced }).then(r => setResults(r.gifs)).catch(() => setResults([])).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [debounced, open, tab]);

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button type="button" size="icon" variant="ghost" aria-label="Emoji and GIFs"><Smile className="w-5 h-5" /></Button>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-1">
                  {mine.map(m => (
                    <button key={m.id} onClick={() => { onGif(m.url); setOpen(false); }} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-secondary transition-transform hover:scale-110">

===== FILE: src/components/EventDialog.tsx =====

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { Switch } from '@project/components/ui/switch';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; date: string; isStaff: boolean; me: DB.UserProfile; onSaved: () => void };

const PRESETS = {
  holiday: { emoji: '🎉', color: '#f59e0b', role: 'Holiday Spirit' },
  event: { emoji: '📣', color: '#22d3ee', role: 'Event Guest' },
  birthday: { emoji: '🎂', color: '#ec4899', role: 'Birthday Star' },
};

export default function EventDialog({ open, onClose, date, isStaff, me, onSaved }: Props) {
  const [type, setType] = useState<DB.CalendarEvent['type']>(isStaff ? 'holiday' : 'birthday');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [emoji, setEmoji] = useState(PRESETS.holiday.emoji);
  const [color, setColor] = useState(PRESETS.holiday.color);
  const [roleName, setRoleName] = useState(PRESETS.holiday.role);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(me.email);
  const [yearly, setYearly] = useState(true);
  const [day, setDay] = useState(date);

  useEffect(() => { setDay(date); }, [date]);
  useEffect(() => { const p = PRESETS[type]; setEmoji(p.emoji); setColor(p.color); setRoleName(p.role); setYearly(type !== 'event'); }, [type]);

  function save() {
    const t = title.trim() || (type === 'birthday' ? `${DB.getUser(target)?.name || 'Someone'}'s Birthday` : '');
    if (!t) { toast.error('Give it a title'); return; }
    if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)) { toast.error('Pick a valid date'); return; }
    DB.addEvent({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), date: day, title: t, type, emoji, color, roleName: roleName.trim(), targetEmail: type === 'birthday' ? target : undefined, yearly, createdBy: me.email });
    toast.success(`${emoji} Added "${t}"`);
    setTitle(''); onSaved(); onClose();
  }

  const users = DB.getAllUsers();
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Add to calendar</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div><Label>Type</Label>
              <Select value={type} onValueChange={v => setType(v as DB.CalendarEvent['type'])}>
                <SelectTrigger className="mt-1"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {isStaff && <SelectItem value="holiday">🎉 Holiday</SelectItem>}
                  {isStaff && <SelectItem value="event">📣 Event</SelectItem>}
                  <SelectItem value="birthday">🎂 Birthday</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div><Label>Date</Label><Input type="date" value={day} onChange={e => setDay(e.target.value)} className="mt-1" /></div>
          </div>
          {type === 'birthday' && isStaff && (
            <div><Label>Whose birthday?</Label>
              <Select value={target} onValueChange={setTarget}>
                <SelectTrigger className="mt-1"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>{users.map(u => <SelectItem key={u.email} value={u.email}>{u.name}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          )}
          <div><Label>Title</Label><Input value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder={type === 'birthday' ? 'Auto: "Name\'s Birthday"' : 'e.g. Halloween, Game Night'} className="mt-1" /></div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-[70px_1fr_60px] gap-3">
            <div><Label>Emoji</Label><Input value={emoji} onChange={e => setEmoji(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 text-center" /></div>
            <div><Label>Daily role (shown all day)</Label><Input value={roleName} onChange={e => setRoleName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Leave empty for none" className="mt-1" /></div>
            <div><Label>Color</Label><input type="color" value={color} onChange={e => setColor(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full h-9 rounded cursor-pointer bg-transparent" /></div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{type === 'birthday' ? 'The birthday person gets this role badge on their day.' : 'Everyone gets this role badge in chat on that day.'}</p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between"><Label>Repeat every year</Label><Switch checked={yearly} onCheckedChange={setYearly} /></div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter><Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button onClick={save}>Add</Button></DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/EventShop.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Clock, RefreshCw, CalendarDays, Flag } from 'lucide-react';
import { itemOwners, events as eventsApi } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useActiveEvent, EVENTS_CHANGED } from '../hooks/useActiveEvent';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { format, formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { COSMETICS_EVENT } from './SettingsExtras';
import { ActiveEvent, HOLIDAYS, Holiday, appliesTo, limitedItems, tierFor, variantFor } from '../lib/holidays';
import { holidaySong } from '../lib/holidaySongs';
import { setMusic, getMusic } from '../lib/personalize';
import ShopMusic from './shop/ShopMusic';
import CountryPicker from './shop/CountryPicker';
import ShopItemCard, { ShopRow } from './shop/ShopItemCard';
import OwnerLimitedEditor from './shop/OwnerLimitedEditor';
import { shopPrice, isVip } from '../lib/vip';
import { useOwnerLimited, bgCss } from '../hooks/useOwnerLimited';

type Props = { event: ActiveEvent; open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void };

/** Which holiday's look the shop uses: a live national day always wins; otherwise the theme picked on the last refresh. */
function resolveTheme(event: ActiveEvent, shopTheme: string | null | undefined): Holiday {
  if (event.holiday.countries) return event.holiday;
  return HOLIDAYS.find(h => h.key === shopTheme) ?? event.holiday;
}

function safeItems(e: ActiveEvent, h: Holiday, drop: number) {
  try { return { holiday: h, ...limitedItems({ holiday: h, year: e.year, variant: variantFor(h, e.year) }, drop) }; }
  catch { return { holiday: e.holiday, ...limitedItems(e, drop) }; } // fall back to the event's own theme
}

export default function EventShop({ event, open, onOpenChange }: Props) {
  const { profile, addGems, updateProfile, isRealOwner } = useApp();
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  const { overrides, country } = useActiveEvent();
  const ov = overrides.find(o => o.holidayKey === event.holiday.key);
  const drop = ov?.shopDrop ?? 0;
  const { holiday: themeH, theme, typing, badge, tier } = useMemo(() => safeItems(event, resolveTheme(event, ov?.shopTheme), drop), [event, ov?.shopTheme, drop]);
  const variant = variantFor(themeH, event.year);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<Record<string, { count: number; firstEmail: string; firstName: string }>>({});
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const { items: ownerItems, mutate } = useOwnerLimited();
  const shownOwnerItems = ownerItems.filter(i => i.active && (!i.holidayKey || i.holidayKey === event.holiday.key));
  const ids = [theme.id, typing.id, badge.id, ...shownOwnerItems.map(i => `own-${i.id}`)].join(',');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    itemOwners({ action: 'stats', itemIds: ids.split(',') })
      .then(r => setStats(Object.fromEntries(r.stats.map(s => [s.itemId, s])))).catch(() => {});
  }, [open, ids]);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const song = holidaySong(themeH.key, event.year);
  const owned = DB.getUserItems(profile.email);
  const eq = DB.getEquipped(profile.email);
  const accent = typing.color;
  const me = profile.email.toLowerCase();
  const isNational = !!event.holiday.countries;

  const refreshShop = async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    // National day stays pinned; otherwise rotate to a random different holiday the user can see
    const pool = HOLIDAYS.filter(h => appliesTo(h, country) && h.key !== themeH.key);
    const next = isNational || !pool.length ? event.holiday.key : pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)].key;
    try {
      await eventsApi({ action: 'refreshShop', holidayKey: event.holiday.key, shopTheme: next });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENTS_CHANGED));
      const h = HOLIDAYS.find(x => x.key === next);
      toast.success(`🔄 Drop ${(drop % 30) + 1}/30 — ${h?.emoji ?? ''} ${h?.name ?? ''} theme!${drop === 30 ? ' Looped back to the first drop.' : ''}`);
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not refresh'); }
    finally { setRefreshing(false); }
  };

  const pay = (id: string, base: number, name: string) => {
    const cost = shopPrice(base, profile.email);
    if (profile.gems < cost) { toast.error(`Need ${(cost - profile.gems).toLocaleString()} more gems!`); return false; }
    addGems(-cost); DB.addUserItem(profile.email, id); toast.success(`🎉 You got ${name}! Limited — gone after this event.`);
    itemOwners({ action: 'claim', itemId: id, ownerName: profile.name })
      .then(r => r.stats[0] && setStats(s => ({ ...s, [id]: r.stats[0] }))).catch(() => {});
    return true;
  };
  const equip = (patch: { bg?: string; typing?: string }) => { DB.setEquipped(profile.email, patch); window.dispatchEvent(new Event(COSMETICS_EVENT)); bump(n => n + 1); };
  const wearBadge = () => { updateProfile({ activeTitle: `${badge.emoji} ${badge.name}`, activeTitleColor: badge.color, activeTitleEffect: 'glow' }); bump(n => n + 1); };

  const box = 'w-20 h-16 rounded-xl border border-white/15 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center';
  const rows: ShopRow[] = [
    { id: theme.id, label: 'Limited Background', name: theme.name, cost: theme.cost, preview: <div className={box} style={{ background: theme.css }} />,
      on: eq.bg === theme.id, use: () => equip({ bg: eq.bg === theme.id ? '' : theme.id }) },
    { id: typing.id, label: 'Limited Typing Effect', name: typing.name, cost: typing.cost, preview: <div className={`${box} bg-background text-3xl`}>{variant.badgeEmoji}</div>,
      sub: <p className={`text-xs rounded-lg bg-background/60 px-2 py-1.5 ${typing.className}`} style={{ color: typing.color }}>You {typing.text}</p>, on: eq.typing === typing.id, use: () => equip({ typing: eq.typing === typing.id ? '' : typing.id }) },
    { id: badge.id, label: 'Limited Badge', name: `${badge.emoji} ${badge.name}`, cost: badge.cost, preview: <div className={`${box} text-4xl`} style={{ background: `${accent}22` }}>{badge.emoji}</div>,
      on: profile.activeTitle === `${badge.emoji} ${badge.name}`, use: wearBadge },
    { id: song.id, label: 'Limited Song', name: song.name, cost: song.cost, preview: <div className={`${box} text-3xl`} style={{ background: `${accent}22` }}>🎵</div>,
      sub: <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{song.genre} · {song.mood}{song.lyrics ? ` · “${song.lyrics[1]}”` : ''}</p>,
      on: getMusic().url === song.url, use: () => { setMusic({ ...getMusic(), url: song.url }); toast.success('Added to your songs — open the 🎵 music player to play it'); window.dispatchEvent(new Event(COSMETICS_EVENT)); bump(n => n + 1); } },
  ];
  for (const i of shownOwnerItems) {
    const id = `own-${i.id}`;
    if (i.kind === 'Background') rows.push({ id, label: '👑 Owner Exclusive Background', name: `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`, cost: i.cost,
      preview: <div className={box} style={{ background: bgCss(i) }} />, on: eq.bg === id, use: () => equip({ bg: eq.bg === id ? '' : id }) });
    else if (i.kind === 'Typing Effect') rows.push({ id, label: '👑 Owner Exclusive Typing', name: `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`, cost: i.cost,
      preview: <div className={`${box} bg-background text-3xl`}>{i.emoji}</div>,
      sub: <p className={`text-xs rounded-lg bg-background/60 px-2 py-1.5 ${i.effect === 'rainbow' ? 'title-rainbow' : i.effect === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}`} style={{ color: i.color }}>You {i.typingText} {i.emoji}</p>,
      on: eq.typing === id, use: () => equip({ typing: eq.typing === id ? '' : id }) });
    else if (i.kind === 'Music') rows.push({ id, label: '👑 Owner Exclusive Song', name: `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`, cost: i.cost,
      preview: <div className={`${box} text-3xl`} style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg,${i.color}55,${i.color2}55)` }}>🎵</div>,
      on: getMusic().url === i.songUrl,
      use: () => { setMusic({ ...getMusic(), url: i.songUrl }); toast.success('Added to your songs — open the 🎵 music player to play it'); window.dispatchEvent(new Event(COSMETICS_EVENT)); bump(n => n + 1); } });
    else rows.push({ id, label: '👑 Owner Exclusive Title', name: `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`, cost: i.cost,
      preview: <div className={`${box} text-3xl`} style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg,${i.color}55,${i.color2}55)` }}>{i.emoji}</div>,
      on: profile.activeTitle === `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`,
      use: () => { updateProfile({ activeTitle: `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`, activeTitleColor: i.color, activeTitleEffect: i.effect === 'none' ? '' : i.effect }); bump(n => n + 1); } });
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-3xl w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto p-0 border-white/10 gap-0">
        {/* Themed hero */}
        <div className="relative px-5 pt-6 pb-5 sm:px-7 text-white" style={{ background: theme.css }}>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/55 via-black/45 to-black/75" />
          <div className="relative space-y-3">
            <DialogHeader className="text-left space-y-1">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em]" style={{ color: accent }}>{isNational ? 'National Day Event' : 'Limited Holiday Shop'} · {tier.name}</p>
              <DialogTitle className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black leading-tight drop-shadow">{themeH.emoji} {themeH.name} — {variant.name}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-white/80 text-sm">{variant.tagline}</DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-white/85">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><CalendarDays className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{event.holiday.emoji} {event.holiday.name} · {format(event.day, 'EEEE, MMM d, yyyy')}</span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />Ends {formatDistanceToNow(event.end, { addSuffix: true })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
              <ShopMusic songUrl={song.url} title={song.name} open={open} />
              <CountryPicker country={country} />
              {isRealOwner && (
                <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className="gap-1.5 h-8 text-xs" disabled={refreshing} onClick={refreshShop}>
                  <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> Refresh shop · {drop || 0}/30
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
            {!country && <p className="text-[11px] text-white/75 flex items-center gap-1"><Flag className="w-3 h-3" />Pick your country to unlock national-day events like Independence Day.</p>}
            {isNational && isRealOwner && <p className="text-[11px] text-white/75">National day is live — refreshes upgrade items but keep this theme.</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
        {/* Items */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-background">
          {rows.map((r, i) => (

===== FILE: src/components/FeedbackModal.tsx =====

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/tabs';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { Bug, Lightbulb, ThumbsUp, Plus, CheckCircle, Clock, Circle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; defaultTab?: 'bugs' | 'suggestions' };

const STATUS_META: Record<DB.Bug['status'], { label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; color: string }> = {
  open:        { label: 'Open',        icon: <Circle className="w-3 h-3" />,        color: 'text-yellow-400' },
  'in-progress': { label: 'In Progress', icon: <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />,         color: 'text-blue-400' },
  resolved:    { label: 'Resolved',    icon: <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />,    color: 'text-green-400' },
};

export default function FeedbackModal({ open, onClose, defaultTab = 'bugs' }: Props) {
  const { profile, updateProfile, checkAchievements } = useApp();

  // Bug state
  const [bugTitle, setBugTitle] = useState('');
  const [bugDesc, setBugDesc] = useState('');
  const [showBugForm, setShowBugForm] = useState(false);
  const [bugs, setBugs] = useState<DB.Bug[]>([]);

  // Suggestion state
  const [sugTitle, setSugTitle] = useState('');
  const [sugDesc, setSugDesc] = useState('');
  const [showSugForm, setShowSugForm] = useState(false);
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<DB.Suggestion[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setBugs(DB.getBugs());
      setSuggestions(DB.getSuggestions().sort((a, b) => b.upvotes - a.upvotes));
    }
  }, [open]);

  function submitBug() {
    if (!profile || !bugTitle.trim() || !bugDesc.trim()) { toast.error('Fill in all fields'); return; }
    const bug: DB.Bug = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), title: bugTitle.trim(), description: bugDesc.trim(), reporterEmail: profile.email, reporterName: profile.name, status: 'open', timestamp: Date.now() };
    DB.addBug(bug);
    const updated = { ...profile, bugCount: profile.bugCount + 1 };
    DB.saveUser(updated); updateProfile(updated);
    toast.success('Bug reported! Thanks 🐛');
    setTimeout(checkAchievements, 200);
    setBugTitle(''); setBugDesc(''); setShowBugForm(false);
    setBugs(DB.getBugs());
  }

  function submitSuggestion() {
    if (!profile || !sugTitle.trim() || !sugDesc.trim()) { toast.error('Fill in all fields'); return; }
    const sug: DB.Suggestion = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), title: sugTitle.trim(), description: sugDesc.trim(), submitterEmail: profile.email, upvotes: 0, upvoters: [], timestamp: Date.now() };
    DB.addSuggestion(sug);
    const updated = { ...profile, suggestionCount: profile.suggestionCount + 1 };
    DB.saveUser(updated); updateProfile(updated);
    toast.success('Suggestion submitted! 💡');
    setTimeout(checkAchievements, 200);
    setSugTitle(''); setSugDesc(''); setShowSugForm(false);
    setSuggestions(DB.getSuggestions().sort((a, b) => b.upvotes - a.upvotes));
  }

  function upvote(id: string) {
    if (!profile) return;
    DB.upvoteSuggestion(id, profile.email);
    setSuggestions(DB.getSuggestions().sort((a, b) => b.upvotes - a.upvotes));
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-md max-h-[85vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Bug className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
            Bugs & Suggestions
          </DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>

        <Tabs defaultValue={defaultTab} className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          <TabsList className="w-full">
            <TabsTrigger value="bugs" className="flex-1 gap-1.5">
              <Bug className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Bugs
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="suggestions" className="flex-1 gap-1.5">
              <Lightbulb className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Suggestions
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          {/* ── Bugs Tab ── */}
          <TabsContent value="bugs" className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto mt-3 space-y-3">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full gap-1.5" onClick={() => setShowBugForm(v => !v)}>
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{showBugForm ? 'Cancel' : 'Report a Bug'}
            </Button>

            {showBugForm && (
              <div className="space-y-3 p-3 bg-secondary/30 border border-border rounded-xl">
                <div><Label>Bug Title</Label><Input value={bugTitle} onChange={e => setBugTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="What went wrong?" className="mt-1" /></div>
                <div><Label>Description</Label><Textarea value={bugDesc} onChange={e => setBugDesc(e.target.value)} placeholder="Describe the issue in detail…" rows={3} className="mt-1 resize-none" /></div>
                <Button onClick={submitBug} size="sm" className="w-full">Submit Bug 🐛</Button>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-2">
              {bugs.length === 0 && <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm py-4">No bugs reported yet!</p>}
              {bugs.map(bug => {
                const s = STATUS_META[bug.status];
                return (
                  <div key={bug.id} className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/20 space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <p className="font-semibold text-sm leading-tight">{bug.title}</p>
                      <span className={cn('flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold flex-shrink-0', s.color)}>
                        {s.icon}{s.label}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{bug.description}</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">by {bug.reporterName}</p>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>

          {/* ── Suggestions Tab ── */}
          <TabsContent value="suggestions" className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto mt-3 space-y-3">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full gap-1.5" onClick={() => setShowSugForm(v => !v)}>
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{showSugForm ? 'Cancel' : 'New Suggestion'}
            </Button>

            {showSugForm && (
              <div className="space-y-3 p-3 bg-secondary/30 border border-border rounded-xl">
                <div><Label>Title</Label><Input value={sugTitle} onChange={e => setSugTitle(e.target.value)} className="mt-1" /></div>
                <div><Label>Description</Label><Textarea value={sugDesc} onChange={e => setSugDesc(e.target.value)} rows={3} className="mt-1 resize-none" /></div>
                <Button onClick={submitSuggestion} size="sm" className="w-full">Submit 💡</Button>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-2">
              {suggestions.length === 0 && <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm py-4">No suggestions yet. Be the first!</p>}
              {suggestions.map(s => (
                <div key={s.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/20">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => upvote(s.id)}
                    className={cn('flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 flex-shrink-0 p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors',
                      s.upvoters.includes(profile?.email || '') ? 'bg-primary/30 text-primary' : 'hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground')}
                  >
                    <ThumbsUp className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold">{s.upvotes}</span>
                  </button>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-sm">{s.title}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{s.description}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/FriendButton.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { friends as friendsApi } from 'zitejs/api';
import { UserPlus, UserCheck, Clock, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';

type Status = 'none' | 'friends' | 'outgoing' | 'incoming';

export default function FriendButton({ email }: { email: string }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const target = email.toLowerCase();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const apply = (r: { friends: string[]; incoming: string[]; outgoing: string[] }) =>
    setStatus(r.friends.includes(target) ? 'friends' : r.outgoing.includes(target) ? 'outgoing' : r.incoming.includes(target) ? 'incoming' : 'none');

  useEffect(() => { friendsApi({ action: 'list' }).then(apply).catch(() => setStatus('none')); }, [target]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (profile?.email.toLowerCase() === target) return null;

  async function run(action: 'request' | 'accept' | 'remove', msg: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    try { apply(await friendsApi({ action, email: target })); toast.success(msg); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Something went wrong'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  if (status === null) return <Button variant="outline" className="w-full" disabled><Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /></Button>;
  if (status === 'friends') return (
    <Button variant="outline" className="w-full gap-2" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('remove', 'Removed friend')}>
      <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" /> Friends · Unfriend
    </Button>
  );
  if (status === 'outgoing') return (
    <Button variant="outline" className="w-full gap-2" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('remove', 'Request cancelled')}>
      <Clock className="w-4 h-4" /> Request sent · Cancel
    </Button>
  );
  if (status === 'incoming') return (
    <Button className="w-full gap-2" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('accept', 'Friend added!')}>
      <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" /> Accept friend request
    </Button>
  );
  return (
    <Button variant="secondary" className="w-full gap-2" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('request', 'Friend request sent!')}>
      <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" /> Add Friend
    </Button>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/FriendsDialog.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Check, UserMinus, UserPlus, MessageCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { friends as friendsApi, FriendsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';

const errMsg = (e: unknown) => (e as { userFacingMessage?: string; message?: string })?.userFacingMessage || (e as Error)?.message || 'Something went wrong';
export const displayName = (email: string) => DB.getUser(email)?.name || email;

type Props = { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onMessage: (email: string) => void };

export default function FriendsDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onMessage }: Props) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<FriendsOutputType | null>(null);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const run = async (action: 'list' | 'request' | 'accept' | 'remove', target?: string, msg?: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { setData(await friendsApi({ action, email: target })); if (msg) toast.success(msg); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { if (open) run('list'); }, [open]);

  const send = async () => { if (!email.trim()) return; await run('request', email.trim(), 'Friend request sent'); setEmail(''); };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Friends</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Input value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && send()} placeholder="friend@email.com" />
          <Button onClick={send} disabled={busy || !email.trim()}>{busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}</Button>
        </div>
        {!data ? <Skeleton className="h-32" /> : (
          <div className="space-y-4 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
            {data.incoming.length > 0 && <Section title="Requests">
              {data.incoming.map(e => <Row key={e} email={e}>
                <Button size="sm" onClick={() => run('accept', e, 'Friend added!')}><Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => run('remove', e)}>Decline</Button>
              </Row>)}
            </Section>}
            <Section title={`Friends (${data.friends.length})`}>
              {!data.friends.length && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground px-1">No friends yet — add someone by email.</p>}
              {data.friends.map(e => <Row key={e} email={e}>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" title="Message" onClick={() => { onMessage(e); onOpenChange(false); }}><MessageCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" title="Unfriend" className="text-destructive" onClick={() => run('remove', e, 'Removed')}><UserMinus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
              </Row>)}
            </Section>
            {data.outgoing.length > 0 && <Section title="Sent">
              {data.outgoing.map(e => <Row key={e} email={e}><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => run('remove', e)}>Cancel</Button></Row>)}
            </Section>}
          </div>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <div><p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground mb-1">{title}</p><div className="space-y-1">{children}</div></div>;
}

function Row({ email, children }: { email: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-secondary/40">
      <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-primary">{displayName(email)[0]?.toUpperCase()}</div>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"><p className="text-sm truncate">{displayName(email)}</p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{email}</p></div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/FriendsWatching.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Clapperboard, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { watchParty, WatchPartyOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';

type Party = WatchPartyOutputType['parties'][0];

/** Strip showing watch parties friends are in, plus a one-time invite toast per party. */
export default function FriendsWatching() {
  const [parties, setParties] = useState<Party[]>([]);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
  const invited = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();

  useEffect(() => {
    const load = () => watchParty({ action: 'friends' }).then(r => {
      setParties(r.parties);
      for (const p of r.parties) {
        if (invited.current.has(p.id)) continue;
        invited.current.add(p.id);
        const live = new Date(p.scheduledFor).getTime() <= Date.now();
        toast(`🍿 ${p.hostName} ${live ? 'started' : 'is starting'} a watch party`, {
          description: p.title,
          action: { label: 'Join', onClick: () => nav(`/watch/${p.id}`) },
        });
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 20_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  if (hidden || !parties.length || pathname.startsWith('/watch')) return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto border-b border-border bg-primary/5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs">
      <Clapperboard className="h-3.5 w-3.5 flex-shrink-0 text-primary" />
      <span className="flex-shrink-0 font-semibold">Friends watching:</span>
      {parties.map(p => {
        const who = p.viewers.length ? p.viewers.map(v => v.name).slice(0, 2).join(', ') : p.hostName;
        return (
          <button key={p.id} onClick={() => nav(`/watch/${p.id}`)} className="flex-shrink-0 rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-2.5 py-0.5 transition hover:border-primary">
            {who} · <span className="font-medium">{p.title}</span> · <span className="text-primary">Join</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
      <button onClick={() => setHidden(true)} className="ml-auto flex-shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" aria-label="Hide"><X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/GambleModal.tsx =====

import { formatGems } from '../lib/formatGems';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { Gem } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void };

const SLOTS = ['💎','🎰','🍒','🍋','⭐','💀','🎲','👑'];

export default function GambleModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const { profile, addGems, updateProfile, checkAchievements } = useApp();
  const [bet, setBet] = useState('50');
  const [spinning, setSpinning] = useState(false);
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState(['❓','❓','❓']);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<null | { win: boolean; amount: number; message: string }>(null);

  if (!profile) return null;

  function spin() {
    const amount = parseInt(bet);
    if (isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) { toast.error('Enter a valid bet'); return; }
    if (amount > profile!.gems) { toast.error('Not enough gems!'); return; }
    setSpinning(true); setResult(null);
    addGems(-amount);

    let ticks = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setSlots([SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)]]);
      ticks++;
      if (ticks > 15) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        const finalSlots = [SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)]];
        setSlots(finalSlots);
        const win = Math.random() < 0.4;
        let payout = 0;
        let msg = '';
        if (finalSlots[0] === finalSlots[1] && finalSlots[1] === finalSlots[2]) { payout = amount * 5; msg = `JACKPOT! Triple ${finalSlots[0]}! 🎉`; }
        else if (finalSlots[0] === finalSlots[1] || finalSlots[1] === finalSlots[2]) { payout = amount * 2; msg = 'Pair! You doubled up! 🙌'; }
        else if (win) { payout = Math.floor(amount * 1.5); msg = 'Lucky! Small win 😊'; }
        else { msg = 'No luck this time 😢'; }
        if (payout > 0) addGems(payout);

        const p = DB.getUser(profile!.email)!;
        const didWin = payout > 0;
        const newStreak = didWin ? 0 : p.gambleLoseStreak + 1;
        const updated = { ...p, gambleCount: p.gambleCount + 1, gambleWins: p.gambleWins + (didWin ? 1 : 0), gambleLoseStreak: newStreak };
        DB.saveUser(updated); updateProfile(updated);
        setResult({ win: didWin, amount: payout, message: msg });
        setSpinning(false);
        setTimeout(checkAchievements, 300);
      }
    }, 80);
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-sm">
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle className="text-center">🎰 Gem Gambler</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4 mt-2">
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-3">
            {slots.map((s, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="w-16 h-16 bg-secondary rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-3xl border-2 border-border shadow-inner">
                <span className={spinning ? 'animate-bounce' : ''}>{s}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {result && (
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl text-center text-sm font-semibold ${result.win ? 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border border-green-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30'}`}>
              {result.message}
              {result.win && <div className="text-xs mt-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">+{result.amount} <Gem className="w-3 h-3" /></div>}
            </div>
          )}
          <div><Label>Bet Amount</Label>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">
              <Input type="number" value={bet} onChange={e => setBet(e.target.value)} className="flex-1" />
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setBet(String(Math.floor(profile.gems / 2)))}>Half</Button>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setBet(String(profile.gems))}>All</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Gem className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />{formatGems(profile.gems)} gems</span>
            <span>Win rate ~40% • Jackpot 5x</span>
          </div>
          <Button className="w-full" onClick={spin} disabled={spinning}>{spinning ? 'Spinning…' : '🎰 Spin!'}</Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

type Props = {
  name: string;
  color: string;
  color2?: string;
  className?: string;
};

export default function GradientName({ name, color, color2, className = '' }: Props) {
  if (color2) {
    return (
      <span className={className} style={{
        backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${color}, ${color2})`,
        WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text',
        WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent',
        backgroundClip: 'text',
      }}>{name}</span>
    );
  }
  return <span className={className} style={{ color }}>{name}</span>;
}


===== FILE: src/components/GroupSettingsDialog.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Globe, Lock, UserPlus, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { groups as groupsApi, friends as friendsApi, GroupsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Switch } from '@project/components/ui/switch';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { displayName } from './FriendsDialog';

export type Group = GroupsOutputType['groups'][number];
const errMsg = (e: unknown) => (e as { userFacingMessage?: string; message?: string })?.userFacingMessage || (e as Error)?.message || 'Something went wrong';

type Props = { group: Group | null; me: string; onClose: () => void; onChanged: (g: Group[]) => void };

export default function GroupSettingsDialog({ group, me, onClose, onChanged }: Props) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [friendList, setFriendList] = useState<string[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => { if (group) friendsApi({ action: 'list' }).then(r => setFriendList(r.friends)).catch(() => {}); }, [group?.id]);
  if (!group) return null;
  const isOwner = group.ownerEmail === me.toLowerCase();

  const act = async (input: Parameters<typeof groupsApi>[0], msg?: string) => {
    try { const r = await groupsApi(input); onChanged(r.groups); if (msg) toast.success(msg); return true; }
    catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); return false; }
  };
  const add = async (who: string) => { if (await act({ action: 'addMember', id: group.id, email: who }, `Added ${displayName(who)}`)) setEmail(''); };
  const addable = friendList.filter(f => !group.members.includes(f));

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={o => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>{group.name}</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {group.visibility === 'Public' ? <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> : <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />}
            <div><Label>{group.visibility === 'Public' ? 'Public' : 'Private'}</Label>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{group.visibility === 'Public' ? 'Anyone can find and join' : 'Only people added can see it'}</p></div>
          </div>
          <Switch checked={group.visibility === 'Public'} disabled={!isOwner}
            onCheckedChange={v => act({ action: 'setVisibility', id: group.id, visibility: v ? 'Public' : 'Private' }, v ? 'Group is now public' : 'Group is now private')} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Input value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && email.trim() && add(email.trim())} placeholder="Add by email" />
          <Button onClick={() => add(email.trim())} disabled={!email.trim()}><UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
        </div>
        {addable.length > 0 && <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {addable.map(f => <Button key={f} size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => add(f)}>+ {displayName(f)}</Button>)}
        </div>}
        <div>
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground mb-1">Members ({group.members.length})</p>
          <div className="space-y-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">
            {group.members.map(m => (
              <div key={m} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-md bg-secondary/40 text-sm">
                <span className="flex-1 truncate">{displayName(m)}{m === group.ownerEmail && <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 ml-1">owner</span>}</span>
                {isOwner && m !== group.ownerEmail && <button onClick={() => act({ action: 'removeMember', id: group.id, email: m })} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"><X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        {isOwner
          ? <Button variant="destructive" onClick={async () => { if (await act({ action: 'delete', id: group.id }, 'Group deleted')) onClose(); }}>Delete group</Button>
          : <Button variant="outline" onClick={async () => { if (await act({ action: 'leave', id: group.id }, 'Left group')) onClose(); }}>Leave group</Button>}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { Timer } from 'lucide-react';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { CAL_HOLIDAYS, daysUntil, nextOccurrence, upcoming } from '../lib/calendarHolidays';

const KEY = 'nexus_countdown_holiday';

/** Pick a holiday and see how many days are left until it. */
export default function HolidayCountdown() {
  const [key, setKey] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(KEY) || upcoming(1)[0].key);
  const h = CAL_HOLIDAYS.find(x => x.key === key) || CAL_HOLIDAYS[0];
  const n = daysUntil(h);
  const pick = (k: string) => { setKey(k); localStorage.setItem(KEY, k); };

  return (
    <div className="mb-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4" style={{ borderLeft: `4px solid ${h.color}` }}>
      <span className="text-5xl">{h.emoji}</span>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-[160px]">
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"><Timer className="w-3 h-3" />Countdown</p>
        <p className="text-3xl font-black tabular-nums" style={{ color: h.color }}>
          {n === 0 ? "It's today! 🎉" : `${n} day${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}
        </p>
        <p className="text-sm">until <b>{h.name}</b> · {format(nextOccurrence(h), 'EEE, MMM d, yyyy')}</p>
      </div>
      <Select value={h.key} onValueChange={pick}>
        <SelectTrigger className="w-60"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>
          {CAL_HOLIDAYS.map(x => <SelectItem key={x.key} value={x.key}>{x.emoji} {x.name} — {daysUntil(x)}d</SelectItem>)}
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { ActiveEvent } from '../lib/holidays';

function Web({ className }: { className: string }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" className={className} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.2">
      {[0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90].map(a => { const r = (a * Math.PI) / 180; return <line key={a} x1="0" y1="0" x2={200 * Math.cos(r)} y2={200 * Math.sin(r)} />; })}
      {[40, 80, 120, 160].map(rad => (
        <path key={rad} d={[0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90].map((a, i) => { const r = (a * Math.PI) / 180; const k = rad * (i % 2 ? 0.92 : 1); return `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${k * Math.cos(r)},${k * Math.sin(r)}`; }).join(' ')} />
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

/** Full-screen, click-through holiday decorations. */
export default function HolidayDecor({ event }: { event: ActiveEvent }) {
  const { variant, holiday } = event;
  const accent = variant.colors[2];

    e: variant.particles[i % variant.particles.length], left: (i * 53) % 100, delay: (i * 1.7) % 12, dur: 10 + ((i * 7) % 10), size: 14 + ((i * 5) % 14),
  })), [variant]);

  return (
    <div className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[5] overflow-hidden" aria-hidden>
      {bits.map((b, i) => (
        <span key={i} className="holiday-fall absolute -top-10 opacity-70" style={{ left: `${b.left}%`, animationDelay: `${b.delay}s`, animationDuration: `${b.dur}s`, fontSize: b.size }}>{b.e}</span>
      ))}
      {holiday.decor === 'spooky' && (
        <>
          <div style={{ color: accent }} className="opacity-40"><Web className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-40 h-40 -scale-x-100" /><Web className="absolute bottom-0 left-56 w-32 h-32 -scale-y-100" /></div>

      ))}

      {holiday.decor === 'clover' && (

          <span className="absolute bottom-3 right-6 text-4xl holiday-dangle">🪙</span>
          <span className="absolute top-3 left-60 text-3xl holiday-beat">🍀</span>
        </>
      )}
      {holiday.decor === 'eggs' && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-56 right-0 flex justify-around items-end text-3xl">
          {['🥚', '🌷', '🐰', '🥚', '🌼', '🐣', '🌷', '🥚'].map((e, i) => <span key={i} className="holiday-hop" style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.35}s` }}>{e}</span>)}
        </div>
      )}
      {holiday.decor === 'leaves' && (
        <>
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 text-4xl flex gap-1 -rotate-12 opacity-80">🍁🍂🍁</div>
          <span className="absolute bottom-3 right-6 text-5xl holiday-hop">🦃</span>
          <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ boxShadow: `inset 0 0 150px ${variant.colors[1]}66` }} />
        </>
      )}
      {holiday.decor === 'snow' && (
        <>
          <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-6 opacity-80" style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 100%, #fff 0 40%, transparent 41%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 100%, #fff 0 45%, transparent 46%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 100%, #fff 0 40%, transparent 41%)' }} />
          <span className="absolute bottom-3 right-8 text-5xl">⛄</span>
          <span className="absolute top-3 right-4 text-3xl holiday-dangle">🔔</span>
        </>
      )}
      {holiday.decor === 'snow' && (
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 flex justify-around">
          {Array.from({ length: 24 }).map((_, i) => <span key={i} className="holiday-twinkle w-2 h-3 rounded-full" style={{ background: ['#ef4444', '#22c55e', '#facc15', '#3b82f6'][i % 4], animationDelay: `${(i % 4) * 0.4}s` }} />)}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/ItemSwitcher.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Tag } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { getInventory } from '../lib/inventory';

const COSMETICS_EVENT = 'nexus-cosmetics';

/** Collapses items with the same name into one entry with a count. */
function groupByName<T extends { name: string }>(items: T[]) {
  const m = new Map<string, { item: T; count: number }>();
  for (const i of items) { const g = m.get(i.name); if (g) g.count++; else m.set(i.name, { item: i, count: 1 }); }
  return [...m.values()];
}

/** Switch between owned original + limited themes, typing effects and titles. */
export default function ItemSwitcher({ showTitles = true }: { showTitles?: boolean }) {
  const { profile, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = () => bump(n => n + 1);
    window.addEventListener(COSMETICS_EVENT, f);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(COSMETICS_EVENT, f);
  }, []);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const inv = getInventory(profile.email);
  const eq = DB.getEquipped(profile.email);

  function equip(patch: Partial<{ bg: string; typing: string }>) {
    DB.setEquipped(profile!.email, patch);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(COSMETICS_EVENT));
  }

  const chip = (active: boolean) => `px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-[11px] transition-colors ${active ? 'border-primary bg-primary/15 text-foreground font-semibold' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary'}`;
  const Row = ({ kind, active, onPick }: { kind: 'theme' | 'typing' | 'title'; active: string; onPick: (id: string) => void }) => (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      <button className={chip(!active)} onClick={() => onPick('')}>Default</button>
      {groupByName(inv.filter(i => i.kind === kind)).map(({ item: i, count }) => (
        <button key={i.id} className={chip(active === i.id)} onClick={() => onPick(i.id)}>
          {i.name}{i.limited && <span className="ml-1 text-[9px] px-1 rounded bg-primary/20 text-primary">LIMITED</span>}
          {count > 1 && <span className="ml-1 text-[9px] font-bold px-1 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-500">×{count}</span>}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2"><Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />My Items <span className="text-[11px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">original + limited</span></h3>
      <div><p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1.5">Theme</p><Row kind="theme" active={eq.bg} onPick={id => { equip({ bg: id }); toast.success('Theme switched'); }} /></div>
      <div><p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1.5">Typing effect</p><Row kind="typing" active={eq.typing} onPick={id => { equip({ typing: id }); toast.success('Typing effect switched'); }} /></div>
      {showTitles && (
        <div><p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1"><Tag className="w-3 h-3" />Title</p>
          <Row kind="title" active={profile.activeTitle} onPick={id => { updateProfile({ activeTitle: id }); toast.success(id ? `Wearing "${id}"` : 'Title removed'); }} />
        </div>
      )}
      {inv.length === 0 && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Buy items in the Shop or the limited event shop.</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

const CLOAK_PRESETS = [
  { label: 'Google Docs', title: 'Untitled document - Google Docs', favicon: 'https://ssl.gstatic.com/docs/documents/images/kix-favicon7.ico' },
  { label: 'Google Drive', title: 'My Drive - Google Drive', favicon: 'https://ssl.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/drive_2020q4_32dp.png' },
  { label: 'Google Classroom', title: 'Google Classroom', favicon: 'https://ssl.gstatic.com/classroom/favicon.png' },

function openCloakedTab() {
  const appUrl = window.location.href;
  const win = window.open('about:blank', '_blank');
  if (!win) {
    toast.error('Pop-ups are blocked! Allow pop-ups for this site first.');
    return false;
  }

  const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nexus_cloak') || '{}');
  const preset = CLOAK_PRESETS.find(p => p.label === saved.preset) || CLOAK_PRESETS[0];
  const title = saved.customTitle || preset.title;
  const favicon = saved.customFavicon || preset.favicon;

  win.document.open();
  win.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head>
<title>${title}</title>
<link rel="icon" href="${favicon}">
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden}iframe{width:100vw;height:100vh;border:none;display:block}</style>
</head><body>
<iframe src="${appUrl}" allow="microphone;camera;clipboard-write"></iframe>
<script>window.addEventListener('beforeunload',function(e){e.preventDefault();});</script>
</body></html>`);
  win.document.close();

  toast.success(`🔒 Opened as "${title.slice(0, 30)}…"`);
  return true;
}

// Auto about:blank: on the first click, reopen the app inside a cloaked tab
// and send this tab somewhere harmless. Skipped when already inside the cloak.
function useAutoCloak() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (window.self !== window.top) return;
    if (localStorage.getItem('nexus_autocloak') === 'off') return;
    const go = () => {
      if (openCloakedTab()) window.location.replace('https://classroom.google.com');
    };
    window.addEventListener('click', go, { once: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('click', go);
  }, []);
}

        <div className="bg-card border-2 border-primary/30 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="bg-primary/10 px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-primary/20">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Megaphone className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary uppercase tracking-wider">📢 Announcement</p>

            <button onClick={onDismiss} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors p-1">

          </div>
          {announcement.content && (
            <div className="px-5 py-4">
