function SettingsPanel({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nexus_cloak') || '{}'));
  const [selectedPreset, setSelectedPreset] = useState<string>(saved.preset || CLOAK_PRESETS[0].label);
  const [customTitle, setCustomTitle] = useState<string>(saved.customTitle || '');
  const [customFavicon, setCustomFavicon] = useState<string>(saved.customFavicon || '');
  const [autoCloak, setAutoCloak] = useState(localStorage.getItem('nexus_autocloak') !== 'off');

  if (!open) return null;

  function selectPreset(label: string) {
    setSelectedPreset(label);
    setCustomTitle('');
    setCustomFavicon('');
    const next = { preset: label, customTitle: '', customFavicon: '' };
    localStorage.setItem('nexus_cloak', JSON.stringify(next));
    setSaved(next);
    toast.success(`Cloak set to "${label}"`);
  }

  function saveCustom() {
    if (!customTitle.trim()) { toast.error('Enter a custom tab title'); return; }
    const next = { preset: selectedPreset, customTitle: customTitle.trim(), customFavicon: customFavicon.trim() };
    localStorage.setItem('nexus_cloak', JSON.stringify(next));
    setSaved(next);
    toast.success('Custom cloak saved!');
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm mx-4 bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-border flex items-center gap-3">
          <Settings className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
          <h2 className="font-bold text-foreground">Settings</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="ml-auto text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"><X className="w-5 h-5" /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="p-5 space-y-4 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/20 text-xs cursor-pointer">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={autoCloak} className="w-4 h-4 accent-primary" onChange={e => { setAutoCloak(e.target.checked); localStorage.setItem('nexus_autocloak', e.target.checked ? 'on' : 'off'); }} />
            <span><strong>Auto about:blank</strong> — open the app in a cloaked tab automatically</span>
          </label>
          <SettingsExtras />
          {/* Cloak Presets */}
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-2 flex items-center gap-2"><EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> Tab Cloak</h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Choose what the cloaked tab looks like. The app loads inside about:blank.</p>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {CLOAK_PRESETS.map(p => (
                <button key={p.label} onClick={() => selectPreset(p.label)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border text-xs transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 ${selectedPreset === p.label && !saved.customTitle ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-foreground font-semibold' : 'border-border hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                  <img src={p.favicon} alt="" className="w-4 h-4 rounded" onError={e => { (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none'; }} />
                  <span>{p.label}</span>
                  <span className="ml-auto text-[9px] text-muted-foreground truncate max-w-32">{p.title}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Custom */}
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/20 space-y-2">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Custom Cloak</h4>
            <input value={customTitle} onChange={e => setCustomTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="Custom tab title..." className="w-full text-xs bg-background border border-border rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground outline-none focus:border-primary" />
            <input value={customFavicon} onChange={e => setCustomFavicon(e.target.value)} placeholder="Favicon URL (optional)" className="w-full text-xs bg-background border border-border rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground outline-none focus:border-primary" />
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full h-8 text-xs" onClick={saveCustom}>Save Custom Cloak</Button>
          </div>

          {/* Current cloak preview */}
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-secondary/30 border border-border space-y-1">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-semibold">Current cloak:</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground truncate">
              {saved.customTitle || CLOAK_PRESETS.find(p => p.label === selectedPreset)?.title || CLOAK_PRESETS[0].title}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Layout() {
  useAutoCloak();
  useFriendOnlineAlerts();
  const [profileOpen, setProfileOpen] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [shopOpen,    setShopOpen]    = useState(false);
  const [feedbackOpen, setFeedbackOpen] = useState(false);
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [questsOpen, setQuestsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = useState<DB.Announcement | null>(null);
  const [dismissedIds, setDismissedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(() => {
    try { return new Set(JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('dismissed_anns') || '[]')); } catch { return new Set(); }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const check = () => {
      const anns = DB.getAnnouncements();
      const pinned = anns.find(a => a.pinned && !dismissedIds.has(a.id));
      const latest = anns.find(a => !dismissedIds.has(a.id));
      setAnnouncement(pinned || latest || null);
    };
    check();
    const t = setInterval(check, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [dismissedIds]);

  const { profile, impersonating, impersonate } = useApp();
  useOwnerLimited(); // loads owner-made limited items so equipped ones render
  useChatSettingsSync();
  const [bgId, setBgId] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const sync = () => setBgId(DB.getEquipped(profile.email).bg);
    sync();
    window.addEventListener(COSMETICS_EVENT, sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(COSMETICS_EVENT, sync);
  }, [profile?.email]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const myTheme = getAllBgThemes().find(b => b.id === bgId);
  const [tradesOpen, setTradesOpen] = useState(false);
  const bgCss = myTheme?.css;
  const { active: holidayEvent } = useActiveEvent();
  const [eventShopOpen, setEventShopOpen] = useState(false);
  const [myCss, setMyCss] = useState('');
  const [myBg, setMyBg] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const sync = () => {
      setMyCss(P.hasCustomCss(profile.email) || isOwnerEmail(profile.email) ? P.getCustomCss(profile.email) : '');
      setMyBg(P.hasCustomBg(profile.email) || isOwnerEmail(profile.email) ? P.getCustomBg(profile.email) : '');
    };
    sync();
    window.addEventListener(P.PERSONALIZE_EVENT, sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(P.PERSONALIZE_EVENT, sync);
  }, [profile?.email]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  function dismissAnnouncement() {
    if (!announcement) return;
    const next = new Set(dismissedIds);
    next.add(announcement.id);
    setDismissedIds(next);
    sessionStorage.setItem('dismissed_anns', JSON.stringify([...next]));
    setAnnouncement(null);
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-background" style={bgCss ? { background: bgCss } : myBg ? { background: `linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.45), rgba(0,0,0,0.45)), url(${myBg}) center / cover no-repeat fixed` } : undefined}>
      {(() => {
        const m = /^ev-([a-z0-9]+)-(\d{4})/.exec(bgId);
        const h = m && HOLIDAYS.find(x => x.key === m[1]);
        if (h) { const y = Number(m![2]); return <HolidayDecor event={{ holiday: h, year: y, variant: variantFor(h, y), ...windowFor(h, y) }} />; }
        return holidayEvent ? <HolidayDecor event={holidayEvent} /> : null;
      })()}
      <button onClick={() => setTradesOpen(true)} title="Trade items"
        className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-40 h-11 px-4 rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold hover:brightness-110 transition">
        <ArrowLeftRight className="h-4 w-4" />Trade
      </button>
      <TradesDialog open={tradesOpen} onOpenChange={setTradesOpen} />
      <WarningNotice />
      <PageTranslator lang={profile?.language || 'en'} />
      {holidayEvent && <EventShop event={holidayEvent} open={eventShopOpen} onOpenChange={setEventShopOpen} />}
      <Sidebar onProfileClick={() => setProfileOpen(true)} />
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0">
        {holidayEvent && (
          <button onClick={() => setEventShopOpen(true)} className="text-white text-xs font-semibold px-4 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 hover:brightness-110 transition" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${holidayEvent.variant.colors[1]}, ${holidayEvent.variant.colors[0]})` }}>
            <span className="text-base">{holidayEvent.holiday.emoji}</span>
            {holidayEvent.holiday.name} {holidayEvent.year}: {holidayEvent.variant.tagline}
            <span className="ml-auto rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold" style={{ background: holidayEvent.variant.colors[2], color: holidayEvent.variant.colors[0] }}>🛍️ Limited shop</span>
          </button>
        )}
        {impersonating && (
          <div className="fixed top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[9999] pointer-events-auto bg-amber-500 text-black text-xs font-semibold pl-4 pr-1.5 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2">
            👀 Signed in as {profile?.name} ({impersonating})
            <button type="button" onClick={() => impersonate('')} className="rounded-full bg-black text-amber-400 px-3 py-1 hover:bg-black/80">Back to my account</button>
          </div>
        )}
        {/* Top Bar */}
        <header className="h-12 border-b border-border bg-card/50 flex items-center px-4 gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
          <GemDisplay />
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShopOpen(true)}
              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <ShoppingBag className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-pink-400" /> Shop
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setQuestsOpen(true)}
              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"

            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setFeedbackOpen(true)}
              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Bug className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Feedback
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1">
            <MusicPlayer />
            <NotificationBell />
            <Link
              to="/market"
              title="Marketplace"
              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Store className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> Marketplace
            </Link>
            <button
              onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(true)}
              title="Settings"
              className="h-8 w-8 flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary rounded-md transition-colors"
            >
              <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />

              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Cloak

      <Toaster position="top-right" richColors />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { COSMETICS_EVENT } from './SettingsExtras';
import { ownedLimitedByHoliday } from '../lib/holidays';

type RowProps = { preview: React.ReactNode; label: string; name: string; on: boolean; toggle: () => void; count?: number };
/** Keeps one of each name and counts the copies. */
function uniq<T extends { name: string }>(items: T[]) {
  const m = new Map<string, { item: T; count: number }>();
  for (const i of items) { const g = m.get(i.name); if (g) g.count++; else m.set(i.name, { item: i, count: 1 }); }
  return [...m.values()];
}
function Row({ preview, label, name, on, toggle, count = 1 }: RowProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5">
      {preview}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-amber-500">{label}</p>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{name}</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">You own {count}</p>
      </div>
      <Button size="sm" variant={on ? 'secondary' : 'outline'} className="text-xs" onClick={toggle}>{on ? 'Unequip' : 'Equip'}</Button>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Your limited (event) items, grouped into one folder per holiday. */
export default function LimitedCollection() {
  const { profile, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const ownedKey = profile ? DB.getUserItems(profile.email).join('|') : '';
  const groups = useMemo(() => ownedLimitedByHoliday(new Set(ownedKey.split('|'))), [ownedKey]);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const eq = DB.getEquipped(profile.email);
  const equip = (patch: { bg?: string; typing?: string }) => { DB.setEquipped(profile.email, patch); window.dispatchEvent(new Event(COSMETICS_EVENT)); bump(n => n + 1); };

  if (!groups.length) {
    return <div className="text-center py-10 text-sm text-muted-foreground"><Sparkles className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-60" />No limited items yet — grab some from the holiday limited shop!</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 mt-2">
      {groups.map(g => {
        const isOpen = open === g.key;
        const equipped = g.themes.some(t => t.id === eq.bg) || g.typing.some(t => t.id === eq.typing) || g.badges.some(b => profile.activeTitle === `${b.emoji} ${b.name}`);
        return (
          <div key={g.key} className="rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden">
            <button onClick={() => setOpen(isOpen ? null : g.key)} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-3 hover:bg-secondary/60 transition-colors text-left">
              <span className="text-2xl">{g.emoji}</span>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold truncate">{g.name}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{g.count} item{g.count === 1 ? '' : 's'}{equipped ? ' · equipped' : ''}</p>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500">×{g.count}</span>
              <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 transition-transform ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
            </button>
            {isOpen && (
              <div className="space-y-2 p-2 pt-0">
                {uniq(g.themes).map(({ item: t, count }) => <Row key={t.id} count={count} label="Limited Theme" name={t.name} on={eq.bg === t.id}
                  preview={<div className="w-14 h-10 rounded-lg border border-border flex-shrink-0" style={{ background: t.css }} />}
                  toggle={() => equip({ bg: eq.bg === t.id ? '' : t.id })} />)}
                {uniq(g.typing).map(({ item: t, count }) => <Row key={t.id} count={count} label="Limited Typing Effect" name={t.name} on={eq.typing === t.id}
                  preview={<div className="w-14 h-10 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] flex-shrink-0"><span className={t.className} style={{ color: t.color }}>{t.text.split(' ')[0]}</span></div>}
                  toggle={() => equip({ typing: eq.typing === t.id ? '' : t.id })} />)}
                {uniq(g.badges).map(({ item: b, count }) => {
                  const title = `${b.emoji} ${b.name}`;
                  const on = profile.activeTitle === title;
                  return <Row key={b.id} count={count} label="Limited Badge" name={title} on={on}
                    preview={<div className="w-14 h-10 rounded-lg border border-border flex items-center justify-center text-2xl flex-shrink-0">{b.emoji}</div>}
                    toggle={() => { updateProfile(on ? { activeTitle: '' } : { activeTitle: title, activeTitleColor: b.color, activeTitleEffect: 'glow' }); bump(n => n + 1); }} />;
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/MatrixRain.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

type Props = {
  color?: string;
  speed?: number;
};

export default function MatrixRain({ color = '#00ff00', speed = 1 }: Props) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let animId: number;
    let w = 0, h = 0;
    let columns = 0;
    const drops: number[] = [];
    const chars = 'アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲン0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    const fontSize = 14;

    function resize() {
      const parent = canvas!.parentElement;
      w = canvas!.width = parent?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
      h = canvas!.height = parent?.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
      columns = Math.floor(w / fontSize);
      while (drops.length < columns) drops.push(Math.random() * -100);
      drops.length = columns;
    }

    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    let last = 0;
    const interval = 50 / speed; // ms per frame, faster = lower

    function draw(ts: number) {
      if (ts - last < interval) {
        animId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
        return;
      }
      last = ts;

      ctx!.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)';
      ctx!.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
      ctx!.fillStyle = color;
      ctx!.font = `${fontSize}px monospace`;

      for (let i = 0; i < columns; i++) {
        const char = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
        const y = drops[i] * fontSize;
        // Head char brighter
        ctx!.fillStyle = color;
        ctx!.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx!.fillText(char, i * fontSize, y);

        // Trail with lower opacity
        ctx!.globalAlpha = 0.4;
        const prevChar = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
        ctx!.fillText(prevChar, i * fontSize, y - fontSize);
        ctx!.globalAlpha = 1;

        if (y > h && Math.random() > 0.975) {
          drops[i] = 0;
        }
        drops[i] += 1;
      }

      animId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }

    animId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
    };
  }, [color, speed]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      className="absolute inset-0 z-0 w-full h-full"
      style={{ background: '#000' }}
    />
  );
}

import RoleChip from './RoleChip';

import * as DB from '../lib/storage';

type Props = {
  msg: DB.Message;
  onDeleted: () => void;
  onReactionUpdate: () => void;
  onReply?: (msg: DB.Message) => void;
  onViewProfile?: (email: string) => void;
};

const MY_HIDDEN = 'nexus_my_hidden_msgs';
const getMyHidden = (): Set<string> => { try { return new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(MY_HIDDEN) || '[]')); } catch { return new Set(); } };

type RoleInfo = { label: string; color: string; icon: React.ReactNode; rank: number };

function getRoleInfo(role: string): RoleInfo | null {
  switch (role) {
    case 'owner':     return { label: 'Owner',     color: '#ffd700', icon: <Crown className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />,       rank: 4 };
    case 'co-owner':  return { label: 'Co-Owner',  color: '#ff9900', icon: <Star className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />,        rank: 3 };
    case 'admin':     return { label: 'Admin',     color: '#ff4444', icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />, rank: 2 };
    case 'senior-mod': return { label: 'Sr. Mod', color: '#a855f7', icon: <Shield className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />,      rank: 1 };
    case 'mod':       return { label: 'Mod',       color: '#44aaff', icon: <Shield className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />,      rank: 1 };
    case 'helper':    return { label: 'Helper',    color: '#22c55e', icon: <Shield className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />,      rank: 0 };
    case 'guardian':  return { label: 'Guardian',  color: '#14b8a6', icon: <Shield className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />,      rank: 0 };
    case 'vip':       return { label: 'VIP',       color: '#ec4899', icon: <Star className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />,        rank: 0 };
    default:          return null;
  }
}

function getDeleteStyle(deleterRole: string): string {
  switch (deleterRole) {
    case 'owner':    return 'text-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-400/20';
    case 'co-owner': return 'text-orange-400 hover:bg-orange-400/20';
    case 'admin':    return 'text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20';
    case 'mod': case 'senior-mod': return 'text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-400/20';
    default:         return 'text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/30';
  }
}

function canDeleteMsg(deleter: DB.UserProfile, msgSenderEmail: string, msgSenderRole: string): boolean {
  const deleterRank = getRoleInfo(deleter.role)?.rank ?? 0;
  const senderRank  = getRoleInfo(msgSenderRole)?.rank ?? 0;
  if (deleter.email === msgSenderEmail) return true;
  if (deleterRank === 0) return false;
  if (deleterRank >= 3) return true;
  if (deleterRank === 2) return senderRank < 2;
  if (deleterRank === 1) return senderRank === 0;
  return false;
}

export default function MessageBubble({ msg, onDeleted, onReactionUpdate, onReply, onViewProfile }: Props) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [showEmoji, setShowEmoji] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const isOwn = profile?.email === msg.senderEmail;
  const [myHidden, setMyHidden] = useState(() => getMyHidden().has(msg.id));
  function toggleMine() {
    const s = getMyHidden();
    if (s.has(msg.id)) s.delete(msg.id); else s.add(msg.id);
    localStorage.setItem(MY_HIDDEN, JSON.stringify([...s]));
    setMyHidden(s.has(msg.id));
  }
  const isGif = /^\[gif\]https:\/\/[^\s]+$/.test(msg.content);

  async function saveEdit() {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text || text === msg.content) { setEditing(false); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await messagesApi({ action: 'edit', messageId: msg.id, content: text, uncensored: !!msg.uncensored });
      setEditing(false);
      onDeleted(); // reloads the room
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not edit message');
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  const senderUser = DB.getUser(msg.senderEmail);
  const senderRole = senderUser?.role ?? 'user';
  const senderRoleInfo = getRoleInfo(senderRole);
  const senderCustomRole = senderUser?.customRole;
  const senderCustomRoleColor = senderUser?.customRoleColor || '#aaaaaa';
  const displayTitle = senderUser?.activeTitle || msg.senderTitle;
  const displayTitleEffect = senderUser?.activeTitle ? senderUser.activeTitleEffect : msg.senderTitleEffect;
  const displayTitleColor = senderUser?.activeTitle ? senderUser.activeTitleColor : msg.senderTitleColor;

  const canDelete = profile ? canDeleteMsg(profile, msg.senderEmail, senderRole) : false;
  const deleteStyle = profile ? getDeleteStyle(profile.role) : '';

  if (msg.deleted) return null;
  const viewerIsOwner = isOwnerEmail(profile?.email) || profile?.role === 'owner';
  if (msg.hidden && !viewerIsOwner) return null;
  function toggleHidden() {
    messagesApi({ action: msg.hidden ? 'unhide' : 'hide', messageId: msg.id })
      .then(() => { toast.success(msg.hidden ? 'Message is visible again' : 'Message hidden from everyone'); onDeleted(); })
      .catch(e => toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not update message'));
  }

  function handleReact(emoji: string) {
    if (!profile) return;
    const reactions = { ...msg.reactions };
    if (!reactions[emoji]) reactions[emoji] = [];
    const idx = reactions[emoji].indexOf(profile.email);
    if (idx !== -1) reactions[emoji].splice(idx, 1);
    else reactions[emoji].push(profile.email);
    messagesApi({ action: 'react', messageId: msg.id, reactions }).then(onReactionUpdate).catch(() => {});
    DB.saveUser({ ...profile, reactionCount: profile.reactionCount + 1 });
    DB.incrementQuestProgress(profile.email, 'react_3');
    setShowEmoji(false);
  }

  const reactionEntries = Object.entries(msg.reactions).filter(([, u]) => u.length > 0);

  if (myHidden) return (
    <div className={cn('flex mb-2', isOwn ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start')}>
      <button onDoubleClick={toggleMine} onClick={() => toast('Double-click to show this message')} title="Double-click to show" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-dashed border-border text-[11px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary transition-colors select-none">
        <EyeOff className="w-3 h-3" /> Hidden message from {msg.senderName} · <span className="font-semibold">Double-click to show</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div id={`msg-${msg.id}`} className={cn('flex mb-3 group transition-shadow', isOwn ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start')}>
      {!isOwn && (
        <button onClick={() => onViewProfile?.(msg.senderEmail)}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center text-sm mr-2 flex-shrink-0 mt-1 overflow-hidden border border-border hover:ring-2 hover:ring-primary/50 transition-all cursor-pointer">
          {senderUser?.profilePic
            ? <img src={senderUser.profilePic} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" onError={e => { (e.target as HTMLImageElement).src=''; (e.target as HTMLImageElement).replaceWith(Object.assign(document.createElement('span'), { className: 'text-xs font-bold text-primary', textContent: (msg.senderName[0] || '?').toUpperCase() })); }} />
            : <span className="text-xs font-bold text-primary">{(msg.senderName[0] || '?').toUpperCase()}</span>}
        </button>
      )}

      <div className={cn('max-w-[70%] flex flex-col gap-1', isOwn ? 'items-end' : 'items-start')}>
        {/* Sender header */}
        <div className={cn('flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap px-1', isOwn ? 'flex-row-reverse' : 'flex-row')}>
          <button onClick={() => onViewProfile?.(msg.senderEmail)} className="text-xs font-semibold hover:underline cursor-pointer" style={
            senderUser?.nameColor2
              ? { backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${senderUser.nameColor}, ${senderUser.nameColor2})`, WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text', WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent', backgroundClip: 'text' }
              : { color: msg.senderNameColor || '#e0e0ff' }
          }>{msg.senderName}</button>
          {(senderUser?.verified || isOwnerEmail(msg.senderEmail)) && (
            <BadgeCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400 flex-shrink-0" />
          )}
          {isOwnerEmail(msg.senderEmail) && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full" style={{ color: '#ffd700', backgroundColor: '#ffd70022', border: '1px solid #ffd70055' }}>
              <Crown className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />{ownerLabel(msg.senderEmail).toUpperCase()}
            </span>
          )}
          {!isOwnerEmail(msg.senderEmail) && senderCustomRole && (
            <RoleChip name={senderCustomRole} color={senderCustomRoleColor} color2={senderUser?.customRoleColor2 || undefined} className="text-[9px]" />
          )}
          {DB.getDailyRolesFor(msg.senderEmail).map(e => (
            <RoleChip key={e.id} name={e.roleName} icon={e.emoji} color={e.color} className="text-[9px] animate-pulse" />
          ))}
          {(() => { const tag = DB.getUserTagForUser(msg.senderEmail); return tag ? (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full"
              style={{ color: tag.color, backgroundColor: tag.color + '18', border: `1px solid ${tag.color}55` }}>
              {tag.icon} {tag.name}
            </span>
          ) : null; })()}
          {!isOwnerEmail(msg.senderEmail) && displayTitle && <TitleBadge title={displayTitle} effect={displayTitleEffect} color={displayTitleColor} />}
        </div>

        {/* Reply reference */}
        {msg.replyTo && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              const el = document.getElementById(`msg-${msg.replyTo!.id}`);
              if (!el) return;
              el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
              el.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary', 'rounded-xl');
              setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary', 'rounded-xl'), 1500);
            }}
            className={cn('text-left text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border-l-2 max-w-full hover:opacity-80 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring', isOwn ? 'bg-primary/10 border-primary/50' : 'bg-secondary/50 border-muted-foreground/30')}
            title="Jump to original message"
