          </button>
        )}

        {/* Bubble */}
        <div className={cn('msg-bubble px-4 py-2.5 text-sm relative', msg.hidden && 'opacity-50 ring-1 ring-dashed ring-muted-foreground', isOwn ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-br-sm' : 'bg-secondary text-foreground rounded-bl-sm')}>
          {msg.hidden && <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 mb-1 opacity-80"><EyeOff className="w-3 h-3" /> Hidden — only you can see this</div>}
          {editing ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 min-w-[220px]">
              <textarea
                autoFocus value={draft} onChange={e => setDraft(e.target.value)} rows={2}
                onKeyDown={e => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); saveEdit(); }
                  if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditing(false);
                }}
                className="w-full rounded-md bg-background/90 text-foreground text-sm px-2 py-1 border border-border resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring"
              />
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
                <button onClick={() => setEditing(false)} className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-background/30 hover:bg-background/50">Cancel</button>
                <button onClick={saveEdit} disabled={saving || !draft.trim()} className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-background text-foreground font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : isGif
            ? <img src={msg.content.slice(5)} alt="GIF" className="rounded-lg max-w-[240px] max-h-60 object-contain" loading="lazy" />
            : <TranslatedText style={textStyleCss(getRoleTextStyle(senderRole))} text={msg.content} lang={profile?.language || 'en'} auto={!isOwn} />}
          {/* Action buttons */}
          {!editing && <div className="absolute -top-1 right-1 opacity-100 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 focus-within:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex gap-0.5 bg-card border border-border rounded-lg px-1 py-0.5 shadow-lg">
            {isOwn && !isGif && (
              <button onClick={() => { setDraft(msg.content); setEditing(true); }} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors" title="Edit">
                <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
            {!isOwn && <ReportMessageButton messageId={msg.id} senderEmail={msg.senderEmail} content={msg.content} canHold={['guardian', 'mod', 'senior-mod', 'admin', 'co-owner', 'owner'].includes(profile?.role || '')} />}
            {msg.hidden && viewerIsOwner ? (
              <button onClick={toggleHidden} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors" title="Unhide for everyone">
                <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button onClick={toggleMine} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors" title="Hide">
                <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
            <button onClick={() => onReply?.(msg)} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors" title="Reply">
              <Reply className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => setShowEmoji(v => !v)} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors">
              <Smile className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
            {canDelete && (
              <button
                onClick={() => { messagesApi({ action: 'delete', messageId: msg.id }).then(onDeleted).catch(() => {}); }}
                className={cn('p-0.5 rounded transition-colors', deleteStyle)}
                title={isOwn ? 'Delete your message' : `Delete (${profile?.role})`}
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>}
          {showEmoji && (
            <div className="absolute top-8 right-0 z-50 bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1 w-48 shadow-xl">
              {EMOJI_LIST.map(e => <button key={e} onClick={() => handleReact(e)} className="text-lg hover:scale-125 transition-transform">{e}</button>)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Reactions */}
        {reactionEntries.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 px-1">
            {reactionEntries.map(([emoji, users]) => (
              <button key={emoji} onClick={() => handleReact(emoji)} className={cn('text-xs flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 border transition-colors', users.includes(profile?.email || '') ? 'bg-primary/30 border-primary/50' : 'bg-secondary border-border hover:bg-secondary/80')}>
                {emoji} <span className="text-muted-foreground">{users.length}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground px-1">{new Date(msg.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}{msg.edited ? ' · edited' : ''}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Music, Play, Pause, Link2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/popover';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Slider } from '@project/components/ui/slider';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { SONGS, getMusic, setMusic, type MusicPrefs } from '../lib/personalize';
import { allHolidaySongs, resolveSongUrl } from '../lib/holidaySongs';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { COSMETICS_EVENT } from './SettingsExtras';

export default function MusicPlayer() {
  const audio = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<MusicPrefs>(() => ({ ...getMusic(), playing: false }));
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState('');
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [owned, setOwned] = useState<string[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const sync = () => setOwned(DB.getUserItems(profile.email));
    sync(); window.addEventListener(COSMETICS_EVENT, sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(COSMETICS_EVENT, sync);
  }, [profile?.email]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const mySongs = allHolidaySongs().filter(s => owned.includes(s.id));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!audio.current) { audio.current = new Audio(); audio.current.loop = true; }
    const a = audio.current;
    const src = resolveSongUrl(prefs.url);
    if (a.src !== src) a.src = src;
    a.volume = prefs.volume;
    if (prefs.playing) a.play().catch(() => { toast.error("Couldn't play that song"); setPrefs(p => ({ ...p, playing: false })); });
    else a.pause();
    setMusic(prefs);
  }, [prefs]);
  useEffect(() => () => audio.current?.pause(), []);

  const update = (patch: Partial<MusicPrefs>) => setPrefs(p => ({ ...p, ...patch }));
  function useCustom() {
    if (!/^https?:\/\/\S+$/.test(custom.trim())) { toast.error('Paste a direct audio link (https://…mp3)'); return; }
    update({ url: custom.trim(), playing: true });
    setCustom('');
  }
  const current = [...SONGS, ...mySongs].find(s => s.url === prefs.url)?.name || 'Custom song';

  return (
    <Popover>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <button title="Background music" className={`h-8 w-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md hover:bg-secondary transition-colors ${prefs.playing ? 'text-primary' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}>
          <Music className={`w-4 h-4 ${prefs.playing ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}`} />
        </button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent align="end" className="w-72 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button size="icon" className="h-9 w-9" onClick={() => update({ playing: !prefs.playing })}>
            {prefs.playing ? <Pause className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Play className="w-4 h-4" />}
          </Button>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Now playing</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{current}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Slider value={[prefs.volume * 100]} max={100} step={1} onValueChange={([v]) => update({ volume: v / 100 })} />
        <div className="space-y-1">
          {SONGS.map(s => (
            <button key={s.url} onClick={() => update({ url: s.url, playing: true })}
              className={`w-full text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs ${prefs.url === s.url ? 'bg-primary/15 font-semibold' : 'hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground'}`}>
              {s.name}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {mySongs.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Your limited holiday songs</p>
            {mySongs.map(s => (
              <button key={s.id} onClick={() => update({ url: s.url, playing: true })}
                className={`w-full text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs ${prefs.url === s.url ? 'bg-primary/15 font-semibold' : 'hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                {s.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
          <Input value={custom} onChange={e => setCustom(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && useCustom()} placeholder="Paste song URL (.mp3)" className="h-8 text-xs" />
          <Button size="icon" variant="outline" className="h-8 w-8 shrink-0" onClick={useCustom}><Link2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/NotificationBell.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Bell, Megaphone, MessageCircle, UserPlus, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/popover';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { friends as friendsApi } from 'zitejs/api';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';

const SEEN_KEY = 'nexus_seen_updates';
const getSeen = (): string[] => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SEEN_KEY) || '[]'); } catch { return []; } };

function Section({ icon, title, children }: { icon: React.ReactNode; title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="py-2">
      <p className="px-3 pb-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">{icon}{title}</p>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function NotificationBell() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [msgs, setMsgs] = useState<DB.Notification[]>([]);
  const [updates, setUpdates] = useState<DB.Announcement[]>([]);
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState<string[]>(getSeen);

  const refresh = useCallback(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    setMsgs(DB.getNotifications(profile.email).slice(0, 15));
    setUpdates(DB.getAnnouncements().slice(0, 10));
    friendsApi({ action: 'list' }).then(r => setRequests(r.incoming)).catch(() => {});
  }, [profile?.email]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  useEffect(() => { refresh(); const t = setInterval(refresh, 15000); return () => clearInterval(t); }, [refresh]);

  const unreadMsgs = msgs.filter(m => !m.read).length;
  const newUpdates = updates.filter(u => !seen.includes(u.id)).length;
  const total = requests.length + unreadMsgs + newUpdates;

  function onOpenChange(v: boolean) {
    setOpen(v);
    if (!v && profile) {
      DB.markNotificationsRead(profile.email);
      const next = updates.map(u => u.id);
      localStorage.setItem(SEEN_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      setSeen(next);
      refresh();
    }
  }

  async function respond(email: string, action: 'accept' | 'remove') {
    try { const r = await friendsApi({ action, email }); setRequests(r.incoming); toast.success(action === 'accept' ? 'Friend added!' : 'Request declined'); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Something went wrong'); }
  }

  const empty = <p className="px-3 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground italic">Nothing here</p>;

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <button title="Notifications" className="relative h-8 w-8 flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary rounded-md transition-colors">
          <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
          {total > 0 && <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 min-w-4 h-4 px-1 rounded-full bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground text-[9px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center">{total > 9 ? '9+' : total}</span>}
        </button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent align="end" className="w-80 p-0 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-border">
        <p className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-sm">Notifications</p>
        <Section icon={<UserPlus className="w-3 h-3" />} title="Friend requests">
          {requests.length === 0 ? empty : requests.map(e => (
            <div key={e} className="px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <span className="flex-1 truncate font-medium">{DB.getUser(e)?.name || e}</span>
              <Button size="icon" className="h-6 w-6" onClick={() => respond(e, 'accept')}><Check className="w-3 h-3" /></Button>
              <Button size="icon" variant="outline" className="h-6 w-6" onClick={() => respond(e, 'remove')}><X className="w-3 h-3" /></Button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Section>
        <Section icon={<MessageCircle className="w-3 h-3" />} title="Messages">
          {msgs.length === 0 ? empty : msgs.map(m => (
            <div key={m.id} className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs ${m.read ? 'opacity-60' : ''}`}>
              <p><span className="font-semibold">{m.senderName}</span> <span className="text-muted-foreground">in {m.roomName} · {formatDistanceToNow(m.timestamp, { addSuffix: true })}</span></p>
              <p className="truncate text-muted-foreground">{m.messagePreview}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Section>
        <Section icon={<Megaphone className="w-3 h-3" />} title="Updates & announcements">
          {updates.length === 0 ? empty : updates.map(u => (
            <div key={u.id} className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs">
              <p className="font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">{!seen.includes(u.id) && <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />}{u.title}</p>
              {u.content && <p className="text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 whitespace-pre-wrap">{u.content}</p>}
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{formatDistanceToNow(u.timestamp, { addSuffix: true })}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Section>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/OnlinePanel.tsx =====

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Circle } from 'lucide-react';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { isOwnerEmail, isOgOwner } from '../lib/gameData';
import TitleBadge from './TitleBadge';
import UserProfileModal from './UserProfileModal';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';
import { usePresence } from '../hooks/useOnlineUsers';

const ROLE_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  owner: 'text-yellow-400',
  'co-owner': 'text-orange-400',
  admin: 'text-red-400',
  'senior-mod': 'text-purple-400',
  mod: 'text-blue-400',
  helper: 'text-green-400',
  vip: 'text-pink-400',
  user: 'text-muted-foreground',
};

const STAFF = ['owner', 'co-owner', 'admin', 'senior-mod', 'mod', 'guardian', 'helper'];

const rank = (r: string) => { const i = STAFF.indexOf(r); return i < 0 ? STAFF.length : i; };

type Props = { roomId: string; currentUserEmail?: string };

export default function OnlinePanel({ roomId, currentUserEmail }: Props) {
  const { online: onlineUsers, everyone } = usePresence();
  const [typing, setTyping] = useState<DB.TypingUser[]>([]);
  const [viewEmail, setViewEmail] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const onlineSet = new Set(onlineUsers.map(u => u.email));
  const merged = [...onlineUsers, ...everyone.filter(u => !onlineSet.has(u.email))].map(u => isOwnerEmail(u.email) ? { ...u, role: 'owner' } : u)
    .sort((a, b) => Number(isOgOwner(b.email)) - Number(isOgOwner(a.email)) || rank(a.role) - rank(b.role) || Number(onlineSet.has(b.email)) - Number(onlineSet.has(a.email)) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  const groups = [
    { label: 'Staff', users: merged.filter(u => STAFF.includes(u.role)) },
    { label: 'Users', users: merged.filter(u => !STAFF.includes(u.role)) },
  ].filter(g => g.users.length > 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setTyping(DB.getTyping(roomId).filter(t => t.email !== currentUserEmail));
    update();
    const t = setInterval(update, 2000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [roomId, currentUserEmail]);

  return (
    <div className="w-44 flex-shrink-0 bg-card/40 border-l border-border flex flex-col overflow-y-auto">
      {/* Online header */}
      <div className="px-3 pt-3 pb-2 border-b border-border">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Circle className="w-2.5 h-2.5 fill-green-400 text-green-400" />
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-green-400">Online</span>
          <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-semibold">{onlineUsers.length}</span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground/60 mt-1 leading-tight">Online first, then offline members</p>
      </div>

      {/* Typing indicator */}
      {typing.length > 0 && (
        <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b border-border bg-primary/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] text-primary font-semibold mb-1">✍️ Typing…</p>
          {typing.map(t => (
            <div key={t.email} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 py-0.5">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/80 truncate">{t.name}</span>
              <span className="flex gap-0.5 ml-auto">
                {[0,1,2].map(i => (
                  <span key={i} className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-primary animate-bounce"
                    style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.15}s` }} />
                ))}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* User list */}
      <div className="flex-1 p-2 space-y-0.5">
        {groups.map(g => (
          <div key={g.label} className="mb-2">
            <p className="px-2 pt-1 pb-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">{g.label} — {g.users.length}</p>
        {g.users.map(u => { const online = onlineSet.has(u.email); return (
          <button key={u.email} onClick={() => setViewEmail(u.email)} className={cn('w-full text-left flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-secondary/60 transition-colors', u.email === currentUserEmail && 'bg-primary/10', !online && 'opacity-50')}>
            <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
              <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                {u.profilePic
                  ? <img src={u.profilePic} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  : <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-primary">{u.name[0]?.toUpperCase()}</span>}
              </div>
              <Circle className={cn('w-2 h-2 absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5', online ? 'fill-green-400 text-green-400' : 'fill-muted-foreground text-muted-foreground')} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold truncate leading-tight" style={{ color: u.nameColor || undefined }}>
                {u.name}{u.email === currentUserEmail && <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal"> (you)</span>}
              </p>
              {u.activeTitle ? (
                <TitleBadge title={u.activeTitle} effect={u.activeTitleEffect} color={u.activeTitleColor} />
              ) : (
                <span className={cn('text-[9px] font-bold', ROLE_COLOR[u.role] || 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                  {u.role === 'co-owner' ? 'Co-Owner' : u.role.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + u.role.slice(1)}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </button>
        ); })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <UserProfileModal email={viewEmail} onClose={() => setViewEmail(null)} />
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/OwnerEventsTab.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Switch } from '@project/components/ui/switch';
import { DatePicker } from '@project/components/ui/date-picker';
import { events as eventsApi } from 'zitejs/api';
import { HOLIDAYS, windowFor, variantFor, Override, COUNTRIES } from '../lib/holidays';
import { useActiveEvent, EVENTS_CHANGED } from '../hooks/useActiveEvent';

export default function OwnerEventsTab() {
  const { active, overrides } = useActiveEvent();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');
  const now = new Date();

  const save = async (key: string, patch: Partial<Override>) => {
    const cur = overrides.find(o => o.holidayKey === key) || { holidayKey: key, earlyStart: null, forceOn: false, forceOff: false };
    const next = { ...cur, ...patch };
    setBusy(key);
    try {
      await eventsApi({ action: 'set', holidayKey: key, earlyStart: next.earlyStart, forceOn: next.forceOn, forceOff: next.forceOff });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENTS_CHANGED)); toast.success('Event updated for everyone');
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not update'); }
    finally { setBusy(''); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/30 text-sm">
        {active ? <>Live now: <b>{active.holiday.emoji} {active.holiday.name} {active.year} — {active.variant.name}</b> (ends {format(active.end, 'MMM d')})</> : 'No event is live right now.'}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Events start a week before the holiday and end a week after. Each year gets a new look and new limited items. National days only show for people who picked that country (Start now shows it to everyone).</p>
      </div>
      {HOLIDAYS.map(h => {
        let year = now.getFullYear();
        if (windowFor(h, year).end < now) year++;
        const o = overrides.find(x => x.holidayKey === h.key);
        const w = windowFor(h, year, o);
        return (
          <div key={h.key} className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-border flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-2xl">{h.emoji}</span>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-[160px]">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{h.name} {year}{h.countries && <span className="ml-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary/15 text-primary">{h.countries.map(c => COUNTRIES[c] ?? c).join(', ')} only</span>}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{variantFor(h, year).name} · {format(w.start, 'MMM d')} – {format(w.end, 'MMM d')}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="w-40"><DatePicker value={o?.earlyStart ? new Date(o.earlyStart + 'T00:00:00') : undefined} onChange={dt => save(h.key, { earlyStart: dt ? format(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') : null })} /></div>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs"><Switch checked={!!o?.forceOn} disabled={busy === h.key} onCheckedChange={v => save(h.key, { forceOn: v, forceOff: false })} />Start now</label>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs"><Switch checked={!!o?.forceOff} disabled={busy === h.key} onCheckedChange={v => save(h.key, { forceOff: v, forceOn: false })} />Turn off</label>
            {o?.earlyStart && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => save(h.key, { earlyStart: null })}>Reset date</Button>}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/OwnerThemesTab.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Palette, Store, Lock, Trash2, Award } from 'lucide-react';
import ThemeMaker from './ThemeMaker';
import BadgeMaker from './BadgeMaker';
import { BG_THEMES, getCustomThemes, saveCustomThemes, THEMES_EVENT, CustomTheme } from '../lib/cosmetics';

export default function OwnerThemesTab() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [badgeOpen, setBadgeOpen] = useState(false);
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState<CustomTheme[]>(getCustomThemes());

  useEffect(() => {
    const refresh = () => setCustom(getCustomThemes());
    window.addEventListener(THEMES_EVENT, refresh);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(THEMES_EVENT, refresh);
  }, [open]);

  const update = (list: CustomTheme[]) => { saveCustomThemes(list); setCustom(list); };
  const toggleShop = (id: string) => update(custom.map(t => t.id === id ? { ...t, inShop: !t.inShop } : t));
  const remove = (id: string) => update(custom.filter(t => t.id !== id));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <h2 className="font-bold">Theme Maker</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Create themes, sell them in the shop, or keep them owner-only to give away.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setBadgeOpen(true)}><Award className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Badge Maker</Button>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}><Palette className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />New theme</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-2">Your custom themes ({custom.length})</h3>
        {custom.length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No custom themes yet.</p>}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {custom.map(t => (
            <div key={t.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-md shrink-0 border border-border" style={{ background: t.css }} />
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{t.name}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t.inShop ? `In shop · ${t.cost} gems` : 'Owner-only (give it out)'}</p>
              </div>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => toggleShop(t.id)} title={t.inShop ? 'Make owner-only' : 'Put in shop'}>
                {t.inShop ? <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Store className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              </Button>
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => remove(t.id)}><Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold mb-2">Built-in shop themes ({BG_THEMES.length})</h3>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-2">
          {BG_THEMES.map(t => (
            <div key={t.id} className="text-center">
              <div className="h-12 rounded-md border border-border" style={{ background: t.css }} />
              <p className="text-[10px] mt-1 truncate">{t.name}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <BadgeMaker open={badgeOpen} onClose={() => setBadgeOpen(false)} />
      <ThemeMaker open={open} onClose={() => { setOpen(false); setCustom(getCustomThemes()); }} />
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/OwnerTypingTab.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Keyboard, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Switch } from '@project/components/ui/switch';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { getCustomTyping, saveCustomTyping, CustomTyping } from '../lib/cosmetics';

const ANIMS = [
  { value: '', label: 'None' },
  { value: 'animate-pulse', label: 'Pulse' },
  { value: 'animate-bounce', label: 'Bounce' },
  { value: 'title-rainbow', label: 'Rainbow' },
];

/** Owner-only: create typing effects that show in the shop. */
export default function OwnerTypingTab() {
  const [list, setList] = useState<CustomTyping[]>(getCustomTyping());
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [text, setText] = useState('is typing…');
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#22d3ee');
  const [anim, setAnim] = useState('animate-pulse');
  const [cost, setCost] = useState('500');

  function save(next: CustomTyping[]) { setList(next); saveCustomTyping(next); }

  function add() {
    if (!name.trim() || !text.trim()) { toast.error('Add a name and the typing text'); return; }
    save([...list, { id: `type-custom-${Date.now()}`, name: name.trim(), text: text.trim(), color, className: anim, cost: Math.max(0, Number(cost) || 0), inShop: true }]);
    setName('');
    toast.success('Typing effect added to the shop');
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 space-y-3">
      <h3 className="font-semibold flex items-center gap-2"><Keyboard className="w-4 h-4" /> Typing effects</h3>
      <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <Input value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Name, e.g. 👻 Ghost" maxLength={30} />
        <Input value={text} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Shown text, e.g. is haunting the chat" maxLength={50} />
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input type="color" value={color} onChange={e => setColor(e.target.value)} className="w-10 h-9 rounded cursor-pointer bg-transparent" />
          <select value={anim} onChange={e => setAnim(e.target.value)} className="flex-1 rounded-md border border-border bg-secondary px-2 text-sm">
            {ANIMS.map(a => <option key={a.value} value={a.value}>{a.label}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <Input type="number" min={0} value={cost} onChange={e => setCost(e.target.value)} placeholder="Price in gems" />
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-lg bg-secondary px-3 py-2 text-xs">Preview: <span className="font-semibold">Alex</span> <span className={anim} style={{ color }}>{text}</span></div>
      <Button className="w-full" onClick={add}>Add typing effect</Button>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        {list.map(t => (
          <div key={t.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2">
            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{t.name} <span className={`text-xs ${t.className}`} style={{ color: t.color }}>{t.text}</span></span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">💎 {t.cost}</span>
            <Switch checked={t.inShop} onCheckedChange={v => save(list.map(x => x.id === t.id ? { ...x, inShop: v } : x))} />
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => save(list.filter(x => x.id !== t.id))}><Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        ))}
        {!list.length && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No custom typing effects yet.</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/PageTranslator.tsx =====

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { translate } from 'zitejs/api';

const SKIP = new Set(['SCRIPT', 'STYLE', 'TEXTAREA', 'INPUT', 'CODE', 'PRE', 'NOSCRIPT']);
const RTL = new Set(['ar', 'he', 'fa', 'ur']);
const originals = new WeakMap<Text, string>();
const tracked = new Set<Text>();

function shouldTranslate(s: string) {
  const t = s.trim();
  return t.length > 1 && t.length <= 500 && /[A-Za-z]{2}/.test(t);
}

/** Translates every visible piece of interface text into the user's chosen language. */
export default function PageTranslator({ lang }: { lang: string }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    html.lang = lang || 'en';
    html.dir = RTL.has(lang) ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';

    // Back to English: restore every original string
    if (!lang || lang === 'en') {
      tracked.forEach(n => { const o = originals.get(n); if (o !== undefined && n.isConnected) n.nodeValue = o; });
      tracked.clear();
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-tr-placeholder],[data-tr-title],[data-tr-aria-label]').forEach(el => {
        ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label'].forEach(a => { const o = el.getAttribute(`data-tr-${a}`); if (o !== null) el.setAttribute(a, o); });
      });
      return;
    }

    const cacheKey = `nexus_tr:${lang}`;
    const cache: Record<string, string> = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(cacheKey) || '{}'); } catch { return {}; } })();
    const pending = new Set<string>();
    let timer: number | undefined;
    let applying = false;

    const apply = (n: Text) => {
      const orig = originals.get(n)!;
      const key = orig.trim();
      const tr = cache[key];
      if (tr && n.nodeValue !== orig.replace(key, tr)) { applying = true; n.nodeValue = orig.replace(key, tr); applying = false; }
    };

    const visit = (n: Text) => {
      const p = n.parentElement;
      if (!p || SKIP.has(p.tagName) || p.closest('[data-no-translate],[contenteditable="true"]')) return;
      const cur = n.nodeValue || '';
      const known = originals.get(n);
      // Text changed by React (not by us) → treat as a new original
      if (known === undefined || (cur !== known && !Object.values(cache).some(v => cur.includes(v)))) originals.set(n, cur);
      const orig = originals.get(n)!;
      if (!shouldTranslate(orig)) return;
      tracked.add(n);
      if (cache[orig.trim()]) apply(n); else pending.add(orig.trim());
    };

    const ATTRS = ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label'];
    const attrEls = new Set<Element>();
    const visitAttrs = (el: Element) => {
      if (el.closest('[data-no-translate]')) return;
      ATTRS.forEach(a => {
        const v = el.getAttribute(a); if (!v) return;
        const ok = `data-tr-${a}`;
        let orig = el.getAttribute(ok);
        if (orig === null || (v !== orig && v !== cache[orig.trim()])) { orig = v; el.setAttribute(ok, v); }
        if (!shouldTranslate(orig)) return;
        attrEls.add(el);
        const tr = cache[orig.trim()];
        if (tr) { if (v !== tr) { applying = true; el.setAttribute(a, tr); applying = false; } } else pending.add(orig.trim());
      });
    };
    const scan = (root: Node) => {
      if (root.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) { visit(root as Text); return; }
      if (root.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return;
      const w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      while (w.nextNode()) visit(w.currentNode as Text);
      const el = root as Element;
      visitAttrs(el);
      el.querySelectorAll('[placeholder],[title],[aria-label]').forEach(visitAttrs);
    };

    const flush = async () => {
      const batch = [...pending].slice(0, 80);
      if (!batch.length) return;
      batch.forEach(b => pending.delete(b));
      try {
        const { translations } = await translate({ lang, texts: batch });
        batch.forEach((b, i) => { cache[b] = translations[i]; });
        localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(cache));
        tracked.forEach(n => n.isConnected ? apply(n) : tracked.delete(n));
        attrEls.forEach(el => el.isConnected ? visitAttrs(el) : attrEls.delete(el));
      } catch { /* keep English if translation fails */ }
      if (pending.size) timer = window.setTimeout(flush, 300);
    };
    const schedule = () => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = window.setTimeout(flush, 400); };

    scan(document.body);
    schedule();
    const obs = new MutationObserver(muts => {
      if (applying) return;
      muts.forEach(m => {
        if (m.type === 'characterData') scan(m.target);
        else if (m.type === 'attributes') visitAttrs(m.target as Element);
        m.addedNodes.forEach(scan);
      });
      if (pending.size) schedule();
    });
    obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ATTRS });
    return () => { obs.disconnect(); clearTimeout(timer); };
  }, [lang]);

  return null;
}


===== FILE: src/components/PersonalizeSettings.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Type, Code2, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/gameData';
import * as P from '../lib/personalize';
import CustomBackground from './CustomBackground';

export default function PersonalizeSettings() {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const role = profile?.role || 'user';
  const [style, setStyle] = useState(() => P.getRoleTextStyle(role));
  const [css, setCss] = useState(() => (profile ? P.getCustomCss(profile.email) : ''));
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const unlocked = isOwnerEmail(profile.email) || P.hasCustomCss(profile.email);

  function update(patch: Partial<P.TextStyle>) {
    const next = { ...style, ...patch };
    setStyle(next);
    P.setRoleTextStyle(role, next);
  }
  function buy() {
    if (profile!.gems < P.CUSTOM_CSS_PRICE) { toast.error(`You need ${P.CUSTOM_CSS_PRICE} gems`); return; }
    addGems(-P.CUSTOM_CSS_PRICE);
    P.unlockCustomCss(profile!.email);
    bump(n => n + 1);
    toast.success('Custom CSS unlocked forever!');
  }
  const toggle = (on: boolean) => `px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-[11px] ${on ? 'border-primary bg-primary/15 font-semibold' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary'}`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"><Type className="w-4 h-4" />Text Style for <span className="capitalize">{role}</span></h3>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">Your chat messages use this style for your role.</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
          <input type="color" value={style.color || '#ffffff'} onChange={e => update({ color: e.target.value })} className="w-10 h-8 rounded cursor-pointer bg-transparent" />
          <select value={style.font} onChange={e => update({ font: e.target.value })} className="flex-1 h-8 text-xs bg-background border border-border rounded-lg px-2">
            {P.TEXT_FONTS.map(f => <option key={f.name} value={f.id}>{f.name}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          <button className={toggle(style.bold)} onClick={() => update({ bold: !style.bold })}>Bold</button>
          <button className={toggle(style.italic)} onClick={() => update({ italic: !style.italic })}>Italic</button>
          <button className={toggle(style.glow)} onClick={() => update({ glow: !style.glow })}>Glow</button>
          <button className={toggle(false)} onClick={() => { setStyle(P.DEFAULT_TEXT_STYLE); P.setRoleTextStyle(role, P.DEFAULT_TEXT_STYLE); }}>Reset</button>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-secondary text-sm" style={P.textStyleCss(style)}>Preview: hey everyone 👋</div>
      </div>

      <CustomBackground />

      <div>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"><Code2 className="w-4 h-4" />Custom CSS</h3>
        {unlocked ? (
          <>
            <Textarea value={css} onChange={e => setCss(e.target.value)} placeholder=".msg-bubble { border: 1px solid hotpink; }" className="font-mono text-xs h-28" />
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
              <Button size="sm" className="flex-1 h-8 text-xs" onClick={() => { P.setCustomCss(profile.email, css); toast.success('CSS applied'); }}>Apply</Button>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-8 text-xs" onClick={() => { setCss(''); P.setCustomCss(profile.email, ''); }}>Clear</Button>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/30 text-center">
            <Lock className="w-4 h-4 mx-auto mb-1 text-muted-foreground" />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">Style the whole app your way. Pay once, keep it forever.</p>
            <Button size="sm" className="h-8 text-xs" onClick={buy}>Unlock for 💎 {P.CUSTOM_CSS_PRICE}</Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/PhotoUploadButton.tsx =====

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { ImagePlus, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useUpload } from 'zitejs/upload';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';

export default function PhotoUploadButton({ onUploaded }: { onUploaded: (url: string) => void }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const { upload, isUploading } = useUpload();

  async function onChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) { toast.error('Please pick an image file'); return; }
    try {
      const { url } = await upload(file);
      onUploaded(url);
    } catch { toast.error('Upload failed'); }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <input ref={ref} type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={onChange} />
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" title="Upload a picture" disabled={isUploading} onClick={() => ref.current?.click()}>
        {isUploading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <ImagePlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/PrankOverlay.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { pranks as pranksApi } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { findPrank, prankOptOut, type Prank } from '../lib/pranks';
import { isVip } from '../lib/vip';

type Active = { prank: Prank; from: string };

const FX: Record<string, string> = {
  flip: 'transform: rotate(180deg);', spin: 'animation: prank-spin 2s linear infinite;',
  shake: 'animation: prank-shake .25s linear infinite;', blur: 'filter: blur(4px);',
  invert: 'filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg);', tiny: 'transform: scale(.5);',
  color: 'animation: prank-hue 1s linear infinite;',
};
const KEYFRAMES = `@keyframes prank-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes prank-shake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0)}25%{transform:translate(-8px,4px)}75%{transform:translate(8px,-4px)}}
@keyframes prank-hue{to{filter:hue-rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes prank-fall{from{transform:translateY(-10vh) rotate(0)}to{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(360deg)}}`;

/** Checks for pranks sent to you and plays them (max 30s, always closable). */
export default function PrankOverlay() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const email = profile?.email || '';
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState<Active[]>([]);
  const cur = queue[0];
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const styleRef = useRef<HTMLStyleElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!email) return;
    const poll = () => pranksApi({ action: 'inbox' }).then(({ pranks }) => {
      if (isVip(email) && prankOptOut(email)) return; // VIP Prank Shield
      const next = pranks.map(p => ({ prank: findPrank(p.prankId)!, from: p.senderName })).filter(a => a.prank);
      if (next.length) setQueue(q => [...q, ...next]);
    }).catch(() => {});
    poll(); const t = setInterval(poll, 8000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [email]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!styleRef.current) { styleRef.current = document.createElement('style'); document.head.appendChild(styleRef.current); }
    const el = styleRef.current;
    if (!cur) { el.textContent = KEYFRAMES; return; }
    const fx = FX[cur.prank.kind];
    el.textContent = KEYFRAMES + (fx ? `#root{${fx}transition:transform .4s,filter .4s;}` : '');
    setProgress(0);
    const secs = Math.min(cur.prank.seconds, 30);
    const tick = setInterval(() => setProgress(p => Math.min(100, p + 100 / (secs * 10))), 100);
    const end = setTimeout(() => setQueue(q => q.slice(1)), secs * 1000);
    return () => { clearInterval(tick); clearTimeout(end); };
  }, [cur]);

  if (!cur) return null;
  const { prank, from } = cur;
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] pointer-events-none">
      {prank.kind === 'rain' && Array.from({ length: 40 }).map((_, i) => (
        <span key={i} className="absolute text-4xl" style={{ left: `${(i * 37) % 100}%`, top: 0,
          animation: `prank-fall ${2 + (i % 5) * 0.6}s linear ${(i % 10) * 0.3}s infinite` }}>{prank.emoji}</span>
      ))}
      {(prank.kind === 'popup' || prank.kind === 'fakeBar') && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-background/70 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="max-w-md mx-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6 text-center shadow-2xl">
            <div className="text-6xl">{prank.emoji}</div>
            <p className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold">{prank.text}</p>
            {prank.kind === 'fakeBar' && <div className="mt-4 h-3 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden"><div className="h-full bg-destructive" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} /></div>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="absolute top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-card border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-sm shadow-lg">
        {prank.emoji} <b>{from}</b> pranked you!
        <button onClick={() => setQueue(q => q.slice(1))} className="ml-1 rounded-full p-1 hover:bg-muted" aria-label="Close prank"><X className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/PrankShop.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Loader2, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Switch } from '@project/components/ui/switch';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { pranks as pranksApi, presence, type PresenceOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { useVip } from '../hooks/useVip';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/gameData';
import { ALL_PRANKS, pranksFor, prankOptOut, setPrankOptOut, type Prank } from '../lib/pranks';

export default function PrankShop() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const { active: vip } = useVip(profile?.email);
  const [people, setPeople] = useState<PresenceOutputType['everyone']>([]);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');
  const [shield, setShield] = useState(() => prankOptOut(profile?.email || ''));
  useEffect(() => { presence({ action: 'getOnline' }).then(r => setPeople(r.everyone)).catch(() => {}); }, []);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const owner = isOwnerEmail(profile.email);
  const allowed = new Set(pranksFor(owner, vip).map(p => p.id));
  const others = people.filter(p => p.email.toLowerCase() !== profile.email.toLowerCase());

  async function send(p: Prank) {
    if (!target) { toast.error('Pick someone to prank first'); return; }
    setBusy(p.id);
    try { await pranksApi({ action: 'send', targetEmail: target, prankId: p.id, senderName: profile!.name }); toast.success(`${p.emoji} Prank sent!`); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not send prank'); }
    finally { setBusy(''); }
  }

  const Grid = ({ list }: { list: Prank[] }) => (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
      {list.map(p => {
        const ok = allowed.has(p.id);
        return (
          <button key={p.id} disabled={!ok || !!busy} onClick={() => send(p)}
            className={`rounded-xl border p-2 text-center transition ${ok ? 'border-border hover:border-primary hover:bg-primary/5' : 'border-border opacity-40'}`}>
            <div className="text-2xl">{busy === p.id ? <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto animate-spin" /> : p.emoji}</div>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold truncate">{p.name}</p>
            {!ok && <p className="text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5"><Lock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />Owner</p>}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Pranks are harmless, last up to 30 seconds and can always be closed.</p>
      <Select value={target} onValueChange={setTarget}>
        <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Who do you want to prank?" /></SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>{others.map(u => <SelectItem key={u.email} value={u.email}>{u.name || u.email}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
      </Select>
      {vip && (
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <Switch checked={shield} onCheckedChange={v => { setPrankOptOut(profile.email, v); setShield(v); }} /> 🛡️ VIP Prank Shield (block pranks on me)
        </label>
      )}
      <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm">😄 Friendly pranks</h4>
      <Grid list={ALL_PRANKS.filter(p => !p.mean)} />
      <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm">😈 Mean pranks {!owner && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-normal">({vip ? '5 for VIP' : '2 unlocked — VIP gets 5'})</span>}</h4>
      <Grid list={ALL_PRANKS.filter(p => p.mean)} />
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/ProBadge.tsx =====

import * as Icons from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';
import { BADGE_DEFS } from '../lib/badges';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';

// Icons offered in the badge maker (lucide names)
export const BADGE_ICONS = ['Award', 'Trophy', 'Crown', 'Star', 'Shield', 'Gem', 'Flame', 'Zap', 'Heart', 'Rocket', 'Medal', 'Sparkles', 'Target', 'Swords', 'Gamepad2', 'Music', 'Palette', 'Brain', 'Code', 'MessageSquare', 'Dices', 'Moon', 'Sun', 'Leaf', 'Skull', 'Ghost', 'Bolt', 'Feather'] as const;

const TIERS = [
  { a: '#b87333', b: '#7a4420' }, // bronze
  { a: '#d7dde4', b: '#8a96a3' }, // silver
  { a: '#f6d365', b: '#c8901a' }, // gold
  { a: '#a8edea', b: '#5b8fb0' }, // platinum
  { a: '#c084fc', b: '#6d28d9' }, // mythic
];

type Look = { icon: string; color: string; color2: string; name: string; description: string };

export function badgeLook(id: string): Look | null {
  const custom = DB.getCustomBadges().find(b => b.id === id);
  if (custom) return custom;
  const def = BADGE_DEFS.find(b => b.id === id);
  if (!def) return null;
  const n = Number(id.replace(/\D/g, '')) || 1;
  const tier = TIERS[Math.min(4, Math.floor(Math.log10(n)))];
  const icon = id.startsWith('msg') ? 'MessageSquare' : id.startsWith('gem') ? 'Gem' : id.startsWith('gam') ? 'Dices' : 'Award';
  return { icon, color: tier.a, color2: tier.b, name: def.name, description: def.description };
}

// A polished medallion: gradient hexagon, inner ring, crisp white icon
export default function ProBadge({ icon, color, color2, size = 36, className, title }: { icon: string; color: string; color2?: string; size?: number; className?: string; title?: string }) {
  const Icon = (Icons as unknown as Record<string, Icons.LucideIcon>)[icon] || Icons.Award;
  const hex = 'polygon(50% 0%, 93% 25%, 93% 75%, 50% 100%, 7% 75%, 7% 25%)';
  return (
    <span title={title} className={cn('relative inline-flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 drop-shadow-md', className)} style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
      <span className="absolute inset-0" style={{ clipPath: hex, background: `linear-gradient(145deg, ${color}, ${color2 || color})` }} />
      <span className="absolute" style={{ inset: size * 0.09, clipPath: hex, background: `linear-gradient(325deg, ${color}, ${color2 || color})`, boxShadow: 'inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.5)' }} />
      <span className="absolute" style={{ inset: size * 0.09, clipPath: hex, background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35), transparent 55%)' }} />

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onOpenShop: () => void };

export default function ProfileModal({ open, onClose, onOpenShop }: Props) {
  const { profile, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const { user: authUser } = useAuth();
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#e0e0ff');
  const [color2, setColor2] = useState('');
  const [useGradient, setUseGradient] = useState(false);
  const [bio, setBio] = useState('');
  const [selectedTitle, setSelectedTitle] = useState('');
  const [selectedTitleEffect, setSelectedTitleEffect] = useState('');
  const [selectedTitleColor, setSelectedTitleColor] = useState('');
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState('en');
  const { upload, isUploading } = useUpload();
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Sync local state when modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && profile) {
      setName(profile.name);
      setColor(profile.nameColor || '#e0e0ff');
      setColor2(profile.nameColor2 || '#ff69b4');
      setUseGradient(!!profile.nameColor2);
      setBio(profile.bio || '');
      setSelectedTitle(profile.activeTitle || '');
      setSelectedTitleEffect(profile.activeTitleEffect || '');
      setSelectedTitleColor(profile.activeTitleColor || '');
      setLanguage(profile.language || 'en');
    }
  }, [open]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- only reset when opened, so picks aren't wiped

  if (!profile) return null;

  const ownedTitles = DB.getUserTitles(profile.email);

  const allTitles = [
    ...(profile.role === 'admin' ? [{ name: 'Admin', effect: 'none', color: '#ff4444' }] : []),
    ...(profile.role === 'mod' ? [{ name: 'Mod', effect: 'none', color: '#44aaff' }] : []),
    ...ownedTitles.filter(t => !['Owner','Admin','Mod','Best Friend'].includes(t)).map(t => {
      const shop = DB.getCustomTitles().find(c => c.name === t);
      return { name: t, effect: shop?.effect || 'none', color: shop?.color || '#aaaaaa' };
    }),
    ...(ownedTitles.includes('Best Friend') ? [{ name: 'Best Friend', effect: 'rainbow', color: '#ff69b4' }] : []),
    ...(() => { const items = new Set(DB.getUserItems(profile.email)); return allLimitedBadges().filter(b => items.has(b.id)).map(b => ({ name: `${b.emoji} ${b.name}`, effect: 'glow', color: b.color })); })(),
  ];
  if (selectedTitle && !allTitles.some(t => t.name === selectedTitle)) allTitles.push({ name: selectedTitle, effect: selectedTitleEffect || 'none', color: selectedTitleColor || '#aaaaaa' });

  async function handlePicUpload(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (!file) return;
    try {
      const { url } = await upload(file);
      updateProfile({ profilePic: url });
      toast.success('Profile picture updated!');
    } catch { toast.error('Upload failed'); }
  }

  function save() {
    if (DB.isNameBanned(name)) { toast.error('That name contains inappropriate content and is not allowed.'); return; }
    updateProfile({
      name,
      nameColor: color,
      nameColor2: useGradient ? color2 : '',
      bio,
      activeTitle: selectedTitle,
      activeTitleEffect: selectedTitleEffect,
      activeTitleColor: selectedTitleColor,
      language,
    });
    toast.success('Profile saved!');
    onClose();
  }

  const previewStyle = useGradient
    ? { backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${color}, ${color2})`, WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text' as const, WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent', backgroundClip: 'text' as const }
    : { color };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>My Profile</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">

              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden border-2 border-primary">
                {profile.profilePic ? <img src={profile.profilePic} alt="pfp" className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> : <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{profile.name[0]?.toUpperCase()}</span>}
              </div>
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center"><Camera className="w-5 h-5 text-white" /></div>
              <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={handlePicUpload} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold text-sm" style={previewStyle}>{name || profile.name}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{profile.email}</p>
              {authUser?.createdAt && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">📅 Joined {new Date(authUser.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}</p>}
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground capitalize">Role: {profile.role}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <CustomBackground />

          {/* Display Name */}
          <div><Label>Display Name</Label><Input value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} className="mt-1" /></div>

          {/* Bio */}
          <div><Label>Bio</Label><Input value={bio} onChange={e => setBio(e.target.value)} placeholder="Tell us about yourself..." className="mt-1" maxLength={150} /><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{bio.length}/150</p></div>

          {/* Name Colors */}

            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">

===== FILE: src/components/ReportMessageButton.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Flag } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { reports, staffTools } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';

const CATEGORIES = ['Harassment / bullying', 'Spam', 'Hate speech', 'Inappropriate content', 'Scam', 'Other'];

/** Flag button on a chat message that files an incident report for staff. */
export default function ReportMessageButton({ messageId, senderEmail, content, canHold = false }: { messageId: string; senderEmail: string; content: string; canHold?: boolean }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [cat, setCat] = useState('');
  const [details, setDetails] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function send() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await reports({
        action: 'create', targetType: 'Chat Message', targetId: messageId,
        subject: `${cat} — message from ${senderEmail}`.slice(0, 150),
        reason: `Category: ${cat}\nSender: ${senderEmail}\nMessage: "${content.slice(0, 500)}"\n\nDetails: ${details.trim() || '(none)'}`,
      });
      toast.success('Thanks — staff will review this incident.');
      setOpen(false); setCat(''); setDetails('');
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as { userFacingMessage?: string }).userFacingMessage || 'Could not send report'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  async function hold() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await staffTools({ action: 'hold', email: senderEmail, messageId, reason: cat ? `${cat}: ${details}` : details });
      toast.success('Message hidden and sent to mods for review.');
      setOpen(false); setCat(''); setDetails('');
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not hold message'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive transition-colors" title="Report">
        <Flag className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
      </button>
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>🚩 Report incident</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>Help keep Nexus safe. Staff will review this message.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <p className="text-xs rounded-lg bg-secondary p-2 line-clamp-3">"{content}"</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {CATEGORIES.map(c => <button key={c} onClick={() => setCat(c)} className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-xs transition ${cat === c ? 'border-destructive bg-destructive/15 font-semibold' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary'}`}>{c}</button>)}
          </div>
          <Textarea placeholder="What happened? (optional)" value={details} onChange={e => setDetails(e.target.value)} maxLength={1000} />
          <DialogFooter className="gap-2">
            {canHold && <Button variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={hold}>🛡️ Hide & send to mods</Button>}
            <Button variant="destructive" disabled={!cat || busy} onClick={send}>Send report</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

===== FILE: src/components/ServerBanPanel.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Ban, Globe, Skull, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { bans, BansOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/gameData';

type BanType = 'Ban' | 'IP Ban' | 'Hard Ban';
const TYPES: { id: BanType; icon: typeof Ban; desc: string }[] = [
  { id: 'Ban', icon: Ban, desc: 'Blocks their account' },
  { id: 'IP Ban', icon: Globe, desc: 'Account + every IP they used' },
  { id: 'Hard Ban', icon: Skull, desc: 'Account + IPs + their devices' },
];

export default function ServerBanPanel({ staffName }: { staffName: string }) {
  const [list, setList] = useState<BansOutputType['bans']>([]);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [type, setType] = useState<BanType>('Ban');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { bans({ action: 'list' }).then(r => setList(r.bans)).catch(() => toast.error('Could not load bans')); }, []);

  async function run(action: 'ban' | 'unban', target: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await bans({ action, email: target, banType: type, reason, bannedBy: staffName });
      setList(r.bans);
      if (action === 'ban') { setEmail(''); setReason(''); toast.success(`🔨 ${type} applied to ${target}`); }
      else toast.success(`Unbanned ${target}`);
    } catch { toast.error('Something went wrong'); }
    setBusy(false);
  }

  type Group = { email: string; types: Set<string>; ips: number; devs: number; by: string };
  type Row = { email: string; banType: string; ipAddress: string; deviceId: string; bannedBy: string };
  const map: Record<string, Group> = {};
  for (const b of list as Row[]) {
    const g = map[b.email] ||= { email: b.email, types: new Set<string>(), ips: 0, devs: 0, by: b.bannedBy };
    g.types.add(b.banType); if (b.ipAddress) g.ips++; if (b.deviceId) g.devs++;
  }
  const grouped: Group[] = Object.values(map);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="p-4 bg-card border border-border rounded-xl space-y-3">
        <h3 className="font-semibold flex items-center gap-2"><Ban className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />Ban a User</h3>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {TYPES.map(t => (
            <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setType(t.id)}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-left transition-colors ${type === t.id ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-500/15' : 'border-border hover:bg-secondary'}`}>
              <t.icon className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 mb-1" />
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold">{t.id}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{t.desc}</p>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div><Label>User Email</Label><Input value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="user@email.com" className="mt-1" /></div>
        <div><Label>Reason (optional)</Label><Input value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} placeholder="Spamming" className="mt-1" /></div>
        <Button variant="destructive" className="w-full" disabled={busy || !email.trim()} onClick={() => {
          const t = email.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (isOwnerEmail(t)) { toast.error("Can't ban the owner!"); return; }
          run('ban', t);
        }}>
          {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : <Ban className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />}{type}
        </Button>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">IP and hard bans block every IP/device the user has signed in from. Users who haven't opened the app yet only get an account ban until they do.</p>
      </div>
      <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">Banned Users ({grouped.length})</h3>
      {grouped.length === 0 && <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm py-4">No banned users</p>}
      {grouped.map(g => (
        <div key={g.email} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-card border border-destructive/30 rounded-xl">
          <Ban className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500 flex-shrink-0" />
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{g.email}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{[...g.types].join(', ')} • {g.ips} IPs • {g.devs} devices • by {g.by}</p>
          </div>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('unban', g.email)}>Unban</Button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { formatGems } from '../lib/formatGems';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Gem } from 'lucide-react';
import TitleBadge from './TitleBadge';
import { SHOP_TITLES } from '../lib/gameData';

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void };

export default function ShopModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const { profile, addGems, checkAchievements, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const [buying, setBuying] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!profile) return null;
  const owned = DB.getUserTitles(profile.email);
  const customShopTitles = DB.getCustomTitles().filter(t => t.availableInShop);

  const allShopItems = [
    ...SHOP_TITLES.map(t => ({ name: t.name, effect: t.effect, cost: t.cost, color: t.color, description: t.description })),
    ...customShopTitles.map(t => ({ name: t.name, effect: t.effect as string, cost: t.cost, color: t.color, description: 'Custom title' })),
  ];

  function buy(item: (typeof allShopItems)[0]) {
    if (!profile) return;
    const title = { ...item, cost: shopPrice(item.cost, profile.email) };
    if (profile.gems < title.cost) { toast.error(`Need ${title.cost - profile.gems} more gems!`); return; }
    if (owned.includes(title.name)) { toast.info('Already owned!'); return; }
    setBuying(title.name);
    addGems(-title.cost);
    DB.addUserTitle(profile.email, title.name);
    toast.success(`🎉 You got "${title.name}"!`);
    setTimeout(() => { checkAchievements(); setBuying(null); }, 500);
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-lg max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Gem className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-400" /> Shop
            <span className="ml-auto text-sm font-normal text-purple-300 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Gem className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{formatGems(profile.gems)} gems
            </span>
          </DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <Tabs defaultValue="titles" className="mt-2">
          <TabsList className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 w-full h-auto">
            <TabsTrigger value="titles">Titles</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="bg">Backgrounds</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="typing">Typing</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="cursors">🖱️ Cursors</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="pranks">🃏 Pranks</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="limited">✨ Limited</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <TabsContent value="cursors"><CursorShop /></TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="pranks"><PrankShop /></TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="limited"><LimitedCollection /></TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="bg"><CosmeticShop kind="bg" /></TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="typing"><CosmeticShop kind="typing" /></TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="titles">
        <div className="space-y-3 mt-2">
          {allShopItems.map(item => {
            const isOwned = owned.includes(item.name);
            const cost = shopPrice(item.cost, profile.email);
            const canAfford = profile.gems >= cost;
            return (
              <div key={item.name} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-secondary/30 hover:bg-secondary/50 transition-colors">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                  <TitleBadge title={item.name} effect={item.effect} color={item.color} size="md" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.description}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Gem className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />{cost.toLocaleString()}{isVip(profile.email) && <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-amber-400">👑 −25%</span>}
                  </span>
                  {isOwned
                    ? (profile.activeTitle === item.name
                      ? <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" className="text-xs" onClick={() => updateProfile({ activeTitle: '' })}>Unequip</Button>
                      : <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-xs" onClick={() => updateProfile({ activeTitle: item.name, activeTitleEffect: item.effect, activeTitleColor: item.color })}>Equip</Button>)
                    : <Button size="sm" disabled={!canAfford || buying === item.name} onClick={() => buy(item)} className="text-xs">{buying === item.name ? '…' : 'Buy'}</Button>
                  }
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
