===== FILE: src/components/StaffModTools.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Trash2, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { staffTools } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@project/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

const QUICK = ['Spamming', 'Be respectful', 'Inappropriate language', 'Off-topic'];

export default function StaffModTools({ email, name, warnOnly = false }: { email: string; name: string; warnOnly?: boolean }) {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [hours, setHours] = useState('24');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<'warn' | 'del' | null>(null);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false);

  async function warn(r: string) {
    if (!r.trim()) return;
    setBusy('warn');
    try {
      await staffTools({ action: 'warn', email, reason: r.trim() });
      toast.success(`Warned ${name}`);
      setReason('');
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not warn'); }
    setBusy(null);
  }

  async function bulkDelete() {
    setBusy('del');
    try {
      const res = await staffTools({ action: 'bulkDelete', email, hours: Number(hours) });
      toast.success(`Deleted ${res.deleted} message${res.deleted === 1 ? '' : 's'} from ${name}`);
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not delete'); }
    setBusy(null);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 pt-1 border-t border-primary/20">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {QUICK.map(q => (
          <button key={q} disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => warn(q)}
            className="text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-full border border-border hover:bg-secondary disabled:opacity-50">⚠ {q}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-1.5">
        <Input value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && warn(reason)}
          placeholder="Custom warning…" maxLength={500} className="h-8 text-xs" />
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-8 text-xs gap-1" disabled={!reason.trim() || !!busy} onClick={() => warn(reason)}>
          {busy === 'warn' ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}Warn
        </Button>
      </div>
      {!warnOnly && <div className="flex gap-1.5">
        <Select value={hours} onValueChange={setHours}>
          <SelectTrigger className="h-8 text-xs flex-1"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="1">Last hour</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="24">Last 24 hours</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="168">Last 7 days</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="720">Last 30 days</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-8 text-xs gap-1" disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => setConfirm(true)}>
          {busy === 'del' ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}Delete msgs
        </Button>
      </div>}
      <AlertDialog open={confirm} onOpenChange={setConfirm}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>Delete {name}'s recent messages?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>All their chat messages from the selected time range will be removed for everyone.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={bulkDelete}>Delete</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/StaffReportUser.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Flag, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { reports } from 'zitejs/api';

/** Lets admins, co-owners and owners file a report against a user. */
export default function StaffReportUser({ email, name }: { email: string; name: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function send() {
    if (reason.trim().length < 3) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await reports({ action: 'create', targetType: 'User', targetId: email, subject: `Staff report: ${name}`, reason: reason.trim() });
      toast.success(`Reported ${name}`);
      setReason(''); setOpen(false);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not send report');
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  if (!open) return (
    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full h-8 text-xs gap-1.5 text-destructive" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
      <Flag className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Report {name}
    </Button>
  );
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Textarea value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} placeholder={`Why are you reporting ${name}?`} maxLength={2000} className="text-xs min-h-[64px]" />
      <div className="flex gap-1.5">
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-8 text-xs flex-1" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-8 text-xs flex-1 gap-1" disabled={busy || reason.trim().length < 3} onClick={send}>
          {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Flag className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} Send report
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/StaffUserActions.tsx =====

import { profileSync } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Award, LogIn, UserCog } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import StaffModTools from './StaffModTools';
import StaffReportUser from './StaffReportUser';

const TITLE_GIVERS = ['owner', 'co-owner', 'admin'];

function EditAccount({ email, onDone }: { email: string; onDone: () => void }) {
  const u = DB.getUser(email);
  const [name, setName] = useState(u?.name || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(u?.bio || '');
  const [gems, setGems] = useState(String(u?.gems ?? 0));
  const [color, setColor] = useState(u?.nameColor || '#e0e0ff');
  if (!u) return <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">This account isn't saved on this device yet.</p>;

  function save() {
    if (!name.trim()) { toast.error('Name is required'); return; }
    const g = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(gems) || 0));
    DB.saveUser({ ...DB.getUser(email)!, name: name.trim(), bio, gems: g, nameColor: color });
    if (name.trim() !== u!.name) profileSync({ action: 'setName', targetEmail: email, name: name.trim() }).catch(e => toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Name not synced'));
    toast.success('Account updated');
    onDone();
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <div className="flex gap-1.5">
        <Input value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Name" maxLength={30} className="h-8 text-xs" />
        <input type="color" value={color} onChange={e => setColor(e.target.value)} className="w-9 h-8 rounded cursor-pointer bg-transparent" />
      </div>
      <Input value={bio} onChange={e => setBio(e.target.value)} placeholder="Bio" maxLength={200} className="h-8 text-xs" />
      <Input value={gems} onChange={e => setGems(e.target.value)} type="number" min={0} placeholder="Gems" className="h-8 text-xs" />
      <Button size="sm" className="w-full h-8 text-xs" onClick={save}>Save changes</Button>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function StaffUserActions({ email, name, onDone }: { email: string; name: string; onDone: () => void }) {
  const { profile, isRealOwner, impersonate } = useApp();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const canGive = isRealOwner || TITLE_GIVERS.includes(profile?.role || '');
  const canEdit = isRealOwner || profile?.role === 'owner' || DB.hasPerm(profile, 'editusers');
  const canMod = isRealOwner || ['owner', 'co-owner', 'admin', 'senior-mod', 'mod'].includes(profile?.role || '');
  const canGuard = profile?.role === 'guardian';
  if ((!canGive && !canEdit && !canMod && !canGuard) || email === profile?.email) return null;

  function give() {
    const t = title.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    DB.addUserTitle(email, t);
    toast.success(`Gave "${t}" to ${name}`);
    setTitle('');
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-3 space-y-2">
      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary uppercase tracking-wider">Staff tools</p>
      {canGive && (
        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
          <Input value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && give()} placeholder="Title to give…" maxLength={30} className="h-8 text-xs" />
          <Button size="sm" className="h-8 text-xs gap-1" disabled={!title.trim()} onClick={give}><Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />Give</Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {canEdit && (editing
        ? <EditAccount email={email} onDone={onDone} />
        : <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full h-8 text-xs gap-1.5" onClick={() => setEditing(true)}><UserCog className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Edit account</Button>
      )}
      {(isRealOwner || canGuard || TITLE_GIVERS.includes(profile?.role || '')) && <StaffReportUser email={email} name={name} />}
      {(isRealOwner || ['owner', 'co-owner', 'admin', 'senior-mod', 'mod'].includes(profile?.role || '')) && <StaffModTools email={email} name={name} />}
      {canGuard && <StaffModTools email={email} name={name} warnOnly />}
      {isRealOwner && (
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full h-8 text-xs gap-1.5" onClick={() => { impersonate(email); toast.success(`Now signed in as ${name}`); onDone(); }}>
          <LogIn className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Sign in as {name}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/SuggestionsModal.tsx =====

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { ThumbsUp, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void };

export default function SuggestionsModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const { profile, updateProfile, checkAchievements } = useApp();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState('');
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<DB.Suggestion[]>([]);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { if (open) setSuggestions(DB.getSuggestions().sort((a,b) => b.upvotes - a.upvotes)); }, [open]);

  function submit() {
    if (!profile || !title.trim() || !desc.trim()) { toast.error('Fill in all fields'); return; }
    const sug: DB.Suggestion = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), title: title.trim(), description: desc.trim(), submitterEmail: profile.email, upvotes: 0, upvoters: [], timestamp: Date.now() };
    DB.addSuggestion(sug);
    const updated = { ...profile, suggestionCount: profile.suggestionCount + 1 };
    DB.saveUser(updated); updateProfile(updated);
    toast.success('Suggestion submitted! 💡');
    setTimeout(checkAchievements, 200);
    setTitle(''); setDesc(''); setShowForm(false);
    setSuggestions(DB.getSuggestions().sort((a,b) => b.upvotes - a.upvotes));
  }

  function upvote(id: string) {
    if (!profile) return;
    DB.upvoteSuggestion(id, profile.email);
    setSuggestions(DB.getSuggestions().sort((a,b) => b.upvotes - a.upvotes));
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-md max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center justify-between">💡 Suggestions <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setShowForm(v=>!v)}><Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />New</Button></DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        {showForm && (
          <div className="space-y-3 border border-border rounded-xl p-3 bg-secondary/30">
            <div><Label>Title</Label><Input value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} className="mt-1" /></div>

===== FILE: src/components/TheaterAccessTab.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Clapperboard, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { watchParty } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Checkbox } from '@project/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';

const ROLES = ['co-owner', 'admin', 'senior-mod', 'mod', 'guardian', 'helper', 'vip', 'user'];

/** Owner panel: choose which roles may start movies in the Theater. */
export default function TheaterAccessTab() {
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { watchParty({ action: 'access' }).then(r => setRoles(r.allowedRoles || [])).catch(() => setRoles([])); }, []);
  const toggle = (r: string) => setRoles(cur => cur!.includes(r) ? cur!.filter(x => x !== r) : [...cur!, r]);
  async function save() {
    setSaving(true);
    try { const r = await watchParty({ action: 'setRoles', roles: roles! }); setRoles(r.allowedRoles || []); toast.success('Theater access saved'); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not save'); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
      <p className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold"><Clapperboard className="h-4 w-4" />Who can start movies in Theater</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">The owner can always start movies. Everyone else can only watch movies that are already playing.</p>
      {roles === null ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
          {ROLES.map(r => (
            <label key={r} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border px-2 py-1.5 text-sm capitalize">
              <Checkbox checked={roles.includes(r)} onCheckedChange={() => toggle(r)} />{r.replace('-', ' ')}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      <Button size="sm" onClick={save} disabled={!roles || saving}>{saving && <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}Save</Button>
    </div>
  );
}

type Style = 'linear' | 'radial' | 'glow';
function buildCss(style: Style, c: string[], angle: number) {
  if (style === 'radial') return `radial-gradient(circle at center, ${c[1]} 0%, ${c[0]} 70%)`;
  if (style === 'glow') return `radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, ${c[1]} 0%, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 75%, ${c[2]} 0%, transparent 40%), ${c[0]}`;
  return `linear-gradient(${angle}deg, ${c[0]} 0%, ${c[1]} 55%, ${c[2]} 100%)`;
}

export default function ThemeMaker({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [colors, setColors] = useState(['#0b1020', '#1e3a8a', '#06b6d4']);
  const [style, setStyle] = useState<Style>('linear');
  const [angle, setAngle] = useState(135);
  const [cost, setCost] = useState(500);
  const [inShop, setInShop] = useState(true);
  const [list, setList] = useState<CustomTheme[]>(getCustomThemes);
  const [giveTo, setGiveTo] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const css = buildCss(style, colors, angle);
  const [idea, setIdea] = useState('');

    if (!idea.trim()) return;
    setAiBusy(true);
    try {
      const t = await aiTheme({ idea: idea.trim() });
      setName(t.name); setColors(t.colors); setStyle(t.style); setAngle(t.angle); setCost(t.cost);
      toast.success('✨ Theme designed — tweak it or save it!');
    } catch { toast.error("AI couldn't make a theme, try again"); }
    finally { setAiBusy(false); }
  }

  const save = (next: CustomTheme[]) => { setList(next); saveCustomThemes(next); };
  function create() {
    if (!name.trim()) { toast.error('Give your theme a name'); return; }
    save([...list, { id: `bg-custom-${Date.now()}`, name: name.trim(), cost: Math.max(0, cost), css, inShop }]);
    setName(''); toast.success(inShop ? 'Theme added to the shop!' : 'Theme saved — give it to someone below');
  }
  function give(t: CustomTheme) {
    const email = (giveTo[t.id] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!email) { toast.error('Enter an email'); return; }
    DB.addUserItem(email, t.id);

    setGiveTo({ ...giveTo, [t.id]: '' });
    toast.success(`🎁 Gave ${t.name} to ${email}`);

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Input value={idea} onChange={e => setIdea(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. spooky halloween night, cozy sunset beach…"

import { EFFECT_TO_CLASS, TITLE_FONTS } from '../lib/gameData';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  effect?: string;
  color?: string;
  font?: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
};

export default function TitleBadge({ title, effect = 'none', color = '#aaaaaa', font, size = 'sm' }: Props) {
  if (!title) return null;
  const cls = EFFECT_TO_CLASS[effect] || '';
  const textSize = size === 'sm' ? 'text-xs' : 'text-sm';
  const fontKey = font ?? DB.getCustomTitles().find(t => t.name === title)?.font;
  const family = fontKey ? TITLE_FONTS[fontKey]?.family : undefined;
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold border ${textSize} ${cls}`}
      style={{ color, borderColor: color + '55', backgroundColor: color + '18', fontFamily: family, fontSize: fontKey === 'pixel' ? '0.6rem' : undefined }}
    >
      {title}
    </span>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { ArrowLeftRight, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { trades as tradesApi, TradesOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/tabs';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Badge } from '@project/components/ui/badge';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { getInventory, giveItem, takeItem, notifyInventory, InvItem } from '../lib/inventory';

type Trade = TradesOutputType['trades'][number];
const ICON: Record<string, string> = { theme: '🎨', typing: '⌨️', title: '🏷️', song: '🎵' };

function ItemPicker({ items, picked, toggle }: { items: InvItem[]; picked: string[]; toggle: (k: string) => void }) {
  if (!items.length) return <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">You don't own any tradeable items yet.</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">
      {items.map(i => {
        const k = `${i.kind}:${i.id}`, on = picked.includes(k);
        return <button key={k} onClick={() => toggle(k)} className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border text-[11px] transition ${on ? 'border-primary bg-primary/15 font-semibold' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary'}`}>
          {ICON[i.kind]} {i.name}{i.limited && ' ✦'}
        </button>;
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

const Items = ({ list }: { list: Trade['offer'] }) =>
  list.length ? <span>{list.map(i => `${ICON[i.kind]} ${i.name}`).join(', ')}</span> : <span className="text-muted-foreground">nothing (gift)</span>;

export default function TradesDialog({ open, onOpenChange }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const email = profile?.email ?? '';
  const [list, setList] = useState<Trade[]>([]);
  const [to, setTo] = useState('');
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [answering, setAnswering] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const inv = email ? getInventory(email) : [];
  const toggle = (k: string) => setPicked(p => p.includes(k) ? p.filter(x => x !== k) : [...p, k]);
  const pickedItems = () => inv.filter(i => picked.includes(`${i.kind}:${i.id}`)).map(({ kind, id, name }) => ({ kind, id, name }));

  // Apply accepted trades to this browser's inventory exactly once.
  const sync = useCallback((ts: Trade[]) => {
    setList(ts);
    for (const t of ts.filter(x => x.needsApply)) {
      const give = t.mine ? t.offer : t.giveBack, get = t.mine ? t.giveBack : t.offer;
      give.forEach(i => takeItem(email, i)); get.forEach(i => giveItem(email, i));
      tradesApi({ action: 'applied', id: t.id }).catch(() => {});
      notifyInventory();
      toast.success(`Trade complete! You got ${get.map(i => i.name).join(', ') || 'nothing'}.`);
    }
  }, [email]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!email) return;
    const load = () => tradesApi({ action: 'list' }).then(r => sync(r.trades)).catch(() => {});
    load(); const t = setInterval(load, 20000); return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [email, sync]);

  async function run(action: 'offer' | 'accept' | 'decline' | 'cancel', id?: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await tradesApi({ action, id, toEmail: to, items: action === 'offer' || action === 'accept' ? pickedItems() : undefined });
      sync(r.trades); setPicked([]); setAnswering(null);
      if (action === 'offer') { setTo(''); toast.success('Trade offer sent!'); }
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as { userFacingMessage?: string }).userFacingMessage || 'Something went wrong'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  const incoming = list.filter(t => !t.mine && t.status === 'Pending');
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2"><ArrowLeftRight className="w-5 h-5" />Trade Items</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Trade themes, typing effects, titles and songs (✦ = limited) with other users.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <Tabs defaultValue={incoming.length ? 'inbox' : 'new'}>
          <TabsList className="w-full">
            <TabsTrigger value="new" className="flex-1">New offer</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="inbox" className="flex-1">Inbox {incoming.length > 0 && <Badge className="ml-1 h-4 px-1">{incoming.length}</Badge>}</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="history" className="flex-1">History</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <TabsContent value="new" className="space-y-3">
            <Input placeholder="Their email" value={to} onChange={e => setTo(e.target.value)} />
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold">What you'll give</p>
            <ItemPicker items={inv} picked={picked} toggle={toggle} />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">They choose what to give back when they accept.</p>
            <Button className="w-full" disabled={busy || !to.trim() || !picked.length} onClick={() => run('offer')}>Send offer</Button>
          </TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="inbox" className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            {incoming.length === 0 && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">No trade offers right now.</p>}
            {incoming.map(t => (
              <div key={t.id} className="border border-border rounded-lg p-3 space-y-2 text-xs">
                <p><b>{t.fromEmail}</b> offers: <Items list={t.offer} /></p>
                {answering === t.id ? (
                  <>
                    <p className="font-semibold">Pick what to give back (or nothing):</p>
                    <ItemPicker items={inv} picked={picked} toggle={toggle} />
                    <div className="flex gap-2"><Button size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('accept', t.id)}><Check className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />Confirm trade</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setAnswering(null)}>Back</Button></div>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex gap-2"><Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setPicked([]); setAnswering(t.id); }}>Accept…</Button><Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('decline', t.id)}><X className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />Decline</Button></div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="history" className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            {list.filter(t => t.mine || t.status !== 'Pending').map(t => (
              <div key={t.id} className="border border-border rounded-lg p-2.5 text-xs flex items-start gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-0.5">
                  <p>{t.mine ? <>To <b>{t.toEmail}</b></> : <>From <b>{t.fromEmail}</b></>}</p>
                  <p>Offered: <Items list={t.offer} /></p>
                  {t.status === 'Accepted' && <p>Back: <Items list={t.giveBack} /></p>}
                </div>
                <Badge variant="outline">{t.status}</Badge>
                {t.mine && t.status === 'Pending' && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-6 px-2" disabled={busy} onClick={() => run('cancel', t.id)}>Cancel</Button>}
              </div>
            ))}
            {list.length === 0 && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">No trades yet.</p>}
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/TranslatedText.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Languages } from 'lucide-react';
import { translate } from 'zitejs/api';

const cache = new Map<string, string>();
let queue: { lang: string; text: string; resolve: (t: string) => void }[] = [];
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

function flush() {
  timer = null;
  const batch = queue; queue = [];
  const byLang = new Map<string, typeof batch>();
  batch.forEach(q => byLang.set(q.lang, [...(byLang.get(q.lang) || []), q]));
  byLang.forEach((items, lang) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 40) {
      const chunk = items.slice(i, i + 40);
      translate({ lang, texts: chunk.map(c => c.text.slice(0, 500)) })
        .then(r => chunk.forEach((c, j) => { const t = r.translations[j] || c.text; cache.set(`${lang}|${c.text}`, t); c.resolve(t); }))
        .catch(() => chunk.forEach(c => c.resolve(c.text)));
    }
  });
}

function translateBatched(lang: string, text: string) {
  const hit = cache.get(`${lang}|${text}`);
  if (hit) return Promise.resolve(hit);
  return new Promise<string>(resolve => { queue.push({ lang, text, resolve }); if (!timer) timer = setTimeout(flush, 250); });
}

const COMMON_EN = new Set('i you he she it we they the a an and or but is are was were be am to of in on at for with my your me so not no yes yeah lol ok okay hi hey hello what why how who when where this that do does did can will just like im its dont gonna wanna good bad u ur sup bro thanks ty np idk omg wow nice cool fr'.split(' '));
/** Cheap guess so we only call the translator for messages that aren't already English. */
export function looksForeign(text: string): boolean {
  const t = text.replace(/https?:\/\/\S+|@\w+|\[gif\]\S*/g, '');
  const letters: string[] = t.match(/\p{L}/gu) ?? [];
  if (!letters.length) return false;
  const nonLatin = letters.filter(c => !/[a-zA-Z]/.test(c)).length;
  if (nonLatin / letters.length > 0.15) return true;
  const words: string[] = t.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z']+/g) ?? [];
  if (words.length < 3) return false;
  return !words.some(w => COMMON_EN.has(w.replace(/'/g, '')));
}

/** Shows a chat message; auto-translates into `lang` (non-English) and lets anyone flip between original/translation. */
export default function TranslatedText({ text, auto, style }: { text: string; lang?: string; auto: boolean; style?: React.CSSProperties }) {
  const target = 'en';
  // Only messages that aren't already English get translated
  const foreign = looksForeign(text);
  const [on, setOn] = useState(auto && foreign);
  const [tr, setTr] = useState<string | null>(cache.get(`${target}|${text}`) ?? null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!on || tr || !text.trim()) return;
    let alive = true;
    translateBatched(target, text).then(t => alive && setTr(t));
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [on, tr, text, target]);
  const showing = on && tr && tr.trim() !== text.trim();
  return (
    <span data-no-translate>
      <span style={style}>{showing ? tr : text}</span>
      {(foreign || auto) && text.trim() && <button type="button" onClick={() => setOn(o => !o)} title={showing ? 'Show original' : 'Translate to English'}
        className="ml-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 align-middle text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary opacity-60 hover:opacity-100">
        <Languages className="w-3 h-3" />{showing ? 'original' : on && !tr ? '…' : 'translate'}
      </button>}
    </span>
  );
}

import { formatGems } from '../lib/formatGems';

import RoleChip from './RoleChip';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { roles as rolesApi } from 'zitejs/api';

type Props = { email: string | null; onClose: () => void; onStartDM?: (email: string) => void };

function getRoleBadge(role: string) {
  switch (role) {
    case 'owner':    return { label: 'Owner',    color: '#ffd700', icon: <Crown className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    case 'co-owner': return { label: 'Co-Owner', color: '#ff9900', icon: <Star className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    case 'admin':    return { label: 'Admin',    color: '#ff4444', icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    case 'senior-mod': return { label: 'Senior Mod', color: '#a855f7', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    case 'mod':      return { label: 'Mod',      color: '#44aaff', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    case 'helper':   return { label: 'Helper',   color: '#22c55e', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    case 'guardian': return { label: 'Guardian', color: '#14b8a6', icon: <Shield className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    case 'vip':      return { label: 'VIP',      color: '#ec4899', icon: <Star className="w-3 h-3" /> };
    default:         return null;
  }
}

export default function UserProfileModal({ email, onClose, onStartDM }: Props) {
  const local = email ? DB.getUser(email) : null;
  const [remote, setRemote] = useState<DB.UserProfile | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [joinedAt, setJoinedAt] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    setRemote(null); setJoinedAt(0);
    if (!email) return;
    setLoading(true);
    rolesApi({ action: 'profile', email }).then(r => {
      const p = r.profile;
      if (!p) return;
      setJoinedAt(p.joinedAt);
      const base = DB.getUser(email);
      setRemote({
        ...(base || { bio: '', nameColor2: '', gems: 0, badges: [], messageCount: 0, gambleWins: 0 } as unknown as DB.UserProfile),
        email: p.email, name: p.name, profilePic: p.profilePic || base?.profilePic || '', nameColor: p.nameColor || base?.nameColor || '#e0e0ff',
        activeTitle: p.activeTitle, activeTitleColor: p.activeTitleColor, activeTitleEffect: p.activeTitleEffect,
        role: p.role as DB.UserProfile['role'], lastSeen: Math.max(p.lastSeen, base?.lastSeen || 0),
      });
    }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [email]);
  const user = remote || local;
  if (!email) return null;
  if (!user) return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-sm">
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>User Profile</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">{loading ? 'Loading profile…' : "This person hasn't set up a profile yet."}</p>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );

  const roleBadge = getRoleBadge(user.role);
  const achievements = DB.getUserAchievements(user.email);
  const userBadges = user.badges || [];
  const isOnline = (Date.now() - (user.lastSeen || 0)) < 2 * 60 * 1000;

  return (
    <Dialog open={!!email} onOpenChange={v => !v && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="bg-card border-border max-w-sm">
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>User Profile</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Avatar + Name */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden border-2 border-border">
                {user.profilePic
                  ? <img src={user.profilePic} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  : <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{user.name[0]?.toUpperCase()}</span>}
              </div>
              <div className={cn('absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 border-card', isOnline ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-muted-foreground/40')} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="font-black text-lg truncate" style={
                user.nameColor2
                  ? { backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${user.nameColor}, ${user.nameColor2})`, WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text', WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent', backgroundClip: 'text' }
                  : { color: user.nameColor }
              }>{user.name}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{user.email}</p>
              {joinedAt > 0 && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">📅 Joined {new Date(joinedAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}</p>}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
                {roleBadge && (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border"
                    style={{ color: roleBadge.color, borderColor: roleBadge.color + '55', backgroundColor: roleBadge.color + '18' }}>
                    {roleBadge.icon}{roleBadge.label}
                  </span>
                )}
                {user.customRole && (
                  <RoleChip name={user.customRole} color={user.customRoleColor} color2={user.customRoleColor2 || undefined} className="text-[10px]" />
                )}
                {(() => { const tag = DB.getUserTagForUser(user.email); return tag ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full"
                    style={{ color: tag.color, backgroundColor: tag.color + '18', border: `1px solid ${tag.color}55` }}>
                    {tag.icon} {tag.name}
                  </span>
                ) : null; })()}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Active Title */}
          {user.activeTitle && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Title:</span>
              <TitleBadge title={user.activeTitle} effect={user.activeTitleEffect} color={user.activeTitleColor} />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Bio */}
          <div className="bg-secondary/30 rounded-xl p-3">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-semibold mb-1">BIO</p>
            <p className="text-sm">{user.bio || 'No bio set'}</p>
          </div>

          {/* Stats */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
            {[
              { icon: <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />, val: user.messageCount, label: 'Messages' },
              { icon: <Gem className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />, val: formatGems(user.gems), label: 'Gems' },
              { icon: <Trophy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />, val: achievements.length, label: 'Achievements' },
              { icon: <Dices className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />, val: user.gambleWins, label: 'Gamble Wins' },
            ].map((s, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="bg-secondary/20 rounded-lg p-2 text-center">
                <div className="flex justify-center mb-0.5 text-muted-foreground">{s.icon}</div>
                <p className="text-sm font-black">{(s.val ?? 0).toLocaleString()}</p>
                <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Badges */}
          <div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-semibold mb-2">BADGES ({userBadges.length})</p>
            {userBadges.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground italic">No badges earned yet</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {userBadges.map(bId => {
                  const badge = badgeLook(bId);
                  if (!badge) return null;
                  return (
                    <span key={bId} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold pl-1 pr-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/30" title={badge.description}>
                      <ProBadge icon={badge.icon} color={badge.color} color2={badge.color2} size={22} />{badge.name}
                    </span>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <StaffUserActions email={user.email} name={user.name} onDone={onClose} />

          <FriendButton email={user.email} />

          {/* Message button */}
          {onStartDM && (
            <Button className="w-full gap-2" onClick={() => { onStartDM(user.email); onClose(); }}>
              <MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> Send Message
            </Button>
          )}

          {/* Member since */}
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground text-center">
            {isOnline ? '🟢 Online now' : `Last seen ${new Date(user.lastSeen).toLocaleString()}`}
          </p>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/WarningNotice.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { staffTools, StaffToolsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';

type Warning = StaffToolsOutputType['warnings'][0];

/** Shows unacknowledged staff warnings to the signed-in user. */
export default function WarningNotice() {
  const [list, setList] = useState<Warning[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const load = () => staffTools({ action: 'myWarnings' }).then(r => alive && setList(r.warnings)).catch(() => {});
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 30000);
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(t); };
  }, []);

  const w = list[0];
  if (!w) return null;

  async function ack() {
    setList(l => l.slice(1));
    staffTools({ action: 'ack', warningId: w.id }).catch(() => {});
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={() => {}}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-sm [&>button]:hidden">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-destructive"><AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" /> You received a warning</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>A staff member flagged your behavior. Repeated warnings can lead to a mute or ban.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-sm">{w.reason}</div>
        <Button onClick={ack} className="w-full">I understand</Button>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/WebsiteMakerButton.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Code2, Loader2, Wand2, RotateCcw, Undo2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { aiWebsite } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';
import BuilderPreview from './builder/BuilderPreview';

const LIMIT = 200_000;
const KINDS = [
  { id: 'business / startup landing page', label: '🚀 Landing page' },
  { id: 'SaaS web app with dashboard', label: '📊 Web app' },
  { id: 'online store with cart', label: '🛍️ Store' },
  { id: 'personal portfolio website', label: '🎨 Portfolio' },
  { id: 'blog / fan page', label: '📰 Blog' },
  { id: 'browser game', label: '🕹️ Game' },
  { id: 'productivity tool (todo, notes, planner)', label: '✅ Tool' },
  { id: 'custom website', label: '✨ Anything' },
];

interface Msg { prompt: string; html: string }

/** AI website builder (Base44 / Zite / Kliv style): chat to build, then keep chatting to edit. */
export default function WebsiteMakerButton() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState(KINDS[0].id);
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState('');
  const [versions, setVersions] = useState<Msg[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [liveChars, setLiveChars] = useState(0);
  const html = versions.at(-1)?.html ?? '';
  const over = prompt.length > LIMIT;

  async function run() {
    const text = prompt.trim();
    if (over || (html && !text)) return;
    setBusy(true); setLiveChars(0);
    try {
      const s = aiWebsite({ kind, prompt: text, currentHtml: html || undefined, history: versions.map(v => v.prompt) });
      for await (const chunk of s) setLiveChars(n => n + chunk.length);
      const r = await s.result;
      setVersions(v => [...v, { prompt: text || `Build a ${kind}`, html: r.html }]);
      setPrompt('');
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not build the site'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}><Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" /> Website Builder</Button>
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-[95vw] w-[95vw] h-[92vh] p-0 overflow-hidden flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-0">
          <DialogTitle className="sr-only">AI Website Builder</DialogTitle>
          <div className="md:w-96 shrink-0 flex flex-col border-b md:border-b-0 md:border-r border-border max-h-[50vh] md:max-h-none">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-border">
              <h2 className="font-black text-lg">🌐 AI Website Builder</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Describe any site or app. Keep chatting to change it.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3">
              {!html && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                  {KINDS.map(k => (
                    <button key={k.id} onClick={() => setKind(k.id)}
                      className={cn('text-xs rounded-md border px-2 py-1.5 text-left', kind === k.id ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10' : 'border-border hover:bg-muted')}>{k.label}</button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
              {versions.map((v, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="ml-6 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 px-3 py-2 text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap break-words max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">{v.prompt}</div>
                  <div className="mr-6 rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-xs">✅ Version {i + 1} built ({v.html.length.toLocaleString()} chars)</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 border-t border-border space-y-2">
              <Textarea value={prompt} onChange={e => setPrompt(e.target.value)} rows={5}
                onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) run(); }}
                placeholder={html ? 'What should change? e.g. "add a pricing page and dark mode"' : 'Describe your site in as much detail as you want…'} />
              <div className={cn('text-[11px] text-right', over ? 'text-destructive font-semibold' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                {prompt.length.toLocaleString()} / {LIMIT.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <Button className="w-full" onClick={run} disabled={busy || over || (!!html && !prompt.trim())}>
                {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1 animate-spin" /> : <Wand2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />}{html ? 'Update site' : 'Build it'}
              </Button>
              {html && (
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="flex-1" disabled={busy || versions.length < 2} onClick={() => setVersions(v => v.slice(0, -1))}><Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Undo</Button>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="flex-1" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setVersions([])}><RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Start over</Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <BuilderPreview html={html} liveChars={liveChars} busy={busy} />
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/WeeklyTitles.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { CalendarClock } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { getWeeklyTitles } from '../lib/cosmetics';
import TitleBadge from './TitleBadge';

/** 3 new titles each week, buyable with gems. */
export default function WeeklyTitles() {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const owned = DB.getUserTitles(profile.email);
  const titles = getWeeklyTitles();
  const now = new Date();
  const daysLeft = 7 - ((Math.floor(now.getTime() / 86400000) + 4) % 7);

  function buy(t: ReturnType<typeof getWeeklyTitles>[0]) {
    if ((profile!.gems ?? 0) < t.cost) { toast.error('Not enough gems'); return; }
    addGems(-t.cost);
    DB.addUserTitle(profile!.email, t.name);
    if (!DB.getCustomTitles().some(c => c.name === t.name)) {
      DB.addCustomTitle({ id: `weekly-${t.name}`, name: t.name, effect: t.effect, color: t.color, cost: t.cost, createdBy: 'weekly', availableInShop: false });
    }
    toast.success(`Unlocked "${t.name}" — equip it in your profile`);
    bump(n => n + 1);
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 space-y-2">
      <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><CalendarClock className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> Weekly Titles</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">New titles in {daysLeft} day{daysLeft === 1 ? '' : 's'}</p>
      {titles.map(t => (
        <div key={t.name} className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <TitleBadge title={t.name} effect={t.effect} color={t.color} />
          <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">💎 {t.cost}</span>
          <Button size="sm" className="h-7 text-xs" disabled={owned.includes(t.name)} onClick={() => buy(t)}>{owned.includes(t.name) ? 'Owned' : 'Buy'}</Button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/WhatsNew.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Bug, Wrench, Rocket } from 'lucide-react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { CHANGELOG, APP_VERSION } from '../lib/changelog';
import { useAuth } from 'zitejs/auth';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/permissions';

const hideIdeas = (items: string[], owner: boolean) => owner ? items : items.filter(i => !/idea generator/i.test(i));

const SEEN = 'nexus_seen_version';

function Section({ icon, label, items, tone }: { icon: React.ReactNode; label: string; items: string[]; tone: string }) {
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <div>
      <p className={`text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 mb-1 ${tone}`}>{icon}{label}</p>
      <ul className="space-y-1">{items.map(i => <li key={i} className="text-sm text-muted-foreground pl-3 border-l-2 border-border">{i}</li>)}</ul>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Sidebar version chip + changelog dialog. Auto-opens once after a new version. */
export default function WhatsNew() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const fresh = localStorage.getItem(SEEN) !== APP_VERSION;
  useEffect(() => { if (fresh) setOpen(true); }, [fresh]);
  const close = (v: boolean) => { setOpen(v); if (!v) localStorage.setItem(SEEN, APP_VERSION); };

  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} className="px-3 py-2 border-t border-border hover:bg-secondary transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground w-full">
        <Rocket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> What's new
        <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-secondary">v{APP_VERSION}</span>
        {fresh && <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary" />}
      </button>
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={close}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2"><Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />What's new in Nexus</DialogTitle>
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {CHANGELOG.map((r, i) => (
              <div key={r.version} className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                  <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold">v{r.version}</span>
                  {i === 0 && <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-bold">LATEST</span>}
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-auto">{r.date}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="font-semibold">{r.title}</p>
                <Section icon={<Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />} label="New" items={hideIdeas(r.added, isOwnerEmail(user?.email))} tone="text-green-500" />
                <Section icon={<Bug className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Bug fixes" items={r.fixed} tone="text-red-500" />
                <Section icon={<Wrench className="w-3 h-3" />} label="Changes" items={r.changed} tone="text-blue-500" />
              </div>
            ))}
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground text-center border-t border-border pt-3">© 2026–2050 Nexus Hub. All rights reserved.</p>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/admin/FeedbackTab.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Bug, Lightbulb, ThumbsUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/tabs';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import * as DB from '../../lib/storage';

/** Owner panel feedback: bug reports and suggestions in one place. */
export default function FeedbackTab() {
  const [bugs, setBugs] = useState<DB.Bug[]>(() => DB.getBugs());
  const suggestions = DB.getSuggestions().sort((a, b) => b.upvotes - a.upvotes);
  const setStatus = (id: string, s: DB.Bug['status']) => { DB.updateBugStatus(id, s); setBugs(DB.getBugs()); };

  return (
    <Tabs defaultValue="bugs">
      <TabsList className="mb-3">
        <TabsTrigger value="bugs"><Bug className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Bugs ({bugs.length})</TabsTrigger>
        <TabsTrigger value="suggestions"><Lightbulb className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Suggestions ({suggestions.length})</TabsTrigger>
      </TabsList>
      <TabsContent value="bugs" className="space-y-3">
        {bugs.length === 0 && <p className="text-muted-foreground text-center py-4 text-sm">No bug reports yet!</p>}
        {bugs.map(bug => (
          <div key={bug.id} className="p-3 bg-card border border-border rounded-xl space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div><p className="font-semibold text-sm">{bug.title}</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">by {bug.reporterName}</p></div>
              <Select value={bug.status} onValueChange={v => setStatus(bug.id, v as DB.Bug['status'])}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-32 h-7 text-xs"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent><SelectItem value="open">Open</SelectItem><SelectItem value="in-progress">In Progress</SelectItem><SelectItem value="resolved">Resolved</SelectItem></SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{bug.description}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent value="suggestions" className="space-y-3">
        {suggestions.length === 0 && <p className="text-muted-foreground text-center py-4 text-sm">No suggestions yet!</p>}
        {suggestions.map(s => (
          <div key={s.id} className="p-3 bg-card border border-border rounded-xl flex gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-primary text-xs font-bold"><ThumbsUp className="w-4 h-4" />{s.upvotes}</div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="font-semibold text-sm">{s.title}</p>
              {s.description && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.description}</p>}
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">{s.submitterEmail} · {new Date(s.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </TabsContent>
    </Tabs>
  );

===== FILE: src/components/admin/IpBansTab.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Ban, ShieldAlert, Undo2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { ipBans, IpBansOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@project/components/ui/badge';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Card } from '@project/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@project/components/ui/table';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { errMsg, when } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

type Data = IpBansOutputType;
const DURATIONS = [['1h', '1 hour'], ['24h', '24 hours'], ['7d', '7 days'], ['30d', '30 days'], ['permanent', 'Permanent']] as const;
type Dur = typeof DURATIONS[number][0];

export default function IpBansTab() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Data | null>(null);
  const [ip, setIp] = useState('');
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState<Dur>('24h');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [unbanId, setUnbanId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const run = (p: Parameters<typeof ipBans>[0], ok?: string) => ipBans(p).then(r => { setData(r); if (ok) toast.success(ok); return true; }).catch(e => { toast.error(errMsg(e)); return false; });
  useEffect(() => { run({ action: 'list' }); }, []);

  async function doBan() {
    setConfirm(false);
    if (await run({ action: 'ban', ip: ip.trim(), duration, reason: reason.trim() }, `Banned ${ip}`)) { setIp(''); setReason(''); }
  }

  if (!data) return <Skeleton className="h-64" />;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {!data.fullIps && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5"><ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />IP addresses are partly hidden. Only Admins can see full IPs and ban them.</p>}
      {data.canBan && (
        <Card className="p-4 space-y-3">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">Ban an IP address</h3>
          <div className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-[1fr_160px]">
            <Input placeholder="e.g. 203.0.113.7" value={ip} onChange={e => setIp(e.target.value)} maxLength={45} />
            <Select value={duration} onValueChange={v => setDuration(v as Dur)}>
              <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>{DURATIONS.map(([v, l]) => <SelectItem key={v} value={v}>{l}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <Input placeholder="Reason (required)" value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} maxLength={500} />
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Safeguard: your own IP and any IP a staff member uses can't be banned.</p>
            <Button variant="destructive" disabled={!ip.trim() || !reason.trim()} onClick={() => setConfirm(true)}><Ban className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Ban</Button>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      <section className="space-y-2">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">IP bans</h3>
        <div className="border border-border rounded-lg overflow-x-auto"><Table>
          <TableHeader><TableRow><TableHead>IP</TableHead><TableHead>Reason</TableHead><TableHead>By</TableHead><TableHead>Expires</TableHead><TableHead /></TableRow></TableHeader>
          <TableBody>{data.bans.map(b => (
            <TableRow key={b.id} className={b.active ? '' : 'opacity-50'}>
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{b.ip}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs max-w-xs truncate">{b.reason}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs">{b.bannedBy}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs whitespace-nowrap">{b.expiresAt ? when(b.expiresAt) : 'Never'}{!b.active && ' (expired)'}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right">{data.canBan && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setUnbanId(b.id)}><Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Remove</Button>}</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}</TableBody>
        </Table>{!data.bans.length && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-6 text-center">No IP bans.</p>}</div>
      </section>

      <section className="space-y-2">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">Recent IP addresses</h3>
        <div className="border border-border rounded-lg overflow-x-auto"><Table>
          <TableHeader><TableRow><TableHead>IP</TableHead><TableHead>Accounts</TableHead><TableHead>Last seen</TableHead><TableHead /></TableRow></TableHeader>
          <TableBody>{data.sightings.map(s => (
            <TableRow key={s.ip + s.lastSeen}>
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{s.ip} {s.staff && <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-1">staff</Badge>}{s.banned && <Badge variant="destructive" className="ml-1">banned</Badge>}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs">{s.emails.join(', ')}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs whitespace-nowrap">{when(s.lastSeen)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right">{data.canBan && !s.staff && !s.banned && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setIp(s.ip)}>Use</Button>}</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}</TableBody>
        </Table></div>
      </section>

      <AlertDialog open={confirm} onOpenChange={setConfirm}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader><AlertDialogTitle>Ban {ip}?</AlertDialogTitle><AlertDialogDescription>Everyone on this IP will be blocked for {DURATIONS.find(d => d[0] === duration)?.[1].toLowerCase()}. This is logged.</AlertDialogDescription></AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter><AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel><AlertDialogAction onClick={doBan}>Ban IP</AlertDialogAction></AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialog open={!!unbanId} onOpenChange={o => !o && setUnbanId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader><AlertDialogTitle>Remove this IP ban?</AlertDialogTitle><AlertDialogDescription>People on that IP will be able to use the app again.</AlertDialogDescription></AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter><AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel><AlertDialogAction onClick={() => { if (unbanId) run({ action: 'unban', banId: unbanId }, 'Ban removed'); setUnbanId(null); }}>Remove ban</AlertDialogAction></AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { reports, ReportsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@project/components/ui/badge';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Card } from '@project/components/ui/card';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/tabs';
import { errMsg, when } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

type R = ReportsOutputType['reports'][number];

export default function ReportsTab() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<R[] | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('Open');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  useEffect(() => { reports({ action: 'list' }).then(r => setItems(r.reports)).catch(e => toast.error(errMsg(e))); }, []);

  async function review(r: R, status: 'Resolved' | 'Dismissed' | 'Open') {
    try { const res = await reports({ action: 'review', id: r.id, status, note: notes[r.id] || '' }); setItems(res.reports); toast.success(`Report ${status.toLowerCase()}`); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); }
  }

  if (!items) return <Skeleton className="h-48" />;
  const shown = items.filter(r => filter === 'All' || r.status === filter);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <Tabs value={filter} onValueChange={setFilter}><TabsList>
        {['Open', 'Resolved', 'Dismissed', 'All'].map(s => <TabsTrigger key={s} value={s}>{s}{s === 'Open' && ` (${items.filter(r => r.status === 'Open').length})`}</TabsTrigger>)}
      </TabsList></Tabs>
      {!shown.length && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-10 text-center">Nothing here.</p>}
      {shown.map(r => (
        <Card key={r.id} className="p-4 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Badge variant="outline">{r.targetType}</Badge>
            <span className="font-semibold">{r.subject}</span>
            <Badge variant={r.status === 'Open' ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'} className="ml-auto">{r.status}</Badge>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{r.reason}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">From {r.reporterEmail} · {when(r.reportedAt)}{r.reviewedBy && ` · reviewed by ${r.reviewedBy}`}</p>
          {r.resolutionNote && <p className="text-xs border-l-2 border-border pl-2">{r.resolutionNote}</p>}
          {r.status === 'Open' ? (
            <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <Input className="flex-1 min-w-[180px] h-8" placeholder="Note (optional)" value={notes[r.id] || ''} onChange={e => setNotes({ ...notes, [r.id]: e.target.value })} maxLength={1000} />
              <Button size="sm" onClick={() => review(r, 'Resolved')}>Resolve</Button>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => review(r, 'Dismissed')}>Dismiss</Button>
            </div>
          ) : <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => review(r, 'Open')}>Reopen</Button>}
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { useDebouncedCallback } from 'use-debounce';
import { adminUsers, AdminUsersOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@project/components/ui/badge';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@project/components/ui/table';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { errMsg } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

type U = AdminUsersOutputType['users'][number];
const ROLES = ['Customer', 'Seller', 'Moderator', 'Admin'] as const;
const RESTRICTIONS = ['None', 'Muted', 'Selling Disabled', 'Suspended'] as const;

export default function UsersTab({ canAssign }: { canAssign: boolean }) {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<U[] | null>(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [restricting, setRestricting] = useState<U | null>(null);
  const [restriction, setRestriction] = useState<typeof RESTRICTIONS[number]>('None');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const search = useDebouncedCallback((s: string) => adminUsers({ action: 'search', q: s }).then(r => setUsers(r.users)).catch(e => toast.error(errMsg(e))), 300);
  useEffect(() => { search(''); }, []);

  async function setRole(u: U, role: typeof ROLES[number]) {
    try { const r = await adminUsers({ action: 'setRole', email: u.email, marketRole: role, q }); setUsers(r.users); toast.success(`${u.name} is now ${role}`); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); }
  }
  async function saveRestriction() {
    if (!restricting) return;
    try { const r = await adminUsers({ action: 'restrict', email: restricting.email, restriction, reason: reason.trim(), q }); setUsers(r.users); toast.success('Restriction saved'); setRestricting(null); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="relative max-w-sm"><Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input className="pl-9" placeholder="Search name or email" value={q} onChange={e => { setQ(e.target.value); search(e.target.value); }} /></div>
      {!users ? <Skeleton className="h-48" /> : (
        <div className="border border-border rounded-lg overflow-x-auto">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader><TableRow><TableHead>User</TableHead><TableHead>Chat role</TableHead><TableHead>Market role</TableHead><TableHead>Restriction</TableHead><TableHead /></TableRow></TableHeader>
