              <TableRow key={u.email}>
                <TableCell><div className="font-medium">{u.name}</div><div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{u.email}</div></TableCell>
                <TableCell><Badge variant="outline">{u.chatRole}</Badge></TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {canAssign ? (
                    <Select value={u.marketRole} onValueChange={v => setRole(u, v as typeof ROLES[number])}>
                      <SelectTrigger className="h-8 w-32"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>{ROLES.map(r => <SelectItem key={r} value={r}>{r}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  ) : <Badge variant="secondary">{u.marketRole}</Badge>}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{u.restriction === 'None' ? <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span> : <Badge variant="destructive" title={u.restrictionReason}>{u.restriction}</Badge>}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right"><Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setRestricting(u); setRestriction(u.restriction as typeof RESTRICTIONS[number]); setReason(u.restrictionReason); }}>Restrict</Button></TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}</TableBody>
          </Table>
          {!users.length && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-8 text-center">No users found.</p>}
        </div>
      )}
      <Dialog open={!!restricting} onOpenChange={o => !o && setRestricting(null)}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Account restriction — {restricting?.name}</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
          <Select value={restriction} onValueChange={v => setRestriction(v as typeof RESTRICTIONS[number])}>
            <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>{RESTRICTIONS.map(r => <SelectItem key={r} value={r}>{r}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Textarea rows={3} placeholder="Reason (required unless removing)" value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} maxLength={500} />
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setRestricting(null)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={saveRestriction} disabled={restriction !== 'None' && !reason.trim()}>Save</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/art/MusicMaker.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Play, Square, Trash2, Save, Shuffle } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Slider } from '@project/components/ui/slider';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';

const STEPS = 16;
const NOTES = [
  { n: 'C5', f: 523.25 }, { n: 'A4', f: 440 }, { n: 'G4', f: 392 }, { n: 'E4', f: 329.63 },
  { n: 'D4', f: 293.66 }, { n: 'C4', f: 261.63 },
];
const DRUMS = ['Hi-hat', 'Snare', 'Kick'];
const ROWS = NOTES.length + DRUMS.length;
const WAVES: OscillatorType[] = ['sine', 'square', 'triangle', 'sawtooth'];
type Song = { name: string; grid: boolean[][]; bpm: number; wave: OscillatorType };
const KEY = 'nexus_songs';
const empty = () => Array.from({ length: ROWS }, () => Array(STEPS).fill(false));
const loadSongs = (): Song[] => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]'); } catch { return []; } };

function playRow(ctx: AudioContext, row: number, wave: OscillatorType) {
  const t = ctx.currentTime;
  const g = ctx.createGain(); g.connect(ctx.destination);
  if (row < NOTES.length) {
    const o = ctx.createOscillator(); o.type = wave; o.frequency.value = NOTES[row].f; o.connect(g);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.3); o.start(t); o.stop(t + 0.3);
    return;
  }
  const d = DRUMS[row - NOTES.length];
  if (d === 'Kick') {
    const o = ctx.createOscillator(); o.connect(g); o.frequency.setValueAtTime(150, t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(40, t + 0.2);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.8, t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.25); o.start(t); o.stop(t + 0.25);
  } else {
    const len = d === 'Snare' ? 0.15 : 0.05;
    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate * len, ctx.sampleRate); const data = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    const s = ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = buf;
    const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'highpass'; f.frequency.value = d === 'Snare' ? 1000 : 6000;
    s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.gain.setValueAtTime(d === 'Snare' ? 0.4 : 0.2, t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + len); s.start(t);
  }
}

export default function MusicMaker() {
  const [grid, setGrid] = useState<boolean[][]>(empty);
  const [bpm, setBpm] = useState(110);
  const [wave, setWave] = useState<OscillatorType>('triangle');
  const [step, setStep] = useState(-1);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [songs, setSongs] = useState<Song[]>(loadSongs);
  const ctxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const live = useRef({ grid, wave }); live.current = { grid, wave };
  const playing = step >= 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setStep(s => {
        const n = (s + 1) % STEPS;
        live.current.grid.forEach((r, i) => r[n] && playRow(ctxRef.current!, i, live.current.wave));
        return n;
      });
    }, 60000 / bpm / 4);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [playing, bpm]);

  const toggle = (r: number, c: number) => {
    setGrid(g => g.map((row, i) => i === r ? row.map((v, j) => j === c ? !v : v) : row));
    if (!grid[r][c]) { ctxRef.current ??= new AudioContext(); playRow(ctxRef.current, r, wave); }
  };
  const play = () => { ctxRef.current ??= new AudioContext(); ctxRef.current.resume(); setStep(playing ? -1 : STEPS - 1); };
  const random = () => setGrid(empty().map((r, i) => r.map(() => Math.random() < (i < NOTES.length ? 0.12 : 0.25))));
  const save = () => {
    if (!name.trim()) return toast.error('Give your song a name');
    const next = [{ name: name.trim(), grid, bpm, wave }, ...songs.filter(s => s.name !== name.trim())].slice(0, 30);
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(next)); setSongs(next); toast.success('Song saved');
  };
  const del = (n: string) => { const next = songs.filter(s => s.name !== n); localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(next)); setSongs(next); };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Button onClick={play}>{playing ? <><Square className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Stop</> : <><Play className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Play</>}</Button>
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={random}><Shuffle className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Random</Button>
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setGrid(empty())}><Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Clear</Button>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-48"><span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground w-16">{bpm} BPM</span><Slider value={[bpm]} min={60} max={200} step={1} onValueChange={v => setBpm(v[0])} /></div>
        <div className="flex gap-1">{WAVES.map(w => <Button key={w} size="sm" variant={wave === w ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setWave(w)} className="capitalize">{w}</Button>)}</div>
      </div>
      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-3 overflow-x-auto">
        {grid.map((row, r) => (
          <div key={r} className={cn('flex items-center gap-1 mb-1', r === NOTES.length && 'mt-3')}>
            <span className="w-14 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{r < NOTES.length ? NOTES[r].n : DRUMS[r - NOTES.length]}</span>
            {row.map((on, c) => (
              <button key={c} onClick={() => toggle(r, c)} className={cn('w-8 h-8 shrink-0 rounded-md border transition-all', c % 4 === 0 ? 'border-border' : 'border-border/50',
                on ? (r < NOTES.length ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-accent') : 'bg-secondary/40 hover:bg-secondary', step === c && 'ring-2 ring-foreground/60 scale-105')} />
            ))}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2 max-w-sm"><Input placeholder="Song name" value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} /><Button onClick={save}><Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Save</Button></div>
      {songs.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {songs.map(s => (
            <div key={s.name} className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-secondary rounded-full pl-3 pr-1 py-1 text-xs">
              <button onClick={() => { setGrid(s.grid); setBpm(s.bpm); setWave(s.wave); setName(s.name); }} className="font-semibold hover:underline">🎵 {s.name}</button>
              <button onClick={() => del(s.name)} className="p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"><Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/browser/BrowserView.tsx =====

import { Loader2, AlertTriangle, RotateCw, ExternalLink, ShieldOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { SearchHome, SearchResults, Result } from './SearchViews';

export type TabView =
  | { kind: 'home' }
  | { kind: 'loading' }
  | { kind: 'results'; query: string; results: Result[]; provider: string }
  | { kind: 'page'; html: string }
  | { kind: 'direct'; url: string }
  | { kind: 'error'; code: string; message: string; externalUrl?: string };

const TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
  TIMEOUT: 'Took too long', PROXY_UNAVAILABLE: 'Proxy unavailable', BLOCKED_BY_SITE: 'This site doesn\'t allow proxy access',
  BLOCKED_ADDRESS: 'Address not allowed', INVALID_URL: 'Invalid address', UNSUPPORTED: 'Can\'t show this page', TOO_LARGE: 'Page too large',
  EMPTY_QUERY: 'Nothing to search', PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: 'Search unavailable', PROVIDER_BLOCKED: 'Search provider refused', BAD_RESPONSE: 'Search failed',
};

type Props = { view: TabView; url: string; onRetry: () => void; onSearch: (q: string) => void; onOpen: (url: string) => void };

export default function BrowserView({ view, url, onRetry, onSearch, onOpen }: Props) {
  if (view.kind === 'home') return <SearchHome onSearch={onSearch} onOpen={onOpen} />;
  if (view.kind === 'results') return <SearchResults query={view.query} results={view.results} provider={view.provider} onOpen={onOpen} />;
  if (view.kind === 'loading') return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-background text-muted-foreground">
      <Loader2 className="w-7 h-7 animate-spin text-primary" />
      <p className="text-sm">Loading…</p>
    </div>
  );
  if (view.kind === 'error') {
    const ext = view.externalUrl ?? url;
    const blocked = view.code === 'BLOCKED_BY_SITE';
    return (
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-background p-6">
        <div className="max-w-sm text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto rounded-full bg-destructive/10 flex items-center justify-center">
            {blocked ? <ShieldOff className="w-6 h-6 text-destructive" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-destructive" />}
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-bold">{TITLES[view.code] || 'Couldn\'t load page'}</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{view.message}</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2 justify-center">
            {!blocked && view.code !== 'EMPTY_QUERY' && <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onRetry}><RotateCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Retry</Button>}
            {ext.startsWith('http') && view.code !== 'BLOCKED_ADDRESS' && view.code !== 'INVALID_URL' && (
              <Button size="sm" onClick={() => window.open(ext, '_blank', 'noopener')}><ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Open in new tab</Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (view.kind === 'direct') return (
    <iframe src={view.url} title="Browser" className="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white"
      sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />
  );
  // Proxied page: scripts allowed but NOT same-origin, so it can't touch Nexus.
  return <iframe srcDoc={view.html} title="Browser" className="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white"
    sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" />;
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { BookMarked, Star, History, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/popover';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/tabs';
import { getBookmarks, getHistory, clearHistory, toggleBookmark, SavedLink } from '../../lib/browserStore';

function Row({ l, onOpen, onRemove }: { l: SavedLink; onOpen: (u: string) => void; onRemove?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="group flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-muted">
      <button onClick={() => onOpen(l.url)} className="flex-1 text-left min-w-0">
        <p className="text-xs font-medium truncate">{l.title}</p>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{l.url.replace('nexus:search?q=', 'Search: ')}</p>
      </button>
      {onRemove && <button onClick={onRemove} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"><Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" /></button>}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function LibraryMenu({ onOpen }: { onOpen: (url: string) => void }) {
  const [, force] = useState(0);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const go = (u: string) => { setOpen(false); onOpen(u); };
  const bookmarks = open ? getBookmarks() : [];
  const history = open ? getHistory() : [];
  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" title="Bookmarks & history"><BookMarked className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent align="end" className="w-80 p-2">
        <Tabs defaultValue="bookmarks">
          <TabsList className="w-full grid grid-cols-2">
            <TabsTrigger value="bookmarks"><Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Bookmarks</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="history"><History className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />History</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
          <TabsContent value="bookmarks" className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
            {bookmarks.length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">Tap the ☆ in the address bar to save a page.</p>}
            {bookmarks.map(b => <Row key={b.url} l={b} onOpen={go} onRemove={() => { toggleBookmark(b.url, b.title); force(n => n + 1); }} />)}
          </TabsContent>
          <TabsContent value="history" className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
            {history.length === 0 ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">No history yet.</p> :
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full text-xs mb-1" onClick={() => { clearHistory(); force(n => n + 1); }}>Clear history</Button>}
            {history.map(h => <Row key={h.url} l={h} onOpen={go} />)}
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/browser/ResearchHelper.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { researchSummary } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Markdown } from '@project/components/markdown';
import type { Result } from './SearchViews';

export default function ResearchHelper({ query, results }: { query: string; results: Result[] }) {
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  if (results.length === 0) return null;
  async function run() {
    setBusy(true); setErr('');
    try { setSummary((await researchSummary({ query, results })).summary); }
    catch { setErr('Couldn\'t summarize right now. Try again.'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-4 space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5"><Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />Research helper</p>
        {!summary && <Button size="sm" onClick={run} disabled={busy}>{busy ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin mr-1" /> : null}Summarize results</Button>}
      </div>
      {err && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{err}</p>}
      {summary ? <>
        <div className="text-sm prose prose-sm dark:prose-invert max-w-none"><Markdown>{summary}</Markdown></div>
        <ol className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground list-decimal pl-4">
          {results.slice(0, 8).map(r => <li key={r.url}><a href={r.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="hover:underline">{r.title}</a></li>)}
        </ol>
      </> : !busy && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Get key facts from these results with numbered sources you can cite.</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: src/components/builder/BuilderPreview.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Monitor, Tablet, Smartphone, Eye, Code2, ExternalLink, Download, Loader2, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';

const DEVICES = [
  { id: 'desktop', icon: Monitor, w: '100%' },
  { id: 'tablet', icon: Tablet, w: '768px' },
  { id: 'mobile', icon: Smartphone, w: '390px' },
] as const;

interface Props { html: string; liveChars: number; busy: boolean }

export default function BuilderPreview({ html, liveChars, busy }: Props) {
  const [device, setDevice] = useState<(typeof DEVICES)[number]['id']>('desktop');
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'preview' | 'code'>('preview');
  const width = DEVICES.find(d => d.id === device)!.w;

  const openTab = () => window.open(URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' })), '_blank');
  const download = () => {
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }));
    a.download = 'my-nexus-site.html'; a.click();
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-[320px] bg-muted/30">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 border-b border-border bg-background">
        {(['preview', 'code'] as const).map(t => (
          <Button key={t} size="sm" variant={tab === t ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'} onClick={() => setTab(t)}>
            {t === 'preview' ? <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" /> : <Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />}{t === 'preview' ? 'Preview' : 'Code'}
          </Button>
        ))}
        <div className="mx-auto hidden sm:flex gap-1">
          {DEVICES.map(d => (
            <Button key={d.id} size="icon" variant={device === d.id ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'} className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => setDevice(d.id)} aria-label={d.id}>
              <d.icon className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="ml-auto flex gap-1">
          <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-8 w-8" disabled={!html} onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(html); toast.success('Code copied'); }} aria-label="Copy code"><Copy className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
          <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-8 w-8" disabled={!html} onClick={openTab} aria-label="Open in new tab"><ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
          <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-8 w-8" disabled={!html} onClick={download} aria-label="Download"><Download className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="relative flex-1 overflow-auto flex justify-center p-2">
        {busy && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-background/80 text-sm gap-2">
            <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-primary" />
            <span>Building your site…</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{liveChars.toLocaleString()} characters of code written</span>
          </div>
        )}
        {!html ? (
          <div className="m-auto text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center p-6">Describe your site on the left and hit Build — it shows up here.</div>
        ) : tab === 'code' ? (
          <pre className="w-full text-xs font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap break-all bg-background rounded-md border border-border p-3">{html}</pre>
        ) : (
          <iframe title="Preview" srcDoc={html} sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals allow-forms allow-popups"
            className={cn('h-full bg-white rounded-md border border-border transition-all')} style={{ width, maxWidth: '100%' }} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

===== FILE: src/components/emoji/EmojiCanvas.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { CANVAS, renderLayers, hitTest, newId, type Layer, type StrokeLayer, type StickerLayer } from '../../lib/emojiParts';

export type Tool = 'pencil' | 'eraser' | 'move';

type Props = {
  layers: Layer[];
  tool: Tool; color: string; size: number;
  selectedId: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string | null) => void;
  commit: (l: Layer[]) => void; preview: (l: Layer[]) => void; finish: (before: Layer[]) => void;
};

export default function EmojiCanvas({ layers, tool, color, size, selectedId, onSelect, commit, preview, finish }: Props) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const live = useRef<StrokeLayer | null>(null);
  const drag = useRef<{ id: string; dx: number; dy: number; before: Layer[] } | null>(null);
  const layersRef = useRef(layers);
  layersRef.current = layers;

  const draw = () => {
    const ctx = ref.current?.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx) renderLayers(ctx, live.current ? [...layersRef.current, live.current] : layersRef.current, tool === 'move' ? selectedId : null);
  };
  useEffect(draw); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const pos = (e: React.PointerEvent): [number, number] => {
    const r = ref.current!.getBoundingClientRect();
    return [((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * CANVAS, ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * CANVAS];
  };

  function down(e: React.PointerEvent) {
    ref.current!.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    const [x, y] = pos(e);
    if (tool === 'move') {
      const hit = hitTest(layers, x, y);
      onSelect(hit?.id ?? null);
      if (hit) drag.current = { id: hit.id, dx: x - hit.x, dy: y - hit.y, before: layers };
      return;
    }
    live.current = { id: newId(), type: 'stroke', points: [[x, y]], color, size, erase: tool === 'eraser' };
    draw();
  }

  function move(e: React.PointerEvent) {
    const [x, y] = pos(e);
    if (live.current) { live.current.points.push([x, y]); draw(); return; }
    const d = drag.current;
    if (d) preview(layersRef.current.map(l => (l.id === d.id ? { ...(l as StickerLayer), x: x - d.dx, y: y - d.dy } : l)));
  }

  function up() {
    if (live.current) { const s = live.current; live.current = null; commit([...layersRef.current, s]); }
    if (drag.current) { finish(drag.current.before); drag.current = null; }
  }

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={ref} width={CANVAS} height={CANVAS}
      onPointerDown={down} onPointerMove={move} onPointerUp={up} onPointerCancel={up}
      className="emoji-checker w-full max-w-[min(100%,70vh)] aspect-square rounded-3xl border-4 border-primary/40 shadow-xl touch-none mx-auto block"
      style={{ cursor: tool === 'move' ? 'grab' : 'crosshair' }}
    />
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Shuffle, Plus, Download, BookOpen, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';

const EMOJIS = ['😀','😂','🥹','😍','😎','🤩','😭','😡','🥶','🤢','😱','🤔','😴','🥳','😇','🤠','👽','🤖','👻','💀','🎃','😺','🐶','🐸','🦄','🐵','🔥','⭐','❤️','🌈','⚡','🍕','🍩','🌮','🎂','👑','💯','💩','🌵','🌸','🍀','🍓','🐙','🐝','🌙','☀️','🍄','🧁'];

const kitchenUrl = (a: string, b: string) => `https://emojik.vercel.app/s/${encodeURIComponent(a)}_${encodeURIComponent(b)}?size=256`;
const getFound = (): string[] => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]'); } catch { return []; } };

function Picker({ value, onPick, label }: { value: string; onPick: (e: string) => void; label: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl p-3">
      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-2">{label}</p>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-8 gap-1 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto">
        {EMOJIS.map(e => (
          <button key={e} onClick={() => onPick(e)} className={cn('text-2xl rounded-lg p-1 transition-transform hover:scale-125', value === e && 'bg-primary/20 ring-2 ring-primary')}>{e}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Emoji Kitchen–style game: pick two emojis, get a real blended emoji, collect discoveries. */
export default function EmojiKitchen() {
  const [a, setA] = useState('😎');
  const [b, setB] = useState('👻');
  const [found, setFound] = useState<string[]>(getFound);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const pair = [a, b].sort().join('_');
  const url = kitchenUrl(a, b);

  useEffect(() => setFailed(false), [url]);
  function onLoad() {
    if (found.includes(pair)) return;
    const next = [pair, ...found];
    setFound(next); localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    toast.success(`✨ New recipe discovered! ${a} + ${b}`);
  }
  const rand = () => EMOJIS[Math.floor(Math.random() * EMOJIS.length)];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] gap-4 items-start">
        <Picker value={a} onPick={setA} label="Ingredient 1" />
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-4xl"><span>{a}</span><span className="text-xl text-muted-foreground">+</span><span>{b}</span></div>
          <div className="w-48 h-48 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-secondary/40 flex items-center justify-center">
            <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
              {failed
                ? <motion.p key="none" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center px-4">These two don't cook together — try another pair!</motion.p>
                : <motion.img key={url} src={url} alt={`${a}${b}`} onLoad={onLoad} onError={() => setFailed(true)} initial={{ scale: 0.3, rotate: -20, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, rotate: 0, opacity: 1 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 14 }} className="w-40 h-40" />}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => { setA(rand()); setB(rand()); }}><Shuffle className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Surprise me</Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" className="h-9 w-9" disabled={failed} asChild><a href={url} download="emoji-kitchen.png" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"><Download className="w-4 h-4" /></a></Button>
            <Button size="sm" disabled={failed} onClick={() => { addMyEmoji(url); toast.success('Added to your emoji collection — use it in chat!'); }}><Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Collect</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Picker value={b} onPick={setB} label="Ingredient 2" />
      </div>

      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Recipe book</p>
          <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"><Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />{found.length} discovered</span>
        </div>
        {found.length === 0 ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Mix two emojis to discover your first recipe.</p> : (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {found.slice(0, 60).map(p => { const [x, y] = p.split('_'); return (
              <button key={p} title={`${x} + ${y}`} onClick={() => { setA(x); setB(y); }} className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl bg-secondary p-1 hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
                <img src={kitchenUrl(x, y)} alt={p} className="w-full h-full" loading="lazy" />
              </button>
            ); })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/emoji/PartThumb.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { drawPart, type PartKind } from '../../lib/emojiParts';

/** Small preview tile for a shape or emoji part. */
export default function PartThumb({ kind, color, label, onClick }: { kind: PartKind; color: string; label: string; onClick: () => void }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const ctx = ref.current?.getContext('2d'); if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 64, 64); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(32, 32); ctx.scale(0.5, 0.5); drawPart(ctx, kind, color); ctx.restore();
  }, [kind, color]);
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} title={label} className="group flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl p-1.5 bg-secondary/40 hover:bg-primary/15 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all">
      <canvas ref={ref} width={64} height={64} className="w-10 h-10" />
      <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-foreground">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/emoji/SelectedPanel.tsx =====

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { Slider } from '@project/components/ui/slider';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Copy, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { newId, type Layer, type StickerLayer } from '../../lib/emojiParts';

type Props = { layers: Layer[]; selected: StickerLayer; commit: (l: Layer[]) => void; preview: (l: Layer[]) => void; finish: (b: Layer[]) => void; onSelect: (id: string | null) => void };

export default function SelectedPanel({ layers, selected, commit, preview, finish, onSelect }: Props) {
  const patch = (p: Partial<StickerLayer>) => preview(layers.map(l => (l.id === selected.id ? { ...selected, ...p } : l)));
  const idx = layers.findIndex(l => l.id === selected.id);
  const moveBy = (d: number) => {
    const j = idx + d; if (j < 0 || j >= layers.length) return;
    const next = [...layers]; [next[idx], next[j]] = [next[j], next[idx]]; commit(next);
  };
  // Sliders preview live; the snapshot before the drag becomes one undo step.
  const before = useRef<Layer[] | null>(null);
  const start = () => { before.current = layers; };
  const end = () => { if (before.current) finish(before.current); before.current = null; };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-card border-2 border-border p-3 space-y-3">
      <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Selected piece</p>
      <label className="block text-xs font-semibold">Size
        <Slider className="mt-2" min={0.2} max={6} step={0.05} value={[selected.scale]} onPointerDown={start} onValueChange={([v]) => patch({ scale: v })} onValueCommit={end} />
      </label>
      <label className="block text-xs font-semibold">Rotate ({Math.round((selected.rot * 180) / Math.PI)}°)
        <Slider className="mt-2" min={-180} max={180} step={1} value={[Math.round((selected.rot * 180) / Math.PI)]} onPointerDown={start} onValueChange={([v]) => patch({ rot: (v * Math.PI) / 180 })} onValueCommit={end} />
      </label>
      <label className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold">Color
        <input type="color" value={selected.color} onChange={e => commit(layers.map(l => (l.id === selected.id ? { ...selected, color: e.target.value } : l)))} className="w-10 h-8 rounded-lg cursor-pointer bg-transparent" />
      </label>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" title="Bring forward" onClick={() => moveBy(1)} disabled={idx === layers.length - 1}><ArrowUp className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" title="Send backward" onClick={() => moveBy(-1)} disabled={idx === 0}><ArrowDown className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" title="Duplicate" onClick={() => { const c = { ...selected, id: newId(), x: selected.x + 20, y: selected.y + 20 }; commit([...layers, c]); onSelect(c.id); }}><Copy className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" title="Delete" onClick={() => { commit(layers.filter(l => l.id !== selected.id)); onSelect(null); }}><Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Package } from 'lucide-react';
import { listings, ListingsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Card } from '@project/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Badge } from '@project/components/ui/badge';
import ReportButton from './ReportButton';
import { errMsg, money } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

type Listing = ListingsOutputType['listings'][number];

export default function ListingCard({ l, myEmail, onBought }: { l: Listing; myEmail: string; onBought: () => void }) {
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const mine = l.sellerEmail.toLowerCase() === myEmail.toLowerCase();
  async function buy() {
    setBusy(true);
    try { await listings({ action: 'buy', id: l.id, quantity: qty }); toast.success(`Ordered ${qty} × ${l.title}`); onBought(); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return (
    <Card className="overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
      <div className="aspect-[4/3] bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center">
        {l.imageUrl ? <img src={l.imageUrl} alt={l.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> : <Package className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground" />}
      </div>
      <div className="p-3 flex-1 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight">{l.title}</h3>
          <span className="font-bold text-primary whitespace-nowrap">{money(l.price)}</span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{l.description || 'No description'}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Badge variant="secondary">{l.inventory} in stock</Badge>
          <span className="truncate">by {l.sellerEmail.split('@')[0]}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-auto pt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          {mine ? <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Your listing</span> : (
            <>
              <Input type="number" min={1} max={Math.min(100, l.inventory)} value={qty} onChange={e => setQty(Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Number(e.target.value) || 1)))} className="w-16 h-8" />
              <Button size="sm" className="flex-1" onClick={buy} disabled={busy || l.inventory < qty}>{l.inventory ? 'Buy' : 'Sold out'}</Button>
              <ReportButton targetType="Listing" targetId={l.id} subject={l.title} />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/market/ListingForm.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { listings, ListingsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { errMsg } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

type Listing = ListingsOutputType['listings'][number];

const schema = z.object({
  title: z.string().trim().min(3, 'At least 3 characters').max(100),
  description: z.string().trim().max(2000),
  price: z.number({ invalid_type_error: 'Enter a price' }).min(0, "Can't be negative").max(1_000_000),
  inventory: z.number({ invalid_type_error: 'Enter a number' }).int('Whole numbers only').min(0).max(100_000),
  imageUrl: z.string().url('Must be a link').or(z.literal('')),
});

export default function ListingForm({ open, onClose, editing, onSaved }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; editing: Listing | null; onSaved: () => void }) {
  const [f, setF] = useState({ title: editing?.title ?? '', description: editing?.description ?? '', price: String(editing?.price ?? ''), inventory: String(editing?.inventory ?? '1'), imageUrl: editing?.imageUrl ?? '' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const parsed = schema.safeParse({ ...f, price: f.price === '' ? NaN : Number(f.price), inventory: f.inventory === '' ? NaN : Number(f.inventory) });
  const errors = parsed.success ? {} : Object.fromEntries(parsed.error.issues.map(i => [i.path[0], i.message]));

  async function save() {
    if (!parsed.success) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await listings(editing ? { action: 'update', id: editing.id, data: parsed.data } : { action: 'create', data: parsed.data });
      toast.success(editing ? 'Listing updated' : 'Listing created');
      onSaved(); onClose();
    } catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  const field = (k: keyof typeof f, label: string, el: React.ReactNode) => (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Label>{label}</Label>{el}
      {f[k] !== '' && errors[k] && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors[k]}</p>}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={o => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>{editing ? 'Edit listing' : 'New listing'}</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {field('title', 'Title', <Input value={f.title} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, title: e.target.value })} />)}
          {field('description', 'Description', <Textarea rows={3} value={f.description} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, description: e.target.value })} />)}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {field('price', 'Price ($)', <Input type="number" min={0} step="0.01" value={f.price} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, price: e.target.value })} />)}
            {field('inventory', 'In stock', <Input type="number" min={0} step="1" value={f.inventory} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, inventory: e.target.value })} />)}
          </div>
          {field('imageUrl', 'Image link (optional)', <Input value={f.imageUrl} placeholder="https://…" onChange={e => setF({ ...f, imageUrl: e.target.value })} />)}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button onClick={save} disabled={!parsed.success || saving}>{saving && <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin mr-1" />}Save</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/market/MyListings.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Plus, Pencil, Pause, Play, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { listings, ListingsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@project/components/ui/badge';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@project/components/ui/table';
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import ListingForm from './ListingForm';
import { errMsg, money } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

type Listing = ListingsOutputType['listings'][number];

export default function MyListings() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Listing[] | null>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Listing | null>(null);
  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<Listing | null>(null);
  const load = () => listings({ action: 'mine' }).then(r => setItems(r.listings)).catch(e => toast.error(errMsg(e)));
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  async function setStatus(l: Listing, status: 'Active' | 'Paused' | 'Removed') {
    const prev = items;
    setItems(it => (it ?? []).flatMap(x => x.id !== l.id ? [x] : status === 'Removed' ? [] : [{ ...x, status }]));
    try { await listings({ action: 'setStatus', id: l.id, status }); toast.success(status === 'Removed' ? 'Listing removed' : `Listing ${status.toLowerCase()}`); }
    catch (e) { setItems(prev); toast.error(errMsg(e)); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex justify-end"><Button onClick={() => { setEditing(null); setFormOpen(true); }}><Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />New listing</Button></div>
      {!items ? <Skeleton className="h-40" /> : !items.length ? <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-10 text-center">You haven't listed anything yet.</p> : (
        <div className="border border-border rounded-lg overflow-x-auto">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader><TableRow><TableHead>Title</TableHead><TableHead className="text-right">Price</TableHead><TableHead className="text-right">Stock</TableHead><TableHead>Status</TableHead><TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead></TableRow></TableHeader>
            <TableBody>{items.map(l => (
              <TableRow key={l.id}>
                <TableCell className="font-medium">{l.title}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">{money(l.price)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">{l.inventory}</TableCell>
                <TableCell><Badge variant={l.status === 'Active' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>{l.status}</Badge></TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { setEditing(l); setFormOpen(true); }} title="Edit"><Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setStatus(l, l.status === 'Active' ? 'Paused' : 'Active')} title={l.status === 'Active' ? 'Pause' : 'Resume'}>{l.status === 'Active' ? <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}</Button>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setRemoving(l)} title="Remove"><Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-destructive" /></Button>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}</TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      )}
      {formOpen && <ListingForm open={formOpen} editing={editing} onClose={() => setFormOpen(false)} onSaved={load} />}
      <AlertDialog open={!!removing} onOpenChange={o => !o && setRemoving(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader><AlertDialogTitle>Remove “{removing?.title}”?</AlertDialogTitle><AlertDialogDescription>Buyers won't see it anymore. Past orders are kept.</AlertDialogDescription></AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter><AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel><AlertDialogAction onClick={() => { if (removing) setStatus(removing, 'Removed'); setRemoving(null); }}>Remove</AlertDialogAction></AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/market/OrdersTable.tsx =====

import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { listings, ListingsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@project/components/ui/table';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { Badge } from '@project/components/ui/badge';
import { errMsg, money, when } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

type Order = ListingsOutputType['orders'][number];
const STATUSES = ['Placed', 'Shipped', 'Completed', 'Cancelled'] as const;

export default function OrdersTable({ orders, editable, onChange, showBuyer = true }: { orders: Order[]; editable: boolean; onChange: (o: Order) => void; showBuyer?: boolean }) {
  async function setStatus(o: Order, s: typeof STATUSES[number]) {
    onChange({ ...o, status: s });
    try { await listings({ action: 'setOrderStatus', id: o.id, orderStatus: s }); }
    catch (e) { onChange(o); toast.error(errMsg(e)); }
  }
  if (!orders.length) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-10 text-center">No orders yet.</p>;
  return (
    <div className="border border-border rounded-lg overflow-x-auto">
      <Table>
        <TableHeader><TableRow>
          <TableHead>#</TableHead><TableHead>Item</TableHead><TableHead>{showBuyer ? 'Buyer' : 'Seller'}</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="text-right">Qty</TableHead><TableHead className="text-right">Total</TableHead><TableHead>Status</TableHead><TableHead>Date</TableHead>
        </TableRow></TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {orders.map(o => (
            <TableRow key={o.id}>
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{o.orderNumber}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="font-medium">{o.listingTitle}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs">{showBuyer ? o.buyerEmail : o.sellerEmail}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right">{o.quantity}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right">{money(o.total)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                {editable ? (
                  <Select value={o.status} onValueChange={v => setStatus(o, v as typeof STATUSES[number])}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="h-8 w-32"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>{STATUSES.map(s => <SelectItem key={s} value={s}>{s}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                ) : <Badge variant="secondary">{o.status}</Badge>}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">{when(o.orderedAt)}</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Flag } from 'lucide-react';
import { reports } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Textarea } from '@project/components/ui/textarea';
import { errMsg } from '../../hooks/usePermissions';

export default function ReportButton({ targetType, targetId, subject }: { targetType: 'User' | 'Listing'; targetId: string; subject: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  async function send() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await reports({ action: 'create', targetType, targetId, subject, reason: reason.trim() });
      toast.success('Report sent to moderators'); setOpen(false); setReason('');
    } catch (e) { toast.error(errMsg(e)); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(true)} title="Report"><Flag className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Report {subject}</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
          <Textarea rows={4} placeholder="What's wrong?" value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} maxLength={2000} />
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button onClick={send} disabled={reason.trim().length < 5 || busy}>Send report</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Plus, Eye, EyeOff, Trash2, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { bgCss, type OwnerItem } from '../../hooks/useOwnerLimited';
import type { CustomLimitedInputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { HOLIDAYS } from '../../lib/holidays';

const KINDS = ['Title', 'Typing Effect', 'Music', 'Background'] as const;
const ALL = '__all__';
const EFFECTS = ['glow', 'rainbow', 'fire', 'pulse', 'none'];

/** Owner-only panel to add hand-made limited items to the shop. */
export default function OwnerLimitedEditor({ items, holidayKey, mutate }: {
  items: OwnerItem[]; holidayKey?: string; mutate: (i: CustomLimitedInputType) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [f, setF] = useState({ kind: 'Title' as (typeof KINDS)[number], name: '', emoji: '✨', color: '#f5c542', color2: '#ff5fa2', effect: 'glow', typingText: 'is typing…', songUrl: '', cost: 1000, holiday: holidayKey || ALL });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const set = <K extends keyof typeof f>(k: K, v: (typeof f)[K]) => setF(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));

  const run = async (input: CustomLimitedInputType, ok: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { await mutate(input); toast.success(ok); } catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const add = () => run({ action: 'create', item: {
    name: f.name, kind: f.kind, emoji: f.emoji, color: f.color, color2: f.color2, effect: f.effect,
    typingText: f.typingText, songUrl: f.songUrl, cost: f.cost, holidayKey: f.holiday === ALL ? '' : f.holiday,
  } }, 'Added to the limited shop').then(() => setF(p => ({ ...p, name: '', songUrl: '' })));

  return (
    <div className="sm:col-span-2 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-primary/50 p-4 space-y-3">
      <p className="font-semibold text-sm">👑 Owner: add your own limited item</p>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {KINDS.map(k => <Button key={k} size="sm" variant={f.kind === k ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => set('kind', k)}>{k}</Button>)}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
        <div className="col-span-2"><Label className="text-xs">Name</Label><Input maxLength={40} value={f.name} onChange={e => set('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="Pumpkin King" /></div>
        <div><Label className="text-xs">Emoji</Label><Input maxLength={8} value={f.emoji} onChange={e => set('emoji', e.target.value)} /></div>
        <div><Label className="text-xs">Price 💎</Label><Input type="number" min={0} value={f.cost} onChange={e => set('cost', Number(e.target.value) || 0)} /></div>
        <div><Label className="text-xs">Color 1</Label><Input type="color" className="h-9 p-1" value={f.color} onChange={e => set('color', e.target.value)} /></div>
        <div><Label className="text-xs">Color 2</Label><Input type="color" className="h-9 p-1" value={f.color2} onChange={e => set('color2', e.target.value)} /></div>
        {f.kind !== 'Background' && f.kind !== 'Music' && (
          <div className="col-span-2"><Label className="text-xs">Effect</Label>
            <select value={f.effect} onChange={e => set('effect', e.target.value)} className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 text-sm">
              {EFFECTS.map(x => <option key={x} value={x}>{x}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}
        {f.kind === 'Music' && <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-4"><Label className="text-xs">Song link (MP3 or audio URL)</Label><Input type="url" value={f.songUrl} onChange={e => set('songUrl', e.target.value)} placeholder="https://…/song.mp3" /></div>}
        {f.kind === 'Typing Effect' && <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-4"><Label className="text-xs">Typing text</Label><Input maxLength={60} value={f.typingText} onChange={e => set('typingText', e.target.value)} /></div>}
      </div>
      <Preview f={f} />
      <div><Label className="text-xs">Which holiday?</Label>
        <select aria-label="Holiday" value={f.holiday} onChange={e => set('holiday', e.target.value)} className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 text-sm">
          <option value={ALL}>🌍 Every holiday</option>
          {HOLIDAYS.map(h => <option key={h.key} value={h.key}>{h.emoji} {h.name}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>
      <Button onClick={add} disabled={busy || !f.name.trim()} className="gap-1.5">{busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />} Add item to limited shop</Button>
      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-border">
          {items.map(i => (
            <div key={i.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="flex-1 truncate">{i.emoji} {i.name} <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">· {i.kind} · {i.cost.toLocaleString()} 💎{i.holidayKey ? ` · ${HOLIDAYS.find(h => h.key === i.holidayKey)?.name ?? i.holidayKey}` : ' · every holiday'}</span></span>
              <button disabled={busy} title={i.active ? 'Hide from shop' : 'Show in shop'} onClick={() => run({ action: 'toggle', id: i.id }, i.active ? 'Hidden' : 'Visible')} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">{i.active ? <Eye className="w-4 h-4" /> : <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" />}</button>
              <button disabled={busy} title="Delete" onClick={() => run({ action: 'delete', id: i.id }, 'Deleted')} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"><Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Preview({ f }: { f: { kind: string; name: string; emoji: string; color: string; color2: string; effect: string; typingText: string } }) {
  if (f.kind === 'Background') return <div className="h-16 rounded-xl border border-border" style={{ background: bgCss({ ...f, id: '', cost: 0, holidayKey: '', active: true, songUrl: '' } as OwnerItem) }} />;
  if (f.kind === 'Music') return <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">🎵 {f.emoji} {f.name || 'Your song'}</p>;
  if (f.kind === 'Typing Effect') return <p className={`text-xs ${f.effect === 'rainbow' ? 'title-rainbow' : f.effect === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}`} style={{ color: f.color }}>You {f.typingText} {f.emoji}</p>;
  return <span className="inline-block font-bold text-sm px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg,${f.color},${f.color2})`, color: '#fff', boxShadow: f.effect === 'glow' ? `0 0 12px ${f.color}` : undefined }}>{f.emoji} {f.name || 'Your title'}</span>;
}

===== FILE: src/components/shop/ShopMusic.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Pause, Play, Volume2, VolumeX } from 'lucide-react';
import { Slider } from '@project/components/ui/slider';
import { resolveSongUrl } from '../../lib/holidaySongs';

const KEY = 'nexus_shop_audio';
type Prefs = { volume: number; muted: boolean };
const read = (): Prefs => { try { return { volume: 0.4, muted: false, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '{}') }; } catch { return { volume: 0.4, muted: false }; } };
const write = (p: Prefs) => { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(p)); } catch { /* storage blocked */ } };

/** Seasonal background track for the shop. Never autoplays — starts only when the user presses play. */
export default function ShopMusic({ songUrl, title, open }: { songUrl: string; title: string; open: boolean }) {
  const audio = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<Prefs>(read);

  // New theme → new track; stop the old one
  useEffect(() => {
    let src = '';
    try { src = resolveSongUrl(songUrl); setFailed(false); } catch { setFailed(true); }
    const a = src ? new Audio(src) : null;
    if (a) { a.loop = true; a.onerror = () => { setFailed(true); setPlaying(false); }; }
    audio.current = a;
    setPlaying(false);
    return () => { a?.pause(); };
  }, [songUrl]);

  useEffect(() => { if (!open) { audio.current?.pause(); setPlaying(false); } }, [open]);
  useEffect(() => { const a = audio.current; if (a) { a.volume = prefs.volume; a.muted = prefs.muted; } write(prefs); }, [prefs, songUrl]);

  const toggle = () => {
    const a = audio.current; if (!a) return;
    if (playing) { a.pause(); setPlaying(false); return; }
    a.play().then(() => setPlaying(true)).catch(() => setPlaying(false)); // browser may still block — stay paused
  };

  if (failed) return <p className="text-[11px] text-white/70">🎵 Music unavailable for this theme</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-black/40 backdrop-blur px-2 py-1 border border-white/15">
      <button onClick={toggle} aria-label={playing ? 'Pause music' : 'Play music'} className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white text-black flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
        {playing ? <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-0.5" />}
      </button>
      <span className="text-[11px] text-white/85 max-w-[9rem] truncate hidden sm:block" title={title}>{title}</span>
      <button onClick={() => setPrefs(p => ({ ...p, muted: !p.muted }))} aria-label={prefs.muted ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute'} className="text-white/85 hover:text-white">
        {prefs.muted || prefs.volume === 0 ? <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
      </button>
      <Slider aria-label="Volume" className="w-20" value={[prefs.muted ? 0 : prefs.volume]} min={0} max={1} step={0.05}
        onValueChange={v => setPrefs({ volume: v[0], muted: v[0] === 0 })} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';

type Game = 'Reaction' | 'Click Frenzy' | 'Speed Typing';

export default function CreateTournament({ open, onOpenChange, onCreated }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void; onCreated: () => void }) {

              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="1">1 hour</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="24">1 day</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="72">3 days</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="168">1 week</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>

===== FILE: src/components/tournament/DailyQuiz.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Brain, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { dailyQuiz, DailyQuizOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../../contexts/AppContext';

const LEVELS = [
  { name: 'Easy', mult: 1 }, { name: 'Medium', mult: 2 }, { name: 'Hard', mult: 4 },
  { name: 'Expert', mult: 8 }, { name: 'High school', mult: 16 }, { name: 'College', mult: 32 },
];
const BASE = 25; // gems per correct answer, times the level multiplier
const SUBJECTS = ['Math', 'Science', 'History', 'Geography', 'Animals', 'Space', 'Movies', 'Sports'];
const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const key = (email: string) => `nexus_quiz_${email}`;

export default function DailyQuiz() {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const email = profile?.email || '';
  const [done, setDone] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(key(email)) === today());
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState('');
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(LEVELS[0]);
  const [qs, setQs] = useState<DailyQuizOutputType['questions'] | null>(null);
  const [i, setI] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function start() {
    if (!subject.trim()) { toast.error('Pick a subject'); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await dailyQuiz({ subject, level: level.name });
      localStorage.setItem(key(email), today()); // uses today's one try
      setDone(true); setQs(r.questions); setI(0); setScore(0);
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not start quiz'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }

  function answer(idx: number) {
    if (!qs) return;
    const right = idx === qs[i].answerIndex;
    const s = score + (right ? 1 : 0);
    toast[right ? 'success' : 'error'](right ? 'Correct!' : `Wrong — it was "${qs[i].choices[qs[i].answerIndex]}"`);
    if (i + 1 < qs.length) { setScore(s); setI(i + 1); return; }
    const won = s * BASE * level.mult;
    if (won > 0) addGems(won);
    toast.success(`${s}/${qs.length} right — you earned 💎 ${won}!`);
    setQs(null);
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-primary/40 bg-card p-4 space-y-3">
      <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Brain className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" /> Daily Quiz Challenge</p>
      {qs ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Question {i + 1}/{qs.length} · {level.name} (×{level.mult})</p>
          <p className="font-semibold">{qs[i].question}</p>
          <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {qs[i].choices.map((c, k) => <Button key={k} variant="outline" className="h-auto whitespace-normal py-2" onClick={() => answer(k)}>{c}</Button>)}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : done ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">You've used today's quiz. Come back tomorrow for another try!</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Pick any subject and a level. Each right answer pays 💎 {BASE} × the level multiplier — College pays ×32! One try per day.</p>
          <Input value={subject} onChange={e => setSubject(e.target.value)} placeholder="Any subject, e.g. Biology" maxLength={80} />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{SUBJECTS.map(s => <Button key={s} size="sm" variant="secondary" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setSubject(s)}>{s}</Button>)}</div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-1.5">
            {LEVELS.map(l => <Button key={l.name} size="sm" variant={l === level ? 'default' : 'outline'} className="h-auto py-1.5 flex-col text-xs" onClick={() => setLevel(l)}>{l.name}<span className="opacity-70">×{l.mult}</span></Button>)}

===== FILE: src/components/tournament/MiniGames.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';

/** Each game calls onFinish(score) — higher is always better. */
export function ReactionGame({ onFinish }: { onFinish: (s: number) => void }) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'idle' | 'wait' | 'go' | 'early'>('idle');
  const start = useRef(0);
  const timer = useRef<number>();
  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  function click() {
    if (phase === 'idle' || phase === 'early') {
      setPhase('wait');
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => { start.current = performance.now(); setPhase('go'); }, 1200 + Math.random() * 2500);
    } else if (phase === 'wait') { clearTimeout(timer.current); setPhase('early'); }
    else { const ms = Math.round(performance.now() - start.current); setPhase('idle'); onFinish(Math.max(0, 1000 - ms)); }
  }
  const label = { idle: 'Click to start', wait: 'Wait for green…', go: 'CLICK!', early: 'Too early! Click to retry' }[phase];
  return (
    <button onClick={click} className={`w-full h-48 rounded-xl text-xl font-bold transition-colors ${phase === 'go' ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : phase === 'early' ? 'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground' : 'bg-secondary text-foreground'}`}>
      {label}
      <p className="text-xs font-normal opacity-70 mt-1">Score = 1000 − your reaction time in ms</p>
    </button>
  );
}

export function ClickFrenzyGame({ onFinish }: { onFinish: (s: number) => void }) {
  const [clicks, setClicks] = useState(0);
  const [left, setLeft] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const count = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (left === null) return;
    if (left <= 0) { onFinish(count.current); setLeft(null); return; }
    const t = setTimeout(() => setLeft(l => (l ?? 0) - 1), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [left, onFinish]);
  function click() {
    if (left === null) { count.current = 0; setClicks(0); setLeft(10); return; }
    count.current += 1; setClicks(count.current);
  }
  return (
    <button onClick={click} className="w-full h-48 rounded-xl bg-secondary active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform">
      <p className="text-4xl font-black">{clicks}</p>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{left === null ? 'Click to start — 10 seconds' : `${left}s left`}</p>
    </button>
  );
}

const SENTENCES = [
  'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog',
  'nexus chat is the best place to hang out with friends',
  'practice makes perfect so keep on typing fast',
  'gems and trophies await the fastest typer in the room',
];

export function SpeedTypingGame({ onFinish }: { onFinish: (s: number) => void }) {
  const [target, setTarget] = useState('');
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const start = useRef(0);
  function begin() { setTarget(SENTENCES[Math.floor(Math.random() * SENTENCES.length)]); setText(''); start.current = 0; }
  function change(v: string) {
    if (!start.current) start.current = performance.now();
    setText(v);
    if (v === target) {
      const min = (performance.now() - start.current) / 60000;
      onFinish(Math.round(target.split(' ').length / Math.max(min, 0.001)));
      setTarget('');
    }
  }
  if (!target) return <Button className="w-full h-24 text-lg" onClick={begin}>Start typing test</Button>;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <p className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-secondary font-mono text-sm">
        {target.split('').map((c, i) => (
          <span key={i} className={i < text.length ? (text[i] === c ? 'text-primary' : 'text-destructive underline') : 'text-muted-foreground'}>{c}</span>
        ))}
      </p>
      <Input autoFocus value={text} onChange={e => change(e.target.value)} onPaste={e => e.preventDefault()} placeholder="Type the sentence above…" />
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Score = words per minute</p>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/video/InRoom.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Copy, Users, Wifi, WifiOff, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';
import VideoTile from './VideoTile';
import MediaControls from './MediaControls';
import { useVideoRoom } from '../../hooks/useVideoRoom';
import { stopStream } from '../../lib/media';

type Ice = { urls: string | string[]; username?: string; credential?: string };
type Props = { code: string; name: string; stream: MediaStream; initialMic: boolean; initialCam: boolean; iceServers: Ice[]; onLeave: (reason?: string) => void };

export const inviteLink = (code: string) => `${window.location.origin}/video/${code}`;
export async function copyInvite(code: string) {
  try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(inviteLink(code)); toast.success('Invite link copied'); }
  catch { toast.error('Could not copy — share the code instead: ' + code); }
}

export default function InRoom({ code, name, stream, initialMic, initialCam, iceServers, onLeave }: Props) {
  const [mic, setMic] = useState(initialMic);
  const [cam, setCam] = useState(initialCam);
  const { remotes, status } = useVideoRoom(code, name, stream, iceServers, reason => { stopStream(stream); onLeave(reason); });

  useEffect(() => { stream.getAudioTracks().forEach(t => (t.enabled = mic)); }, [stream, mic]);
  useEffect(() => { stream.getVideoTracks().forEach(t => (t.enabled = cam)); }, [stream, cam]);
  useEffect(() => () => stopStream(stream), [stream]);

  const hasAudio = stream.getAudioTracks().length > 0, hasVideo = stream.getVideoTracks().length > 0;
  const total = remotes.length + 1;
  const cols = total === 1 ? 'grid-cols-1' : total === 2 ? 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2' : total <= 4 ? 'grid-cols-2' : 'grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3';

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 px-3 sm:px-5 py-3 border-b border-border">
        <span className="font-mono font-bold tracking-widest text-lg">{code}</span>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => copyInvite(code)}><Copy className="w-4 h-4 mr-1.5" />Copy invite link</Button>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground"><Users className="w-4 h-4" />{total}</span>
        <StatusPill status={status} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto p-3 sm:p-5">
        <div className={cn('grid gap-3 sm:gap-4 h-full auto-rows-fr', cols)}>
          <VideoTile stream={stream} name={`${name} (you)`} muted mirrored camOff={!cam || !hasVideo} micOff={!mic || !hasAudio} />
          {remotes.map(r => <VideoTile key={r.peerId} stream={r.stream} name={r.name} status={r.state === 'failed' ? 'Connection failed — retrying…' : 'Connecting…'} />)}
        </div>
        {remotes.length === 0 && status !== 'connecting' && (
          <div className="text-center mt-4 text-muted-foreground">
            <p className="font-medium text-foreground">You’re the only one here</p>
            <p className="text-sm">Share the code <span className="font-mono font-bold">{code}</span> or the invite link to bring people in.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="py-4 border-t border-border bg-card/60">
        <MediaControls micOn={mic && hasAudio} camOn={cam && hasVideo} disabledMic={!hasAudio} disabledCam={!hasVideo}
          onMic={() => setMic(m => !m)} onCam={() => setCam(c => !c)} onLeave={() => { stopStream(stream); onLeave(); }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatusPill({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const map: Record<string, [string, React.ReactNode, string]> = {
    connecting: ['Connecting…', <Loader2 key="i" className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />, 'bg-secondary text-muted-foreground'],
    connected: ['Connected', <Wifi key="i" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />, 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400'],
    reconnecting: ['Reconnecting…', <WifiOff key="i" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />, 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400'],
    ended: ['Room ended', <WifiOff key="i" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />, 'bg-destructive/15 text-destructive'],
  };
  const [label, icon, cls] = map[status] ?? map.connecting;
  return <span role="status" className={cn('ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full', cls)}>{icon}{label}</span>;
}

import { Mic, MicOff, Video, VideoOff, PhoneOff } from 'lucide-react';

type Props = { micOn: boolean; camOn: boolean; onMic: () => void; onCam: () => void; onLeave?: () => void; disabledMic?: boolean; disabledCam?: boolean };

function Ctl({ on, onClick, label, children, danger, disabled }: { on?: boolean; onClick: () => void; label: string; children: React.ReactNode; danger?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} disabled={disabled} aria-label={label} title={label}
      className={cn('h-14 w-14 sm:h-16 sm:w-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all shadow-md disabled:opacity-40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        danger ? 'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:brightness-110' : on ? 'bg-secondary text-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80' : 'bg-red-500/90 text-white hover:bg-red-500')}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export default function MediaControls({ micOn, camOn, onMic, onCam, onLeave, disabledMic, disabledCam }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
      <Ctl on={micOn} onClick={onMic} disabled={disabledMic} label={micOn ? 'Mute microphone' : 'Unmute microphone'}>{micOn ? <Mic className="w-6 h-6" /> : <MicOff className="w-6 h-6" />}</Ctl>
      <Ctl on={camOn} onClick={onCam} disabled={disabledCam} label={camOn ? 'Turn camera off' : 'Turn camera on'}>{camOn ? <Video className="w-6 h-6" /> : <VideoOff className="w-6 h-6" />}</Ctl>
      {onLeave && <Ctl danger onClick={onLeave} label="Leave room"><PhoneOff className="w-6 h-6" /></Ctl>}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/video/PreJoin.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Loader2, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@project/components/ui/alert';
import VideoTile from './VideoTile';
import MediaControls from './MediaControls';
import { getMedia, stopStream } from '../../lib/media';

type Props = { code: string; name: string; onJoin: (s: MediaStream, mic: boolean, cam: boolean) => void; onBack: () => void; joining: boolean };

export default function PreJoin({ code, name, onJoin, onBack, joining }: Props) {
  const [stream, setStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [devices, setDevices] = useState<MediaDeviceInfo[]>([]);
  const [audioId, setAudioId] = useState<string>();
  const [videoId, setVideoId] = useState<string>();
  const [mic, setMic] = useState(true);
  const [cam, setCam] = useState(true);

  async function start(a?: string, v?: string) {
    setLoading(true);
    const r = await getMedia(a, v);
    setStream(prev => { stopStream(prev); return r.stream; });
    setError(r.error);
    setLoading(false);
    navigator.mediaDevices?.enumerateDevices().then(d => setDevices(d.filter(x => x.deviceId))).catch(() => {});
  }
  useEffect(() => { start(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  useEffect(() => { stream?.getAudioTracks().forEach(t => (t.enabled = mic)); }, [stream, mic]);
  useEffect(() => { stream?.getVideoTracks().forEach(t => (t.enabled = cam)); }, [stream, cam]);

  const hasAudio = !!stream?.getAudioTracks().length, hasVideo = !!stream?.getVideoTracks().length;
  const mics = devices.filter(d => d.kind === 'audioinput'), cams = devices.filter(d => d.kind === 'videoinput');

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full p-4 sm:p-6 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr] items-start">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="aspect-video">
          {loading ? <div className="w-full h-full rounded-2xl bg-secondary flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground"><Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin" /><p className="text-sm">Asking for camera & microphone…</p></div>
            : <VideoTile stream={stream} name={`${name} (you)`} muted mirrored camOff={!cam || !hasVideo} micOff={!mic || !hasAudio} />}
        </div>
        <MediaControls micOn={mic && hasAudio} camOn={cam && hasVideo} onMic={() => setMic(m => !m)} onCam={() => setCam(c => !c)} disabledMic={!hasAudio} disabledCam={!hasVideo} />
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Ready to join</p><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono tracking-widest">{code}</h2></div>
        {error && <Alert variant="destructive"><AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" /><AlertDescription className="space-y-2"><p>{error}</p>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => start(audioId, videoId)}><RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />Try again</Button></AlertDescription></Alert>}
        {mics.length > 0 && <DevicePick label="Microphone" items={mics} value={audioId ?? stream?.getAudioTracks()[0]?.getSettings().deviceId} onChange={id => { setAudioId(id); start(id, videoId); }} />}
        {cams.length > 0 && <DevicePick label="Camera" items={cams} value={videoId ?? stream?.getVideoTracks()[0]?.getSettings().deviceId} onChange={id => { setVideoId(id); start(audioId, id); }} />}
        <Button size="lg" className="w-full h-14 text-base" disabled={loading || joining || !stream} onClick={() => stream && onJoin(stream, mic, cam)}>
          {joining ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : (hasAudio || hasVideo) ? 'Join room' : 'Join without camera or mic'}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" className="w-full" onClick={() => { stopStream(stream); onBack(); }}>Back</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DevicePick({ label, items, value, onChange }: { label: string; items: MediaDeviceInfo[]; value?: string; onChange: (id: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5"><p className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</p>
      <Select value={value} onValueChange={onChange}>
        <SelectTrigger className="h-11"><SelectValue placeholder={`Choose ${label.toLowerCase()}`} /></SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>{items.map((d, i) => <SelectItem key={d.deviceId} value={d.deviceId}>{d.label || `${label} ${i + 1}`}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
      </Select>
    </div>
  );
}
