import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { MicOff, VideoOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';

type Props = { stream: MediaStream | null; name: string; muted?: boolean; mirrored?: boolean; camOff?: boolean; micOff?: boolean; status?: string };

export default function VideoTile({ stream, name, muted, mirrored, camOff, micOff, status }: Props) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { if (ref.current && ref.current.srcObject !== stream) ref.current.srcObject = stream; }, [stream]);
  const showVideo = !!stream && !camOff;
  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-full min-h-[160px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-secondary border border-border shadow-lg">
      <video ref={ref} autoPlay playsInline muted={muted} className={cn('w-full h-full object-cover', mirrored && '-scale-x-100', !showVideo && 'invisible')} />
      {!showVideo && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-full bg-primary/20 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-primary">{name[0]?.toUpperCase() || '?'}</div>
          {camOff ? <VideoOff className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" /> : <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{status || 'Connecting…'}</p>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="absolute left-2 bottom-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-black/60 text-white text-xs sm:text-sm px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full backdrop-blur">
        {micOff && <MicOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-400" aria-label="Muted" />}
        <span className="truncate max-w-[10rem]">{name}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { vipSettings } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import * as Vip from '../../lib/vip';

/** Owner-only: change the VIP monthly price for everyone. */
export default function OwnerVipPrice({ current }: { current: number }) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState(String(current));
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const n = Number(val);
  const ok = Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n !== current;
  async function save() {
    setBusy(true);
    try { const r = await vipSettings({ monthlyPrice: n }); Vip.setMonthlyPrice(r.monthlyPrice); toast.success(`VIP is now ${r.monthlyPrice.toLocaleString()} gems/month`); }
    catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not save'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return (
    <div className="mt-5 max-w-sm space-y-1.5">
      <label htmlFor="vip-price" className="text-sm font-semibold">Monthly VIP price (gems)</label>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Input id="vip-price" type="number" min={0} value={val} onChange={e => setVal(e.target.value)} />
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={!ok || busy}>{busy && <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}Save</Button>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Currently {current.toLocaleString()} 💎/month for everyone else.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

      </div>

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Crown, Gem, RefreshCw, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Switch } from '@project/components/ui/switch';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@project/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../../contexts/AppContext';
import { useVip } from '../../hooks/useVip';
import * as Vip from '../../lib/vip';
import { isInfiniteGems } from '../../lib/formatGems';
import OwnerVipPrice from './OwnerVipPrice';

export default function VipMembershipCard() {
  const { profile, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const { active, owner, status, days, style, monthlyPrice } = useVip(profile?.email);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const season = Vip.seasonalVariant();
  const price = Vip.nextPrice(profile.email);
  const first = price === Vip.VIP_UNLOCK_PRICE;
  const canAfford = isInfiniteGems(profile.gems) || profile.gems >= price;

  const pay = () => {
    setBusy(true);
    const fresh = profile;
    if (!isInfiniteGems(fresh.gems) && fresh.gems < price) { toast.error('Not enough gems'); setBusy(false); return; }
    const updates: Partial<typeof fresh> = isInfiniteGems(fresh.gems) ? {} : { gems: fresh.gems - price };
    if (fresh.role === 'user') updates.role = 'vip'; // never changes staff roles
    updateProfile(updates);
    Vip.markUnlocked(fresh.email);
    const s = Vip.extendVip(fresh.email);
    toast.success(`👑 VIP active until ${new Date(s.expiresAt).toLocaleDateString()}`);
    setBusy(false); setConfirm(false);
  };

  if (owner) return (
    <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border p-6"
      style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${style.color1}22, ${style.color2}22)` }}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground"><Crown className="w-4 h-4" /> Nexus VIP · Owner</div>
      <h2 className="text-3xl font-black mt-2" style={Vip.nameStyle(style)}>VIP forever — free for the owner</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">You always have every VIP perk and never pay the monthly fee.</p>
      <OwnerVipPrice current={monthlyPrice} />
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border p-6"
      style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${style.color1}22, ${style.color2}22)` }}>
      <div className="absolute -right-10 -top-10 text-[140px] opacity-10 select-none">{style.icon}</div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">
        <Crown className="w-4 h-4" /> Nexus VIP · {season.emoji} {season.label}
      </div>
      <h2 className="text-3xl font-black mt-2" style={Vip.nameStyle(style)}>
        {active ? `You're VIP — ${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} left` : 'Become a VIP'}
      </h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1 max-w-lg">
        {Vip.VIP_UNLOCK_PRICE.toLocaleString()} gems one-time to unlock (includes your first {Vip.VIP_DAYS} days), then {monthlyPrice.toLocaleString()} gems every month. Perks, private spaces and gem boosts —
        VIP never grants moderation powers.
      </p>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mt-5">
        <Button onClick={() => setConfirm(true)} disabled={!canAfford || busy} className="gap-2">
          {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : active ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Gem className="w-4 h-4" />}
          {first ? 'Unlock VIP' : active ? 'Add 30 days' : 'Renew VIP'}{status && status.months >= 12 ? ` (${Vip.durationLabel(status.months)} so far)` : ''} · {price.toLocaleString()} 💎
        </Button>
        {!canAfford && <span className="text-xs text-destructive">You need {(price - profile.gems).toLocaleString()} more gems</span>}
        {status && (
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <Switch checked={status.autoRenew} onCheckedChange={v => { Vip.setAutoRenew(profile.email, v); toast(v ? 'Auto-renew on' : 'Auto-renew off — VIP ends when time runs out'); }} />
            Auto-renew
          </label>
        )}
        {status && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{Vip.durationLabel(status.months)} supported</span>}
      </div>
      <AlertDialog open={confirm} onOpenChange={setConfirm}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>{active ? 'Extend VIP?' : 'Start VIP?'}</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              {price.toLocaleString()} gems will be taken from your balance for {Vip.VIP_DAYS} days of VIP{first ? ` (after this, VIP is ${monthlyPrice.toLocaleString()} gems/month)` : ''}. Gems aren't refunded if you cancel.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={pay}>Pay {price.toLocaleString()} 💎</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ThumbsUp, Trash2, Music, MessageCircleQuestion, Lightbulb, Gift, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../../contexts/AppContext';
import { useVip } from '../../hooks/useVip';
import * as Vip from '../../lib/vip';
import * as DB from '../../lib/storage';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../../lib/gameData';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';

const KINDS = [
  { id: 'song', label: 'Song for playlist', icon: Music },
  { id: 'topic', label: 'Event topic', icon: MessageCircleQuestion },
  { id: 'idea', label: 'Server idea', icon: Lightbulb },
] as const;

export default function VipPerksBoard() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  useVip(profile?.email);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<Vip.VipRequest['kind']>('idea');
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  if (!profile) return null;
  const owner = isOwnerEmail(profile.email);
  const reqs = Vip.getRequests().sort((a, b) => b.votes.length - a.votes.length);
  const votm = Vip.getVipOfMonth();
  const votmUser = votm ? DB.getUser(votm) : null;
  const entered = Vip.hasGiveawayEntry(profile.email);

  const submit = () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    Vip.addRequest({ kind, text: text.trim().slice(0, 140), by: profile.email });
    setText(''); toast.success('Submitted to the VIP board');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold"><Gift className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> Monthly giveaway</div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{Vip.giveawayCount()} VIPs entered this month.</p>
          <Button size="sm" className="mt-3" disabled={entered} onClick={() => { Vip.enterGiveaway(profile.email); toast.success('Entered! 🍀'); }}>
            {entered ? 'You’re entered ✓' : 'Enter giveaway'}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold"><Star className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> VIP of the Month</div>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2">{votmUser ? `🏆 ${votmUser.name}` : 'Not picked yet — the owner chooses each month.'}</p>
          {owner && (
            <select className="mt-2 w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 text-sm" value={votm}
              onChange={e => { Vip.setVipOfMonth(e.target.value); toast.success('VIP of the Month set'); }}>
              <option value="">Pick a VIP…</option>
              {DB.getAllUsers().filter(u => Vip.isVip(u.email)).map(u => <option key={u.email} value={u.email}>{u.name}</option>)}
            </select>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border p-4">
        <p className="font-semibold mb-3">Requests & ideas — vote on what happens next</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3">
          {KINDS.map(k => (
            <Button key={k.id} size="sm" variant={kind === k.id ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setKind(k.id)} className="gap-1.5">
              <k.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{k.label}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Input value={text} maxLength={140} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && submit()} placeholder="Type your request…" />
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={!text.trim()}>Submit</Button>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
          {reqs.length === 0 && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No requests yet — be the first.</p>}
          {reqs.map(r => {
            const K = KINDS.find(k => k.id === r.kind)!;
            const voted = r.votes.includes(profile.email);
            return (
              <div key={r.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg bg-secondary/50 px-3 py-2">
                <K.icon className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm break-words">{r.text}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{DB.getUser(r.by)?.name || r.by.split('@')[0]}</p>
                </div>
                <button onClick={() => Vip.toggleVote(r.id, profile.email)}
                  className={cn('flex items-center gap-1 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-md', voted ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'bg-background')}>
                  <ThumbsUp className="w-3 h-3" />{r.votes.length}
                </button>
                {(owner || r.by === profile.email) && (
                  <button onClick={() => Vip.deleteRequest(r.id)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"><Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../../contexts/AppContext';
import * as Vip from '../../lib/vip';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';

const PRESETS: [string, string, string][] = [
  ['Royal', '#f5c542', '#ff5fa2'], ['Aurora', '#3cf0c5', '#7b5cff'], ['Inferno', '#ff4d2e', '#ffc93c'],
  ['Ocean', '#2ec5ff', '#1b5cff'], ['Toxic', '#a8ff3e', '#00c27a'], ['Midnight', '#9aa8ff', '#ff6ad5'],
];
const ANIMS: Vip.VipStyle['animation'][] = ['none', 'shimmer', 'pulse', 'rainbow'];

export default function VipStyleStudio() {
  const { profile, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const [s, setS] = useState<Vip.VipStyle>(Vip.DEFAULT_STYLE);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (profile) setS({ ...Vip.getStyle(profile.email), ...(profile.vipStyle as Partial<Vip.VipStyle> | undefined) });
  }, [profile?.email]);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const set = <K extends keyof Vip.VipStyle>(key: K, v: Vip.VipStyle[K]) => setS(p => ({ ...p, [key]: v }));

  const save = () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      try { Vip.saveStyle(profile.email, s); } catch { /* local copy is optional; the profile copy below syncs */ }
      const plainRole = !profile.role || profile.role === 'vip' || profile.role === 'user';
      updateProfile({
        vipStyle: { ...s },
        nameColor: s.color1, nameColor2: s.color2,
        ...(plainRole ? { customRole: `${s.icon} ${s.roleName || 'VIP'}`, customRoleColor: s.color1, customRoleColor2: s.color2 } : {}),
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('vip-change'));
      toast.success('VIP style saved');
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not save your style');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px] gap-6">
      <div className="space-y-5">
        <AiDesigner onApply={v => setS(p => ({ ...p, ...v }))} />
        <div>
          <Label>Color presets</Label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-2">
            {PRESETS.map(([n, a, b]) => (
              <button key={n} onClick={() => setS(p => ({ ...p, color1: a, color2: b }))}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-white border border-white/10"
                style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg,${a},${b})` }}>{n}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div><Label>Color 1</Label><Input type="color" value={s.color1} onChange={e => set('color1', e.target.value)} className="h-10 p-1" /></div>
          <div><Label>Color 2</Label><Input type="color" value={s.color2} onChange={e => set('color2', e.target.value)} className="h-10 p-1" /></div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <Label>Animation</Label>
          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
            {ANIMS.map(a => (
              <Button key={a} size="sm" variant={s.animation === a ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => set('animation', a)} className="capitalize">{a}</Button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Switch checked={s.glow} onCheckedChange={v => set('glow', v)} /> Neon glow</label>
        <div>
          <Label>Role icon</Label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
            {Vip.VIP_ICONS.map(i => (
              <button key={i} onClick={() => set('icon', i)}
                className={cn('w-9 h-9 rounded-lg text-lg border', s.icon === i ? 'border-primary bg-primary/15' : 'border-border')}>{i}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div><Label>Role name</Label><Input maxLength={20} value={s.roleName} onChange={e => set('roleName', e.target.value)} /></div>
          <div><Label>Server nickname</Label><Input maxLength={24} value={s.nickname} placeholder={profile.name} onChange={e => set('nickname', e.target.value)} /></div>
          <div><Label>Profile flair</Label>
            <select value={s.flair} onChange={e => set('flair', e.target.value)} className="w-full h-10 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 text-sm">
              {Vip.VIP_FLAIRS.map(f => <option key={f} value={f}>{f || 'None'}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div><Label>Custom status</Label><Input maxLength={40} value={s.status} placeholder="Vibing in the lounge" onChange={e => set('status', e.target.value)} /></div>
        </div>
        <div><Label>Personal welcome message</Label><Textarea maxLength={160} value={s.welcome} placeholder="Shown when you enter the VIP Lounge" onChange={e => set('welcome', e.target.value)} /></div>
        <Button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="gap-2">{saving ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-4 h-4" />} Save style</Button>
      </div>
      <Preview s={s} name={s.nickname || profile.name} pic={profile.profilePic} />
    </div>

function AiDesigner({ onApply }: { onApply: (v: Partial<Vip.VipStyle>) => void }) {
  const [vibe, setVibe] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const run = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { onApply(await aiVipStyle({ vibe })); toast.success('AI look applied — tweak it, then Save'); }
    catch { toast.error('AI designer failed, try again'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/40 bg-primary/5 p-3">
      <Label className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Wand2 className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> AI style designer</Label>
      <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
        <Input value={vibe} maxLength={200} onChange={e => setVibe(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && !busy && run()} placeholder="e.g. cyberpunk dragon, cozy autumn, galaxy queen" />
        <Button onClick={run} disabled={busy} className="gap-1.5">{busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Wand2 className="w-4 h-4" />} Design</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: src/components/watch/PartyPlayer.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Maximize } from 'lucide-react';

export type PlayState = { playing: boolean; positionSeconds: number; syncedAtMs: number };
export const targetTime = (s: PlayState) => s.playing ? s.positionSeconds + (Date.now() - s.syncedAtMs) / 1000 : s.positionSeconds;

const ytId = (url: string) => /(?:youtu\.be\/|v=|embed\/|shorts\/)([\w-]{11})/.exec(url)?.[1] || null;
const isFile = (url: string) => /\.(mp4|webm|ogg|m3u8)(\?|$)/i.test(url);

/**
 * Live-stream style player: only the host controls play/pause/seek. Viewers always join at the
 * host's current position (never from the beginning) and are kept in sync automatically.
 */
export default function PartyPlayer({ url, state, isHost, nonce = 0 }: { url: string; state: PlayState; isHost: boolean; nonce?: number }) {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const frame = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);
  const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const stateRef = useRef(state);
  stateRef.current = state;
  const yt = ytId(url);
  const key = `${state.playing}-${state.positionSeconds}-${state.syncedAtMs}-${nonce}`;
  // Start position is baked into the embed URL once, so the video opens at the live point instead of 0:00.
  const [startAt] = useState(() => Math.floor(targetTime(state)));

  const ytSend = (func: string, args: unknown[] = []) =>
    frame.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'command', func, args }), '*');

  const syncNow = (force: boolean) => {
    const s = stateRef.current; const t = targetTime(s);
    if (yt) { ytSend('seekTo', [t, true]); ytSend(s.playing ? 'playVideo' : 'pauseVideo'); }
    const v = video.current;
    if (v && v.readyState >= 1) {
      if (force || Math.abs(v.currentTime - t) > 2) v.currentTime = t;
      if (s.playing) v.play().catch(() => {}); else v.pause();
    }
  };

  // Host changed play/pause/seek (or viewer pressed Sync) → follow it.
  useEffect(() => { syncNow(true); }, [key]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  // Viewers: keep correcting drift so everyone stays on the same moment.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isHost) return;
    const i = setInterval(() => { if (stateRef.current.playing) syncNow(false); }, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(i);
  }, [isHost, url]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const fullscreen = () => box.current?.requestFullscreen?.().catch(() => {});
  const canSync = !!yt || isFile(url);

  return (
    <div ref={box} className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-black">
      {yt ? (
        <iframe ref={frame} title="Theater" className="h-full w-full" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; fullscreen"
          src={`https://www.youtube.com/embed/${yt}?enablejsapi=1&autoplay=1&start=${startAt}&controls=${isHost ? 1 : 0}&disablekb=${isHost ? 0 : 1}&rel=0&playsinline=1&origin=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin)}`}
          onLoad={() => { setTimeout(() => syncNow(true), 1000); setTimeout(() => syncNow(true), 3000); }} />
      ) : isFile(url) ? (
        <video ref={video} src={url} className="h-full w-full" playsInline controls={false} preload="auto"
          onLoadedMetadata={() => syncNow(true)} />
      ) : (
        <iframe title="Theater stream" src={url} className="h-full w-full" allow="autoplay; fullscreen" />
      )}
      {/* Viewers can't click the player (so only the host can pause), but can still go fullscreen. */}
      {!isHost && canSync && <div className="absolute inset-0" aria-hidden />}
      {!isHost && (
        <button onClick={fullscreen} aria-label="Fullscreen"
          className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 z-10 rounded-md bg-background/70 p-1.5 text-foreground hover:bg-background">
          <Maximize className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      )}
      {!isHost && <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 z-10 rounded bg-destructive px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-destructive-foreground">● LIVE</span>}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/watch/PartyRoom.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft, Pause, Play, Rewind, FastForward, RefreshCw, Send, Users, Power, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { watchParty, WatchPartyOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useApp } from '../../contexts/AppContext';
import PartyPlayer, { targetTime } from './PartyPlayer';
import ShowtimeEditor from './ShowtimeEditor';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../../lib/permissions';
import { platformOf, opensExternally } from '../../lib/theater';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

type Party = WatchPartyOutputType['parties'][0];
type Msg = WatchPartyOutputType['messages'][0];
const REACTIONS = ['😂', '😱', '🔥', '❤️', '👏', '💀'];

export default function PartyRoom({ id, onLeave }: { id: string; onLeave: () => void }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [party, setParty] = useState<Party | null>(null);
  const [msgs, setMsgs] = useState<Msg[]>([]);
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [nonce, setNonce] = useState(0);
  const [floating, setFloating] = useState<{ id: string; e: string; left: number }[]>([]);
  const seen = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const endRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const name = profile?.name;

  const apply = (r: WatchPartyOutputType) => {
    if (r.parties[0]) setParty(r.parties[0]);
    const fresh = r.messages.filter(m => m.isReaction && !seen.current.has(m.id));
    r.messages.forEach(m => seen.current.add(m.id));
    if (fresh.length && seen.current.size > fresh.length) setFloating(f => [...f, ...fresh.map(m => ({ id: m.id, e: m.text, left: 10 + Math.random() * 80 }))]);
    setMsgs(r.messages);
  };
  const call = (input: Parameters<typeof watchParty>[0]) => watchParty({ id, name, ...input }).then(apply).catch(e => toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Something went wrong'));

  useEffect(() => {
    call({ action: 'state' });
    const t = setInterval(() => call({ action: 'state' }), 2500);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [id]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { endRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'end' }); }, [msgs.length]);
  useEffect(() => { if (!floating.length) return; const t = setTimeout(() => setFloating(f => f.slice(1)), 2500); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, [floating]);

  if (!party) return <div className="p-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Joining party…</div>;
  const isHost = party.hostEmail.toLowerCase() === profile?.email.toLowerCase() || isOwnerEmail(profile?.email);
  const platform = platformOf(party.videoUrl);
  const now = targetTime(party);
  const control = (playing: boolean, pos: number) => {
    setParty({ ...party, playing, positionSeconds: pos, syncedAtMs: Date.now() });
    call({ action: 'control', playing, positionSeconds: Math.max(0, pos) });
  };
  const send = (t: string, isReaction = false) => { if (!t.trim()) return; if (!isReaction) setText(''); call({ action: 'send', text: t, isReaction }); };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-3 p-3 lg:flex-row">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onLeave}><ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /></Button>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><p className="truncate font-bold">{party.title}</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{platform} · Hosted by {party.hostName} · {party.ended ? 'Ended' : party.playing ? 'Playing' : 'Paused'}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Starts {format(new Date(party.scheduledFor), 'MMM d, h:mm a')}{party.endsAt ? ` · Ends ${format(new Date(party.endsAt), 'MMM d, h:mm a')}` : ''}</p></div>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><Users className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{party.viewers.length}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="relative">
          {opensExternally(platform) ? (
            <div className="flex aspect-video w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 p-6 text-center">
              <p className="text-lg font-bold">{party.title}</p>
              <p className="max-w-sm text-sm text-muted-foreground">{platform} only plays in its own app or site. Open it with your own {platform} account, then hang out in Theater chat.</p>
              <Button asChild><a href={party.videoUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open on {platform}</a></Button>
            </div>
          ) : <PartyPlayer url={party.videoUrl} state={party} isHost={isHost} nonce={nonce} />}
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden">
            {floating.map(f => <span key={f.id} className="wp-float absolute bottom-2 text-3xl" style={{ left: `${f.left}%` }}>{f.e}</span>)}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {isHost && !party.ended && <>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => control(party.playing, now - 10)}><Rewind className="h-4 w-4" /></Button>
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => control(!party.playing, now)}>{party.playing ? <><Pause className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />Pause</> : <><Play className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />Play for everyone</>}</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => control(party.playing, now + 10)}><FastForward className="h-4 w-4" /></Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-destructive" onClick={() => call({ action: 'end' })}><Power className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />End</Button>
            <ShowtimeEditor party={party} onSave={(scheduledFor, endsAt) => call({ action: 'schedule', scheduledFor, endsAt })} />
          </>}
          {!isHost && <>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Only {party.hostName} can pause or skip — you're watching live.</span>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setNonce(n => n + 1)}><RefreshCw className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />Jump to live</Button>
          </>}
          <div className="ml-auto flex gap-1">{REACTIONS.map(r => <button key={r} onClick={() => send(r, true)} className="rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1 text-xl transition hover:scale-125">{r}</button>)}</div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Watching now: {party.viewers.map(v => v.name).join(', ') || 'just you'}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex h-80 flex-col rounded-xl border border-border bg-card lg:h-auto lg:w-80">
        <p className="border-b border-border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold">Theater chat</p>
        <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto p-3 text-sm">
          {msgs.filter(m => !m.isReaction).map(m => (
            <p key={m.id} className="group flex items-start gap-1">
              <span className="flex-1"><span className="font-semibold text-primary">{m.senderName}</span> {m.text}</span>
              {isOwnerEmail(profile?.email) && (
                <button type="button" title="Delete message" className="opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                  onClick={() => { setMsgs(ms => ms.filter(x => x.id !== m.id)); call({ action: 'deleteMessage', messageId: m.id }); }}>
                  <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </p>
          ))}
          <div ref={endRef} />
        </div>
        <form className="flex gap-1.5 border-t border-border p-2" onSubmit={e => { e.preventDefault(); send(text); }}>
          <Input value={text} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Say something…" maxLength={300} className="h-9" />
          <Button size="sm" type="submit" disabled={!text.trim()}><Send className="h-4 w-4" /></Button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/watch/ShowtimeEditor.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { DateTimePicker } from '@project/components/ui/date-picker';
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/popover';

type Props = { party: { scheduledFor: string; endsAt: string }; onSave: (start: string, end?: string) => void };

/** Host/owner-only control to change a movie's start and end time. */
export default function ShowtimeEditor({ party, onSave }: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [start, setStart] = useState<Date | undefined>(party.scheduledFor ? new Date(party.scheduledFor) : undefined);
  const [end, setEnd] = useState<Date | undefined>(party.endsAt ? new Date(party.endsAt) : undefined);
  const bad = !!end && !!start && end <= start;
  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild><Button size="sm" variant="outline"><Clock className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />Showtimes</Button></PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-72 space-y-2">
        <p className="text-xs font-medium">Start time</p>
        <DateTimePicker value={start} onChange={setStart} />
        <p className="text-xs font-medium">End time</p>
        <DateTimePicker value={end} onChange={setEnd} />
        {bad && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">End must be after start.</p>}
        <Button size="sm" className="w-full" disabled={bad || !start} onClick={() => { onSave(start!.toISOString(), end?.toISOString()); setOpen(false); }}>Save showtimes</Button>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/contexts/AppContext.tsx =====

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { profileSync } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useAuth } from 'zitejs/auth';
import { ACHIEVEMENTS, isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/gameData';
import { checkBadges } from '../lib/badges';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { isInfiniteGems } from '../lib/formatGems';
import { vipBonus } from '../lib/vip';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { roles as rolesApi } from 'zitejs/api';

type AppContextType = {
  profile: DB.UserProfile | null;
  refreshProfile: () => void;
  updateProfile: (updates: Partial<DB.UserProfile>) => void;
  addGems: (amount: number, opts?: { noBonus?: boolean }) => void;
  checkAchievements: () => void;
  unreadCount: number;
  setUnreadCount: (n: number) => void;
  playNotifSound: () => void;
  activeRoomId: string;
  impersonating: string;
  isRealOwner: boolean;
  impersonate: (email: string) => void;
  setActiveRoomId: (id: string) => void;
};

// HMR-safe: reuse the same context reference across hot reloads so the
// provider and hook always share the exact same object.
const IMP_KEY = 'nexus_impersonate';
const CTX_KEY = '__hubx_app_ctx__';
declare global { interface Window { [key: string]: unknown } }
if (!window[CTX_KEY]) {
  window[CTX_KEY] = createContext<AppContextType | null>(null);
}
const Ctx = window[CTX_KEY] as React.Context<AppContextType | null>;

export const useApp = () => {
  const c = useContext(Ctx);
  if (!c) throw new Error('useApp outside provider');
  return c;
};

function playBeep() {
  try {
    const ctx = new AudioContext();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime);
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(660, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
    osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
  } catch { /* silence */ }
}

export function AppProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [impersonating, setImpersonating] = useState<string>(() => localStorage.getItem(IMP_KEY) || '');
  const realEmail = user?.email || '';
  const email = isOwnerEmail(realEmail) && impersonating ? impersonating : realEmail;
  const impersonate = useCallback((target: string) => {
    if (target && !isOwnerEmail(realEmail.toLowerCase())) return; // owner only
    if (target) localStorage.setItem(IMP_KEY, target); else localStorage.removeItem(IMP_KEY);
    setImpersonating(target);
  }, [realEmail]);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<DB.UserProfile | null>(null);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const [activeRoomId, setActiveRoomId] = useState('global');
  const prevNotifCount = useRef(0);

  const refreshProfile = useCallback(() => {
    if (!email) return;
    const p = DB.getOrCreateUser(email);
    DB.ensureBotUser();
    // Backfill new fields
    if (p.streak === undefined) { p.streak = 0; p.lastStreakDate = ''; p.lastMessageTime = 0; DB.saveUser(p); }
    if (!p.language) { p.language = 'en'; DB.saveUser(p); }
    if (p.verified === undefined) { p.verified = false; DB.saveUser(p); }
    // Apply language
    document.documentElement.lang = p.language;
    if (isOwnerEmail(email)) {
      let changed = false;
      if (p.role !== 'owner') { p.role = 'owner'; changed = true; }
      if (!p.name || p.name === email.split('@')[0]) { p.name = 'Jayden Rogres'; changed = true; }
      if (!p.activeTitle || p.activeTitle === '') { p.activeTitle = 'Owner'; p.activeTitleColor = '#ffd700'; p.activeTitleEffect = ''; changed = true; }
      if (!p.verified) { p.verified = true; changed = true; }
      if (changed) DB.saveUser(p);
    }
    setProfile({ ...p });
  }, [email]);

  useEffect(() => { refreshProfile(); }, [refreshProfile]);

  // One shared profile per email: load the server copy on sign-in (any device),
  // then keep it updated so other devices never start a duplicate account.
  const synced = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!email || email !== realEmail) return;
    synced.current = false;
    profileSync({ action: 'get' }).then(({ data }) => {
      if (data) { DB.saveUser({ ...DB.getOrCreateUser(email), ...JSON.parse(data), email }); refreshProfile(); }
      else { const local = DB.getUser(email); if (local) profileSync({ action: 'save', data: JSON.stringify(local) }).catch(() => {}); }
      synced.current = true;
    }).catch(() => { synced.current = true; });
  }, [email, realEmail]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile || !synced.current || profile.email !== realEmail) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      profileSync({ action: 'save', data: JSON.stringify(profile) }).then(({ data }) => {
        const srv = data ? JSON.parse(data) : null;
        if (srv && srv.name !== profile.name) { DB.saveUser({ ...profile, name: srv.name, renamedByOwnerAt: srv.renamedByOwnerAt } as typeof profile); refreshProfile(); }
      }).catch(() => {});
    }, 1500);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [profile, realEmail]);

  // Owner signed in as someone else: a name change is saved to that person's shared profile
  const impName = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile || profile.email === realEmail || !isOwnerEmail(realEmail)) { impName.current = null; return; }
    if (impName.current === null) { impName.current = profile.name; return; }
    if (impName.current === profile.name) return;
    const name = profile.name.trim();
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      profileSync({ action: 'setName', targetEmail: profile.email, name })
        .then(() => { impName.current = name; toast.success(`Name changed to ${name} for everyone`); })
        .catch(e => toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Name not saved'));
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [profile, realEmail]);

  // Check streak on login
  const streakChecked = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!email || streakChecked.current) return;
    streakChecked.current = true;
    const result = DB.checkAndUpdateStreak(email);
    if (result.isNewDay) {
      if (result.streak > 1) {
        toast.success(`🔥 ${result.streak}-day streak! +${result.gemsAwarded} gems`, { duration: 5000 });
      } else {
        toast.success(`👋 Welcome back! +${result.gemsAwarded} gems`, { duration: 4000 });
      }
      refreshProfile();
    }
  }, [email, refreshProfile]);

  const updateProfile = useCallback((updates: Partial<DB.UserProfile>) => {
    setProfile(prev => {
      if (!prev) return prev;
      const updated = { ...(DB.getUser(prev.email) || prev), ...updates };
      DB.saveUser(updated);
      if (updates.language) document.documentElement.lang = updates.language;
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  const addGems = useCallback((rawAmount: number, opts?: { noBonus?: boolean }) => {
    setProfile(prev => {
      if (!prev) return prev;
      // VIPs earn +25% on rewards (spending is unaffected)
      const amount = rawAmount > 0 && !opts?.noBonus ? Math.round(rawAmount * vipBonus(prev.email)) : rawAmount;
      if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) return prev;
      const base = DB.getUser(prev.email) || prev;
      // Infinite gems stay infinite — spending or earning doesn't change them.
      if (isInfiniteGems(base.gems)) return base;
      // No cap — gems grow endlessly, but never become Infinity/NaN
      const cur = Number.isFinite(base.gems) ? base.gems : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
      const sum = cur + amount;
      const next = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number.isFinite(sum) ? Math.min(sum, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER));
      const updated = { ...base, gems: next };
      DB.saveUser(updated);
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  const checkAchievements = useCallback(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const earned = DB.getUserAchievements(profile.email);
    const titles = DB.getUserTitles(profile.email);
    for (const a of ACHIEVEMENTS) {
      if (earned.includes(a.id)) continue;
      let unlock = false;
      const p = profile;
      if (a.id === 'first_message'    && p.messageCount >= 1)   unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'chat_10'          && p.messageCount >= 10)  unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'chat_100'         && p.messageCount >= 100) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'chat_500'         && p.messageCount >= 500) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'chat_1000'        && p.messageCount >= 1000) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'gems_100'         && p.gems >= 100)   unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'gems_1000'        && p.gems >= 1000)  unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'gems_10000'       && p.gems >= 10000) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'gems_100000'      && p.gems >= 100000) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'first_title'      && titles.length >= 1) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'titles_5'         && titles.length >= 5) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'gamble_win'       && p.gambleWins >= 1) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'gamble_10'        && p.gambleCount >= 10) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'gamble_lose_5'    && p.gambleLoseStreak >= 5) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'bug_report'       && p.bugCount >= 1) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'suggestion'       && p.suggestionCount >= 1) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'dm_first'         && p.dmCount >= 1) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'group_create'     && p.groupCount >= 1) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'voice_join'       && p.voiceJoined) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'proxy_use'        && p.proxyUsed) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'reactions_5'      && p.reactionCount >= 5) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'title_broke'      && titles.includes('Broke')) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'title_alpha'      && titles.includes('THE ALPHA')) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'title_scythe'     && titles.includes('Scythe')) unlock = true;
      if (a.id === 'night_owl') { const h = new Date().getHours(); if (h >= 0 && h < 4) unlock = true; }
      if (unlock) { DB.addAchievement(profile.email, a.id); if (a.gems > 0) addGems(a.gems); }
    }
    // Also check badges
    checkBadges(profile.email);
  }, [profile, addGems]);

  // Poll notifications
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const check = () => {
      const notifs = DB.getNotifications(profile.email);
      const unread = notifs.filter(n => !n.read && n.chatRoomId !== activeRoomId).length;
      if (unread > prevNotifCount.current) playBeep();
      prevNotifCount.current = unread;
      setUnreadCount(unread);
    };
    check();
    const t = setInterval(check, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [profile, activeRoomId]);

  // Ping online presence
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile?.email) return;
    DB.pingOnline(profile.email);
    const t = setInterval(() => { if (profile?.email) DB.pingOnline(profile.email); }, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [profile?.email]);

  // Sync my role from the shared server (roles set by staff on any device)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!email) return;
    const sync = () => rolesApi({ action: 'list' }).then(({ myRole, users: rawUsers }) => {
      const users = rawUsers as Array<{ email: string; name: string; role: string; customRole: string; customRoleColor: string; customRoleColor2: string }>;
      // Keep every locally-known user's role in line with the shared server copy
      for (const su of users) {
        const lu = DB.getUser(su.email);
        if (lu && lu.role !== su.role && !isOwnerEmail(su.email)) DB.saveUser({ ...lu, role: su.role as DB.UserProfile['role'] });
        const lu2 = DB.getUser(su.email);
        if (lu2 && (lu2.customRole || '') !== su.customRole) {
          DB.applyCustomRoleLocally(su.email, su.customRole ? { name: su.customRole, color: su.customRoleColor, color2: su.customRoleColor2 } : null);
        }
      }
      const me = users.find(u => u.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase());
      if (me && email === realEmail) {
        setProfile(prev => prev && (prev.customRole || '') !== me.customRole
          ? { ...prev, customRole: me.customRole || undefined, customRoleColor: me.customRoleColor || undefined, customRoleColor2: me.customRoleColor2 || undefined }
          : prev);
      }
      const p = DB.getUser(email);
      if (p && p.role !== myRole && !isOwnerEmail(email) && email === realEmail) {
        DB.saveUser({ ...p, role: myRole as DB.UserProfile['role'] });
        setProfile(prev => prev ? { ...prev, role: myRole as DB.UserProfile['role'] } : prev);
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
    sync();
    const t = setInterval(sync, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [email]);

  // Init broadcast
  useEffect(() => DB.initBroadcast(), []);

  return (
    <Ctx.Provider value={{ profile, refreshProfile, updateProfile, addGems, checkAchievements, unreadCount, setUnreadCount, playNotifSound: playBeep, activeRoomId, setActiveRoomId, impersonating: isOwnerEmail(realEmail) ? impersonating : '', isRealOwner: isOwnerEmail(realEmail), impersonate }}>
      {children}
    </Ctx.Provider>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useActiveEvent.ts =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { events as eventsApi } from 'zitejs/api';
import { getActiveEvent, Override, ActiveEvent, getCountry, COUNTRY_CHANGED } from '../lib/holidays';

export const EVENTS_CHANGED = 'nexus-events-changed';
let cache: Override[] = [];

/** Current holiday event (or null), with owner overrides from the server. Re-checks every 5 minutes. */
export function useActiveEvent() {
  const [overrides, setOverrides] = useState<Override[]>(cache);
  const [country, setCountryState] = useState(getCountry());
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const load = () => eventsApi({ action: 'list' }).then(r => { cache = r.overrides; if (alive) setOverrides(r.overrides); }).catch(() => {});
    const onCountry = () => setCountryState(getCountry());
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 5 * 60 * 1000);
    window.addEventListener(EVENTS_CHANGED, load);
    window.addEventListener(COUNTRY_CHANGED, onCountry);
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(t); window.removeEventListener(EVENTS_CHANGED, load); window.removeEventListener(COUNTRY_CHANGED, onCountry); };
  }, []);
  const active: ActiveEvent | null = getActiveEvent(overrides, new Date(), country);
  return { active, overrides, country };
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useChatSettingsSync.ts =====

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { chatSettings } from 'zitejs/api';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';

/** Keeps this device's word filter + immunity list in step with the shared one. */
export function useChatSettingsSync() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const pull = () => chatSettings({ action: 'get' }).then(r => {
      if (r.words) DB.setChatWords(r.words);
      DB.setMuteImmune(r.immune);
    }).catch(() => {});
    pull();
    const t = setInterval(pull, 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useFriendOnlineAlerts.ts =====

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { friends } from 'zitejs/api';
import { usePresence } from './useOnlineUsers';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';

const norm = (e: string) => e.trim().toLowerCase();

/** Toasts when one of your friends comes online (checked against live presence). */
export function useFriendOnlineAlerts() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const { online } = usePresence();
  const friendSet = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const wasOnline = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const seeded = useRef(false);

  // Keep the friend list fresh.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    let alive = true;
    const load = async () => {
      try { const r = await friends({ action: 'list' }); if (alive) friendSet.current = new Set(r.friends.map(norm)); }
      catch { /* retry next cycle */ }
    };
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 60000);
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(t); };
  }, [profile?.email]);

  // Compare the online set each tick; alert on friends that just appeared.
  useEffect(() => {
    const nowOnline = new Set(online.map(u => norm(u.email)).filter(e => friendSet.current.has(e)));
    if (!seeded.current) { wasOnline.current = nowOnline; seeded.current = true; return; }
    for (const u of online) {
      const e = norm(u.email);
      if (friendSet.current.has(e) && !wasOnline.current.has(e)) {
        toast(`${u.name} is online 🟢`, { description: 'Your friend just came online.' });
      }
    }
    wasOnline.current = nowOnline;
  }, [online]);
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useLayerHistory.ts =====

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import type { Layer } from '../lib/emojiParts';

type H = { past: Layer[][]; present: Layer[]; future: Layer[][] };

export function useLayerHistory() {
  const [h, setH] = useState<H>({ past: [], present: [], future: [] });

  // Commit a new state as one undo step.
  const commit = useCallback((next: Layer[]) => setH(s => ({ past: [...s.past, s.present].slice(-60), present: next, future: [] })), []);
  // Live update without an undo step (dragging); `before` is pushed once on finish.
  const preview = useCallback((next: Layer[]) => setH(s => ({ ...s, present: next })), []);
  const finish = useCallback((before: Layer[]) => setH(s => (before === s.present ? s : { past: [...s.past, before].slice(-60), present: s.present, future: [] })), []);
  const undo = useCallback(() => setH(s => (s.past.length ? { past: s.past.slice(0, -1), present: s.past[s.past.length - 1], future: [s.present, ...s.future] } : s)), []);
  const redo = useCallback(() => setH(s => (s.future.length ? { past: [...s.past, s.present], present: s.future[0], future: s.future.slice(1) } : s)), []);

  return { layers: h.present, canUndo: h.past.length > 0, canRedo: h.future.length > 0, commit, preview, finish, undo, redo };
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useOnlineUsers.ts =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { presence, PresenceOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';

export type OnlineUser = PresenceOutputType['online'][number];

// Pings "I'm here" and fetches everyone online, across all devices, every 10s.
export function useOnlineUsers() { return usePresence().online; }

export function usePresence() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [online, setOnline] = useState<OnlineUser[]>([]);
  const [everyone, setEveryone] = useState<OnlineUser[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    let alive = true;
    const tick = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await presence({
          action: 'ping',
          user: {
            email: profile.email, name: profile.name, profilePic: profile.profilePic || '',
            nameColor: profile.nameColor || '', activeTitle: profile.activeTitle || '',
            activeTitleColor: profile.activeTitleColor || '', activeTitleEffect: profile.activeTitleEffect || '',
            role: profile.role,
          },
        });
        if (alive) { setOnline(res.online); setEveryone(res.everyone); }
      } catch { /* try again next tick */ }
    };
    tick();
    const t = setInterval(tick, 10000);
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(t); };
  }, [profile?.email, profile?.name, profile?.profilePic, profile?.nameColor, profile?.activeTitle, profile?.role]);

  return { online, everyone };
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useOwnerLimited.ts =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { customLimited, CustomLimitedOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { setOwnerLimited, type BgTheme, type TypingStyle } from '../lib/cosmetics';

export type OwnerItem = CustomLimitedOutputType['items'][0];
const CHANGED = 'nexus-owner-limited';

export const bgCss = (i: OwnerItem) =>
  `radial-gradient(circle at 80% 15%, ${i.color2}66, transparent 45%), linear-gradient(135deg, ${i.color}, ${i.color2})`;

function register(items: OwnerItem[]) {
  const bg: BgTheme[] = items.filter(i => i.kind === 'Background').map(i => ({ id: `own-${i.id}`, name: `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`, cost: i.cost, css: bgCss(i) }));
  const typing: TypingStyle[] = items.filter(i => i.kind === 'Typing Effect').map(i => ({
    id: `own-${i.id}`, name: `${i.emoji} ${i.name}`, cost: i.cost, text: `${i.typingText} ${i.emoji}`,
    className: `limited-typing ${i.effect === 'rainbow' ? 'title-rainbow' : i.effect === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}`.trim(), color: i.color,
  }));
  setOwnerLimited(bg, typing);
}

/** Loads owner-made limited items and keeps cosmetics in sync. */
export function useOwnerLimited() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<OwnerItem[]>([]);
  const load = useCallback(() => customLimited({ action: 'list' }).then(r => { setItems(r.items); register(r.items); }).catch(() => {}), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    window.addEventListener(CHANGED, load);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(CHANGED, load);
  }, [load]);
  const mutate = async (input: Parameters<typeof customLimited>[0]) => {
    const r = await customLimited(input);
    setItems(r.items); register(r.items); window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGED));
  };
  return { items, mutate };
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/usePermissions.ts =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { adminUsers } from 'zitejs/api';

export function errMsg(e: unknown, fallback = 'Something went wrong') {
  const err = e as { userFacingMessage?: string; message?: string };
  return err?.userFacingMessage || err?.message || fallback;
}

export function usePermissions() {
  const [perms, setPerms] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [marketRole, setMarketRole] = useState('Customer');
  const [restriction, setRestriction] = useState('None');
  useEffect(() => {
    adminUsers({ action: 'me' })
      .then(r => { setPerms(r.permissions); setMarketRole(r.marketRole); setRestriction(r.restriction); })
      .catch(() => setPerms([]));
  }, []);
  return { perms, has: (p: string) => !!perms?.includes(p), marketRole, restriction, loading: perms === null };
}

export const money = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString(undefined, { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' });
export const when = (s: string) => (s ? new Date(s).toLocaleString(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) : '—');


===== FILE: src/hooks/useServerBan.ts =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { bans } from 'zitejs/api';

export type ServerBan = { bannedBy: string; banType: string; reason: string };

export function getDeviceId() {
  let id = localStorage.getItem('nexus_device_id');
  if (!id) { id = crypto.randomUUID(); localStorage.setItem('nexus_device_id', id); }
  return id;
}

export async function getMyIp(): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('https://api.ipify.org?format=json');
    return ((await r.json()) as { ip: string }).ip || '';
  } catch { return ''; }
}

/** Checks the shared ban list (email, IP and device) for the signed-in user. */
export function useServerBan(enabled: boolean) {
  const [ban, setBan] = useState<ServerBan | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    let alive = true;
    const run = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await bans({ action: 'check', ip: await getMyIp(), deviceId: getDeviceId() });
        if (alive) setBan(res.ban);
      } catch { /* ignore network errors */ }
    };
    run();
    const t = setInterval(run, 60000);
    return () => { alive = false; clearInterval(t); };
  }, [enabled]);
  return ban;
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useVideoRoom.ts =====

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { videoRooms } from 'zitejs/api';

export type Remote = { peerId: string; name: string; stream: MediaStream | null; state: RTCPeerConnectionState | 'new' };
export type ConnStatus = 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'reconnecting' | 'ended';
type Ice = { urls: string | string[]; username?: string; credential?: string };
type Out = { to: string; kind: string; payload: string };

const POLL_MS = 1500;

export function useVideoRoom(code: string, name: string, local: MediaStream | null, iceServers: Ice[], onEnded: (reason: string) => void) {
  const myId = useRef(crypto.randomUUID()).current;
  const pcs = useRef(new Map<string, RTCPeerConnection>());
  const pendingIce = useRef(new Map<string, RTCIceCandidateInit[]>());
  const outbox = useRef<Out[]>([]);
  const seq = useRef(0);
  const known = useRef(new Map<string, string>());
  const failures = useRef(0);
  const [remotes, setRemotes] = useState<Record<string, Remote>>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ConnStatus>('connecting');

  const send = (to: string, kind: string, data: unknown) =>
    outbox.current.push({ to, kind, payload: JSON.stringify({ seq: seq.current++, data }) });

  const patch = (id: string, p: Partial<Remote>) =>
    setRemotes(r => {
      const base: Remote = r[id] ?? { peerId: id, name: known.current.get(id) || 'Guest', stream: null, state: 'new' };
      return { ...r, [id]: { ...base, ...p } };
    });

  const drop = useCallback((id: string) => {
    pcs.current.get(id)?.close();
    pcs.current.delete(id); pendingIce.current.delete(id);
    setRemotes(r => { const n = { ...r }; delete n[id]; return n; });
  }, []);

  const makePc = useCallback((id: string) => {
    pcs.current.get(id)?.close();
    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers });
    local?.getTracks().forEach(t => pc.addTrack(t, local));
    pc.onicecandidate = e => { if (e.candidate) send(id, 'ice', e.candidate.toJSON()); };
    pc.ontrack = e => patch(id, { stream: e.streams[0] ?? new MediaStream([e.track]) });
    pc.onconnectionstatechange = () => {
      patch(id, { state: pc.connectionState });
      if (pc.connectionState === 'failed' && myId < id) void offer(id, true);
    };
    pcs.current.set(id, pc);
    patch(id, { state: 'new' });
    return pc;
  }, [iceServers, local]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  async function offer(id: string, restart = false) {
    const pc = restart && pcs.current.get(id) ? pcs.current.get(id)! : makePc(id);
    const o = await pc.createOffer({ iceRestart: restart });
    await pc.setLocalDescription(o);
    send(id, 'offer', pc.localDescription);
  }

  async function flushIce(id: string, pc: RTCPeerConnection) {
    for (const c of pendingIce.current.get(id) || []) await pc.addIceCandidate(c).catch(() => {});
    pendingIce.current.delete(id);
  }

  async function handle(from: string, kind: string, data: unknown) {
    if (kind === 'offer') {
      const pc = pcs.current.get(from) ?? makePc(from);
      await pc.setRemoteDescription(data as RTCSessionDescriptionInit);
      await flushIce(from, pc);
      await pc.setLocalDescription(await pc.createAnswer());
      send(from, 'answer', pc.localDescription);
    } else if (kind === 'answer') {
      const pc = pcs.current.get(from);
      if (pc && pc.signalingState === 'have-local-offer') { await pc.setRemoteDescription(data as RTCSessionDescriptionInit); await flushIce(from, pc); }
    } else if (kind === 'ice') {
      const pc = pcs.current.get(from);
      if (pc?.remoteDescription) await pc.addIceCandidate(data as RTCIceCandidateInit).catch(() => {});
      else pendingIce.current.set(from, [...(pendingIce.current.get(from) || []), data as RTCIceCandidateInit]);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!local) return;
    let alive = true;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

    const tick = async () => {
      const outgoing = outbox.current.splice(0);
      try {
        const r = await videoRooms({ action: 'sync', code, peerId: myId, displayName: name, outgoing });
        if (!alive) return;
        failures.current = 0;
        setStatus('connected');
        const ids = new Set(r.participants.map(p => p.peerId));
        for (const p of r.participants) {
          if (!known.current.has(p.peerId)) {
            known.current.set(p.peerId, p.displayName);
            toast(`${p.displayName} joined`);
            if (myId < p.peerId) await offer(p.peerId); else patch(p.peerId, {});
          }
        }
        for (const [id, n] of [...known.current]) {
          if (!ids.has(id)) { known.current.delete(id); drop(id); toast(`${n} left`); }
        }
        const sorted = r.signals
          .map(s => ({ from: s.from, kind: s.kind, ...(JSON.parse(s.payload) as { seq: number; data: unknown }) }))
          .sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
        for (const s of sorted) await handle(s.from, s.kind, s.data).catch(err => console.warn('signal', err));
      } catch (e) {
        outbox.current.unshift(...outgoing);
        const msg = (e as { userFacingMessage?: string })?.userFacingMessage || '';
        if (/expired|doesn't exist/i.test(msg)) { setStatus('ended'); onEnded(msg); return; }
        failures.current++;
        if (alive) setStatus('reconnecting');
      }
      if (alive) timer = setTimeout(tick, failures.current ? Math.min(POLL_MS * 2 ** failures.current, 10000) : POLL_MS);
    };
    tick();

    const bye = () => { void videoRooms({ action: 'leave', code, peerId: myId }).catch(() => {}); };
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', bye);
    return () => {
      alive = false; clearTimeout(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', bye);
      pcs.current.forEach(pc => pc.close()); pcs.current.clear();
      known.current.clear(); setRemotes({});
      bye();
    };
  }, [code, local]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return { remotes: Object.values(remotes), status };
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useVip.ts =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { vipSettings } from 'zitejs/api';
import * as Vip from '../lib/vip';

let priceLoaded = false;

/** Re-renders whenever VIP data changes; returns live VIP info for an email. */
export function useVip(email: string | undefined) {
  const [, tick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const on = () => tick(t => t + 1);
    window.addEventListener('vip-change', on);
    window.addEventListener('storage', on);
    if (!priceLoaded) { priceLoaded = true; vipSettings({}).then(r => Vip.setMonthlyPrice(r.monthlyPrice)).catch(() => { priceLoaded = false; }); }
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('vip-change', on); window.removeEventListener('storage', on); };
  }, []);
  const e = email || '';
  return { active: Vip.isVip(e), owner: Vip.isOwnerVip(e), status: Vip.getVip(e), days: Vip.daysLeft(e), style: Vip.getStyle(e), monthlyPrice: Vip.VIP_PRICE };
}

/** Check and award new badges for a user. Returns newly earned badge ids. */
export function checkBadges(email: string): string[] {
  const user = DB.getUser(email);
  if (!user) return [];
  const current = user.badges || [];
  const newBadges: string[] = [];
  for (const badge of BADGE_DEFS) {
    if (current.includes(badge.id)) continue;
    if (badge.check(user)) {
      newBadges.push(badge.id);
    }
  }
  if (newBadges.length > 0) {
    DB.saveUser({ ...user, badges: [...current, ...newBadges] });
  }
  return newBadges;
}


===== FILE: src/lib/browserNav.ts =====

/**
 * Pure browser navigation logic (no React) so it can be unit-tested.
 * History entries: 'nexus:home', 'nexus:search?q=…', 'nexus:game/…' or an http(s) URL.
 */
export const HOME = 'nexus:home';
export const searchEntry = (q: string) => `nexus:search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`;
export const queryOf = (entry: string) =>
  entry.startsWith('nexus:search') ? new URLSearchParams(entry.split('?')[1] ?? '').get('q') ?? '' : null;

/** Turns what the user typed into a history entry: a URL if it looks like one, otherwise a search. */
export function classifyInput(raw: string): string {
  const v = raw.trim();
  if (!v) return HOME;
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(v)) return v;
  if (/^(localhost|\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3})(:\d+)?(\/\S*)?$/i.test(v)) return `http://${v}`;
  if (!/\s/.test(v) && /^[^\s/]+\.[a-z]{2,}(:\d+)?(\/\S*)?$/i.test(v)) return `https://${v}`;
  return searchEntry(v);
}

/** Only http(s) pages may be loaded — blocks javascript:, data:, file: etc. */
export function isSafeUrl(u: string): boolean {
  try { return ['http:', 'https:'].includes(new URL(u).protocol); } catch { return false; }
}

export interface NavTab { id: number; history: string[]; idx: number }

export const current = (t: NavTab) => t.history[t.idx];
export const canBack = (t: NavTab) => t.idx > 0;
export const canForward = (t: NavTab) => t.idx < t.history.length - 1;

/** Navigating drops any forward history, like a real browser. Same-entry navigations don't duplicate. */
export function push<T extends NavTab>(t: T, entry: string): T {
  if (current(t) === entry) return t;
  const history = [...t.history.slice(0, t.idx + 1), entry];
  return { ...t, history, idx: history.length - 1 };
}

export function step<T extends NavTab>(t: T, d: -1 | 1): T {
  const idx = t.idx + d;
  return idx < 0 || idx >= t.history.length ? t : { ...t, idx };
}

/** Closes a tab and picks the next active one. Never leaves zero tabs. */
export function closeTab<T extends NavTab>(tabs: T[], id: number, activeId: number, make: () => T): { tabs: T[]; activeId: number } {
  const i = tabs.findIndex(t => t.id === id);
  if (i === -1) return { tabs, activeId };
  const rest = tabs.filter(t => t.id !== id);
  if (!rest.length) { const t = make(); return { tabs: [t], activeId: t.id }; }
  if (id !== activeId) return { tabs: rest, activeId };
  return { tabs: rest, activeId: rest[Math.min(i, rest.length - 1)].id };
}

/** Next/previous tab with wrap-around (Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab). */
export function cycleTab(tabs: NavTab[], activeId: number, d: -1 | 1): number {
  const i = tabs.findIndex(t => t.id === activeId);
  return tabs[(i + d + tabs.length) % tabs.length].id;
}

/** Friendly copy for error codes shown on the error page. */
export function errorMessage(code: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    EMPTY_QUERY: 'Type something to search for.',
    BLOCKED_SCHEME: 'That kind of link can’t be opened here for security reasons.',
    REFUSED_EMBED: 'This site doesn’t allow being shown inside other apps. Open it in a new tab instead.',
    NOT_FOUND: 'That page couldn’t be found.',
    TIMEOUT: 'The page took too long to respond.',
    OFFLINE: 'You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.',
  };
  return map[code] ?? 'Something went wrong loading this page.';
}


===== FILE: src/lib/browserStore.ts =====

export type SavedLink = { url: string; title: string; at: number };

const read = (k: string): SavedLink[] => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k) || '[]'); } catch { return []; } };
const write = (k: string, v: SavedLink[]) => localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v));

export const getBookmarks = () => read('nexus_bookmarks');
export const isBookmarked = (url: string) => getBookmarks().some(b => b.url === url);
export function toggleBookmark(url: string, title: string) {
  const b = getBookmarks();
  write('nexus_bookmarks', b.some(x => x.url === url) ? b.filter(x => x.url !== url) : [{ url, title, at: Date.now() }, ...b]);
}

export const getHistory = () => read('nexus_browser_history');

export type Engine = 'google' | 'duckduckgo';
export const engineUrl = (e: Engine, q: string) =>
  e === 'duckduckgo'
    ? `https://duckduckgo.com/?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`
    : `https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`;
export const getEngine = (): Engine => (localStorage.getItem('nexus_search_engine') === 'duckduckgo' ? 'duckduckgo' : 'google');
export const setEngine = (e: Engine) => localStorage.setItem('nexus_search_engine', e);
export const searchUrl = (q: string) => engineUrl(getEngine(), q);

export function addHistory(url: string, title: string) {
  if (url === 'nexus:home') return;
  write('nexus_browser_history', [{ url, title, at: Date.now() }, ...getHistory().filter(h => h.url !== url)].slice(0, 100));
}
export const clearHistory = () => write('nexus_browser_history', []);

import { addDays } from 'date-fns';

export type CalHoliday = { key: string; name: string; emoji: string; color: string; date: (y: number) => Date };

const d = (y: number, m: number, day: number) => new Date(y, m - 1, day);
const nth = (y: number, m: number, wd: number, n: number) => { const f = d(y, m, 1); return d(y, m, 1 + ((wd - f.getDay() + 7) % 7) + (n - 1) * 7); };
const last = (y: number, m: number, wd: number) => { const l = new Date(y, m, 0); return d(y, m, l.getDate() - ((l.getDay() - wd + 7) % 7)); };
function easter(y: number) {
  const a = y % 19, b = Math.floor(y / 100), c = y % 100, dd = Math.floor(b / 4), e = b % 4, f = Math.floor((b + 8) / 25), g = Math.floor((b - f + 1) / 3);
  const h = (19 * a + b - dd - g + 15) % 30, i = Math.floor(c / 4), k = c % 4, l = (32 + 2 * e + 2 * i - h - k) % 7, m = Math.floor((a + 11 * h + 22 * l) / 451);
  return d(y, Math.floor((h + l - 7 * m + 114) / 31), ((h + l - 7 * m + 114) % 31) + 1);
}

const same = (a: Date, b: Date) => a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();
export const holidaysOn = (day: Date) => CAL_HOLIDAYS.filter(h => same(h.date(day.getFullYear()), day));

/** Next date (today counts) this holiday happens. */
export function nextOccurrence(h: CalHoliday, from = new Date()) {
  const today = new Date(from.getFullYear(), from.getMonth(), from.getDate());
  const t = h.date(today.getFullYear());
  return t >= today ? t : h.date(today.getFullYear() + 1);
}
export function daysUntil(h: CalHoliday, from = new Date()) {
  const today = new Date(from.getFullYear(), from.getMonth(), from.getDate());
  return Math.round((nextOccurrence(h, from).getTime() - today.getTime()) / 864e5);
}
export const upcoming = (n: number, from = new Date()) => [...CAL_HOLIDAYS].sort((a, b) => daysUntil(a, from) - daysUntil(b, from)).slice(0, n);
export { addDays };

const ownedKey = (e: string) => `nexus_cursors_owned_${e}`;
const eqKey = (e: string) => `nexus_cursor_equipped_${e}`;
const customKey = (e: string) => `nexus_cursor_custom_${e}`;
export const CURSOR_EVENT = 'nexus-cursor-change';

export type CustomCursor = { emoji: string; size: number };
export function getCustom(email: string): CustomCursor | null {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(customKey(email)) || 'null'); } catch { return null; }
}
export function saveCustom(email: string, c: CustomCursor) {
  localStorage.setItem(customKey(email), JSON.stringify(c));
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CURSOR_EVENT));
}

export function getOwned(email: string): string[] {
  try { return ['default', ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ownedKey(email)) || '[]')]; } catch { return ['default']; }
}
export function addOwned(email: string, id: string) {
  const list = getOwned(email).filter(x => x !== 'default');
  localStorage.setItem(ownedKey(email), JSON.stringify([...new Set([...list, id])]));
}
export function getEquipped(email: string) { return localStorage.getItem(eqKey(email)) || 'default'; }
export function equip(email: string, id: string) {
  localStorage.setItem(eqKey(email), id);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CURSOR_EVENT));
}
export function emojiCursorCss(emoji: string, size = 24): string {
  const box = size + 8;
  const svg = `<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='${box}' height='${box}'><text x='2' y='${size + 2}' font-size='${size}'>${emoji}</text></svg>`;
  return `url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}") 4 4, auto`;
}
export function cursorCss(id: string, email = ''): string {
  if (id === 'custom') { const c = getCustom(email); return c ? emojiCursorCss(c.emoji, c.size) : ''; }
  const c = CURSORS.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!c || c.id === 'default') return '';
  return emojiCursorCss(c.emoji);
}

export type StrokeLayer = { id: string; type: 'stroke'; points: [number, number][]; color: string; size: number; erase: boolean };
export type StickerLayer = { id: string; type: 'sticker'; kind: PartKind; x: number; y: number; scale: number; rot: number; color: string };
export type Layer = StrokeLayer | StickerLayer;

export type PartKind =
  | 'circle' | 'square' | 'triangle' | 'star' | 'heart'
  | 'eyes-dot' | 'eyes-happy' | 'eyes-heart' | 'eyes-wink' | 'eyes-big'
  | 'mouth-smile' | 'mouth-frown' | 'mouth-open' | 'mouth-tongue' | 'mouth-flat'
  | 'blush' | 'tear' | 'sunglasses' | 'eyebrows-angry' | 'sparkle';

export const CANVAS = 512;
const INK = '#664500'; // the warm brown used for features on real emoji faces

function shade(hex: string, amt: number) {
  const m = hex.replace('#', '').match(/^([0-9a-f]{6})$/i); if (!m) return hex;
  const n = parseInt(m[1], 16);
  const f = (c: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(amt >= 0 ? c + (255 - c) * amt : c * (1 + amt))));
  return `rgb(${f(n >> 16)},${f((n >> 8) & 255)},${f(n & 255)})`;
}

/** Glossy radial fill like Apple / Google emoji: bright top-left, deeper rim. */
function glossy(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, color: string, r = 50) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-r * 0.3, -r * 0.4, r * 0.1, 0, 0, r * 1.1);
  g.addColorStop(0, shade(color, 0.45)); g.addColorStop(0.55, color); g.addColorStop(1, shade(color, -0.22));
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
}
