===== FILE: src/pages/BrowserPage.tsx =====

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, RotateCw, Home, Search, Globe, ExternalLink, Plus, X, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import LibraryMenu from '../components/browser/LibraryMenu';
import { addHistory, isBookmarked, toggleBookmark, searchUrl } from '../lib/browserStore';
import { proxyPage, webSearch } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';
import BrowserView, { TabView } from '../components/browser/BrowserView';
import { GAMES } from '../components/browser/SearchViews';
import HpClickerPage from './HpClickerPage';
import { HOME, searchEntry, queryOf, classifyInput, isSafeUrl, push, step as stepTab, canBack, canForward, closeTab as closeTabs, cycleTab, errorMessage } from '../lib/browserNav';

/** History entries: 'nexus:home', 'nexus:search?q=…', or a real http(s) URL. */
const googleUrl = (q: string) => searchUrl(q);

type Tab = { id: number; url: string; history: string[]; idx: number; view: TabView; title: string };
let nextId = 1;
const newTab = (): Tab => ({ id: nextId++, url: HOME, history: [HOME], idx: 0, view: { kind: 'home' }, title: 'New tab' });
const hostOf = (u: string) => { try { return new URL(u).hostname.replace(/^www\./, ''); } catch { return u; } };
/** Google/Bing search links found inside pages become native searches (those engines refuse proxy access). */
function toEntry(url: string) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (/(^|\.)(google|bing)\.[a-z.]+$/.test(u.hostname) && u.pathname === '/search' && u.searchParams.get('q')) return searchEntry(u.searchParams.get('q')!);
  } catch { /* not a URL */ }
  return url;
}

export default function BrowserPage() {
  const [tabs, setTabs] = useState<Tab[]>(() => [newTab()]);
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState(tabs[0].id);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [starTick, setStarTick] = useState(0);
  const proxyOff = useRef(false);
  const addressRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const active = tabs.find(t => t.id === activeId) ?? tabs[0];
  const patch = (id: number, p: Partial<Tab>) => setTabs(ts => ts.map(t => t.id === id ? { ...t, ...p } : t));

  const load = useCallback(async (id: number, entry: string) => {
    if (entry === HOME) { patch(id, { url: HOME, view: { kind: 'home' }, title: 'New tab' }); return; }
    if (entry.startsWith('nexus:game/')) { patch(id, { url: entry, view: { kind: 'home' }, title: GAMES.find(g => g.id === entry)?.label ?? 'Game' }); return; }
    if (!navigator.onLine) { patch(id, { url: entry, view: { kind: 'error', code: 'OFFLINE', message: errorMessage('OFFLINE') } }); return; }
    const q = queryOf(entry);
    if (q !== null) {
      if (!q.trim()) { patch(id, { url: entry, view: { kind: 'error', code: 'EMPTY_QUERY', message: 'Type something to search for.' } }); return; }
      patch(id, { url: entry, view: { kind: 'loading' }, title: q });
      try {
        const r = await webSearch({ query: q });
        patch(id, r.ok
          ? { view: { kind: 'results', query: r.query || q, results: r.results || [], provider: r.provider || '' } }
          : { view: { kind: 'error', code: r.code || 'BAD_RESPONSE', message: r.message || 'Search failed.', externalUrl: googleUrl(q) } });
      } catch {
        patch(id, { view: { kind: 'error', code: 'PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Couldn\'t reach search. Check your connection and try again.', externalUrl: googleUrl(q) } });
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!isSafeUrl(entry)) { patch(id, { url: entry, view: { kind: 'error', code: 'BLOCKED_SCHEME', message: errorMessage('BLOCKED_SCHEME') }, title: 'Blocked' }); return; }
    if (proxyOff.current) { patch(id, { url: entry, view: { kind: 'direct', url: entry }, title: hostOf(entry) }); return; }
    patch(id, { url: entry, view: { kind: 'loading' }, title: hostOf(entry) });
    try {
      const r = await proxyPage({ url: entry });
      if (r.ok && r.html) {
        const title = r.html.match(/<title[^>]*>([^<]{1,60})/i)?.[1]?.trim() || hostOf(r.finalUrl || entry);
        patch(id, { url: r.finalUrl || entry, view: { kind: 'page', html: r.html }, title });
      } else if (r.code === 'DISABLED') {
        proxyOff.current = true;
        patch(id, { view: { kind: 'direct', url: entry } });
      } else {
        patch(id, { view: { kind: 'error', code: r.code || 'UNSUPPORTED', message: r.message || 'Something went wrong.' } });
      }
    } catch {
      patch(id, { view: { kind: 'error', code: 'PROXY_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Couldn\'t reach the proxy. Check your connection and try again.' } });
    }
  }, []);

  const navigate = useCallback((id: number, raw: string) => {
    const entry = toEntry(raw);
    setTabs(ts => ts.map(t => t.id === id ? push(t, entry) : t));
    load(id, entry);
  }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMsg = (e: MessageEvent) => { if (e.data?.type === 'nexus-nav' && typeof e.data.url === 'string') navigate(activeId, e.data.url); };
    window.addEventListener('message', onMsg);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', onMsg);
  }, [activeId, navigate]);

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    navigate(active.id, classifyInput(input));
    setInput(''); addressRef.current?.blur();
  }
  const step = (d: -1 | 1) => {
    const next = stepTab(active, d);
    if (next === active) return;
    patch(active.id, { idx: next.idx });
    load(active.id, next.history[next.idx]);
  };
  const addTab = () => { const t = newTab(); setTabs(ts => [...ts, t]); setActiveId(t.id); setInput(''); };
  const closeTab = (id: number) => { const r = closeTabs(tabs, id, activeId, newTab); setTabs(r.tabs); setActiveId(r.activeId); };
  const reload = () => load(active.id, active.url);
  const goHome = () => { setInput(''); navigate(active.id, HOME); };
  const bookmark = () => { if (active.url !== HOME) { toggleBookmark(active.url, active.title); setStarTick(n => n + 1); } };

  // Keyboard shortcuts — Ctrl/Cmd: T new tab, W close, L focus address, R reload, D bookmark, Tab cycle; Alt+←/→ back/forward; Alt+Home.
  const keys = useRef({ addTab, closeTab, reload, goHome, bookmark, step: (d: -1 | 1) => step(d), cycle: (d: -1 | 1) => setActiveId(cycleTab(tabs, activeId, d)), id: activeId });
  keys.current = { addTab, closeTab, reload, goHome, bookmark, step: (d: -1 | 1) => step(d), cycle: (d: -1 | 1) => setActiveId(cycleTab(tabs, activeId, d)), id: activeId };
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const k = keys.current; const mod = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey;
      const run = (f: () => void) => { e.preventDefault(); f(); };
      if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 't') run(k.addTab);
      else if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'w') run(() => k.closeTab(k.id));
      else if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'l') run(() => addressRef.current?.select());
      else if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') run(k.reload);
      else if (mod && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'd') run(k.bookmark);
      else if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'Tab') run(() => k.cycle(e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1));
      else if (e.altKey && e.key === 'ArrowLeft') run(() => k.step(-1));
      else if (e.altKey && e.key === 'ArrowRight') run(() => k.step(1));
      else if (e.altKey && e.key === 'Home') run(k.goHome);
      else if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.activeElement === addressRef.current) { setInput(''); addressRef.current?.blur(); }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);
  const q = queryOf(active.url);
  useEffect(() => { if (active.view.kind !== 'loading' && active.view.kind !== 'error') addHistory(active.url, active.title); }, [active.url, active.title, active.view.kind]);
  const externalUrl = q !== null ? googleUrl(q) : active.url.startsWith('http') ? active.url : 'https://www.google.com/';

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Browser tabs" className="flex items-end gap-1 px-2 pt-2 overflow-x-auto bg-secondary/40">
        {tabs.map(t => (
          <div key={t.id} role="tab" aria-selected={t.id === active.id} tabIndex={0} title={t.title}
            onClick={() => { setActiveId(t.id); setInput(''); }} onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); setActiveId(t.id); } }}
            className={cn('group flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-3 pr-1.5 py-1.5 rounded-t-lg text-xs max-w-[180px] min-w-[110px] cursor-pointer border border-b-0',
              t.id === active.id ? 'bg-card border-border text-foreground' : 'border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary')}>
            {t.view.kind === 'loading' ? <RotateCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin shrink-0" /> : queryOf(t.url) !== null ? <Search className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" /> : <Globe className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />}
            <span className="truncate flex-1">{t.title}</span>
            <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); closeTab(t.id); }} className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-muted" title="Close tab (Ctrl+W)" aria-label={`Close ${t.title}`}><X className="w-3 h-3" /></button>
          </div>
        ))}
        <button onClick={addTab} className="mb-1 p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-secondary text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" title="New tab (Ctrl+T)" aria-label="New tab"><Plus className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-card border-y border-border px-3 py-2">
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => step(-1)} disabled={!canBack(active)} aria-label="Back" title="Back (Alt+←)"><ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => step(1)} disabled={!canForward(active)} aria-label="Forward" title="Forward (Alt+→)"><ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={reload} aria-label="Reload" title="Reload (Ctrl+R)"><RotateCw className={cn('w-4 h-4', active.view.kind === 'loading' && 'animate-spin')} /></Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={goHome} aria-label="Home" title="Home (Alt+Home)"><Home className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
          <div className="flex-1 relative mx-1">
            <Globe className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input ref={addressRef} aria-label="Address and search bar" value={input} onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)} placeholder={q !== null ? `Search: ${q}` : active.url.startsWith('http') ? active.url : 'Search the web or type a URL (Ctrl+L)'} className="pl-8 pr-8 h-8 text-xs bg-secondary/50" />
            <button type="submit" title="Go" aria-label="Go" className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
          </div>
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" disabled={active.url === HOME} onClick={bookmark} title="Bookmark (Ctrl+D)" aria-label={isBookmarked(active.url) ? 'Remove bookmark' : 'Bookmark this page'} aria-pressed={isBookmarked(active.url)}>
            <Star className={cn('w-4 h-4', starTick >= 0 && isBookmarked(active.url) && 'fill-primary text-primary')} />
          </Button>
          <LibraryMenu onOpen={u => navigate(active.id, u)} />
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => window.open(externalUrl, '_blank', 'noopener')} title="Open in a new browser tab" aria-label="Open in a new browser tab"><ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
        </form>
      </div>
      <div className="h-0.5 bg-transparent overflow-hidden" role="progressbar" aria-label="Page loading" aria-busy={active.view.kind === 'loading'}>
        {active.view.kind === 'loading' && <div className="h-full w-1/3 bg-primary animate-[browser-load_1.1s_ease-in-out_infinite]" />}
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 relative bg-background">
        {active.url === 'nexus:game/hpclicker' ? <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-y-auto"><HpClickerPage /></div> :
        <BrowserView key={active.id} view={active.view} url={externalUrl} onRetry={() => load(active.id, active.url)}
          onSearch={s => navigate(active.id, searchEntry(s.trim()))} onOpen={u => navigate(active.id, u)} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/pages/CalendarPage.tsx =====

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { addMonths, subMonths, startOfMonth, endOfMonth, startOfWeek, endOfWeek, eachDayOfInterval, isSameMonth, isToday, format } from 'date-fns';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Plus, Trash2, CalendarDays } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import EventDialog from '../components/EventDialog';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import HolidayCountdown from '../components/HolidayCountdown';
import { holidaysOn } from '../lib/calendarHolidays';

export default function CalendarPage() {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(new Date());
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(DB.toDateKey(new Date()));
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [, setTick] = useState(0);
  const refresh = () => setTick(t => t + 1);

  useEffect(() => { const t = setInterval(refresh, 5000); return () => clearInterval(t); }, []);
  if (!profile) return null;

  const isStaff = ['owner', 'co-owner', 'admin'].includes(profile.role);
  const days = eachDayOfInterval({ start: startOfWeek(startOfMonth(month)), end: endOfWeek(endOfMonth(month)) });
  const dayEvents = DB.eventsOn(selected);
  const todayRoles = DB.eventsOn(DB.toDateKey(new Date())).filter(e => e.roleName);

  function remove(e: DB.CalendarEvent) {
    DB.deleteEvent(e.id); refresh(); toast.success('Removed');
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto p-4 max-w-5xl mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><CalendarDays className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" /><h1 className="text-xl font-black">Calendar</h1></div>
        <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} size="sm"><Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />{isStaff ? 'Add event' : 'Add my birthday'}</Button>
      </div>

      <HolidayCountdown />

      {todayRoles.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Today's roles:</span>
          {todayRoles.map(e => (
            <span key={e.id} className="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full" style={{ color: e.color, backgroundColor: e.color + '22', border: `1px solid ${e.color}55` }}>
              {e.emoji} {e.roleName}{e.targetEmail ? ` → ${DB.getUser(e.targetEmail)?.name ?? ''}` : ' → everyone'}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_300px] gap-4">
        <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => setMonth(subMonths(month, 1))}><ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
            <h2 className="font-bold">{format(month, 'MMMM yyyy')}</h2>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => setMonth(addMonths(month, 1))}><ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-semibold mb-1">
            {['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'].map(d => <div key={d} className="text-center py-1">{d}</div>)}
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
            {days.map(d => {
              const key = DB.toDateKey(d);
              const evs = DB.eventsOn(key);
              const hols = holidaysOn(d);
              return (
                <button key={key} onClick={() => setSelected(key)}
                  className={cn('min-h-[64px] sm:min-h-[80px] rounded-lg p-1 text-left border transition-colors flex flex-col gap-0.5',
                    selected === key ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10' : 'border-transparent hover:bg-secondary',
                    !isSameMonth(d, month) && 'opacity-40')}>
                  <span className={cn('text-xs font-semibold w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full', isToday(d) && 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground')}>{d.getDate()}</span>
                  {hols.map(h => <span key={h.key} className="text-[9px] truncate rounded px-1 font-semibold" style={{ backgroundColor: h.color + '33', color: h.color }}>{h.emoji} {h.name}</span>)}
                  {evs.slice(0, 2).map(e => (
                    <span key={e.id} className="text-[9px] truncate rounded px-1" style={{ backgroundColor: e.color + '33', color: e.color }}>{e.emoji} {e.title}</span>
                  ))}
                  {evs.length > 2 && <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">+{evs.length - 2} more</span>}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-3">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-sm mb-2">{format(new Date(selected + 'T12:00:00'), 'EEEE, MMM d')}</h3>
          {holidaysOn(new Date(selected + 'T12:00:00')).map(h => (
            <div key={h.key} className="p-2 mb-2 rounded-lg border border-border" style={{ borderLeft: `3px solid ${h.color}` }}>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{h.emoji} {h.name}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Holiday • every year</p>
            </div>
          ))}
          {dayEvents.length === 0 && holidaysOn(new Date(selected + 'T12:00:00')).length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Nothing planned.</p>}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {dayEvents.map(e => (
              <div key={e.id} className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-border" style={{ borderLeft: `3px solid ${e.color}` }}>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{e.emoji} {e.title}</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground capitalize">{e.type}{e.yearly ? ' • every year' : ''}</p>
                    {e.roleName && <p className="text-[10px] mt-1" style={{ color: e.color }}>Daily role: {e.roleName}</p>}
                  </div>
                  {(isStaff || e.createdBy === profile.email) && (
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => remove(e)}><Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-destructive" /></Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <EventDialog open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} date={selected} isStaff={isStaff} me={profile} onSaved={refresh} />
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/pages/ChatPage.tsx =====

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Plus, Hash, MessageCircle, Users, Settings2, Globe, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { groups as groupsApi } from 'zitejs/api';
import FriendsDialog from '../components/FriendsDialog';
import GroupSettingsDialog, { Group } from '../components/GroupSettingsDialog';
import { Switch } from '@project/components/ui/switch';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@project/components/ui/dialog';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import ChatRoom from '../components/ChatRoom';
import OnlinePanel from '../components/OnlinePanel';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { cn } from '@project/components/lib/utils';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { roleRoomsFor, canEnterRoleRoom, VIP_LOUNGE_ID } from '../lib/roleRooms';
import { isVip } from '../lib/vip';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

export default function ChatPage() {
  const { profile, unreadCount, setUnreadCount, setActiveRoomId } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState<DB.ChatRoom[]>([]);
  const [activeRoom, _setActiveRoom] = useState<DB.ChatRoom | null>(null);
  const activeRoomRef = useRef<DB.ChatRoom | null>(null);
  const [showNewGroup, setShowNewGroup] = useState(false);
  const [showNewDM, setShowNewDM] = useState(false);
  const [groupName, setGroupName] = useState('');
  const [dmEmail, setDmEmail] = useState('');
  const [groupPublic, setGroupPublic] = useState(false);
  const [serverGroups, _setServerGroups] = useState<Group[]>([]);
  const serverGroupsRef = useRef<Group[]>([]);
  const [friendsOpen, setFriendsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [settingsId, setSettingsId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toRoom = (g: Group): DB.ChatRoom => ({ id: `grp_${g.id}`, name: `${g.visibility === 'Public' ? '🌐' : '🔒'} ${g.name}`, type: 'group', members: g.members, createdBy: g.ownerEmail });
  function setServerGroups(g: Group[]) { serverGroupsRef.current = g; _setServerGroups(g); }

  // Keep ref in sync with state so interval callbacks always see latest room
  function setActiveRoom(room: DB.ChatRoom | null) {
    activeRoomRef.current = room;
    _setActiveRoom(room);
  }

  const loadRooms = useCallback(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const all = DB.getChatRooms();
    const accessible = [...all.filter(r => r.type === 'global' || r.members.includes(profile.email)), ...roleRoomsFor(profile), ...serverGroupsRef.current.filter(g => g.isMember).map(toRoom)];
    setRooms(accessible);

    const currentId = activeRoomRef.current?.id;
    if (currentId) {
      // Re-sync the active room object with the fresh list (keeps DMs/groups selected)
      const fresh = accessible.find(r => r.id === currentId);
      if (fresh) {
        setActiveRoom(fresh);
      } else {
        // Room was deleted or user removed — fall back to global
        const global = accessible.find(r => r.id === 'global');
        if (global) { setActiveRoom(global); setActiveRoomId('global'); }
      }
    } else {
      // No room selected yet — default to global
      const global = accessible.find(r => r.id === 'global');
      if (global) { setActiveRoom(global); setActiveRoomId('global'); }
    }
  }, [profile?.email, profile?.role, setActiveRoomId]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!profile) return;
    const pull = () => groupsApi({ action: 'list' }).then(r => { setServerGroups(r.groups); loadRooms(); }).catch(() => {});
    pull(); const t = setInterval(pull, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [profile?.email, loadRooms]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  function onGroupsChanged(g: Group[]) { setServerGroups(g); loadRooms(); }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRooms();
    const t = setInterval(loadRooms, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [loadRooms]);

  function selectRoom(room: DB.ChatRoom) {
    if (room.id === VIP_LOUNGE_ID && !isVip(profile!.email) && !canEnterRoleRoom(profile!, 'vip', true)) {
      toast('💖 The VIP Lounge is for VIPs — unlock VIP to get in!'); navigate('/vip'); return;
    }
    setActiveRoom(room); setActiveRoomId(room.id);
    if (room.type === 'dm') { DB.markNotificationsRead(profile!.email); setUnreadCount(0); }
  }

  async function createGroup() {
    if (!profile || !groupName.trim()) { toast.error('Enter a group name'); return; }
    try {
      const r = await groupsApi({ action: 'create', name: groupName.trim(), visibility: groupPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private' });
      onGroupsChanged(r.groups);
      DB.saveUser({ ...profile, groupCount: profile.groupCount + 1 });
      setGroupName(''); setGroupPublic(false); setShowNewGroup(false); toast.success('Group created!');
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not create group'); }
  }

  async function joinGroup(g: Group) {
    try { const r = await groupsApi({ action: 'join', id: g.id }); onGroupsChanged(r.groups); toast.success(`Joined ${g.name}`); selectRoom(toRoom({ ...g, isMember: true })); }
    catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not join'); }
  }

  function createDM() {
    if (!profile || !dmEmail.trim()) { toast.error('Enter an email'); return; }
    startDMWith(dmEmail.trim());
    setDmEmail(''); setShowNewDM(false);
  }

  function startDMWith(targetEmail: string) {
    if (!profile) return;
    if (targetEmail === profile.email) { toast.error("Can't DM yourself"); return; }
    const existing = rooms.find(r => r.type === 'dm' && r.members.includes(targetEmail) && r.members.includes(profile.email));
    if (existing) { selectRoom(existing); return; }
    const targetUser = DB.getUser(targetEmail);
    const name = targetUser ? targetUser.name : targetEmail;
    const room: DB.ChatRoom = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), name: `💬 ${name}`, type: 'dm', members: [profile.email, targetEmail], createdBy: profile.email };
    DB.addChatRoom(room); loadRooms(); selectRoom(room); toast.success('DM started!');
  }

  const globalRoom = rooms.find(r => r.id === 'global');
  const roleRooms = rooms.filter(r => r.id.startsWith('role-'));
  const groupRooms = rooms.filter(r => r.type === 'group' && !r.id.startsWith('role-'));
  const dmRooms = rooms.filter(r => r.type === 'dm');
  const discover = serverGroups.filter(g => !g.isMember && g.visibility === 'Public');
  const settingsGroup = serverGroups.find(g => g.id === settingsId && g.isMember) || null;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full">
      {/* Room List */}
      <div className="w-52 flex-shrink-0 bg-card/50 border-r border-border flex flex-col overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="p-2 pt-3">
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full mb-2 h-8 text-xs" onClick={() => setFriendsOpen(true)}><Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />Friends</Button>
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground px-2 mb-1">Global</p>
          {globalRoom && <RoomItem room={globalRoom} active={activeRoom?.id === globalRoom.id} onClick={() => selectRoom(globalRoom)} />}
        </div>
        {roleRooms.length > 0 && (
          <div className="p-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground px-2 mb-1">Role Rooms</p>
            {roleRooms.map(r => <RoomItem key={r.id} room={r} active={activeRoom?.id === r.id} onClick={() => selectRoom(r)} />)}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="p-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 mb-1">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Groups</p>
            <button onClick={() => setShowNewGroup(true)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
          </div>
          {groupRooms.map(r => (
            <div key={r.id} className="group/room relative">
              <RoomItem room={r} active={activeRoom?.id === r.id} onClick={() => selectRoom(r)} />
              {r.id.startsWith('grp_') && <button title="Group settings" onClick={() => setSettingsId(r.id.slice(4))} className="absolute right-1 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground opacity-0 group-hover/room:opacity-100"><Settings2 className="w-3 h-3" /></button>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {discover.length > 0 && (
          <div className="p-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground px-2 mb-1">Public Groups</p>
            {discover.map(g => (
              <div key={g.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" /><span className="truncate flex-1">{g.name}</span>
                <button onClick={() => joinGroup(g)} className="text-primary hover:underline font-medium">Join</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="p-2 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 mb-1">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">Direct Messages</p>
            <button onClick={() => setShowNewDM(true)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></button>
          </div>
          {dmRooms.map(r => <RoomItem key={r.id} room={r} active={activeRoom?.id === r.id} onClick={() => selectRoom(r)} unread={unreadCount > 0} />)}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Chat Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        {activeRoom
          ? <ChatRoom room={activeRoom} onStartDM={startDMWith} />
          : <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-muted-foreground">Select a chat to get started 💬</div>}
      </div>

      {/* Online Users Panel */}
      <OnlinePanel roomId={activeRoom?.id || 'global'} currentUserEmail={profile?.email} />

      </Dialog>

        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

function exportBlob(layers: Layer[]): Promise<Blob> {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = CANVAS; c.height = CANVAS;
  renderLayers(c.getContext('2d')!, layers, null);
  return new Promise((res, rej) => c.toBlob(b => (b ? res(b) : rej(new Error('Export failed'))), 'image/png'));
}

function ToolButton({ active, onClick, icon, label }: { active: boolean; onClick: () => void; icon: React.ReactNode; label: string }) {
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} className={cn('flex flex-col items-center gap-1 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold transition-all', active ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-lg scale-105' : 'bg-secondary/50 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary')}>
      {icon}{label}
    </button>
  );
}

export default function EmojiMakerPage({ mode = 'emoji' }: { mode?: 'emoji' | 'draw' }) {
  const isEmoji = mode === 'emoji';

  const [tool, setTool] = useState<Tool>('pencil');
  const [color, setColor] = useState('#2b2140');
  const [size, setSize] = useState(12);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mine, setMine] = useState(getMyEmojis);
  const { upload, isUploading } = useUpload();
  const selected = layers.find(l => l.id === selectedId && l.type === 'sticker') as StickerLayer | undefined;

  useEffect(() => { const s = () => setMine(getMyEmojis()); window.addEventListener(MY_EMOJIS_EVENT, s); return () => window.removeEventListener(MY_EMOJIS_EVENT, s); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const k = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (!(e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) || (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName === 'INPUT') return;
      if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'z') { e.preventDefault(); e.shiftKey ? redo() : undo(); }
      if (e.key.toLowerCase() === 'y') { e.preventDefault(); redo(); }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', k); return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', k);
  }, [undo, redo]);

  }

            <Button variant="outline" onClick={savePng} className="gap-1.5"><Download className="w-4 h-4" /><span className="hidden sm:inline">Save PNG</span></Button>
            {isEmoji && <Button onClick={addToCollection} disabled={isUploading} className="gap-1.5">{isUploading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />}<span className="hidden sm:inline">Add to my emojis</span></Button>}
          </div>
        </header>

const EMOJIS = ['😀','😂','🥹','😍','😎','🤩','😭','😡','🥶','🤢','😱','🤔','😴','🥳','😇','🤠','👽','🤖','👻','💀','🎃','😺','🐶','🐸','🦄','🐵','🔥','⭐','❤️','💎','🌈','⚡','🍕','🍩','🌮','🎉','👑','🕶️','🎩','🧢','💯','💩','🌵','🌸','🍀','🎮','💰','🍓'];

type Style = { id: string; label: string };
const STYLES: Style[] = [
  { id: 'wear', label: 'Wear it' },     // B worn on top of A (hats, glasses)
  { id: 'fuse', label: 'Fuse' },        // A tinted with B, B face peeks
  { id: 'hold', label: 'Holding' },     // B small in front corner
  { id: 'split', label: 'Half & half' },
];
const SIZE = 256;

function draw(c: HTMLCanvasElement, a: string, b: string, style: string, sB: number, yB: number) {
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d')!;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, SIZE, SIZE);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  const glyph = (e: string, x: number, y: number, s: number) => { ctx.font = `${s}px "Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif`; ctx.fillText(e, x, y); };
  const off = yB * SIZE;
  if (style === 'split') {
    ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, 0, SIZE / 2, SIZE); ctx.clip(); glyph(a, SIZE / 2, SIZE / 2 + 10, 210); ctx.restore();
    ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(SIZE / 2, 0, SIZE / 2, SIZE); ctx.clip(); glyph(b, SIZE / 2, SIZE / 2 + 10, 210); ctx.restore();
    return;
  }
  glyph(a, SIZE / 2, SIZE / 2 + 12, 200);
  if (style === 'fuse') {
    // tint the base with B's colors, then layer B semi-transparent
    const t = document.createElement('canvas'); t.width = t.height = SIZE;
    const tc = t.getContext('2d')!; tc.textAlign = 'center'; tc.textBaseline = 'middle';
    tc.font = `260px sans-serif`; tc.fillText(b, SIZE / 2, SIZE / 2 + 14);
    ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop'; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45; ctx.filter = 'blur(6px)'; ctx.drawImage(t, 0, 0); ctx.restore();
    ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9; glyph(b, SIZE / 2, SIZE / 2 + 12 + off, 110 * sB); ctx.restore();
  } else if (style === 'hold') {
    glyph(b, SIZE * 0.74, SIZE * 0.76 + off, 100 * sB);
  } else {
    glyph(b, SIZE / 2, SIZE * 0.22 + off, 130 * sB);
  }
}

function Grid({ value, onPick }: { value: string; onPick: (e: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-8 gap-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto p-1">
      {EMOJIS.map(e => (
        <button key={e} onClick={() => onPick(e)} className={cn('text-2xl rounded-md p-1 transition-colors hover:bg-secondary', value === e && 'bg-primary/20 ring-2 ring-primary')}>{e}</button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'kitchen' | 'custom'>('kitchen');
  const [mine, setMine] = useState<MyEmoji[]>(getMyEmojis());

  useEffect(() => { if (ref.current) draw(ref.current, a, b, style, sB, yB); }, [a, b, style, sB, yB]);
  useEffect(() => { const s = () => setMine(getMyEmojis()); window.addEventListener(MY_EMOJIS_EVENT, s); return () => window.removeEventListener(MY_EMOJIS_EVENT, s); }, []);

  const shuffle = () => { setA(EMOJIS[Math.floor(Math.random() * EMOJIS.length)]); setB(EMOJIS[Math.floor(Math.random() * EMOJIS.length)]); setStyle(STYLES[Math.floor(Math.random() * STYLES.length)].id); };
  const save = () => { addMyEmoji(ref.current!.toDataURL('image/png')); toast.success('Added to your emoji collection — find it in the chat emoji picker!'); };

  return (

===== FILE: src/pages/GamblePage.tsx =====

import { formatGems } from '../lib/formatGems';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Gem, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/tabs';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import * as DB from '../lib/storage';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { DiceGame, RouletteGame, HigherLowerGame, WheelGame, Settle } from '../components/CasinoGames';
import DailyLottery from '../components/DailyLottery';
import WeeklyTitles from '../components/WeeklyTitles';

const SLOTS = ['💎','🎰','🍒','🍋','⭐','💀','🎲','👑','🌙','🔥'];

type HistoryEntry = { type: string; bet: number; result: number; win: boolean; timestamp: number };

function resolveSlotOutcome(rig: DB.GambleRig, betNum: number): { final: string[]; payout: number; msg: string } {
  if (rig === 'jackpot') {
    const sym = SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SLOTS.length)];
    return { final: [sym, sym, sym], payout: betNum * 10, msg: `🎉 JACKPOT! Triple ${sym}! 10x win!` };
  }
  if (rig === 'win') {
    const a = SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SLOTS.length)];
    const b = SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SLOTS.length)];
    return { final: [a, a, b], payout: betNum * 2, msg: '✌️ Pair! 2x win!' };
  }
  if (rig === 'lose') {
    // Ensure no matching pairs
    let f: string[];
    do { f = [SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)]]; }
    while (f[0]===f[1] || f[1]===f[2] || f[0]===f[2]);
    return { final: f, payout: 0, msg: '😢 No luck this time…' };
  }
  // Normal
  const final = [SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)]];
  let payout = 0; let msg = '';
  if (final[0]===final[1] && final[1]===final[2]) { payout = betNum * 10; msg = `🎉 JACKPOT! Triple ${final[0]}! 10x win!`; }
  else if (final[0]===final[1] || final[1]===final[2] || final[0]===final[2]) { payout = betNum * 2; msg = '✌️ Pair! 2x win!'; }
  else if (Math.random() < 0.35) { payout = Math.floor(betNum * 1.5); msg = '😊 Small win! 1.5x'; }
  else { msg = '😢 No luck this time…'; }
  return { final, payout, msg };
}

function resolveCoinOutcome(rig: DB.GambleRig, choice: 'heads' | 'tails'): 'heads' | 'tails' {
  if (rig === 'jackpot' || rig === 'win') return choice;
  if (rig === 'lose') return choice === 'heads' ? 'tails' : 'heads';
  return Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'heads' : 'tails';
}

export default function GamblePage() {
  const { profile, addGems, updateProfile, checkAchievements } = useApp();
  const [bet, setBet] = useState('50');
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState(['❓','❓','❓']);
  const [spinning, setSpinning] = useState(false);
  const [slotResult, setSlotResult] = useState<null | { win: boolean; amount: number; message: string }>(null);
  const [coinSide, setCoinSide] = useState<null | 'heads' | 'tails'>(null);
  const [coinFlipping, setCoinFlipping] = useState(false);
  const [coinChoice, setCoinChoice] = useState<'heads' | 'tails'>('heads');
  const [coinResult, setCoinResult] = useState<null | { win: boolean; amount: number; side: string }>(null);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<HistoryEntry[]>([]);
  const [rig, setRig] = useState<DB.GambleRig>('normal');

  useEffect(() => { setRig(DB.getGambleRig()); }, []);

  if (!profile) return null;

  function addHistory(entry: HistoryEntry) { setHistory(h => [entry, ...h].slice(0, 15)); }

  const betNum = parseInt(bet) || 0;

  // ── Slots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function spinSlots() {
    if (betNum <= 0 || (betNum > profile!.gems)) { toast.error(betNum <= 0 ? 'Enter a valid bet' : 'Not enough gems!'); return; }
    setSpinning(true); setSlotResult(null);
    addGems(-betNum);
    let ticks = 0;
    const currentRig = DB.getGambleRig();
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      setSlots([SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)], SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)]]);
      if (++ticks > 18) {
        clearInterval(iv);
        const { final, payout, msg } = resolveSlotOutcome(currentRig, betNum);
        setSlots(final);
        if (payout > 0) addGems(payout);
        const didWin = payout > 0;
        const p = DB.getUser(profile!.email)!;
        const streak = didWin ? 0 : p.gambleLoseStreak + 1;
        const up = { ...p, gambleCount: p.gambleCount+1, gambleWins: p.gambleWins+(didWin?1:0), gambleLoseStreak: streak };
        DB.saveUser(up); updateProfile(up);
        setSlotResult({ win: didWin, amount: payout, message: msg });
        addHistory({ type: 'Slots', bet: betNum, result: payout - betNum, win: didWin, timestamp: Date.now() });
        DB.incrementQuestProgress(profile!.email, 'gamble_3');
        setSpinning(false); setTimeout(checkAchievements, 300);
      }
    }, 70);
  }

  // ── Coin Flip ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function flipCoin() {
    if (betNum <= 0 || (betNum > profile!.gems)) { toast.error(betNum <= 0 ? 'Enter a valid bet' : 'Not enough gems!'); return; }
    setCoinFlipping(true); setCoinResult(null); setCoinSide(null);
    addGems(-betNum);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const currentRig = DB.getGambleRig();
      const result = resolveCoinOutcome(currentRig, coinChoice);
      setCoinSide(result);
      const didWin = result === coinChoice;
      const payout = didWin ? betNum * 2 : 0;
      if (payout > 0) addGems(payout);
      const p = DB.getUser(profile!.email)!;
      const streak = didWin ? 0 : p.gambleLoseStreak + 1;
      const up = { ...p, gambleCount: p.gambleCount+1, gambleWins: p.gambleWins+(didWin?1:0), gambleLoseStreak: streak };
      DB.saveUser(up); updateProfile(up);
      setCoinResult({ win: didWin, amount: payout, side: result });
      addHistory({ type: 'Coin Flip', bet: betNum, result: payout - betNum, win: didWin, timestamp: Date.now() });
      DB.incrementQuestProgress(profile!.email, 'gamble_3');
      setCoinFlipping(false); setTimeout(checkAchievements, 300);
    }, 1200);
  }

  const settle: Settle = {
    bet: betNum,
    disabled: betNum <= 0 || (betNum > profile.gems),
    start: () => {
      if (betNum <= 0 || (betNum > profile!.gems)) { toast.error(betNum <= 0 ? 'Enter a valid bet' : 'Not enough gems!'); return false; }
      addGems(-betNum);
      return true;
    },
    finish: (game, payout) => {
      if (payout > 0) addGems(payout);
      const didWin = payout > betNum;
      const p = DB.getUser(profile!.email)!;
      const up = { ...p, gambleCount: p.gambleCount + 1, gambleWins: p.gambleWins + (didWin ? 1 : 0), gambleLoseStreak: didWin ? 0 : p.gambleLoseStreak + 1 };
      DB.saveUser(up); updateProfile(up);
      addHistory({ type: game, bet: betNum, result: payout - betNum, win: didWin, timestamp: Date.now() });
      DB.incrementQuestProgress(profile!.email, 'gamble_3');
      setTimeout(checkAchievements, 300);
    },
  };

  const winRate = profile.gambleCount > 0 ? Math.round((profile.gambleWins / profile.gambleCount) * 100) : 0;

  const RIG_LABELS: Record<DB.GambleRig, string> = {
    normal: '🎲 Fair',
    win:    '✅ Rigged — Win',
    jackpot:'🏆 Rigged — Jackpot',
    lose:   '❌ Rigged — Lose',
  };

  return (

      <div className="text-center mb-6">
        <div className="text-4xl mb-2">🎰</div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-black">Gem Casino</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">Bet your gems, win big (or lose it all)</p>
        {rig !== 'normal' && (

            ⚠️ {RIG_LABELS[rig]}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-6">
        <DailyLottery />
        <WeeklyTitles />
      </div>

      {/* Stats Bar */}

          <p className="text-lg font-black text-purple-300">{formatGems(profile.gems)}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Gems</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-3 text-center">
          <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-1" />
          <p className="text-lg font-black text-green-400">{winRate}%</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Win Rate</p>
        </div>

function formatTime(ms: number) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const sec = s % 60;
  return `${m}:${sec.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export default function HpClickerPage() {
  const { profile, addGems } = useApp();
  const isOwner = profile && (isOwnerEmail(profile.email) || profile.role === 'owner');
  const [hp, setHp] = useState(0);
  const [totalClicks, setTotalClicks] = useState(0);
  const [upgrades, setUpgrades] = useState<UpgradesMap>({});
  const [prestige, setPrestige] = useState(0);
  const [godPrestige, setGodPrestige] = useState(0);
  const [floats, setFloats] = useState<FloatingText[]>([]);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1);
  const [hue, setHue] = useState(0);
  const [showUpgrades, setShowUpgrades] = useState(false);
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState(CATEGORIES[0]);
  const [floatingHearts, setFloatingHearts] = useState<FloatingHeart[]>([]);
  const [activeBoosts, setActiveBoosts] = useState<ActiveBoost[]>([]);
  const [heartLevel, setHeartLevel] = useState(1);
  const [xp, setXp] = useState(0);
  const [lastDaily, setLastDaily] = useState('');
  const [heartName, setHeartName] = useState('My Heart');
  const [buyAmt, setBuyAmt] = useState<1 | 10 | 'max'>(1);
  const [, setNow] = useState(0);
  const floatId = useRef(0);
  const heartId = useRef(0);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load save
  useEffect(() => {
    const d = loadSave();
    setHp(d.hp || 0);
    setTotalClicks(d.totalClicks || 0);
    if (d.upgrades) setUpgrades(d.upgrades);
    setPrestige(d.prestige || 0);
    setGodPrestige(d.godPrestige || 0);
    setHeartLevel(d.heartLevel || 1); setXp(d.xp || 0); setLastDaily(d.lastDaily || ''); setHeartName(d.heartName || 'My Heart');
    if (d.activeBoosts) setActiveBoosts(d.activeBoosts.filter(b => b.expiresAt > Date.now()));
  }, []);

  // Auto-save
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('hub:hpclicker', JSON.stringify({ hp, totalClicks, upgrades, prestige, godPrestige, activeBoosts, heartLevel, xp, lastDaily, heartName }));
  }, [hp, totalClicks, upgrades, prestige, godPrestige, activeBoosts, heartLevel, xp, lastDaily, heartName]);

  // Re-render each second for event timer
  useEffect(() => { const t = setInterval(() => setNow(n => n + 1), 1000); return () => clearInterval(t); }, []);

  // Hue animation
  useEffect(() => { const t = setInterval(() => setHue(h => (h + 1) % 360), 50); return () => clearInterval(t); }, []);

  // Float cleanup
  useEffect(() => { if (floats.length === 0) return; const t = setTimeout(() => setFloats(f => f.slice(1)), 800); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, [floats]);

  // Spawn floating hearts randomly
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      const boost = HEART_BOOSTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * HEART_BOOSTS.length)];
      setFloatingHearts(prev => [...prev, { id: heartId.current++, x: 10 + Math.random() * 80, color: boost.color, emoji: boost.emoji, boostType: boost.type, boostLabel: boost.label }]);
    }, 8000 + Math.random() * 7000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);

  // Remove floating hearts after animation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (floatingHearts.length === 0) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setFloatingHearts(h => h.slice(1)), 5000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [floatingHearts]);

  // Tick active boosts countdown
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      setActiveBoosts(prev => prev.filter(b => b.expiresAt > Date.now()));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);

  const bonuses = useMemo(() => {
    let clickPower = 1, autoHP = 0, multiChance = 0, gemBonus = 0, critChance = 0, hpMult = 1, comboBonus = 0;
    for (const u of ALL_UPGRADES) {
      const lvl = upgrades[u.key] || 0;
      if (lvl === 0) continue;
      const val = lvl * u.perLevel;
      if (u.category === 'Click Power') clickPower += val;
      else if (u.category === 'Auto Clicker') autoHP += val;
      else if (u.category === 'Multi Click') multiChance += val;
      else if (u.category === 'Gem Bonus') gemBonus += val;
      else if (u.category === 'Critical Hit') critChance += val;
      else if (u.category === 'Multiplier') hpMult += val * 0.1;
      else if (u.category === 'Combo') comboBonus += val;
      else clickPower += val;
    }
    // Prestige bonus: +10% per prestige
    hpMult *= (1 + prestige * 0.1);
    // God Prestige bonus: x2 per god prestige
    hpMult *= Math.pow(2, godPrestige);
    // Heart level: +5% per level
    hpMult *= 1 + (heartLevel - 1) * 0.05;
    // Active boosts
    for (const b of activeBoosts) {
      if (b.type === 'click') clickPower = Math.floor(clickPower * 1.5);
      if (b.type === 'auto') autoHP = Math.floor(autoHP * 1.5);
      if (b.type === 'crit') critChance += 25;
      if (b.type === 'mult') hpMult *= 2;
      if (b.type === 'gems') gemBonus += gemBonus;
    }
    return { clickPower, autoHP, multiChance: Math.min(multiChance, 95), gemBonus, critChance: Math.min(critChance, 80), hpMult, comboBonus };
  }, [upgrades, prestige, godPrestige, activeBoosts, heartLevel]);
  const { ev, endsAt } = currentEvent();
  const evMult = ev?.mult ?? 1;

  // Auto HP
  useEffect(() => {
    if (bonuses.autoHP <= 0) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setHp(prev => prev + Math.floor(bonuses.autoHP * bonuses.hpMult * (currentEvent().ev?.mult ?? 1))), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [bonuses.autoHP, bonuses.hpMult]);

  const handleClick = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const rect = containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = rect ? e.clientX - rect.left : 100;
    const y = rect ? e.clientY - rect.top : 100;
    let value = bonuses.clickPower;
    if (Math.random() * 100 < bonuses.multiChance) value *= 2;
    if (Math.random() * 100 < bonuses.critChance) value *= 5;
    value = Math.floor(value * bonuses.hpMult * evMult * (1 + bonuses.comboBonus / 100));
    gainXp(1);
    setHp(prev => prev + value);
    setTotalClicks(prev => prev + 1);
    setFloats(prev => [...prev, { id: floatId.current++, x, y, value }]);
    setScale(0.9);
    setTimeout(() => setScale(1), 100);
    if ((totalClicks + 1) % 100 === 0 && profile) {
      const gemReward = 5 + bonuses.gemBonus;
      addGems(gemReward);
      toast.success(`💎 +${gemReward} gems for 100 clicks!`);
    }
  }, [totalClicks, profile, addGems, bonuses, evMult]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  function gainXp(n: number) {
    setXp(prev => {
      let x = prev + n;
      let lvl = heartLevel;
      while (x >= xpFor(lvl)) { x -= xpFor(lvl); lvl++; }
      if (lvl !== heartLevel) { setHeartLevel(lvl); toast.success(`💗 ${heartName} reached level ${lvl}! (+5% HP)`); }
      return x;
    });
  }

  const today = new Date().toDateString();
  function claimDaily() {
    if (lastDaily === today) return;
    const hpGift = Math.max(500, Math.floor(bonuses.autoHP * bonuses.hpMult * 300));
    setHp(p => p + hpGift); addGems(25 + heartLevel * 2); gainXp(50); setLastDaily(today);
    toast.success(`🎉 Daily reward: +${hpGift.toLocaleString()} HP, +${25 + heartLevel * 2} 💎, +50 XP`);
  }

  function bulkCost(baseCost: number, costMult: number, level: number) {
    const limit = buyAmt === 'max' ? 100 : buyAmt;
    let total = 0, n = 0;
    while (n < limit && level + n < MAX_LEVEL) {
      const c = getCost(baseCost, costMult, level + n);
      if (buyAmt === 'max' && total + c > hp) break;
      total += c; n++;
    }
    return { total: n === 0 ? getCost(baseCost, costMult, level) : total, n: Math.max(n, 1) };
  }

  function buyUpgrade(key: string, baseCost: number, costMult: number) {
    const level = upgrades[key] || 0;
    if (level >= MAX_LEVEL) { toast.error(`Max level (${MAX_LEVEL.toLocaleString()}) reached!`); return; }
    const { total, n } = bulkCost(baseCost, costMult, level);
    if (hp < total) { toast.error(`Need ${formatGems(total)} HP!`); return; }
    setHp(prev => prev - total);
    setUpgrades(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: Math.min((prev[key] || 0) + n, MAX_LEVEL) }));
    gainXp(n * 2);
    toast.success(`⬆️ +${n} level${n > 1 ? 's' : ''}!`);
  }

  function doPrestige() {
    if (hp < 100000) { toast.error('Need 100K HP to prestige!'); return; }
    setHp(0);
    setUpgrades({});
    setTotalClicks(0);
    setPrestige(p => p + 1);
    toast.success(`🔄 Prestige ${prestige + 1}! +10% boost to all HP gains!`);
  }

  function doGodPrestige() {
    if (prestige < 10) { toast.error('Need 10 prestiges for God Prestige!'); return; }
    setHp(0);
    setUpgrades({});
    setTotalClicks(0);
    setPrestige(0);
    setGodPrestige(g => g + 1);
    toast.success(`⚡ GOD PRESTIGE ${godPrestige + 1}! x2 multiplier to EVERYTHING!`);
  }

  function catchHeart(h: FloatingHeart) {
    setFloatingHearts(prev => prev.filter(fh => fh.id !== h.id));
    gainXp(10);
    if (h.boostType === 'comet' || h.boostType === 'supernova') {
      const secs = h.boostType === 'comet' ? 60 : 600;
      const gain = Math.max(100, Math.floor(bonuses.autoHP * bonuses.hpMult * secs));
      setHp(p => p + gain); toast.success(`${h.emoji} +${formatGems(gain)} HP!`); return;
    }
    if (h.boostType === 'void') {
      const per = Math.floor(bonuses.clickPower * bonuses.hpMult * evMult);
      let ticks = 0;
      const t = setInterval(() => { setHp(p => p + per * 15); setTotalClicks(c => c + 15); if (++ticks >= 15) clearInterval(t); }, 1000);
      toast.success(`${h.emoji} Void heart! Auto-clicking 15×/sec for 15s`); return;
    }
    const boost: ActiveBoost = { type: h.boostType, label: h.boostLabel, color: h.color, expiresAt: Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000 };
    setActiveBoosts(prev => {
      const filtered = prev.filter(b => b.type !== h.boostType);
      return [...filtered, boost];
    });
    toast.success(`${h.emoji} ${h.boostLabel} for 10 minutes!`);
  }

  const milestones = [100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, 1000000];
  const nextMilestone = milestones.find(m => m > hp) || hp + 1000000;
  const progress = Math.min(100, (hp / nextMilestone) * 100);
  const totalUpgradeLevels = Object.values(upgrades).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const filteredUpgrades = ALL_UPGRADES.filter(u => u.category === activeCategory);
  const canPrestige = hp >= 100000;
  const canGodPrestige = prestige >= 10;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto px-4 py-6 h-full overflow-y-auto relative">
      {/* Floating Hearts */}
      {floatingHearts.map(h => (
        <button key={h.id} onClick={() => catchHeart(h)}
          className="absolute z-30 text-2xl animate-bounce cursor-pointer hover:scale-150 transition-transform"
          style={{ left: `${h.x}%`, animation: 'floatUp 5s ease-out forwards', filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${h.color})` }}>
          {h.emoji}
        </button>
      ))}

      <div className="text-center mb-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <Heart className="w-7 h-7 text-destructive fill-current" /> HP Clicker
        </h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
          {ALL_UPGRADES.length} upgrades — max level {MAX_LEVEL.toLocaleString()}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* World event banner */}
      {ev && (
        <div className="mx-auto mb-3 w-fit rounded-full border px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold" style={{ color: ev.color, borderColor: ev.color + '66', backgroundColor: ev.color + '18', boxShadow: `0 0 18px ${ev.color}33` }}>
          {ev.name} — everything ×{ev.mult} · {formatTime(endsAt - Date.now())} left
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Heart level + rank + daily */}
      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-3 mb-4 space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <button className="text-sm font-bold hover:text-primary" title="Click to rename" onClick={() => { const n = window.prompt('Name your heart', heartName); if (n?.trim()) setHeartName(n.trim().slice(0, 24)); }}>💗 {heartName} ✏️</button>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary/15 text-primary">{RANKS[Math.min(RANKS.length - 1, Math.floor((heartLevel - 1) / 5))]}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-muted-foreground"><span>LEVEL {heartLevel} · +{(heartLevel - 1) * 5}% HP</span><span>{xp} / {xpFor(heartLevel)} XP</span></div>
        <div className="h-2 bg-secondary rounded-full overflow-hidden"><div className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-400 to-rose-600 transition-all" style={{ width: `${(xp / xpFor(heartLevel)) * 100}%` }} /></div>
        <Button size="sm" className="w-full h-8 text-xs" disabled={lastDaily === today} onClick={claimDaily}>{lastDaily === today ? '✓ Daily reward claimed — come back tomorrow' : '🎁 Claim Daily Reward'}</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-2 mb-4">
        <StatBox icon={<Heart className="w-4 h-4 text-destructive" />} value={hp >= 999999999 ? '∞' : formatGems(hp)} label="HP" />
        <StatBox icon={<Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-400" />} value={totalClicks >= 999999999 ? '∞' : totalClicks.toLocaleString()} label="Clicks" />
        <StatBox icon={<ArrowUp className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />} value={totalUpgradeLevels.toLocaleString()} label="Levels" />
        <StatBox icon={<RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />} value={prestige >= 999999999 ? '∞' : String(prestige)} label="Prestige" />
        <StatBox icon={<Star className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-400" />} value={godPrestige >= 999999999 ? '∞' : String(godPrestige)} label="God P." />
        <StatBox icon={<Gem className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />} value={formatGems(profile?.gems)} label="Gems" />
      </div>

      {/* Active Boosts with countdown */}
      {activeBoosts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 justify-center mb-3">
          {activeBoosts.map(b => (
            <span key={b.type} className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1"
              style={{ backgroundColor: b.color + '20', color: b.color, border: `1px solid ${b.color}40` }}>
              <Timer className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
              {b.label} — {formatTime(b.expiresAt - Date.now())}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Owner Cheats */}
      {isOwner && (
        <div className="bg-card border-2 border-yellow-500/40 rounded-xl p-3 mb-4 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-400" />
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-yellow-400">Owner Cheats</span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8" onClick={() => { setHp(999999999); toast.success('∞ HP!'); }}>∞ HP</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8" onClick={() => { setTotalClicks(999999999); toast.success('∞ Clicks!'); }}>∞ Clicks</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8" onClick={() => { setPrestige(999999999); toast.success('∞ Prestige!'); }}>∞ Prestige</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-400/40" onClick={() => { setGodPrestige(999999999); toast.success('⚡ ∞ God Prestige!'); }}>∞ God P.</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8 text-purple-400 border-purple-400/40" onClick={() => {
              if (!profile) return;
              DB.saveUser({ ...profile, gems: INFINITE_GEMS });
              addGems(0);
              toast.success('♾️ ∞ Gems!');
            }}>∞ 💎</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8" onClick={() => {
              const maxed: UpgradesMap = {};
              ALL_UPGRADES.forEach(u => { maxed[u.key] = MAX_LEVEL; });
              setUpgrades(maxed);
              toast.success(`All maxed to ${MAX_LEVEL.toLocaleString()}!`);
            }}>Max All ⬆️</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8" onClick={() => { setHp(p => p + 1000000); toast.success('+1M HP!'); }}>+1M HP</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-[10px] h-8" onClick={() => { addGems(100000); toast.success('💎 +100K!'); }}>+100K 💎</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Prestige Buttons */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-4">
        <button onClick={doPrestige} disabled={!canPrestige}
          className={`p-3 rounded-xl border-2 text-left transition-all ${canPrestige ? 'border-cyan-500/50 bg-cyan-500/10 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 cursor-pointer' : 'border-border opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed'}`}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RotateCcw className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-cyan-400">Prestige</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Reset for +10% boost</p>
              <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Requires 100K HP</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </button>
        <button onClick={doGodPrestige} disabled={!canGodPrestige}
          className={`p-3 rounded-xl border-2 text-left transition-all ${canGodPrestige ? 'border-yellow-500/50 bg-yellow-500/10 hover:bg-yellow-500/20 cursor-pointer' : 'border-border opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed'}`}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Star className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-400" />
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-yellow-400">God Prestige</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Reset for x2 mult</p>
              <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Requires 10 prestiges</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Progress */}
      <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-2.5 mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] mb-1">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"><Trophy className="w-3 h-3" />Milestone</span>
          <span className="font-bold">{formatGems(hp)} / {formatGems(nextMilestone)}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-2 bg-secondary rounded-full overflow-hidden">
          <div className="h-full bg-destructive rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Active bonuses */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 justify-center mb-3">
        {bonuses.clickPower > 1 && <span className="text-[9px] bg-primary/20 text-primary font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{bonuses.clickPower} HP/click</span>}
        {bonuses.autoHP > 0 && <span className="text-[9px] bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{Math.floor(bonuses.autoHP * bonuses.hpMult)} HP/sec</span>}
        {bonuses.multiChance > 0 && <span className="text-[9px] bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{bonuses.multiChance}% 2x</span>}
        {bonuses.critChance > 0 && <span className="text-[9px] bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{bonuses.critChance}% crit</span>}
        {bonuses.hpMult > 1 && <span className="text-[9px] bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">x{bonuses.hpMult.toFixed(1)}</span>}
        {prestige > 0 && <span className="text-[9px] bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">P{prestige >= 999999999 ? '∞' : prestige}</span>}
        {godPrestige > 0 && <span className="text-[9px] bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">GP{godPrestige >= 999999999 ? '∞' : godPrestige}</span>}
      </div>

      {/* Pixel Heart */}
      <div ref={containerRef} className="relative flex items-center justify-center py-4 select-none cursor-pointer" onClick={handleClick}>
        <div className="transition-transform duration-100" style={{ transform: `scale(${scale})` }}>
          <div className="grid gap-0.5" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(11, 1fr)' }}>
            {PIXEL_HEART.flatMap((row, ry) =>
              row.map((cell, cx) => (
                <div key={`${ry}-${cx}`} className="w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 rounded-sm"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: cell ? `hsl(${(hue + ry * 10 + cx * 5) % 360}, 80%, 55%)` : 'transparent',
                    boxShadow: cell ? `0 0 8px hsl(${(hue + ry * 10) % 360}, 80%, 55%)` : 'none',
                  }} />
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {floats.map(f => (
          <span key={f.id} className="absolute font-black text-lg pointer-events-none animate-float-up"
            style={{ left: f.x, top: f.y, color: f.value >= 50 ? '#ffd700' : '#ff6b6b' }}>
            +{f.value.toLocaleString()}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>

      <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-1">Every 100 clicks = 💎 {5 + bonuses.gemBonus} gems</p>
      <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-4">Catch floating hearts for boosts! ❤️💛💚💙💜🩵🩶🧡</p>

      {/* Upgrades */}
      <Button variant="outline" className="w-full mb-3" onClick={() => setShowUpgrades(!showUpgrades)}>
        {showUpgrades ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />}
        {showUpgrades ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} Upgrades ({ALL_UPGRADES.length} × {MAX_LEVEL.toLocaleString()})
      </Button>

      {showUpgrades && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
            {CATEGORIES.map(cat => {
              const catUps = ALL_UPGRADES.filter(u => u.category === cat);
              const catLevels = catUps.reduce((s, u) => s + (upgrades[u.key] || 0), 0);
              return (
                <button key={cat} onClick={() => setActiveCategory(cat)}
                  className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border transition-colors ${activeCategory === cat ? 'border-primary bg-primary/20 text-primary' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-secondary'}`}>
                  {cat} {catLevels > 0 && <span className="text-[8px] opacity-70">({catLevels})</span>}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Buy:</span>
            {([1, 10, 'max'] as const).map(a => (
              <button key={a} onClick={() => setBuyAmt(a)} className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${buyAmt === a ? 'border-primary bg-primary/20 text-primary' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground'}`}>{a === 'max' ? 'Max' : `×${a}`}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {filteredUpgrades.map(u => {
              const level = upgrades[u.key] || 0;
              const maxed = level >= MAX_LEVEL;
              const bc = maxed ? { total: 0, n: 0 } : bulkCost(u.baseCost, u.costMult, level);
              const cost = bc.total;
              return (
                <button key={u.key} onClick={() => !maxed && buyUpgrade(u.key, u.baseCost, u.costMult)}
                  disabled={maxed || hp < cost}
                  className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-2.5 text-left hover:bg-secondary/50 transition-colors disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-0.5">
                    <span className="text-sm">{u.icon}</span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold truncate">{u.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary mt-0.5">{u.format(level, u.perLevel)}</p>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Lv.{formatGems(level)} / {formatGems(MAX_LEVEL)}</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-destructive">{maxed ? 'MAXED' : `${bc.n > 1 ? `×${bc.n} ` : ''}♥${formatGems(cost)}`}</span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Heart float-up animation */}
      <style>{`
        @keyframes floatUp {
          0% { transform: translateY(100vh) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
          70% { opacity: 1; }
          100% { transform: translateY(-20vh) scale(1.3); opacity: 0; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatBox({ icon, value, label }: { icon: React.ReactNode; value: string; label: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-card border border-border rounded-xl p-2 text-center">
      <div className="mx-auto mb-0.5 flex justify-center">{icon}</div>
      <p className="text-xs font-black truncate">{value}</p>
      <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/pages/IdeasPage.tsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Lightbulb, Loader2, Sparkles, Copy, Repeat, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { ideas as ideasApi, IdeasOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import { useAuth } from 'zitejs/auth';
import { isOwnerEmail } from '../lib/gameData';

const FOCUS = ['Games', 'Chat features', 'Making money with gems', 'Staff tools', 'Customization', 'Events'];
const SECTIONS = ['Chat', 'DMs & Groups', 'Shop', 'Limited Shop', 'Casino', 'HP Clicker', 'Art', 'Video Rooms', 'Theater', 'Marketplace', 'Tournaments', 'VIP', 'Profile', 'Leaderboard', 'Staff Tools', 'Browser', 'Calendar'];

type Kind = 'features' | 'site' | 'roles' | 'events' | 'tabs' | 'future' | 'titles' | 'typing';
const KINDS: [Kind, string][] = [['features', '✨ Features'], ['site', '🧭 Every part of the site'], ['roles', '🛡️ New roles'], ['tabs', '🗂️ New tabs'], ['future', '🚀 Future roadmap'], ['events', '🎃 Theme events'], ['titles', '🏷️ Titles'], ['typing', '⌨️ Typing effects']];
type Idea = IdeasOutputType['ideas'][0] & { repeat?: boolean };

const HIST = 'nexus_idea_history';
const norm = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g, '').trim();
const loadHist = (): string[] => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(HIST) || '[]'); } catch { return []; } };
const saveHist = (h: string[]) => localStorage.setItem(HIST, JSON.stringify(h.slice(-300)));
const ACTION_STYLE: Record<string, string> = { Add: 'bg-green-500/15 text-green-500', Change: 'bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-500', Delete: 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-500' };

export default function IdeasPage() {
  const { user: ideasUser } = useAuth();
  if (!isOwnerEmail(ideasUser?.email)) return null;
  return <IdeasPageInner />;
}

function IdeasPageInner() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const isOwner = isOwnerEmail(user?.email?.toLowerCase());
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<Kind>('features');
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [list, setList] = useState<Idea[]>([]);
  const [histCount, setHistCount] = useState(() => loadHist().length);

  const generate = async (f = focus, k = kind) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const hist = loadHist();
      const seen = new Set(hist.map(norm));
      const res = (await ideasApi({ focus: f || undefined, kind: k, avoid: hist.slice(-150) })).ideas;
      setList(res.map(i => ({ ...i, repeat: seen.has(norm(i.title)) })));
      const next = [...hist, ...res.filter(i => !seen.has(norm(i.title))).map(i => i.title)];
      saveHist(next); setHistCount(next.length);
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as { userFacingMessage?: string }).userFacingMessage || 'Could not get ideas — try again'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  const toggleRepeat = (idx: number) => setList(l => l.map((i, n) => n === idx ? { ...i, repeat: !i.repeat } : i));
  const clearHist = () => { saveHist([]); setHistCount(0); toast.success('Idea memory cleared'); };

  return (
    <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6">
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black flex items-center gap-2"><Lightbulb className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-400" />AI Idea Generator</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Fresh ideas every time — it remembers {histCount} past idea{histCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} and won't repeat them.</p>
          </div>
          {histCount > 0 && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={clearHist}><Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />Reset memory</Button>}
        </div>
        {isOwner && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 p-1 bg-secondary rounded-lg w-fit">
            {KINDS.map(([k, label]) => (
              <button key={k} disabled={loading} onClick={() => { setKind(k); generate(focus, k); }}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold transition ${kind === k ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}>{label}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Input placeholder={kind === 'site' ? "Optional part, e.g. 'Shop'" : "Optional focus, e.g. 'something for Halloween'"} value={focus} onChange={e => setFocus(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && generate()} />
          <Button onClick={() => generate()} disabled={loading}>{loading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <><Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Generate</>}</Button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {(kind === 'site' ? SECTIONS : FOCUS).map(f => <Button key={f} size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={loading} onClick={() => { setFocus(f); generate(f); }}>{f}</Button>)}
        </div>
        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {loading && Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-32 rounded-xl" />)}
          {!loading && list.map((i, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className={`bg-card border rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2 ${i.repeat ? 'border-orange-500/60 opacity-75' : 'border-border'}`}>
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <span className="text-2xl">{i.emoji}</span>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="font-bold text-sm">{i.title}</p>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
                    <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-secondary text-muted-foreground">{i.section}</span>
                    <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold ${ACTION_STYLE[i.action] || 'bg-secondary'}`}>{i.action}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-secondary text-muted-foreground">{i.effort}</span>
                    {i.repeat && <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-500 font-semibold">Repeat</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button title={i.repeat ? 'Unmark repeat' : 'Mark as repeated'} onClick={() => toggleRepeat(idx)} className={i.repeat ? 'text-orange-500' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}><Repeat className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
                <button onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${i.title}: ${i.description}`); toast.success('Copied'); }} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><Copy className="w-4 h-4" /></button>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{i.description}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
          {!loading && list.length === 0 && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground col-span-full text-center py-10">Hit Generate to get 6 ideas.</p>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
