===== FILE: src/pages/MarketplacePage.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Search, Store } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from 'zitejs/auth';
import { listings, ListingsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@project/components/ui/tabs';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import ListingCard from '../components/market/ListingCard';
import MyListings from '../components/market/MyListings';
import OrdersTable from '../components/market/OrdersTable';
import { errMsg, usePermissions } from '../hooks/usePermissions';

type Listing = ListingsOutputType['listings'][number];
type Order = ListingsOutputType['orders'][number];

export default function MarketplacePage() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { has, marketRole, restriction } = usePermissions();
  const [all, setAll] = useState<Listing[] | null>(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [sales, setSales] = useState<Order[]>([]);
  const [purchases, setPurchases] = useState<Order[]>([]);

  const loadBrowse = () => listings({ action: 'browse' }).then(r => setAll(r.listings)).catch(e => toast.error(errMsg(e)));
  const loadOrders = () => {
    listings({ action: 'myPurchases' }).then(r => setPurchases(r.orders)).catch(() => {});
    listings({ action: 'sellerOrders' }).then(r => setSales(r.orders)).catch(() => {});
  };
  useEffect(() => { loadBrowse(); loadOrders(); }, []);

  const shown = useMemo(() => (all ?? []).filter(l => `${l.title} ${l.description}`.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())), [all, q]);
  const canSell = has('listings.sell');
  const patch = (setter: typeof setSales) => (o: Order) => setter(list => list.map(x => (x.id === o.id ? o : x)));

  return (
    <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center"><Store className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" /></div>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Marketplace</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">You're a {marketRole}{restriction !== 'None' && ` · ${restriction}`}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Tabs defaultValue="browse">
        <TabsList className="flex-wrap h-auto">
          <TabsTrigger value="browse">Browse</TabsTrigger>
          {canSell && <TabsTrigger value="sell">My listings</TabsTrigger>}
          {canSell && <TabsTrigger value="sales">Orders to fill</TabsTrigger>}
          <TabsTrigger value="purchases">My purchases</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="browse" className="space-y-4">
          <div className="relative max-w-sm"><Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" /><Input className="pl-9" placeholder="Search listings" value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} /></div>
          {!all ? <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">{[0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-64" />)}</div>
            : !shown.length ? <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-10 text-center">No listings found.</p>
            : <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">{shown.map(l => <ListingCard key={l.id} l={l} myEmail={user?.email ?? ''} onBought={() => { loadBrowse(); loadOrders(); }} />)}</div>}
          {!canSell && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Want to sell? Ask an Admin to give you the Seller role.</p>}
        </TabsContent>
        {canSell && <TabsContent value="sell"><MyListings /></TabsContent>}
        {canSell && <TabsContent value="sales"><OrdersTable orders={sales} editable onChange={patch(setSales)} /></TabsContent>}
        <TabsContent value="purchases"><OrdersTable orders={purchases} editable={false} showBuyer={false} onChange={patch(setPurchases)} /></TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/pages/TournamentPage.tsx =====

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Trophy, Plus, Clock, Crown, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
import { tournaments, TournamentsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import { ReactionGame, ClickFrenzyGame, SpeedTypingGame } from '../components/tournament/MiniGames';
import CreateTournament from '../components/tournament/CreateTournament';
import DailyQuiz from '../components/tournament/DailyQuiz';

type T = TournamentsOutputType['tournaments'][0];
const STAFF = ['owner', 'co-owner', 'admin', 'senior-mod', 'mod'];
const ICON: Record<string, string> = { Reaction: '⚡', 'Click Frenzy': '👆', 'Speed Typing': '⌨️' };

function Board({ t, me }: { t: T; me: string }) {
  if (!t.leaderboard.length) return <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No scores yet — be the first!</p>;
  return (
    <ol className="space-y-1">
      {t.leaderboard.map((r, i) => (
        <li key={r.email} className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm px-2 py-1 rounded ${r.email === me ? 'bg-primary/10' : ''}`}>
          <span className="w-5 text-center font-bold">{i === 0 ? '🥇' : i === 1 ? '🥈' : i === 2 ? '🥉' : i + 1}</span>
          <span className="flex-1 truncate">{r.name}</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{r.attempts} tries</span>
          <span className="font-mono font-semibold">{r.score}</span>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

export default function TournamentPage() {
  const { profile, isRealOwner, addGems } = useApp();
  const me = (profile?.email || '').toLowerCase();
  const isStaff = isRealOwner || STAFF.includes(profile?.role || '');
  const [list, setList] = useState<T[] | null>(null);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(() => tournaments({ action: 'list' }).then(r => setList(r.tournaments)).catch(() => setList([])), []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); const i = setInterval(load, 15000); return () => clearInterval(i); }, [load]);

  const current = list?.find(t => t.id === active);

  const finish = useCallback(async (score: number) => {
    if (!active) return;
    toast.success(`Score: ${score}`);
    try { await tournaments({ action: 'submit', tournamentId: active, score, playerName: profile?.name }); load(); }
    catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not submit'); }
  }, [active, profile?.name, load]);

  async function claim(t: T) {
    try {
      const r = await tournaments({ action: 'claim', tournamentId: t.id });
      addGems(r.prize);
      toast.success(`You won ${r.prize} gems! 🏆`);
      load();
    } catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not claim'); }
  }

  async function remove(t: T) {
    try { await tournaments({ action: 'delete', tournamentId: t.id }); if (active === t.id) setActive(null); load(); }
    catch (e) { toast.error((e as Error).message || 'Could not delete'); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto p-4 md:p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black flex items-center gap-2"><Trophy className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" /> Mini-Game Tournaments</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Play as many times as you like — your best score counts. Top player wins the gems.</p>
        </div>
        {isStaff && <Button onClick={() => setCreating(true)} className="gap-1.5"><Plus className="w-4 h-4" />New</Button>}
      </div>

      <DailyQuiz />

      {current && !current.ended && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-primary/40 bg-card p-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="font-bold">{ICON[current.game]} {current.title}</p>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setActive(null)}>Close</Button>
          </div>
          {current.game === 'Reaction' && <ReactionGame onFinish={finish} />}
          {current.game === 'Click Frenzy' && <ClickFrenzyGame onFinish={finish} />}
          {current.game === 'Speed Typing' && <SpeedTypingGame onFinish={finish} />}
        </div>
      )}

      {!list ? <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">{[0, 1].map(i => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-56 rounded-2xl" />)}</div>
        : !list.length ? (
          <div className="text-center py-16 text-muted-foreground border border-dashed border-border rounded-2xl">
            <Trophy className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
            No tournaments yet.{isStaff ? ' Start one with the New button.' : ' Check back soon!'}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {list.map(t => {
              const winner = t.leaderboard[0];
              return (
                <div key={t.id} className={`rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 space-y-3 ${t.ended ? 'opacity-80' : ''}`}>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="font-bold truncate">{ICON[t.game]} {t.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"><Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {t.ended ? 'Ended' : `Ends ${formatDistanceToNow(new Date(t.endsAt), { addSuffix: true })}`} · 💎 {t.prizeGems}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    {isStaff && <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => remove(t)}><Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>}
                  </div>
                  <Board t={t} me={me} />
                  {!t.ended && <Button size="sm" className="w-full" onClick={() => setActive(t.id)}>Play</Button>}
                  {t.ended && winner && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" /> Winner: <b>{winner.name}</b>
                      {winner.email === me && !t.prizePaid && <Button size="sm" className="ml-auto" onClick={() => claim(t)}>Claim prize</Button>}
                      {t.prizePaid && <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">Prize claimed</span>}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}

      <CreateTournament open={creating} onOpenChange={setCreating} onCreated={load} />
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/pages/VideoRoomsPage.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Video, Plus, LogIn, Loader2, Copy, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { videoRooms, VideoRoomsOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@project/components/ui/label';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@project/components/ui/alert';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import PreJoin from '../components/video/PreJoin';
import InRoom, { copyInvite } from '../components/video/InRoom';

type Stage = 'home' | 'prejoin' | 'room';
type Ice = VideoRoomsOutputType['iceServers'];
const errMsg = (e: unknown) => (e as { userFacingMessage?: string })?.userFacingMessage || (e as Error)?.message || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
const NAME_KEY = 'nexus.video.name';

export default function VideoRoomsPage() {
  const { code: linkCode } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [name, setName] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(NAME_KEY) || '');
  const [codeInput, setCodeInput] = useState(linkCode?.toUpperCase() || '');
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>('home');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [ice, setIce] = useState<Ice>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<'create' | 'join' | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [justCreated, setJustCreated] = useState(false);
  const [media, setMedia] = useState<{ stream: MediaStream; mic: boolean; cam: boolean } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { if (!name && profile?.name) setName(profile.name); }, [profile?.name]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const cleanName = name.trim().slice(0, 40);

  async function go(kind: 'create' | 'join') {
    if (!cleanName) { setError('Please enter your display name first.'); return; }
    const c = codeInput.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
    if (kind === 'join' && !c) { setError('Enter the room code you were given.'); return; }
    setBusy(kind); setError(null);
    try {
      const r = await videoRooms(kind === 'create' ? { action: 'create', displayName: cleanName } : { action: 'check', code: c });
      localStorage.setItem(NAME_KEY, cleanName);
      setCode(r.code); setIce(r.iceServers); setJustCreated(kind === 'create'); setStage('prejoin');
      navigate(`/video/${r.code}`, { replace: true });
    } catch (e) { setError(errMsg(e)); }
    finally { setBusy(null); }
  }

  function leave(reason?: string) {
    setMedia(null); setStage('home'); setCode(''); setCodeInput('');
    navigate('/video', { replace: true });
    if (reason) setError(reason);
  }

  if (stage === 'room' && media) {
    return <InRoom code={code} name={cleanName} stream={media.stream} initialMic={media.mic} initialCam={media.cam} iceServers={ice} onLeave={leave} />;
  }

  if (stage === 'prejoin') {
    return (
      <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto">
        {justCreated && (
          <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 pt-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/10 p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-[12rem]"><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Your room code</p><p className="text-3xl font-mono font-black tracking-[0.3em]">{code}</p></div>
              <Button size="lg" onClick={() => copyInvite(code)}><Copy className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />Copy invite link</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <PreJoin code={code} name={cleanName} joining={false} onBack={() => leave()}
          onJoin={(stream, mic, cam) => { setMedia({ stream, mic, cam }); setStage('room'); }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md space-y-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center"><Video className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" /></div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">Video Rooms</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Start a call or join one with a code.</p>
        </div>
        {error && <Alert variant="destructive"><AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" /><AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription></Alert>}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="vname" className="text-base">Display name</Label>
          <Input id="vname" className="h-12 text-base" value={name} maxLength={40} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="How others will see you" />
        </div>
        <Button size="lg" className="w-full h-14 text-base" disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => go('create')}>
          {busy === 'create' ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : <><Plus className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />Create room</>}
        </Button>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><div className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" />or join<div className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" /></div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Input className="h-14 text-lg font-mono tracking-widest uppercase" value={codeInput} maxLength={8} aria-label="Room code"
            onChange={e => setCodeInput(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && go('join')} placeholder="ROOM CODE" />
          <Button size="lg" variant="secondary" className="h-14 px-5" disabled={!!busy} onClick={() => go('join')}>
            {busy === 'join' ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : <><LogIn className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />Join</>}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-center text-muted-foreground">Rooms expire after 24 hours. We’ll ask for camera & mic access right before you join.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: src/pages/WatchPartyPage.tsx =====

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Clapperboard, Plus, Users, CalendarClock, Search, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@project/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@project/components/ui/input';
import { DateTimePicker } from '@project/components/ui/date-picker';
import { Skeleton } from '@project/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@project/components/ui/select';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { watchParty, WatchPartyOutputType } from 'zitejs/api';
import { useApp } from '../contexts/AppContext';
import PartyRoom from '../components/watch/PartyRoom';
import { PLATFORMS, platformOf } from '../lib/theater';

type Party = WatchPartyOutputType['parties'][0];
const fmt = (d: string) => format(new Date(d), 'EEE MMM d, h:mm a');
const isLive = (p: Party) => new Date(p.scheduledFor).getTime() <= Date.now() + 60_000;

function CreateMovie({ onCreated }: { onCreated: (id: string) => void }) {
  const { profile } = useApp();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [start, setStart] = useState<Date | undefined>();
  const [end, setEnd] = useState<Date | undefined>();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const badEnd = !!end && end <= (start ?? new Date());
  const valid = title.trim() && /^https?:\/\//.test(url.trim()) && !badEnd;
  async function create() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await watchParty({ action: 'create', title, videoUrl: url, scheduledFor: start?.toISOString(), endsAt: end?.toISOString(), name: profile?.name });
      toast.success(start ? 'Movie scheduled!' : 'Movie started!');
      onCreated(r.parties[0].id);
    } catch (e) { toast.error(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Could not start the movie'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
      <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold"><Plus className="h-4 w-4" />Start a movie</p>
      <Input value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="Movie title" maxLength={100} />
      <Input value={url} onChange={e => setUrl(e.target.value)} placeholder="Link: YouTube, Netflix, Plex, Disney+, video file…" />
      {url && /^https?:\/\//.test(url) && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Detected: <b>{platformOf(url)}</b></p>}
      <label className="block text-xs font-medium">Start time <span className="text-muted-foreground">(empty = now)</span></label>
      <DateTimePicker value={start} onChange={setStart} />
      <label className="block text-xs font-medium">End time <span className="text-muted-foreground">(optional)</span></label>
      <DateTimePicker value={end} onChange={setEnd} />
      {badEnd && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">End time must be after the start time.</p>}
      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">YouTube and video files stay synced. Netflix, Plex and other services open in each viewer's own account.</p>
      <Button className="w-full" disabled={!valid || busy} onClick={create}>{start ? 'Schedule movie' : 'Start now'}</Button>
    </div>
  );
}

function MovieCard({ p, onJoin }: { p: Party; onJoin: () => void }) {
  const live = isLive(p);
  return (
    <button onClick={onJoin} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 text-left transition hover:border-primary">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/15 text-primary"><Clapperboard className="h-5 w-5" /></div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate font-semibold">{p.title}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{platformOf(p.videoUrl)} · Hosted by {p.hostName}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><CalendarClock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{fmt(p.scheduledFor)}{p.endsAt && ` – ${format(new Date(p.endsAt), 'h:mm a')}`}</p>
          {live && <p className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><Users className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{p.viewers.length ? p.viewers.map(v => v.name).join(', ') : 'Nobody watching yet'}</p>}
        </div>
        <span className={live ? 'rounded-full bg-destructive px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-destructive-foreground' : 'rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold'}>{live ? 'NOW PLAYING' : 'UPCOMING'}</span>
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

export default function WatchPartyPage() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const [parties, setParties] = useState<Party[] | null>(null);
  const [canStart, setCanStart] = useState(false);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('all');
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState('all');
  useEffect(() => { watchParty({ action: 'access' }).then(r => setCanStart(!!r.canStart)).catch(() => {}); }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) return;
    const load = () => watchParty({ action: 'list' }).then(r => setParties(r.parties)).catch(() => setParties([]));
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 8000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [id]);
  const shown = useMemo(() => (parties || []).filter(p =>
    (!q.trim() || `${p.title} ${p.hostName}`.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))
    && (status === 'all' || (status === 'live') === isLive(p))
    && (platform === 'all' || platformOf(p.videoUrl) === platform)), [parties, q, status, platform]);
  if (id) return <PartyRoom id={id} onLeave={() => nav('/watch')} />;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-5xl gap-4 p-4 md:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]">
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div><h1 className="text-xl font-bold">🎭 Theater</h1><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Watch movies together, chat and react in real time.</p></div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="relative min-w-[160px] flex-1">
            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search movies or hosts" className="h-9 pl-8" aria-label="Search theaters" />
          </div>
          <Select value={status} onValueChange={setStatus}>
            <SelectTrigger className="h-9 w-[140px]" aria-label="Filter by status"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent><SelectItem value="all">All showtimes</SelectItem><SelectItem value="live">Now playing</SelectItem><SelectItem value="upcoming">Upcoming</SelectItem></SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Select value={platform} onValueChange={setPlatform}>
            <SelectTrigger className="h-9 w-[140px]" aria-label="Filter by service"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent><SelectItem value="all">All services</SelectItem>{PLATFORMS.map(p => <SelectItem key={p} value={p}>{p}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
        {parties === null ? [0, 1, 2].map(i => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-20 w-full rounded-xl" />)
          : shown.length === 0 ? <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{parties.length ? 'No movies match your filters.' : 'No movies playing right now — check back soon!'}</p>
          : shown.map(p => <MovieCard key={p.id} p={p} onJoin={() => nav(`/watch/${p.id}`)} />)}
      </div>
      {canStart ? <CreateMovie onCreated={pid => nav(`/watch/${pid}`)} /> : (
        <div className="h-fit space-y-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 text-sm">
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold"><Lock className="h-4 w-4" />Movies are started by staff</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Pick a movie that's playing to join. Only the owner and roles they allow can start new ones.</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: tests/browserNav.test.ts =====

// Run: npx tsx --test tests/browserNav.test.ts
import { describe, it } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
const expect = (a: unknown) => ({ toBe: (b: unknown) => assert.equal(a, b), toEqual: (b: unknown) => assert.deepEqual(a, b), toMatch: (r: RegExp) => assert.match(String(a), r) });
import { HOME, classifyInput, searchEntry, queryOf, isSafeUrl, push, step, canBack, canForward, closeTab, cycleTab, errorMessage, NavTab } from '../src/lib/browserNav';

const tab = (id: number, history = [HOME], idx = 0): NavTab => ({ id, history, idx });

describe('search vs URL', () => {
  it('treats URLs as URLs', () => {
    expect(classifyInput('https://example.com')).toBe('https://example.com');
    expect(classifyInput('example.com/path')).toBe('https://example.com/path');
    expect(classifyInput('localhost:3000')).toBe('http://localhost:3000');
  });
  it('treats everything else as a search', () => {
    expect(classifyInput('how do volcanoes work')).toBe(searchEntry('how do volcanoes work'));
    expect(classifyInput('node.js tutorial')).toBe(searchEntry('node.js tutorial'));
    expect(queryOf(classifyInput('cats & dogs'))).toBe('cats & dogs');
  });
  it('empty input goes home', () => expect(classifyInput('   ')).toBe(HOME));
});

describe('security', () => {
  it('only allows http(s)', () => {
    expect(isSafeUrl('https://a.com')).toBe(true);
    expect(isSafeUrl('javascript:alert(1)')).toBe(false);
    expect(isSafeUrl('data:text/html,hi')).toBe(false);
    expect(isSafeUrl('file:///etc/passwd')).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('navigation', () => {
  it('push, back, forward', () => {
    let t = push(push(tab(1), 'https://a.com'), 'https://b.com');
    expect(t.history).toEqual([HOME, 'https://a.com', 'https://b.com']);
    t = step(t, -1);
    expect(canForward(t)).toBe(true);
    t = push(t, 'https://c.com');
    expect(t.history).toEqual([HOME, 'https://a.com', 'https://c.com']);
    expect(canForward(t)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('step stays in bounds', () => {
    const t = tab(1);
    expect(step(t, -1)).toBe(t);
    expect(step(t, 1)).toBe(t);
    expect(canBack(t)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('does not duplicate same entry', () => {
    const t = push(tab(1), 'https://a.com');
    expect(push(t, 'https://a.com').history.length).toBe(2);
  });
});

describe('tabs', () => {
  const make = () => tab(99);
  it('closing active picks a neighbour', () => {
    const r = closeTab([tab(1), tab(2), tab(3)], 2, 2, make);
    expect(r.tabs.map(t => t.id)).toEqual([1, 3]);
    expect(r.activeId).toBe(3);
  });
  it('closing last active tab picks previous', () => {
    expect(closeTab([tab(1), tab(2)], 2, 2, make).activeId).toBe(1);
  });
  it('closing inactive keeps active', () => {
    expect(closeTab([tab(1), tab(2)], 1, 2, make).activeId).toBe(2);
  });
  it('never leaves zero tabs', () => {
    const r = closeTab([tab(1)], 1, 1, make);
    expect(r.tabs.map(t => t.id)).toEqual([99]);
    expect(r.activeId).toBe(99);
  });
  it('cycles with wrap-around', () => {
    const ts = [tab(1), tab(2), tab(3)];
    expect(cycleTab(ts, 3, 1)).toBe(1);
    expect(cycleTab(ts, 1, -1)).toBe(3);
  });
});

describe('errors', () => {
  it('has friendly messages and a fallback', () => {
    expect(errorMessage('OFFLINE')).toMatch(/offline/i);
    expect(errorMessage('WHATEVER')).toMatch(/something went wrong/i);
  });
});

// Run: npx tsx tests/formatGems.test.ts
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { formatGems, INFINITE_GEMS, isInfiniteGems } from '../src/lib/formatGems';

const eq = (v: unknown, want: string, mode?: 'game' | 'si') =>
  assert.equal(formatGems(v as number, mode), want, `formatGems(${String(v)}, ${mode ?? 'game'})`);

// Infinity — must never look like a finite suffix
eq(Infinity, '∞');
eq(-Infinity, '−∞');
eq(INFINITE_GEMS, '∞');
eq(-INFINITE_GEMS, '−∞');
eq('Infinity', '∞');
eq(Infinity, '∞', 'si');
eq(-Infinity, '−∞', 'si');
for (const v of [Infinity, INFINITE_GEMS]) {
  assert.notEqual(formatGems(v), '1b');
  assert.ok(!/[0-9]/.test(formatGems(v)), 'infinity must have no digits');
}
assert.ok(isInfiniteGems(Infinity) && isInfiniteGems(-Infinity) && isInfiniteGems(INFINITE_GEMS));
assert.ok(!isInfiniteGems(999_999_999) && !isInfiniteGems(1e300));
// The old "infinite" grant value is a real number, so it is NOT infinity
eq(999_999_999, '999m');

// Zero, small, invalid
eq(0, '0'); eq(-0, '0'); eq(7, '7'); eq(999, '999'); eq(12.9, '12');
eq(NaN, '0'); eq(undefined, '0'); eq(null, '0'); eq('', '0'); eq('abc', '0');

// Game-style boundaries
eq(1_000, '1k');
eq(999_999, '999k');
eq(1_000_000, '1m');
eq(1_000_000_000, '1b');
eq(1e12, '1t');
eq(1e15, '1q');
eq(1e18, '1Qn');
eq(1_500, '1.5k'); eq(12_340, '12.3k'); eq(123_456, '123k'); eq(2_500_000, '2.5m');

// SI boundaries — official symbols & capitalization
const si: [number, string][] = [[1e3, '1k'], [1e6, '1M'], [1e9, '1G'], [1e12, '1T'], [1e15, '1P'],
  [1e18, '1E'], [1e21, '1Z'], [1e24, '1Y'], [1e27, '1R'], [1e30, '1Q']];
for (const [v, want] of si) eq(v, want, 'si');
eq(1_500_000, '1.5M', 'si');

// Negatives use a real minus sign
eq(-1_000, '−1k'); eq(-2_500_000, '−2.5m'); eq(-5, '−5'); eq(-1e9, '−1G', 'si');

// Very large finite values fall back to scientific notation, never ∞
eq(1e40, '1e40'); eq(1e300, '1e300'); eq(1e33, '1e33', 'si');

console.log('formatGems: all tests passed');


===== FILE: tests/messageOrder.test.ts =====

// Run with: npx tsx apps/nexus-chat-1/tests/messageOrder.test.ts
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mergeMessages } from '../src/lib/messageOrder';

type M = { id: string; timestamp: number; sender: string };
const msg = (id: string, timestamp: number, sender: string): M => ({ id, timestamp, sender });
const ids = (list: M[]) => list.map(m => m.id);

// 1. Initial load from server keeps chronological order across users.
let screen = mergeMessages<M>([], [msg('a1', 1000, 'alice'), msg('b1', 2000, 'bob')], []);
assert.deepEqual(ids(screen), ['a1', 'b1']);

// 2. Alice sends a message: it shows at the end while still saving.
const pending = msg('a2', 3000, 'alice');
screen = mergeMessages(screen, [msg('a1', 1000, 'alice'), msg('b1', 2000, 'bob')], [pending]);
assert.deepEqual(ids(screen), ['a1', 'b1', 'a2']);

// 3. Bob's reply arrives while Alice's message is still saving: Bob's is appended after
//    the saved messages, and Alice's unsaved message stays last until it's saved.
screen = mergeMessages(screen, [msg('a1', 1000, 'alice'), msg('b1', 2000, 'bob'), msg('b2', 3500, 'bob')], [pending]);
assert.deepEqual(ids(screen), ['a1', 'b1', 'b2', 'a2']);

// 4. Once Alice's message is saved, nothing moves (no jumping around).
screen = mergeMessages(screen, [msg('a1', 1000, 'alice'), msg('b1', 2000, 'bob'), msg('a2', 3100, 'alice'), msg('b2', 3500, 'bob')], []);
assert.deepEqual(ids(screen), ['a1', 'b1', 'b2', 'a2']);

// 5. A message whose clock is "in the past" (sender's device skew) is still added to the end,
//    never inserted beneath an older message.
screen = mergeMessages(screen, [msg('a1', 1000, 'alice'), msg('c1', 1500, 'carol'), msg('b1', 2000, 'bob'), msg('a2', 3100, 'alice'), msg('b2', 3500, 'bob')], []);
assert.deepEqual(ids(screen), ['a1', 'b1', 'b2', 'a2', 'c1']);

// 6. Several new messages from different users in one poll are appended in server order.
screen = mergeMessages([], [msg('x', 10, 'bob'), msg('y', 20, 'alice'), msg('z', 20, 'carol')], []);
assert.deepEqual(ids(screen), ['x', 'y', 'z']);

// 7. Deleted messages disappear without reordering the rest.
screen = mergeMessages(screen, [msg('x', 10, 'bob'), msg('z', 20, 'carol')], []);
assert.deepEqual(ids(screen), ['x', 'z']);

console.log('✅ messageOrder: all tests passed');


===== FILE: tests/permissions.test.ts =====

// Run: npx tsx tests/permissions.test.ts
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  Actor, can, checkAssignRole, checkIpBan, checkRestrict, isBanActive, maskIp, isValidIp, canEditListing, OWNER_EMAIL,
} from '../src/lib/permissions';

const mk = (email: string, marketRole = 'Customer', chatRole = 'user', restriction = 'None'): Actor => ({ email, marketRole, chatRole, restriction });
const owner = mk(OWNER_EMAIL);
const admin = mk('admin@x.com', 'Admin');
const admin2 = mk('admin2@x.com', 'Admin');
const mod = mk('mod@x.com', 'Moderator');
const seller = mk('seller@x.com', 'Seller');
const customer = mk('cust@x.com');
let passed = 0;
const t = (name: string, fn: () => void) => { fn(); passed++; console.log('✓', name); };

// ── Roles & permissions ──
t('customers cannot open the dashboard or sell', () => {
  assert.equal(can(customer, 'dashboard.view'), false);
  assert.equal(can(customer, 'listings.sell'), false);
  assert.equal(can(customer, 'market.buy'), true);
});
t('moderators review but cannot ban IPs or assign roles', () => {
  assert.equal(can(mod, 'reports.review'), true);
  assert.equal(can(mod, 'ip.ban'), false);
  assert.equal(can(mod, 'ip.viewFull'), false);
  assert.equal(can(mod, 'roles.assign'), false);
});
t('existing chat staff roles map onto dashboard levels', () => {
  assert.equal(can(mk('a@x.com', 'Customer', 'admin'), 'ip.ban'), true);
  assert.equal(can(mk('m@x.com', 'Customer', 'mod'), 'reports.review'), true);
  assert.equal(can(mk('v@x.com', 'Customer', 'vip'), 'dashboard.view'), false);
});
t('suspended staff lose all staff powers; selling-disabled sellers cannot sell', () => {
  assert.equal(can(mk('a@x.com', 'Admin', 'user', 'Suspended'), 'ip.ban'), false);
  assert.equal(can(mk('s@x.com', 'Seller', 'user', 'Selling Disabled'), 'listings.sell'), false);
});

// ── Privilege escalation ──
t('cannot change own role', () => assert.ok(checkAssignRole(admin, admin, 'Customer')));
t('admin cannot create another admin or touch a peer admin', () => {
  assert.ok(checkAssignRole(admin, customer, 'Admin'));
  assert.ok(checkAssignRole(admin, admin2, 'Customer'));
});
t('admin can promote a customer to moderator', () => assert.equal(checkAssignRole(admin, customer, 'Moderator'), null));
t('only owner can create admins; owner role is untouchable', () => {
  assert.equal(checkAssignRole(owner, customer, 'Admin'), null);
  assert.ok(checkAssignRole(admin, owner, 'Customer'));
});
t('moderators and sellers cannot assign roles at all', () => {
  assert.ok(checkAssignRole(mod, customer, 'Seller'));
  assert.ok(checkAssignRole(seller, customer, 'Seller'));
});
t('restrictions only apply downward', () => {
  assert.equal(checkRestrict(mod, seller), null);
  assert.ok(checkRestrict(mod, admin));
  assert.ok(checkRestrict(mod, mod));
  assert.ok(checkRestrict(customer, seller));
});

// ── Listings ──
t('sellers edit only their own listings; moderators can edit any', () => {
  assert.equal(canEditListing(seller, 'seller@x.com'), true);
  assert.equal(canEditListing(seller, 'other@x.com'), false);
  assert.equal(canEditListing(mod, 'other@x.com'), true);
  assert.equal(canEditListing(customer, 'cust@x.com'), false);
});

// ── IP bans ──
t('only admins can ban IPs', () => {
  assert.ok(checkIpBan(mod, '203.0.113.7', [], []));
  assert.equal(checkIpBan(admin, '203.0.113.7', [], []), null);
});
t('lockout safeguards: own IP and staff IPs are refused', () => {
  assert.match(checkIpBan(admin, '198.51.100.1', ['198.51.100.1'], [])!, /own IP/);
  assert.match(checkIpBan(admin, '198.51.100.2', [], ['198.51.100.2'])!, /staff/);
});
t('invalid IPs are rejected', () => {
  assert.ok(checkIpBan(admin, '999.1.1.1', [], []));
  assert.ok(checkIpBan(admin, 'drop table', [], []));
  assert.equal(isValidIp('2001:db8::1'), true);
});
t('ban expiry: timed bans end, permanent bans do not', () => {
  const now = Date.parse('2026-10-26T12:00:00Z');
  assert.equal(isBanActive(null, now), true);
  assert.equal(isBanActive('2026-10-26T13:00:00Z', now), true);
  assert.equal(isBanActive('2026-10-26T11:00:00Z', now), false);
});
t('unbanned (deleted) / expired bans no longer match', () => {
  const now = Date.parse('2026-10-26T12:00:00Z');
  const bans = [{ ip: '203.0.113.7', expiresAt: '2026-10-26T11:59:00Z' }];
  assert.equal(bans.some(b => b.ip === '203.0.113.7' && isBanActive(b.expiresAt, now)), false);
});
t('IPs are masked for people without full access', () => {
  assert.equal(maskIp('203.0.113.7'), '203.0.*.*');
  assert.equal(maskIp('2001:db8:85a3::1'), '2001:db8:****');
  assert.equal(maskIp(''), '');
});

console.log(`\n${passed} tests passed`);


===== FILE: tests/proxyCore.test.ts =====

// Run: npx tsx tests/proxyCore.test.ts
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { fetchViaProxy, validateTarget, isPrivateHost, buildUpstream } from '../src/lib/proxyCore';

type R = { status: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; body?: string };
const fake = (responses: R[] | ((url: string) => R)) => {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  const fn = async (url: string) => {
    calls.push(url);
    const r = typeof responses === 'function' ? responses(url) : responses[i++];
    const h = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r.headers ?? { 'content-type': 'text/html' }).map(([k, v]) => [k.toLowerCase(), v]));
    return { status: r.status, headers: { get: (n: string) => h[n.toLowerCase()] ?? null }, text: async () => r.body ?? '' };
  };
  return { fn, calls };
};
const on = { enabled: true };

(async () => {
  // Successful load: HTML returned, <base> + nav script injected
  {
    const f = fake([{ status: 200, body: '<html><head><title>Hi</title></head><body><img src="/a.png"></body></html>' }]);
    const r = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com/page', on, f.fn);
    assert.ok(r.ok);
    if (r.ok) {
      assert.match(r.html, /<base href="https:\/\/example.com\/page">/);
      assert.match(r.html, /nexus-nav/);
      assert.equal(r.finalUrl, 'https://example.com/page');
    }
  }
  // Redirects are followed and re-validated
  {
    const f = fake([{ status: 301, headers: { location: 'https://www.example.com/' } }, { status: 200, body: '<p>ok</p>' }]);
    const r = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com', on, f.fn);
    assert.ok(r.ok && r.finalUrl === 'https://www.example.com/');
  }
  {
    const f = fake([{ status: 302, headers: { location: 'http://169.254.169.254/latest' } }]);
    const r = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com', on, f.fn);
    assert.ok(!r.ok && r.code === 'BLOCKED_ADDRESS', 'redirect to metadata IP must be blocked');
  }
  // Proxy failure: network error, 503, timeout
  {
    const r = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com', on, async () => { throw new Error('ECONNREFUSED'); });
    assert.ok(!r.ok && r.code === 'PROXY_UNAVAILABLE');
    const f = fake([{ status: 503 }]);
    const r2 = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com', on, f.fn);
    assert.ok(!r2.ok && r2.code === 'PROXY_UNAVAILABLE');
    const slow = (_u: string, init: { signal: AbortSignal }) => new Promise<never>((_, rej) => init.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => rej(new Error('aborted'))));
    const r3 = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com', { enabled: true, timeoutMs: 50 }, slow);
    assert.ok(!r3.ok && r3.code === 'TIMEOUT');
  }
  // Blocked by site / unsupported content
  {
    const r = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com', on, fake([{ status: 403 }]).fn);
    assert.ok(!r.ok && r.code === 'BLOCKED_BY_SITE');
    const r2 = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com/f.pdf', on, fake([{ status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/pdf' } }]).fn);
    assert.ok(!r2.ok && r2.code === 'UNSUPPORTED');
  }
  // Disabled proxy path never fetches
  {
    const f = fake([{ status: 200, body: 'x' }]);
    const r = await fetchViaProxy('https://example.com', { enabled: false }, f.fn);
    assert.ok(!r.ok && r.code === 'DISABLED');
    assert.equal(f.calls.length, 0);
  }
  // Input validation + private network protection
  for (const bad of ['ftp://example.com', 'javascript:alert(1)', 'not a url', 'https://user:pw@example.com']) assert.ok(!validateTarget(bad).ok, bad);
  for (const host of ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '10.1.2.3', '192.168.0.1', '172.20.0.1', '169.254.169.254', '::1', 'fd00::1', '2130706433', 'intranet', 'printer.local'])
    assert.ok(isPrivateHost(host), host);
  for (const host of ['example.com', '8.8.8.8', 'www.google.com']) assert.ok(!isPrivateHost(host), host);
  // Upstream proxy URL + token stay server-side
  {
    const u = buildUpstream({ enabled: true, endpoint: 'https://p.example/fetch?u={url}', token: 'secret' }, 'https://a.com/?q=1');
    assert.equal(u.url, 'https://p.example/fetch?u=https%3A%2F%2Fa.com%2F%3Fq%3D1');
    assert.equal(u.headers.Authorization, 'Bearer secret');
  }
  console.log('proxyCore: all tests passed');
})();


===== FILE: tests/searchCore.test.ts =====

// Run: npx tsx tests/searchCore.test.ts
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { runSearch, buildRequest } from '../src/lib/searchCore';

/** Fake provider that echoes the decoded query into its results, so we can verify each query maps to its own results. */
const echo = (provider: 'brave' | 'wikipedia') => async (url: string) => {
  const u = new URL(url);
  const q = u.searchParams.get(provider === 'brave' ? 'q' : 'srsearch')!;
  const body = provider === 'brave'
    ? { type: 'search', web: { results: [{ title: `${q} — guide`, url: `https://example.com/${encodeURIComponent(q)}`, description: `All about <b>${q}</b>` }] } }
    : { query: { search: [{ title: `${q} overview`, snippet: `Article on <span>${q}</span>` }] } };
  return { status: 200, json: async () => body };
};

(async () => {
  for (const provider of ['wikipedia', 'brave'] as const) {
    const key = provider === 'brave' ? 'k' : undefined;
    for (const q of ['Minecraft', 'weather in Tokyo', 'how plants grow', 'C++ & Rust: "fast"?']) {
      const r = await runSearch(q, { braveKey: key }, echo(provider));
      assert.ok(r.ok, `${provider} ${q}`);
      if (r.ok) {
        assert.equal(r.provider, provider);
        assert.equal(r.query, q);
        assert.ok(r.results[0].title.includes(q), `title matches query: ${q}`);
        assert.ok(r.results[0].snippet.includes(q) && !r.results[0].snippet.includes('<'), 'snippet cleaned');
        assert.ok(r.results[0].url.startsWith('https://'));
      }
    }
  }
  // Spaces and special chars are encoded, never truncated
  assert.match(buildRequest('weather in Tokyo').url, /srsearch=weather%20in%20Tokyo$/);
  assert.match(buildRequest('a&b=c', 'k').url, /q=a%26b%3Dc&/);
  // Brave key goes in a header only
  assert.equal(buildRequest('x', 'secret').headers['X-Subscription-Token'], 'secret');
  assert.ok(!buildRequest('x', 'secret').url.includes('secret'));

  // Empty query never calls the provider
  let called = false;
  const e = await runSearch('   ', {}, async () => { called = true; return { status: 200, json: async () => ({}) }; });
  assert.ok(!e.ok && e.code === 'EMPTY_QUERY' && !called);
  // Network error, timeout, blocked, down, malformed
  const net = await runSearch('x', {}, async () => { throw new Error('offline'); });
  assert.ok(!net.ok && net.code === 'PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE');
  const slow = (_u: string, i: { signal: AbortSignal }) => new Promise<never>((_, rej) => i.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => rej(new Error('abort'))));
  const t = await runSearch('x', { timeoutMs: 30 }, slow);
  assert.ok(!t.ok && t.code === 'TIMEOUT');
  const b = await runSearch('x', { braveKey: 'k' }, async () => ({ status: 429, json: async () => ({}) }));
  assert.ok(!b.ok && b.code === 'PROVIDER_BLOCKED');
  const d = await runSearch('x', {}, async () => ({ status: 503, json: async () => ({}) }));
  assert.ok(!d.ok && d.code === 'PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE');
  const m = await runSearch('x', {}, async () => ({ status: 200, json: async () => ({ nope: 1 }) }));
  assert.ok(!m.ok && m.code === 'BAD_RESPONSE');
  console.log('searchCore: all tests passed');
})();
